english.completed: Return to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 迟到的报告
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛的双足飞龙管理员多拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: Garrosh is brash and speaks harshly, but his intentions are good. In time, he will grow to see your people as a valuable ally.$B$BI am awaiting reports about recent Alliance activity in Durotar, but they haven't arrived yet. Would you be willing to visit Razor Hill and ask him for the reports in person? The easiest way to get there is by wind rider. Doras, Orgrimmar's wind rider master will let you use one of his wind riders for a small fee. Look for him on the rise north of the Valley of Strength.
text.completion: So you need to get to Razor Hill in a hurry? That's no problem at all. One of my wind riders will get you there very quickly and it only costs a few coins to hire one.

english.title: Missing Reports
english.objectives: Talk to Orgrimmar's wind rider master, Doras.
english.description: Garrosh is brash and speaks harshly, but his intentions are good. In time, he will grow to see your people as a valuable ally.$B$BI am awaiting reports about recent Alliance activity in Durotar, but they haven't arrived yet. Would you be willing to visit Razor Hill and ask him for the reports in person? The easiest way to get there is by wind rider. Doras, Orgrimmar's wind rider master will let you use one of his wind riders for a small fee. Look for him on the rise north of the Valley of Strength.
english.completion: So you need to get to Razor Hill in a hurry? That's no problem at all. One of my wind riders will get you there very quickly and it only costs a few coins to hire one.

text.title: 飞往剃刀岭
text.objectives: 与多拉斯交谈，租用一只双足飞龙前往剃刀岭。抵达之后，去找加索克。
text.description: 等你准备好乘坐双足飞龙前往剃刀岭了，就跟我说一声。到了那里之后，直接去找加索克。他负责撰写最近联盟在杜隆塔尔的活动情况报告。
text.completion: Eitrigg sent you? The warchief must be getting anxious to read my reports. I'd've sent them long ago, but each day we discover more about the Alliance's plans for invading Durotar.

english.title: Flight to Razor Hill
english.objectives: Speak to Doras to purchase a wind rider ride to Razor Hill. Once you arrive, speak with Gar'Thok.
english.description: When you're ready to take the wind rider down to Razor Hill, simply speak with me again. When you get there, waste no time in finding Gar'Thok. He's the one responsible for preparing reports on recent Alliance activity in Durotar.
english.completion: Eitrigg sent you? The warchief must be getting anxious to read my reports. I'd've sent them long ago, but each day we discover more about the Alliance's plans for invading Durotar.

text.title: 去海角！
text.objectives: 跟罗伯特·洛德斯谈一谈，飞往荆棘谷海角的探险者协会挖掘场。
text.description: 探险者协会正在壮大，$N。他们不仅吸纳了像我这样的狼人成员，也在扩大搜索范围寻找神器。我们中最出色的一位，布朗温·斧击，在南边建立了一个营地，据称那里藏着一件泰坦时代的文物。$B$B布朗温把我指派到这里来，其中一个任务就是甄别有潜力的新人。你看来资质还不错，去跟飞行管理员罗伯特·洛德斯谈谈，他会把你送过去的。路费算布朗温的。
text.completion: Wulfred has a good eye.  I think you'll do just fine here at my camp.
text.completed: 跟罗伯特·洛德斯谈一谈，飞往荆棘谷海角的探险者协会挖掘场。

english.title: To the Cape!
english.objectives: Speak with Robert Rhodes to obtain a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: The Explorers' League is growing, $N.  Not only have they taken in worgen like me, but they have expanded their range in search of artifacts.  One of our best, Bronwyn Hewstrike, has set up a camp in the south, where he believes an item of titan origin may be hidden.$b$bBronwyn asked me to perform some duties here in the north, one of which was to identify potential recruits.  You seem to be made of the right stuff.  Talk to Robert Rhodes, the flight master, and he'll send you down there.  Bronwyn's treat.
english.completion: Wulfred has a good eye.  I think you'll do just fine here at my camp.
english.completed: Speak with Robert Rhodes to obtain a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 送往奥格瑞玛的报告
text.objectives: 将加索克的报告交给剃刀岭的波洛克。
text.description: 伊崔格看到我已经完成的这部分报告之后，一定会很高兴的。告诉他，我还会陆续发给他更多报告。$B$B<加索克把一摞粗略叠起来的文件递给你。>$B$B部署在北方岗哨的联盟部队正在持续获得增援，详细情况都已经写在这些报告里了。请代我向伊崔格道歉，告诉他，我们一直在忙着保持剃刀岭的安全和补给，实在抽不出身。等你准备返回奥格瑞玛的时候，就去找波洛克租一只双足飞龙。
text.progress: Are you ready to return to Orgrimmar?
text.completion: Ready to return to Orgrimmar with those reports? I can arrange a flight for you right away.

english.title: Reports to Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Take Gar'Thok's Reports to Burok at Razor Hill.
english.description: Eitrigg will have to be happy with the part of the report that I've finished. Tell him to expect more in the future.$B$B<Gar'Thok hands you a stack of roughly folded papers.>$B$BThis should cover the most important details of the increase in Alliance forces working out of Northwatch. Please apologize to Eitrigg for me and let him know that we've had our hands full here, trying to keep Razor Hill secure and supplied. When you're ready to return to Orgrimmar, simply speak to Burok and hire a wind rider.
english.progress: Are you ready to return to Orgrimmar?
english.completion: Ready to return to Orgrimmar with those reports? I can arrange a flight for you right away.

text.title: 向伊崔格复命
text.objectives: 与波洛克交谈，租用双足飞龙回到奥格瑞玛。抵达奥格瑞玛之后，将加索克的报告交给力量谷中的伊崔格。
text.description: 既然你已经跟多拉斯聊过了，就可以在这里租一只双足飞龙，直接飞回奥格瑞玛。每当你抵达新的城镇，都别忘了找当地的飞行管理员聊聊。那样的话你就可以借助飞行管理员的服务，方便快捷地旅行啦。$B$B等你准备飞回奥格瑞玛的时候，就跟我说一声。抵达之后，把这些报告交给力量谷的伊崔格。
text.progress: Did you bring those reports?
text.completion: The Alliance has grown bolder than we'd thought! I'll talk to the warchief about sending reinforcements right away. Thank you for getting these reports to me so quickly. I hope this coin is enough to cover your travel expenses.

english.title: Return to Eitrigg
english.objectives: Speak with Burok and purchase a flight back to Orgrimmar. Once in Orgrimmar, bring Gar'Thok's Reports to Eitrigg in the Valley of Strength.
english.description: Since you've already spoken to Doras, you'll be able to hire a wind rider to take you right back to Orgrimmar. Each time you arrive in a new town, be sure to speak with the town's flight master. After that, you'll be able to use the flight master's services to travel quickly.$B$BSpeak to me again when you're ready to purchase a return flight to Orgrimmar. Bring those reports to Eitrigg in the Valley of Strength once you've landed.
english.progress: Did you bring those reports?
english.completion: The Alliance has grown bolder than we'd thought! I'll talk to the warchief about sending reinforcements right away. Thank you for getting these reports to me so quickly. I hope this coin is enough to cover your travel expenses.

text.title: 梅维克
text.objectives: 把琳兹的礼物给探险者协会挖掘场的祖达萨的梅维克带去。
text.description: <琳兹貌似心头烦恼。>$B$B你知道，有只巨魔藏在那堆盒子后面。她不出来，跟谁都不说话，一定是非常伤心。$B$B<琳兹在方巾里搁了一些海蛇草扎起来。>$B$B给，把这个给她拿去。它们可软了，也许能让她觉得好受些。
text.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
text.completion: You have my thanks.  You may tell your young dwarven friend that I am not sad.  I am waiting.  For you. I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

english.title: Maywiki
english.objectives: Bring Linzi's Gift to Maywiki of Zuldazar at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: <Linzi looks troubled.>$b$bYou know, there's a troll hiding behind that pile of boxes.  She must be awfully sad, if she doesn't want to come out and talk to anyone.$b$b<Linzi places some of the Akiris reeds in a kerchief and ties it together.>$b$bHere, give these to her.  They're very soft, and that maybe they will make her feel a little more comfortable back there.
english.progress: Care to explain yourself, $c?
english.completion: You have my thanks.  You may tell your young dwarven friend that I am not sad.  I am waiting.  For you. I have identified you as the most promising $r here in this strange town.  I have a task for you, if you would be willing to take it.

text.title: 幕后交易
text.objectives: 将古拉巴什熏香放在希里克图腾前，然后听取赞吉尔的阴谋。
text.description: 我的目标，是被古拉巴什部落放逐的流亡者赞吉尔。最近，我听兄弟们说他打算重返部族，并打算往劈颅派遣使者。这可不是好消息。$B$B我要你去刺探赞吉尔眼下的计划。带上这焚香，把它放在北边朱布瓦尔废墟的蝙蝠图腾前。希里克会指引你去那里。
text.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
text.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.objective1: Place incense in front of Totem of Hir'eek

english.title: Backdoor Dealings
english.objectives: Place the Gurubashi Incense in front of the Totem of Hir'eek, then listen to Zanzil's plot.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast, an exile from the Gurubashi tribe, is my quarry.  Recently, I have heard tales from my brothers in the north about his planned reentry into society, starting with the emissary he sent to the Skullsplitters.  This is not good news.$b$bI want you to peer into Zanzil's current plans.  Take this incense, and place it in front of the bat totem in the Ruins of Jubuwal, to the north.  Hir'eek will guide you from there.
english.completion: It is as I suspected.  Zanzil is too haughty to interfere with the squabbles between the Bloodscalps and the Skullsplitters.  No, he is playing a part in a grander scheme... Jin'do the Hexxer is using him to help bring Hakkar back to Zul'Gurub. It's good that we found this out now, because it offers us a simple solution.
english.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.objective1: Place incense in front of Totem of Hir'eek

text.title: 消灭流亡者
text.objectives: 前往荆棘谷海角阿博拉兹废墟对付流亡者赞吉尔。
text.description: 你得去杀掉赞吉尔。希里克的翅膀带你飞翔，希里克的双眼为你所及。去把他杀掉。$B$B哦，对了$R：要是我们走散了，你可以使用这尊神像。它只在荆棘谷有效，不过却可以迅速把你传送到我这里来。$B$B祝你好运，$R。赞吉尔可不是一般的对手。
text.giverWindow: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

english.title: Eliminate the Outcast
english.objectives: Travel to the Ruins of Aboraz in the Cape of Stranglethorn and deal with Zanzil the Outcast.
english.description: You are to kill Zanzil.  You rode on Hir'eek's wings and saw through Hir'eek's eyes; you know where Zanzil hides within the Ruins of Aboraz.  Travel there and kill him.$b$bOh, and $r: if we become separated, you should use this fetish.  It only works within Stranglethorn, but it will transport you back here to me should you need to return switfly.$b$bGood luck, $r.  Zanzil is no ordinary opponent.
english.giverWindow: His potion-mixing days are at an end.

text.title: 穿过巨魔洞
text.objectives: Use Zanzil's Portal and enter Zul'Gurub.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
text.description: 看来赞吉尔前往祖尔格拉布的传送门还开着。祖尔格拉布是个危险的地方，但梅维克觉得你能胜任。$B$B传送门就在前面正等着你呢。

english.title: Through the Troll Hole
english.objectives: Use Zanzil's Portal and enter Zul'Gurub.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: It looks like Zanzil's portal into Zul'Gurub is still open.  Zul'Gurub is a dangerous place, but Maywiki entrusted this task to you.$b$bThe portal lies in wait in front of you.

text.title: 高阶祭司耶克里克
text.objectives: 在赞吉尔复活他之前消灭高阶祭司耶克里克。$B$B假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 你的前方涌现出一条坡道，通向城市众多平台之一。前面蝙蝠形状的图腾表明这是的追随者，高阶祭司耶克里克的领域。$B$B耶克里克是众多崇拜哈卡的祭司之一，赞吉尔正打算复活他。假如你动作快，或许可以阻止他的复活！
text.giverWindow: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

english.title: High Priestess Jeklik
english.objectives: Destroy High Priestess Jeklik's body before Zanzil can resurrect her.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Ahead of you looms a ramp up to one of the city's many terraces.  The bat-shaped totems ahead of you indicate that this is the domain of High Priestess Jeklik, a follower of Hir'eek.$b$bJeklik was one of the Hakkar-worshipping priests that Zanzil was planning to resurrect.  Perhaps if you hurry, you can stop the resurrection!
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hir'eek, the bat loa.

text.title: 身陷祖尔格拉布
text.objectives: 穿过赞吉尔的传送门。$B$B假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 流亡者赞吉尔再次从另一道传送门逃了。追上他！

english.title: Plunging Into Zul'Gurub
english.objectives: Pass through Zanzil's Portal.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Zanzil the Outcast has once again escaped through one of his portals.  Follow him!

text.title: 高阶祭司温诺希斯
text.objectives: 对付流亡者赞吉尔和高阶祭司温诺希斯。$B$B假如你迷路了或者需要回到祖尔格拉布，去跟探险者协会挖掘场的梅维克交谈。
text.description: 温诺希斯是赞吉尔打算复生的两名祭司之一。你已经成功地摧毁了高阶祭司耶克里克的肉身……温诺希斯将是下一个。
text.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
text.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

english.title: High Priest Venoxis
english.objectives: Deal with Zanzil the Outcast and High Priest Venoxis.$b$bIf you become lost or need to return to Zul'Gurub, speak with Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Venoxis was the second of the two priests that Zanzil planned to bring back from the dead.  You have already succeeded in destroying the body of High Priestess Jeklik... Venoxis must be the next.
english.completion: I ask you to slay Zanzil the Outcast, a lowly, hermetic exile of the Gurubashi, and what do you do?  You dash headfirst into the Gurubashi capital and eliminate one of their High Priests!  Very nearly two!  Only one word suffices to explain such a rash and foolhardy endeavor: Heroism. Jin'do the Hexxer still walks within Zul'Gurub's walls, but he lost one of his legs when you crushed Jeklik.  Today's battle is ours.
english.completed: Return to Maywiki at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Follower of Hethiss, the snake loa.

text.title: 赞吉尔的秘密
text.objectives: 获取5瓶赞吉尔的药剂。
text.description: 多年前，古拉巴什将一名自己人逐出了祖尔格拉布：那个巨魔名叫赞吉尔。原因为何不是很清楚，但我想多半是因为他倾向对所有人都投与一种强大的行为控制药剂有关。不管怎么说，古拉巴什的祭司们和他们的血神已经被消灭了，但流亡者赞吉尔却幸存了下来……$B$B……还有他那强大的行为控制药剂。$B$B我接下来的实验需要他的药剂。去北边的僵尸身上找找看。
text.progress: Excellent... you're not a zombie yet.  That's good.$b$bOh, umm... nothing.  It's just that... that was a potential risk.  Did I forget to warn you?
text.completion: This mixture is... PERFECT!  Let's see what it does to your potentially-titan artifact here!
text.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Zanzil's Secret
english.objectives: Obtain 5 vials of Zanzil's Mixture.
english.description: Years ago, the Gurubashi exiled one of their own from Zul'Gurub: a troll by the name of Zanzil.  The reasons why aren't all that clear, but I'd guess it had something to do with his tendency to administer powerful, behavior-altering drugs to anyone he saw.  Anyhow, the Gurubashi priests and their blood god have been slain, but Zanzil the Outcast remains...$b$b...as do his powerful, behavior-altering drugs.$b$bI need his mixture for my next test.  Check the zombies to the north.
english.progress: Excellent... you're not a zombie yet.  That's good.$b$bOh, umm... nothing.  It's just that... that was a potential risk.  Did I forget to warn you?
english.completion: This mixture is... PERFECT!  Let's see what it does to your potentially-titan artifact here!
english.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 灾难的配方
text.objectives: 从阿博拉兹废墟赞吉尔的追随者手里获得赞吉尔的配方。
text.description: 你看见我制造的爆炸了吗？我肯定离地飞起来有10英寸高！$B$B我一定得弄到赞吉尔的配方，才能知道这是为什么。阿博拉兹废墟里赞吉尔的马屁精里肯定有人拿着它。去东边海角岸边，帮我抢过来！
text.progress: Did he use shimmerweed?  I'm guessing he used shimmerweed.$b$bNo wait... amberseeds!  It's gotta be amberseeds.
text.completion: This is fascinating!  Just think of all the applications! Thanks again, $n.  Remember, if you ever need anything mixed for you... and I mean ANYTHING... you can always ask The Flask.
text.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Recipe for Disaster
english.objectives: Obtain Zanzil's Formulation from one of Zanzil's followers in the Ruins of Aboraz.
english.description: Did you see that explosion I made?  I must have flown 10 inches off the ground!$b$bI've just got to get Zanzil's recipe so I can find out why it did that.  One of Zanzil's flunkies at the Ruins of Aboraz must have it on him.  Head east, to the coast of the Cape, and snatch it for me!
english.progress: Did he use shimmerweed?  I'm guessing he used shimmerweed.$b$bNo wait... amberseeds!  It's gotta be amberseeds.
english.completion: This is fascinating!  Just think of all the applications! Thanks again, $n.  Remember, if you ever need anything mixed for you... and I mean ANYTHING... you can always ask The Flask.
english.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 纯天然
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷海角纳克迈尼圣泉里打上澄澈圣水。
text.description: 这体液没法直接用。太黏稠。简直太黏稠了。$B$B西边的纳迦掌着一座祭坛，那里面产暮色森林这儿唯一的净水。大多数药水我就用河水凑合了，但布朗温要的就是精确！$B$B去纳迦营地顶上的纳克迈尼圣泉打点过来。祝你好运！
text.progress: <Dask looks eagerly at your pack as you approach.>
text.completion: Do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Alright, let's get this mix started!
text.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Perfectly Pure
english.objectives: Obtain The Holy Water of Clarity from the Nek'mani Wellspring in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: This humour won't serve on its own.  Too thick.  WAY too thick.$b$bThe nagas to our west maintain a shrine that dispenses the only clean water this side of Duskwood.  For most potions, I'll use river water, but Bronwyn demands accuracy!$b$bObtain it from the Nek'mani Wellspring at the peak of the naga camp.  Good luck!
english.progress: <Dask looks eagerly at your pack as you approach.>
english.completion: Do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Alright, let's get this mix started!
english.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 绒皮
text.objectives: 剥来4张柔软的虎皮和4张光滑的猎豹皮。
text.description: 嗨，我是镇里的小贩！布朗温是我爹！$B$B不好意思，我不能太兴奋，老爸说这样不专业。$B$B总之，人们都管我这儿买东西，重皮啦、生皮啦，但我觉得也该进点细软货……比如虎皮！你能给我弄些来么？$B$B附近就有些虎豹，不过你要是想找大虫，就得打这儿往西北边……巨魔的大竞技场还要朝北。
text.progress: Oooh... I hope they're soft!
text.completion: These are so nice and cushy!  I think my customers are going to LOVE them!
text.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Plush Pelts
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Supple Tiger Furs and 4 Velvety Panther Furs.
english.description: Hi, I'm the town merchant!  And Bronwyn's my dad!$b$bSorry, I shouldn't get too excited.  Father says it's not professional.$b$bAnyhow, people always come to me asking for heavy leather, or rough hides, but I think they might also like it if I had some soft materials... like tiger fur!  Think you could get some for me?$b$bYou'll find a few panthers nearby, but if you want to see the big tigers, you'll have to go northwest from here... north of that big troll arena.
english.progress: Oooh... I hope they're soft!
english.completion: These are so nice and cushy!  I think my customers are going to LOVE them!
english.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 一捆海蛇草
text.objectives: 从纳迦探险者身上获得6捆海蛇草。
text.description: 西边的纳迦探险者带着一种值钱的海草——海蛇草。商人们用它来制药，工匠们用它来给盔甲衬里，甚至是卷雪茄！$B$B晚上挖掘结束后，父亲就会教我怎么来用它们……可不幸的是，我们断货了。你介不介意帮我们搞点来？
text.progress: Welcome back!
text.completion: Hooray!  It's been days and days since we last had Akiris reeds!
text.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Camp in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Akiris by the Bundle
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Akiris Reeds from Naga Explorers.
english.description: The naga explorers to our west carry a valuable ocean reed - Akiris reeds.  Traders use them to make medicines and poultices, and craftsmen use them to line armor or even wrap cigars!$b$bIn the evenings, when digging's done, father's been teaching me how to use them... but unfortunately, we ran out.  Would you mind getting us some more?
english.progress: Welcome back!
english.completion: Hooray!  It's been days and days since we last had Akiris reeds!
english.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Camp in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 要是他们就把它们那么搁着的话……
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷海角南野人海岸获得6尊纳迦雕像。
text.description: 父亲说称职的商人总是会留意好买卖。我去哪儿都会多加注意，我想我算是发现一桩了！$B$B西边的纳迦会在栖息地树立很多雕像。他们不可能需要那么多的……所以我琢磨着咱们是不是能给自己拿几座过来！$B$B不要钱的雕像啊！是桩好买卖，对不对？
text.progress: Let's see 'em!
text.completion: These statues are beautiful... Wow, I had no idea the naga were so talented.  Thanks, $n!
text.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: If They're Just Going to Leave Them Lying Around...
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Naga Icons from the Southern Savage Coast in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Father says that a responsible merchant is always keeping an eye out for good deals.  I've been trying to look for deals everywhere I go, and I think I've just found one!$b$bThe naga to the west have dozens of statues that they place on the ground where they live.  They couldn't possibly need all of them... so I was thinking that we'd take some for ourselves!$b$bFree statues!  That's a good deal, right?
english.progress: Let's see 'em!
english.completion: These statues are beautiful... Wow, I had no idea the naga were so talented.  Thanks, $n!
english.completed: Return to Linzi Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 艾尔温·短麻
text.objectives: 把打开的莫什奥格的馈赠带给荆棘谷海角藏宝海湾的艾尔温·短麻。
text.description: 嗯，我们不知道这神器是什么。它很古老，历经沧桑……但不是泰坦时代的。我是搞不定了。$B$B藏宝海湾的艾尔温·短麻是我的顶头上司，下一步我们应该通知她这一发现。你能不能把它给带过去？
text.progress: Yes, $r?  I'm quite busy.
text.completion: Fascinating! I'll need some time to study this.  Why don't you have a look around Booty Bay and come back later?

english.title: Airwyn Bantamflax
english.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'ogg Bounty to Airwyn Bantamflax at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Well, we have no idea what this artifact is.  It's old, older than dirt... but not titan.  I'm completely dumbstruck.$b$bAirwyn Bantamflax in Booty Bay is my direct superior.  Our next step should be to inform her of this find.  Please, would you bring it to her?
english.progress: Yes, $r?  I'm quite busy.
english.completion: Fascinating! I'll need some time to study this.  Why don't you have a look around Booty Bay and come back later?

text.title: 一无是处是虫蛇
text.objectives: 杀死12条钢尾蜥蜴或铁腭蜥蜴。
text.description: 啊哼！唔，唔……$B$B<矮人清了几秒钟喉咙。>$B$B你在找事情做？于是就寻上我？没人睬的老格里斯？！$B$B好吧，啊……这是头一遭。啊，我晓得咧！$B$B北边的山谷里统统都是讨厌的，肚皮亮闪闪的石化蜥蜴。它们可不是什么好东西，我听说有个人就被变成了石头。$B$B要是你把它们杀掉，我这儿有东西给你。
text.completion: Ahem!  Ahhh... right... Well done!  And, congratulations, on killing them, I mean. Here you go.
text.completed: Return to Goris at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Good-Fer-Nothin' Slither-Dogs
english.objectives: Kill 12 Thrashtail or Ironjaw Basilisks.
english.description: Ahem!  Hrm, hrm...$b$b<The dwarf clears his throat for several seconds.>$b$bYou're lookin' fer somethin' ta do?  And ya come askin' ME?  Lowly ol' Goris?!$b$bWell, ah... this is a first.  Ah, I've got it!$b$bThe vale ta tha north is filled with a bunch o' useless, belly-scrapin' basilisks.  They don't do nothin' for no one, and I hear they turned a guy ta stone once.$b$bIf ya kill 'em, I'll give ya some o' my stuff.
english.completion: Ahem!  Ahhh... right... Well done!  And, congratulations, on killing them, I mean. Here you go.
english.completed: Return to Goris at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 自卖自夸
text.objectives: 从水晶矿洞的铁腭巨兽身上获得一瓶铁腭的体液。
text.description: 不管你想要什么效果，我这儿总有一款配方适合您。你想要爆炸药水？砰！！你想要闪电药水？噼！！你想要缩小药水？嗖。$B$B话说布朗温要的是碳定药水？简单。我闭着眼睛都能做出来。只不过……结果想要准确的话，你就得给我弄些上等的材料来。$B$B先从北边石化蜥蜴的体液着手吧。还得是条非常大的石化蜥蜴……
text.progress: You got the task?  I got the flask.
text.completion: Alright!  Step one - getting ingredients - is all done.  Time for the next step: getting more ingredients.
text.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Too Big For His Britches
english.objectives: Obtain a vial of Ironjaw Humour from the Ironjaw Behemoth in the Crystalvein Mine.
english.description: Whatever it is you want to do: I've got a recipe that'll do exactly that.  You want an exploding potion?  BOOM!!  You want a lightning potion?  ZAP!!  You want a shrinking potion?  Smeerp.$b$bSo Bronwyn says he wants a carbon-dating potion?  Easy.  I could make that in my sleep.  The thing is... if we want it to be accurate, I need you to get some quality ingredients.$b$bStart with some humour from a basilisk to the north.  It'll need to be a pretty big basilisk...
english.progress: You got the task?  I got the flask.
english.completion: Alright!  Step one - getting ingredients - is all done.  Time for the next step: getting more ingredients.
english.completed: Return to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 结果：不可辨识
text.objectives: 把打开的莫什奥格的馈赠还给荆棘谷海角探险者协会营地的布朗温。
text.description: 我尽力而为了，$N。药水是对的……配方也是对的……可这份样本的来头不对。它有数万年的历史，可却不是泰坦的造物。那么……以布莱恩之名，它到底是啥东西？$B$B告诉布朗温我尽力了。抱歉。
text.progress: I saw smoke.  Everything alright?
text.completion: I knew that alchemist was all talk.  Well, thanks for your help, $n.  I know you tried.
text.completed: Return the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Bronwyn at the Explorers' League Camp in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Results: Inconclusive
english.objectives: Return the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Bronwyn at the Explorers' League Camp in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: I did all I could, $N.  I had the right potions... I had the right recipes... but the source of this sample eludes me.  It's tens of thousands of years old, but we've shown that it's not of titan origin.  And it's not saronite, I can tell you just by looking at it.  So... what in Brann's name is it?$b$bTell Bronwyn that I tried my best.  Sorry.
english.progress: I saw smoke.  Everything alright?
english.completion: I knew that alchemist was all talk.  Well, thanks for your help, $n.  I know you tried.
english.completed: Return the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Bronwyn at the Explorers' League Camp in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 达斯克·“空瓶”·哥布菲兹
text.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.description: Hey - you must be that $g fella': lass; that Wulfred was talkin' about!  The one who found the ogre artifact, and helped him test out those strange stones from up north.  Welcome to the digsite, $N!$b$bWe were actually working on identifying those samples right as you got here.  Would you mind bringing the sample over to Dask?  I need him to help me find out how old it is.
text.progress: You got something that needs mixing?
text.completion: So once again, it falls upon tiny Dask to get the Explorers' League work done!  Alright... let's see what you've got in there.
text.completed: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle
english.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Hey - you must be that $g fella': lass; that Wulfred was talkin' about!  The one who found the ogre artifact, and helped him test out those strange stones from up north.  Welcome to the digsite, $N!$b$bWe were actually working on identifying those samples right as you got here.  Would you mind bringing the sample over to Dask?  I need him to help me find out how old it is.
english.progress: You got something that needs mixing?
english.completion: So once again, it falls upon tiny Dask to get the Explorers' League work done!  Alright... let's see what you've got in there.
english.completed: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 达斯克·“空瓶”·哥布菲兹
text.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.description: Hey - you must be that $g fella': lass; that Wulfred was talkin' about!  Welcome to the digsite, $N.$b$bWe were actually just starting a project when you arrived.  Would you mind bringing this sample over to Dask?  I need him to help me find out how old it is.
text.progress: You got something that needs mixing?
text.completion: So once again, it falls upon tiny Dask to get the Explorers' League work done!  Alright... let's see what you've got in there.
text.completed: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle
english.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Hey - you must be that $g fella': lass; that Wulfred was talkin' about!  Welcome to the digsite, $N.$b$bWe were actually just starting a project when you arrived.  Would you mind bringing this sample over to Dask?  I need him to help me find out how old it is.
english.progress: You got something that needs mixing?
english.completion: So once again, it falls upon tiny Dask to get the Explorers' League work done!  Alright... let's see what you've got in there.
english.completed: Bring the Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty to Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 召集大地之环
text.objectives: 从大地神殿后面的房间中集结5名萨满，然后跟玛鲁特·缚石谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须集结大地之环的成员来参加战斗。我们人数不多，就用本领来补足。$B$B去神殿后面的房间里的把那些正在休息的萨满都叫来。诺莎拉、洛瓦留斯，还有我会在洛苏娜之门同他们碰头。
text.completion: You've done what I thought not possible. Quite impressive, $c.
text.completed: Speak to Maruut Stonebinder.

english.title: Rallying the Earthen Ring
english.objectives: Rally 5 shaman in the rear of the Temple of Earth, and then speak to Maruut Stonebinder.
english.description: We must be rallyin' da Earthen Ring for dis fight. What we be lackin' in numbers, we make up for in strength.$B$BGo to tha temple and gather da restin' shaman from tha rear rooms. Norsala, Lorvarius, and I will be meetin' them at Lorthuna's Gate.
english.completion: You've done what I thought not possible. Quite impressive, $c.
english.completed: Speak to Maruut Stonebinder.

text.title: 我们那份协议
text.objectives: 跟哈尔西恩法阵的塞拉赞恩谈一谈。
text.description: 很遗憾，我必须留下来，看住裂隙，因此你只能抛下我上阵了。马上如约去和塞拉赞恩参加战斗。你可以在哈尔西恩法阵找到她，那地方在洛苏娜之门的北边，蚀沙荒漠的东边。$B$B等履行完我们的协议，就赶紧把最后一片世界之柱带回来。
text.completion: And so you arrive, fleshling.  As promised.

english.title: Our Part of the Bargain
english.objectives: Speak to Therazane on the Halcyon Egress.
english.description: Sadly, I must stay and hold the rift, so you will have to battle without me. Go now to Therazane and join the battle, as promised. You should find her at the Halcyon Egress, north of Lorthuna's Gate and east of the Scoured Reach.$B$BWhen our part of the bargain is fulfilled, bring the last piece of the World Pillar here as quickly as possible.
english.completion: And so you arrive, fleshling.  As promised.

text.title: 岩石进军
text.objectives: 消灭15名暮光绝壁邪教徒。
text.description: 我的部队已经展开了进攻。同他们合流。把邪教徒的血洒在大地上，好教我品尝他们的痛苦。
text.completion: Their blood upon the earth is a sweet thing. I shall cherish every moment, slowly extinguishing the stragglers from my realm.
text.completed: Return to Therazane upon the Halcyon Egress.

english.title: The Stone March
english.objectives: Kill 15 Twilight Precipice Cultists.
english.description: My forces have already begun the assault. Join them. Spill the blood of these cultists upon the ground, that I might feel how they suffer.
english.completion: Their blood upon the earth is a sweet thing. I shall cherish every moment, slowly extinguishing the stragglers from my realm.
english.completed: Return to Therazane upon the Halcyon Egress.

text.title: 引蛇出洞
text.objectives: 质问飞艇塔附近的奥格瑞玛空港苦工。寻找任何可疑的苦工。想办法把萨乌拉诺克揪出来杀掉。
text.description: I haven't given up my search for the Twilight's Hammer agents that lurk here in Orgrimmar. I need someone I can trust to collect the final evidence of treachery.$B$B<Hellscream pulls you aside.>$B$BSauranok the Mystic - my own most trusted advisor! - is under suspicion. Uncover the truth, $N, and you'll be rewarded.$B$BI understand Twilight's Hammer has infiltrated workers at the airship docks, to spread their lies all over the continent. Question them. If you discover Sauranok's guilt... Kill him.
text.completion: Sauranok, Sauranok. His own visions worked against him. Twilight's Hammer probably corrupted him from afar. Bah! Weak! We'll speak his name no more. I told him you were investigating the airship docks, $n. To flush him out. Yes, I used you as bait. You served your Horde well, and deserve a reward for outing this viper from our midst.
text.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.
text.giverWindow: Talk to the Skyway Peons and find evidence of Sauranok's treachery. Then kill him.

english.title: Traitor's Bait
english.objectives: Question Orgrimmar Skyway Peons around the Zeppelin Towers. Look for any Suspicious Peons. Try to flush out Sauranok the Mystic and kill him.
english.description: I haven't given up my search for the Twilight's Hammer agents that lurk here in Orgrimmar. I need someone I can trust to collect the final evidence of treachery.$B$B<Hellscream pulls you aside.>$B$BSauranok the Mystic - my own most trusted advisor! - is under suspicion. Uncover the truth, $N, and you'll be rewarded.$B$BI understand Twilight's Hammer has infiltrated workers at the airship docks, to spread their lies all over the continent. Question them. If you discover Sauranok's guilt... Kill him.
english.completion: Sauranok, Sauranok. His own visions worked against him. Twilight's Hammer probably corrupted him from afar. Bah! Weak! We'll speak his name no more. I told him you were investigating the airship docks, $n. To flush him out. Yes, I used you as bait. You served your Horde well, and deserve a reward for outing this viper from our midst.
english.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.
english.giverWindow: Talk to the Skyway Peons and find evidence of Sauranok's treachery. Then kill him.

text.title: 暮光飞行军
text.objectives: 击败佐尔奇克·龙灾。
text.description: 特尔拉斯想让你到悬崖的尽头去干掉佐尔奇克·龙灾。他也在朝那边赶，但他估计佐尔奇克会飞到天上去。$B$B你好像深得人心啊，小东西。你有没有想过，要是当初我们刚见面时，我就一脚把你踩烂，这些事也就都不会发生了。命运可真是奇妙啊。
text.completion: It is good that you were here. I find my size to be inhibiting when it comes to dragon riding, strangely.
text.completed: Speak to Terrath the Steady upon the Twilight Precipice.
text.giverWindow: Leader of the Twilight Drakeriders in Deepholm.

english.title: The Twilight Flight
english.objectives: Defeat Zoltrik Drakebane.
english.description: Terrath wants you to make your way to the far end of the precipice to fight Zoltrik Drakebane. He is on his way there as well, but he thinks Zoltrik is likely to take to the sky.$B$BQuite an impression you seem to have made, little one. Have you ever mused that none of this would have happened if I had just stepped on you during our first meeting? Fate is a strange thing.
english.completion: It is good that you were here. I find my size to be inhibiting when it comes to dragon riding, strangely.
english.completed: Speak to Terrath the Steady upon the Twilight Precipice.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the Twilight Drakeriders in Deepholm.

text.title: 塞拉赞恩的怜悯
text.objectives: 击败碎石者博尔德里克和高阶女祭司洛苏娜。
text.description: 暮光有两个头领必须要杀掉。$B$B一个是叫做博尔德里克的人类。小个头，和你一样。不过依然危险，也和你一样。$B$B另一个是名叫洛苏娜的女祭司。她狡猾多端，很难抓住。迅速出击不要让她逃了，不然我保证，你以后肯定会后悔。
text.completion: You let Lorthuna escape? I warned you of this. Still, their forces are shattered and their resources cut off. There is little they can do to me or my allies.
text.completed: Return to Therazane upon the Halcyon Egress.

english.title: Therazane's Mercy
english.objectives: Defeat Boldrich Stonerender and High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.description: There are two leaders among the Twilight that need to be killed.$B$BOne is a human by the name of Boldrich. Small, as you are. But still dangerous, as you also are.$B$BThe other is a priestess by the name of Lorthuna. She is wily and hard to corner. Strike swiftly and do not let her escape, or I promise you, you will regret it later.
english.completion: You let Lorthuna escape? I warned you of this. Still, their forces are shattered and their resources cut off. There is little they can do to me or my allies.
english.completed: Return to Therazane upon the Halcyon Egress.

text.title: 石中的文字
text.objectives: 跟大地神殿的玛鲁特·缚石谈一谈。
text.description: 你照我说的做了，$R。我说话算话。格尔西克会在神殿里拿着我们的世界之柱碎片等你。$B$B完成你的仪式，合拢裂隙。事成之后，告诉你的大地之环离开这里。$B$B而你……如果愿意的话，你可以在这里待上一会儿。至少这是你应得的。
text.completion: Gorsik has arrived. All of the pieces of the World Pillar are here, thanks to you. What you have done for us is immeasurable.  These final moments shall be the most crucial.  I hesitate to ask more of you, but I'd like you to stay with us and see this through. The Twilight's Hammer was devastated by your attacks, but not destroyed.  It's no stretch to assume they will try to stop us from completing our ritual.

english.title: Word In Stone
english.objectives: Speak to Maruut Stonebinder in the Temple of Earth.
english.description: You have done as I've asked of you, $r. I shall honor my word. Gorsik will meet you at the temple with our piece of the World Pillar.$B$BFinish your ritual and bind the rift. After you have done such, tell your Earthen Ring to leave this place.$B$BYou however... you can stay for a time if you want. You've earned at least that.
english.completion: Gorsik has arrived. All of the pieces of the World Pillar are here, thanks to you. What you have done for us is immeasurable.  These final moments shall be the most crucial.  I hesitate to ask more of you, but I'd like you to stay with us and see this through. The Twilight's Hammer was devastated by your attacks, but not destroyed.  It's no stretch to assume they will try to stop us from completing our ritual.

text.title: 深入裂口
text.objectives: 跟深岩之洲针石熔渣场的斯雷特·流沙谈一谈。
text.description: 在针石裂口下面，秘法师们种植着各种真菌怪物。我派斯雷特·流沙和一支小分队去对付它们了，可他们遇到了麻烦。$B$B你还记得那个高阶地占师吗？能不能飞到东北边去帮帮他们？
text.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Now we'll get somewhere.

english.title: Down Into the Chasm
english.objectives: Speak with Slate Quicksand at Needlerock Chasm in Deepholm.
english.description: Down below in Needlerock Chasm is where the mystics are sprouting all of these fungal monstrosities. I sent Slate Quicksand and a small force to deal with it, but they've run into a snag.$B$BYou remember the Arch Geomancer? Would you fly down there to the northeast and lend him a hand?
english.completion: Good to see you again, $n. Now we'll get somewhere.

text.title: 小麻烦
text.objectives: 去找深岩之洲针石熔渣场的燃钢·磁石。
text.description: 你不在的时候，燃钢·磁石联系过我。他说有一件十万火急的事情急需你的援助。到西南方的针石熔渣场去找他吧。$B$B祝你好运，愿你能救出国王，找回中部碎片。
text.completion: $N, we have good news and a slight problem....

english.title: A Slight Problem
english.objectives: Return to Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.
english.description: While you were out there, Pyrium Lodestone contacted me. He said that there is a matter of great urgency and that your assistance is needed immediately. Return to him at the entrance to Needlerock Slag to the southwest.$B$BI wish you luck with the rescue of the Stonefather and the recovery of the middle fragment.
english.completion: $N, we have good news and a slight problem....

text.title: 营救石父……还有弗林特
text.objectives: 解救石父岩幔。
text.description: 我们刚找到石父的所在，年轻的弗林特殿下就冲出去救他父王了！$B$B不用我说，你都知道这有多糟。王子多半也会被抓，或者更要命！$B$B石头穴居人的酋长——石胆——就在北边的针石裂口上面的悬崖边。$B$B拜托了，$N，你一定要追上弗林特，救出石父，别让他们俩都遇害了！
text.completion: $N! You did it! How will we ever repay you?
text.completed: 去找深岩之洲针石熔渣场的燃钢·磁石。
text.giverWindow: Slay the stone trogg chieftain to rescue the Stonefather... and Flint!

english.title: Rescue the Stonefather... and Flint
english.objectives: Free Stonefather Oremantle.
english.description: We found out where the Stonefather is being held and young Flint ran off on his own to rescue him!$B$BI don't have to tell you that this is bad. Flint is going to get himself captured as well, or worse!$B$BThe stone trogg chieftain, Bouldergut, is at the end of the ledges above Needlerock Chasm to the north.$B$BPlease, $N, you must go after Flint and free the Stonefather before we lose them both!
english.completion: $N! You did it! How will we ever repay you?
english.completed: Return to Pyrium Lodestone at Needlerock Slag in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Slay the stone trogg chieftain to rescue the Stonefather... and Flint!

text.title: 探险者协会挖掘场
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角探险者协会挖掘场的布朗温·斧击。
text.description: 我得说，$N……你看上去挺合适。$B$B探险者协会的布朗温·斧击一直在荆棘谷海角的挖掘场招人。个人而言，我不明白他干吗不去藏宝海湾找人手……给一两块金币海盗们就动心了。$B$B不管怎么说……谣传他总算在森林里有所发现了。我想知道究竟是什么？
text.completed: Report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Explorers' League Digsite
english.objectives: Report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Say, $N... you seem suitable.$b$bBronwyn Hewstrike of the Explorers' League has been asking for recruits at his digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.  Personally, I don't understand why he can't just go down to Booty Bay and find his recruits there... pirates are easily swayed by a couple pieces of gold.$b$bEither way... rumors are he's finally found something in that jungle.  I wonder what it is?
english.completed: Report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 无果的反叛
text.objectives: 去找北荆棘谷反抗军营地的多伦上尉。
text.description: 几年前，暴风城的库尔森上尉带着一个旅进驻荆棘谷执行任务，这支部队的细节到目前还是个谜。库尔森很快就陷入疯狂，他的人也一样……除了少数几名反抗军，他们立志要铲除让库尔森变得异常的祸害。$B$B正如我所说，那是多年之前的事情了。现在我听说库尔森死了，但那些反抗军依然在那里。假如你愿意调查的话，去荆棘谷北部边界就能找到他们的营地。
text.completion: Welcome to our camp, $c.  You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
text.completed: Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Rebels Without a Clue
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Several years ago, Stormwind's Captain Kurzen brought a brigade into Stranglethorn Vale on a mission whose details are still murky.  Kurzen swiftly descended into madness, as did his men... except for a few rebels who made it their mission to undo the evils that Kurzen had wrought.$b$bAs I said, that was years ago.  I'm now hearing rumors that Kurzen is dead, but those rebels still persist at their rebellion.  If you wish to investigate, you'll find them at a camp on Stranglethorn's northern border.
english.completion: Welcome to our camp, $c.  You couldn't have arrived at a better time.
english.completed: Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 统统赚走！
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角硬钳避世乐园的莎希·硬钳。
text.description: 哟，$C，你看来很累啊。还得拎着那么重的钱包……呃，我是说……那么重的装备……肯定不堪你那$R重负吧。$B$B莎希·硬钳最近在荆棘谷海角黄金地段的海岸上建立了一处上好的五星度假村。气球观光，划艇，藏宝海湾一日游……什么都有。$B$B你真的应该去瞧瞧。我一眼就看出来你经历了那么多困难，就该好好休息休息，富有的冒险者。
text.completed: 去找荆棘谷海角硬钳避世乐园的莎希·硬钳。

english.title: Get Away From It All!
english.objectives: Visit Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Say, $c, you look tired.  Carrying around that heavy wallet... er, I mean... heavy equipment... must be a strain on your poor $r back.$b$bSassy Hardwrench has recently established a premier five-star resort on the sparkling coast off the Cape of Stranglethorn.  Balloon tours, rowboating, day trips to Booty Bay... they've got it all.$b$bYou should really go visit.  I can tell just by looking that you need a break after so many difficult, lucrative adventures.
english.completed: Visit Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 重返高地
text.objectives: 用奥格瑞玛的暮光高地传送门回到暮光高地的龙喉哨站，同扎伊拉交谈。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛的安全得以保障，龙喉也成了我们的盟友，现在该把注意力集中在征服暮光高地，以及彻底摧毁死亡之翼的部队上了。$B$B需要部落最棒的人顶在前线上，那就是你，还有你所有的朋友们。$B$B高地必将是我们的！$B$B用你刚新建好的传送门前往龙喉哨站。向扎伊拉报告，看看她哪儿最需要你。
text.completion: $n! I trust Orgrimmar fares well? As you can see, construction of Dragonmaw Port continues at a breakneck pace. If my people questioned the Horde's power before... the sight of this imposing edifice and the speed in which it was constructed leaves no doubt. A new day dawns for the Dragonmaw.
text.completed: 用奥格瑞玛的暮光高地传送门回到暮光高地的龙喉哨站，同扎伊拉交谈。

english.title: Return to the Highlands
english.objectives: Use the Twilight Highlands Portal in Orgrimmar to return to Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands and speak to Zaela.
english.description: With Orgrimmar secure and our Dragonmaw allies behind us, we can turn our attention to the conquest of the Twilight Highlands and the utter destruction of Deathwing's forces there.$B$BI need the Horde's best on the front lines. That means you. And all your friends.$B$BThe Highlands WILL be ours!$B$BUse the new portal you created to return to Dragonmaw Port. Report to Zaela to see where she needs you the most.
english.completion: $n! I trust Orgrimmar fares well? As you can see, construction of Dragonmaw Port continues at a breakneck pace. If my people questioned the Horde's power before... the sight of this imposing edifice and the speed in which it was constructed leaves no doubt. A new day dawns for the Dragonmaw.
english.completed: Use the Twilight Highlands Portal in Orgrimmar to return to Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands and speak to Zaela.

text.title: 禁戒魔符
text.objectives: 与幽影谷中奥达希尔里面的莱恩达交谈。
text.description: 这个魔符是由我们的法师训练师莱恩达派来的信使交给我的。看样子莱恩达希望你能抽空过去与她会面。你读一下魔符上说了些什么吧，读完之后把魔符交给她。
text.progress: I'm glad that you've come, $n.
text.completion: I will be your mentor and guide for now. It is my duty to teach you the arcane arts and how you might best fit in among our people. As you learn and grow in power, you will learn an immense variety of spells that should allow you to deal with nearly any situation. But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.

english.title: Forbidden Sigil
english.objectives: Speak to Rhyanda inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
english.description: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our mage trainer, Rhyanda. It seems Rhyanda would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
english.progress: I'm glad that you've come, $n.
english.completion: I will be your mentor and guide for now. It is my duty to teach you the arcane arts and how you might best fit in among our people. As you learn and grow in power, you will learn an immense variety of spells that should allow you to deal with nearly any situation. But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.

text.title: 凭空出现
text.objectives: 从藓皮斥候或藓皮猛击者身上收集12只豺狼人的耳朵。
text.description: 幸会，$C。我们有个麻烦，得要你帮手。$B$B是豺狼人。镇子西边的山上到处都是。通常这不是什么穷紧张的理由，不过通常在洛克莫丹这儿也没有豺狼人。$B$B我很好奇他们是从哪儿来的，但还没好奇到能跟这些污秽的家伙们打听打听的程度。我说，将他们清理掉。把你击杀的证据带回来，我会提供丰厚的赏金。
text.progress: Got some ears for me, then?
text.completion: Nicely done, $glad:lass;. I could use a $c like you around here.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Out of Gnoll-where
english.objectives: Collect 12 Gnoll Ears from Mosshide Scouts or Mosshide Bashers.
english.description: Well met, $c. We've got a problem, and I'd ask you to lend a hand.$B$BIt's gnolls. There's a mess of the things west of town, roaming the hills. Not usually any cause for alarm, but we've not usually had gnolls here in Loch Modan.$B$BI'm curious where they came from, but not curious enough to bother asking the mangy things. Clear 'em out, I say. Bring back proof of your kills and I'll pay a solid bounty.
english.progress: Got some ears for me, then?
english.completion: Nicely done, $glad:lass;. I could use a $c like you around here.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 小小聪明指挥官
text.objectives: 杀死指挥官纳兹利姆。
text.description: 我们已经在这片土地上对付狗头人多年了。充其量不过是一些讨人嫌。可他们偷东西的手法越来越高明。$B$B我觉得是其中一个突然变得聪明起来的缘故。不过，也持续不了多久！$B$B我要你到南边的营地去，确保狗头人里没有什么“大人物”在搅和。一定要查看一下洞穴，那里十分可疑。$B$B一路上也别客气，把其它的狗头人清理清理掉。
text.completion: So I was right! Now the question is what the little freaks were plotting...
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.
text.giverWindow: Look for the kobold with the longest candle.

english.title: A Tiny, Clever Commander
english.objectives: Slay Commander Nazrim.
english.description: We've dealt with kobolds in these lands for years. Not much other than a nuisance. But they've been getting craftier at their stealing.$B$BI think one of them's ended up smarter than usual. Won't be that way for long, though!$B$BI want you to go to the camp south of here and make sure there's not a "big shot" kobold stirrin' up the other ones. Make sure to check the cave; it's a likely spot.$B$BAnd don't be shy about clearing out the other kobolds along the way.
english.completion: So I was right! Now the question is what the little freaks were plotting...
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.
english.giverWindow: Look for the kobold with the longest candle.

text.title: 更多的狗头人
text.objectives: 消灭5名坑道鼠勘探员和5名坑道鼠征粮官。
text.description: 对付了这些小混账之后，我们还有更多的事情要处理。$B$B银泉矿洞里滋生着坑道鼠，他们建立营地，一天天地四下打探。我琢磨，这些贪婪的小东西们是想找宝贝。$B$B勘探和征粮没什么不好的，只要不是在矮人的地盘上！把这些坑道鼠处理掉，然后再来找我。
text.completion: Good, good. Now we can see what's going on down in that mine.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

english.title: Kobold and Kobolder
english.objectives: Slay 5 Tunnel Rat Surveyors and 5 Tunnel Rat Foragers.
english.description: Now that those little blighters are dealt with, we've got more to take care of.$B$BThe tunnel rats are swarming all over the Silver Stream Mine, setting up camps and sniffing around further and further every day. Greedy little things are looking for loot, I gather.$B$BSurveying and foraging is all fine and dandy when it's not on dwarven land! Take care of those tunnel rats and report back to me.
english.completion: Good, good. Now we can see what's going on down in that mine.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

text.title: 这儿谁做主？
text.objectives: 获得工头山普斯尼尔的徽记。
text.description: 狗头人让穴居人当奴隶就够疯狂了。多尔莉把我派到这个行动里来，如果你还没有跟她谈过这件事，我建议你去谈谈。$B$B我想把它了结掉。完全没错！不管是谁在指导这场戏，他一定就在矿洞的深处发号施令，我要把他们给处理掉。$B$B不管这指挥地卜师和掘地工的狡猾混蛋是谁，找到他，把他的徽记给我带来。
text.progress: I don't suppose it was Moira down there? Miracles do happen.
text.completion: That's a gnoll head. Are you trying to pull some funny business, $N?$B$BIf you're not, I've not the faintest idea what's going on here.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

english.title: Who's In Charge Here?
english.objectives: Collect the head of Foreman Sharpsneer.
english.description: Dorli's filled me in on this crazy trogg-slave operation the kobolds have going, and if you haven't talked to her about it yet, I suggest you do.$B$BI'd like to get to the bottom of this. Literally! Whoever's running this show is bound to be at the bottom of the mine, calling the shots, and I want them dealt with.$B$BFind whatever crafty bugger is directing the geomancers and diggers and bring me back their head.
english.progress: I don't suppose it was Moira down there? Miracles do happen.
english.completion: That's a gnoll head. Are you trying to pull some funny business, $N?$B$BIf you're not, I've not the faintest idea what's going on here.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

text.title: 肮脏的把戏
text.objectives: 杀掉5名坑道鼠地卜师。
text.description: 我已经查明白那些老鼠想干嘛了。这里他们数量不多，是因为他们在让穴居人帮他们挖矿！$B$B坑道鼠地卜师学会了某种把戏，可以控制大地的生物，比如穴居人之类的。$B$B很有意思，不过咱们可不能容许他们那么干。立刻把那些地卜师干掉。
text.completion: I'm sure that only worked because the troggs aren't bright to begin with. But then again, us dwarves were once creatures of the earth as well.$B$BBeing bossed around by a kobold doesn't sound quite dignified, and I'm glad we didn't get to find out if they could pull that off.
text.completed: Return to Scout Dorli at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

english.title: A Nasty Exploit
english.objectives: Slay 5 Tunnel Rat Geomancers.
english.description: I've found out what those rats are up to. There's so many of them outside because they've got troggs digging for them in the mine!$B$BThe tunnel rat geomancers figured out some kind of parlor trick to control the troggs, as creatures of the earth or somesuch.$B$BFascinating, but not something we want to let them practice. Take out those geomancers right away.
english.completion: I'm sure that only worked because the troggs aren't bright to begin with. But then again, us dwarves were once creatures of the earth as well.$B$BBeing bossed around by a kobold doesn't sound quite dignified, and I'm glad we didn't get to find out if they could pull that off.
english.completed: Return to Scout Dorli at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

text.title: 地震旷野
text.objectives: Speak with King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
text.description: The king has moved south, just past Stonehearth, to the Quaking Fields.$B$BGood luck in retrieving the middle fragment of the World Pillar, but beware the giants and other creatures of the field, $N.

english.title: The Quaking Fields
english.objectives: Speak with King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
english.description: The king has moved south, just past Stonehearth, to the Quaking Fields.$B$BGood luck in retrieving the middle fragment of the World Pillar, but beware the giants and other creatures of the field, $N.

text.title: X Marks the Spot
text.objectives: Head out to where King Oremantle buried the second World Pillar fragment.
text.description: <The king marks a spot on your map.>$B$BThat's where I buried it. Head on out there and dig it up for me.$B$BJust avoid those giants. I can tell you from experience that they hit like a... well, like a giant!
text.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
text.objective1: Go to where the World Pillar fragment is buried

english.title: X Marks the Spot
english.objectives: Head out to where King Oremantle buried the second World Pillar fragment.
english.description: <The king marks a spot on your map.>$B$BThat's where I buried it. Head on out there and dig it up for me.$B$BJust avoid those giants. I can tell you from experience that they hit like a... well, like a giant!
english.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
english.objective1: Go to where the World Pillar fragment is buried

text.title: 裂地之斧
text.objectives: 消灭5名碎裂的翡翠巨人。
text.description: The emerald colossi need to be removed from the field. It's conceivable that one of them has the fragment. Regardless, Therzane has moved her forces too close to Stonehearth and they pose a threat.$B$BSunder the giants with my axe. That should bring them down to a more manageable size so that you can finish them off.
text.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: The Axe of Earthly Sundering
english.objectives: Slay 5 Sundered Emerald Colossi.
english.description: The emerald colossi need to be removed from the field. It's conceivable that one of them has the fragment. Regardless, Therzane has moved her forces too close to Stonehearth and they pose a threat.$B$BSunder the giants with my axe. That should bring them down to a more manageable size so that you can finish them off.
english.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 元素矿砂
text.objectives: 收集6份元素矿砂。
text.description: We'll need to perform a ritual to pinpoint where the World Pillar fragment's been taken.$B$BGo out into the field and collect elemental ore from the ragers. With enough of it, I should be able to make you one with the ground to learn what we need.
text.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: Elemental Ore
english.objectives: Collect 6 Elemental Ore.
english.description: We'll need to perform a ritual to pinpoint where the World Pillar fragment's been taken.$B$BGo out into the field and collect elemental ore from the ragers. With enough of it, I should be able to make you one with the ground to learn what we need.
english.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 合二为一
text.objectives: Through the One With the Ground ritual, discover the location of the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
text.description: I know a ritual of the earth that will make you one with the ground. Because I have already handled the fragment, the spirits of the ground will take you near to it.$B$BKeep your mind focused on the World Pillar and let me know when you are ready, $N.
text.objective1: Middle Fragment of the World Pillar located

english.title: One With the Ground
english.objectives: Through the One With the Ground ritual, discover the location of the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
english.description: I know a ritual of the earth that will make you one with the ground. Because I have already handled the fragment, the spirits of the ground will take you near to it.$B$BKeep your mind focused on the World Pillar and let me know when you are ready, $N.
english.objective1: Middle Fragment of the World Pillar located

text.title: The Fragment's Inside
text.objectives: Collect the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
text.description: The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar is within Avalanchion's Vault. Enter and retrieve it.
text.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: The Fragment's Inside
english.objectives: Collect the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
english.description: The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar is within Avalanchion's Vault. Enter and retrieve it.
english.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 中部碎片
text.objectives: Deliver the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
text.description: Fly. Fly as fast as you can, $N!$B$BGet the middle fragment back to the Temple of Earth in the middle of Deepholm!

english.title: The Middle Fragment
english.objectives: Deliver the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.description: Fly. Fly as fast as you can, $N!$B$BGet the middle fragment back to the Temple of Earth in the middle of Deepholm!

text.title: 失踪的驾驶员
text.objectives: 在盔枕湖北面找到驾驶员铁钻。
text.description: 我的朋友攻城坦克驾驶员莫里·铁钻在山上走丢了。当时我们正寻找一种制作高级火药的稀有矿石，然后他把坦克开上了一个陡峭的山丘，就熄火了！$B$B铁钻坚信那种矿石就在这片山脉里，他让我看守坦克，自己步行继续寻找。$B$B已经过去好多天了，我听见通道西方，盔枕湖的北边传来阵阵野兽的嚎叫。莫里结实强悍，但我还是担心。$B$B拜托你，$N。去找他。
text.completion: 这里有一具伤痕累累的矮人屍体，已经完全被冻住了，而且被食腐动物撕咬得不成样子。在它的手里是一本由莫里·铁钻草草写下的日记。这本日记保存得很好，因为它被包在一件坦克驾驶员军用外衣里。$B$B这里一定是那位蒸汽坦克的驾驶员遇难的地方。$B$B

english.title: The Lost Pilot
english.objectives: Find Pilot Hildelve north of Helm's Bed Lake.
english.description: My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills. We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!$B$BStill convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot.$B$BIt's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls north of Helm's Bed Lake, west of the tunnel. Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.$B$BPlease, $N. Find him.
english.completion: Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers.  Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve.  And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest. This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.

text.title: 驾驶员的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死癞爪。$B$B把他肮脏的爪子和莫里·铁钻的日记交给南门哨岗的驾驶员塞克·锤足。
text.description: 莫里·铁钻在他的日记中写道，他受到了一头名叫癞爪的巨型冰爪熊的袭击。他赶走了这只野兽，不过自己也已遍体鳞伤。$B$B从莫里尸体上的伤痕判断，癞爪一定又折回来杀死了他。$B$B然而，莫里在他的日记中写下了他最后的遗愿：$B$B杀死癞爪，为我复仇。
text.progress: 你好，$N。你有我朋友莫里·铁钻的消息吗?
text.completion: 这真是个让人伤心的消息，莫里是我最好的朋友……我真希望你杀死那头叫作癞爪的野兽时我也在场!$B$B谢谢你，$N。铁炉堡攻城坦克旅的驾驶员会永远感谢你的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Pilot Hammerfoot at the South Gate Outpost.
text.giverWindow: Look around Hildelve's body.  The bear will certainly be nearby.

english.title: A Pilot's Revenge
english.objectives: Kill Mangeclaw.$B$BBring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot at the South Gate Outpost.
english.description: Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.$B$BJudging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.$B$BHowever, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:$B$BRevenge against Mangeclaw.
english.progress: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
english.completion: This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend.  And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw! Thank you, $n. Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.
english.completed: Return to Pilot Hammerfoot at the South Gate Outpost.
english.giverWindow: Look around Hildelve's body.  The bear will certainly be nearby.

text.title: 反击入侵
text.objectives: 杀死奥格弗林特、巴扎兰，以及祈求者耶戈什。
text.description: 这座洞穴曾经是一处莫大的荣誉之地。年轻的战士们被带到这里来，宰掉钻土虫作为他们的第一次杀生——这是我们兽人永生难忘的一刻。$B$B火刃的使者们奴役了洞里的动物，打算同他们的穴居人盟友对奥格瑞玛发动一次全面进攻。$B$B如果你把他们的军官干掉，或许就可以打他们个措手不及，将这次入侵扼杀在摇篮中。
text.completion: You've done it, $n! You've upturned the Searing Blade's invasion before it could even start! Take this, as a token of my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Kurjack in Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: Repel the Invasion
english.objectives: Kill Oggleflint, Bazzalan, and Jergosh the Invoker.
english.description: This cavern was once a place of great honor. Young warriors were taken here to slay an Earthborer worm for their first kill - something we Orcs remember for our entire lives.$B$BThe Burning Blade agents inside have enslaved the cave's inhabitants and plan to launch a full-scale attack on Orgrimmar along with their Trogg allies.$B$BIf you strike down their Lieutenants, you may be able to catch them unprepared and stop this invasion before it starts.
english.completion: You've done it, $n! You've upturned the Searing Blade's invasion before it could even start! Take this, as a token of my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Kurjack in Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 艾比希昂的爪牙
text.objectives: 在艾比希昂的巢穴里打败8名暮光或者龙人单位。
text.description: 如果巨龙拿着碎片，那么我们就要把他的注意力引回他的巢穴。$B$B到东边艾比希昂的巢穴去，击败他的走卒。这样他迟早就得带着世界之柱碎片现身。
text.completion: That ought to get the dragon's attention, $n.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

english.title: Abyssion's Minions
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Twilight or Dragonkin units at Abyssion's Lair.
english.description: If it's the dragon that's got the fragment, we're going to need to draw his attention back to his den.$B$BGo to Abyssion's Lair just east of here and defeat his underlings.  That should get him to show up with the World Pillar fragment sooner or later.
english.completion: That ought to get the dragon's attention, $n.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

text.title: 饥饿者塔拉加曼
text.objectives: 拿到塔拉加曼的精华。
text.description: 燃刃成功地召唤了一个可鄙的恶魔，来领导他们妄图占领奥格瑞玛的第一次进攻，他们称他为饥饿者塔拉加曼！$B$B以酋长的名义，赶紧杀掉塔拉加曼！Lok'tar ogar！
text.progress: If Taragaman is dead, show me his heart.
text.completion: My children will sing songs of your glories, $n!
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Kurjack in Ragefire Chasm.
text.giverWindow: Time to feed him a heaping plate of pain.

english.title: Taragaman the Hungerer
english.objectives: Take Taragaman the Hungerer's heart.
english.description: The Searing Blade has managed to summon a foul demon they call Taragaman the Hungerer to lead the first attack in their takeover of Orgrimmar!$B$BMake haste and slay Taragaman in the name of the Warchief! Lok'tar ogar!
english.progress: If Taragaman is dead, show me his heart.
english.completion: My children will sing songs of your glories, $n!
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Kurjack in Ragefire Chasm.
english.giverWindow: Time to feed him a heaping plate of pain.

text.title: 寻找背包
text.objectives: 在怒焰裂谷搜寻玛尔·恐怖图腾的尸体以及他留下的东西。
text.description: 穴居人并不是怒焰裂谷中唯一令玛加萨感兴趣的东西。她已经得到消息说她的仆从——玛尔·恐怖图腾在怒焰裂谷找到了某种奇特的东西，但是他没能活着把它拿出来。她希望能找到玛尔的遗体——如果他还有遗体的话——以及他在试图与穴居人交谈的过程中发现的东西。$B$B如果你能将玛加萨感兴趣的东西交给她，我敢肯定她会慷慨地奖赏你。$B那么，到奥格瑞玛最黑暗的区域去找寻怒焰裂谷吧。

english.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel
english.objectives: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
english.description: The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.$B$BReturn to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.$B$BAgain, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.

text.title: 塞尔萨玛血肠
text.objectives: 从洛克莫丹的黑熊身上割下8块熊臀肉。
text.description: 塞尔萨玛从来不缺饿肚子的人。孩子们跑进跑出，工人们从挖掘场累了一天回来。我们这儿的血肠可出名了，我想你还没尝过吧？$B$B没有？那好，在这儿想吃饭就得干活，别以为你是个了不起的$C，就能搞特殊。$B$B你去给我弄点新鲜的熊臀肉来，烹饪的事情就交给我吧！
text.progress: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the bear meat for me?
text.completion: Much obliged! The rump's part of my own secret twist on the recipe... but here's instructions on how to make it with any kind of bear meat.$B$BAnd here's a fresh batch of me own. Mind you eat them fresh!
text.completed: Return to Vidra Hearthstove at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
english.objectives: Collect 8 Bear Rumps from Black Bears in Loch Modan.
english.description: There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?$b$bNo? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.$b$bYou get me some fresh bear rumps and leave the cooking to me!
english.progress: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the bear meat for me?
english.completion: Much obliged! The rump's part of my own secret twist on the recipe... but here's instructions on how to make it with any kind of bear meat.$B$BAnd here's a fresh batch of me own. Mind you eat them fresh!
english.completed: Return to Vidra Hearthstove at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 封锁大门
text.objectives: 对艾比希昂的巢穴里的暮光之门和元素之门使用风暴石。
text.description: 如果我们要一举拿下艾比希昂，就得保证他无法获得增援。$B$B你可以在东边他的巢穴里找到两座界门。用这颗风暴石干扰界门的运作。$B$B如果一切按计划进行，我们就可以在他帮手不多的时候撂倒艾比希昂。
text.completion: Excellent.  When we make our move against Abyssion, we should be able to do so without reinforcements coming to his aid.
text.completed: Return to Seer Galekk at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

english.title: Block the Gates
english.objectives: Use the Stormstone at the Twilight Gate and Elemental Gate in Abyssion's Lair.
english.description: If we're to have a shot against Abyssion, we must make sure he receives no aid from reinforcements.$B$BYou will find two gateways in his lair to the east.  Use this stormstone to disrupt their operation.$B$BIf everything goes as planned, we'll be able to tackle Abyssion without him being able to receive much assistance.
english.completion: Excellent.  When we make our move against Abyssion, we should be able to do so without reinforcements coming to his aid.
english.completed: Return to Seer Galekk at the Twilight Overlook in Deepholm.

text.title: 收买元素
text.objectives: 获得6条灼热绑带。
text.description: 燃刃的术士们奴役了怒焰裂谷的元素灵魂，$N。只要我的法术能把它们制住，它们就不会对城市构成威胁，但我支持不了多久。$B$B给我弄六条用以控制它们的灼热绑带来，我会把灵魂们放回到裂谷中去。
text.progress: Do you have the bindings?
text.completion: Thank you, $c. The Molten Elementals' spirits are finally back to rest.
text.completed: Return to Bovaal Whitehorn in Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: Elemental Tampering
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Searing Bindings.
english.description: The Searing Blade's warlocks have enslaved Ragefire Chasm's elemental spirits, $N. They aren't a threat to the city while my spell keeps them at bay, but I can't maintain it much longer.$B$BBring me six of the Searing Bindings used to control them and I will release their spirits back into the Chasm.
english.progress: Do you have the bindings?
english.completion: Thank you, $c. The Molten Elementals' spirits are finally back to rest.
english.completed: Return to Bovaal Whitehorn in Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 肮脏的爪子
text.objectives: 从银泉矿洞里收集6车矿工装备。
text.description: 东边的银泉矿洞很久以前就枯竭了。矿工联盟把它改造成了储藏库，不过现在狗头人占据了那里，把他们肮脏的爪子放在了我们矮人制造的工具上！$B$B我们很快就能把这些害人虫赶走，但是矿工联盟要求我们在冲进去大开杀戒之前，先把洞里的矿工装备拿出来。这是个艰难的任务——你也许需要几个帮手。$B$B他们的装备就在矿工联盟的储物箱里，祝你好运。
text.progress: 你拿到矿工装备了吗，$N?
text.completion: Did you see a lot of kobolds in there? The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

english.title: Filthy Paws
english.objectives: Collect 6 loads of Miners' Gear from the Silver Stream Mine.
english.description: The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, dwarven tools!$B$BWe'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.$B$BThe gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
english.progress: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
english.completion: Did you see a lot of kobolds in there? The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Stormpike at Algaz Station in Loch Modan.

text.title: 捎上豺狼人的消息
text.objectives: 将工头山普斯尼尔的徽记交给巡山人卡德雷尔。
text.description: 我要你把这个带回去给巡山人卡德雷尔。让他看看，告诉他那些肮脏的小东西们在这儿可能有个聚会。
text.progress: Any news from Algaz Station?
text.completion: Gnolls and kobolds, and troggs? Oh my.$B$BI'd laugh if I didn't have another twist in the story for you.

english.title: The Bearer of Gnoll-edge
english.objectives: Deliver Foreman Sharpsneer's Head to Mountaineer Kadrell.
english.description: I need you to take this back to Mountaineer Kadrell. Show it to him and tell him the nasty critters around here might be having some kind of get-together.
english.progress: Any news from Algaz Station?
english.completion: Gnolls and kobolds, and troggs? Oh my.$B$BI'd laugh if I didn't have another twist in the story for you.

text.title: 脚下之敌
text.objectives: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
text.description: 部落的敌人就躲在这座城市下面，$C。$B$B燃刃氏族密谋夺取奥格瑞玛，他们已经占领了怒焰裂谷！我们必须攻打他们的部队，夺回我们的领土！$B$B去跟怒焰裂谷里面的石头守卫库尔加克谈谈。他会给你进一步的指引。
text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.title: Enemies Below
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
english.description: There are enemies of the Horde beneath this very city, $c.$B$BThe Searing Blade plots to take Orgrimmar for their own, and have already taken Ragefire Chasm! We need to storm their forces and retake what is ours!$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside Ragefire Chasm. He will have further orders for you.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.title: 脚下之敌
text.objectives: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛的怒焰裂谷已经被燃刃氏族占领了，$N，我们不能听之任之，让他们接着觊觎雷霆崖。$B$B去跟裂谷里的石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。尽你所能帮助他，毕竟雷霆崖与奥格瑞玛唇齿相依。
text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.title: Enemies Below
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
english.description: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. $N, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.title: 脚下之敌
text.objectives: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
text.description: 加尔鲁什以一贯的优雅好言请你将怒焰裂谷从燃刃的手里收复过来。显然，他的城防并不如他所想得那样坚不可破。$B$B去跟怒焰里的石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈，我肯定有个强力的帮手，他会高兴的。
text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.title: Enemies Below
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
english.description: With all his usual grace, Warchief Garrosh has kindly requested your presence in Ragefire Chasm to help retake it from the Searing Blade. Apparently, his reinforced city isn't as impenetrable as he thought.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside Ragefire, I'm sure he'll be glad to have competent help.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.title: 恶心轴心
text.objectives: 使用精巧的植物伪装包并溜藓皮使者身边，在他身上使用超浓鱼人信息素。
text.description: 好吧，现在闭上你的嘴听我说，计划是这样的。$B$B那些豺狼人和鱼人多半要在什么地方会面。你就把我的这套精巧的植物伪装包带上，打扮成一棵植物的样子。然后你摸到他们那儿去，将你拿到的这些超浓鱼人信息素洒在鱼人身边的藓皮豺狼人身上。$B$B然后鱼人就会口喷白沫，而藓皮豺狼人在同这些疯狂的小混蛋合作之前也会再三考虑的！
text.completion: Worked like a charm, didn't it? Maybe Kadrell will get off my darn back now what with savin' the whole town and all!$B$BI suppose you've done earned yourself some proper goods.
text.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Axis of Awful
english.objectives: Use the Clever Plant Disguise Kit to sneak up on the Mosshide Representative and use the Potent Murloc Pheromones on him.
english.description: Alright, now just shut yer gob and lemme talk, 'cause here's the plan.$B$BThose gnolls and murlocs are liable to be meetin' out there somewhere. So you take this clever plant disguise of mine, and you wear it and look like a plant. Then you sneak up on 'em, and you throw this scent pheromone you gathered on the mosshide standin' with the murlocs.$B$BThen the murlocs'll flip their spit, and the mosshides will think twice about trying to work with such crazy lil' buggers!
english.completion: Worked like a charm, didn't it? Maybe Kadrell will get off my darn back now what with savin' the whole town and all!$B$BI suppose you've done earned yourself some proper goods.
english.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 深渊之渊
text.objectives: 在碎岩之渊里找到钙铝石。
text.description: <大地轻轻地颤抖，岱亚曼塔低沉而熟悉的声音传来，仿佛石头本身在说话一般。>$B$B干得好，$R。$B$B在下面的坑道里，可以找到你所寻求的那种石头。钙铝石。$B$B前方危险重重……$B$B就连石领主们自己也有所忌惮。$B$B保持镇定。$B$B保持坚定的意志。$B$B岩石的力量就在你的脚下。
text.completion: <This is it. This is the stone Diamant sent you for.>
text.giverWindow: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

english.title: Depth of the Depths
english.objectives: Find the Painite within the Crumbling Depths.
english.description: <The ground trembles slightly, and the low, familiar voice of Diamant speaks as if from the stone itself.>$B$BWell done, $r.$B$BWithin the tunnels below, you will find the stone which you seek. Painite.$B$BThe dangers ahead are many...$B$BDangers that the Stone Lords themselves fear.$B$BRemain steady.$B$BRemain strong.$B$BThe strength of the rock itself is beneath your feet.
english.completion: <This is it. This is the stone Diamant sent you for.>
english.giverWindow: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

text.title: 净化洞穴
text.objectives: 哀嚎洞穴的厄布鲁要你去杀掉毒牙之王考布莱恩、安娜科德拉、皮萨斯，以及瑟芬迪斯。
text.description: 纳拉雷克斯有一个崇高的目标。$B$B我们伟大的领袖渴望进入翡翠梦境，帮忙将这些严酷的土地重新恢复成往日茂密的森林。$B$B但发生了可怕的事情。$B$B纳拉雷克斯信赖的盟友，毒牙德鲁伊们背叛了他！他们所追求的并非治疗贫瘠之地，而是统治它。$B$B$N，在我们能够唤醒纳拉雷克斯，恢复这一重要地区的平衡之前，你必须铲除毒牙之王。他们的势力过于根深蒂固了。
text.completion: I can already feel the balance returning! Quick, talk to Muyoh to help him awaken Naralex!
text.completed: Return to Ebru.

english.title: Cleansing the Caverns
english.objectives: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill the Fanglords Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas, and Serpentis.
english.description: Naralex had a noble goal.$b$bOur great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was.$B$BBut something went terribly wrong.$b$bNaralex's trusted allies, the Druids of the Fang, turned on him! They seek not to heal the Barrens, but to dominate it.$B$B$N, before we can awaken Naralex and restore balance to this vital place, you need to eradicate the Fanglords. Their influence has sunk too deeply.
english.completion: I can already feel the balance returning! Quick, talk to Muyoh to help him awaken Naralex!
english.completed: Return to Ebru.

text.title: 石中之石
text.objectives: 带着一大块钙铝石去找洛苏娜之门的岱亚曼塔。
text.description: <大地轻轻地颤抖，岱亚曼塔低沉而熟悉的声音传来，仿佛石头本身在说话一般。>$B$B你照我说的做了。$B$B安全逃出这个洞穴吧。$B$B别把宝石忘了。
text.progress: You're alive. This is good.$B$BIs the gemstone with you?
text.completion: Well done, fleshling!$B$BThe gyreworms are among our most dangerous enemies.$B$BThe other Stone Lords shall have trouble not turning their head to this accomplishment.
text.giverWindow: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

english.title: A Rock Amongst Many
english.objectives: Return to Diamant at Lorthuna's Gate with the Painite Chunk.
english.description: <The ground trembles slightly, and the low, familiar voice of Diamant speaks as if from the stone itself.>$B$BYou've done as I've asked.$B$BTurn back and escape the cave in one piece.$B$BDon't forget the gemstone.
english.progress: You're alive. This is good.$B$BIs the gemstone with you?
english.completion: Well done, fleshling!$B$BThe gyreworms are among our most dangerous enemies.$B$BThe other Stone Lords shall have trouble not turning their head to this accomplishment.
english.giverWindow: Diamant the Patient. The Timeless. The Long-Winded.

text.title: 变异皮革
text.objectives: 纳尔帕克需要10张变异皮革。
text.description: 纳拉雷克斯进一步深陷噩梦，一种奇怪的物种从贫瘠之地深处来到了哀嚎洞穴。$B$B这些变异的生物有种奇怪的超自然特性。它们的存在给大地带来了极大的痛苦。我相信杀掉它们将会对我们治疗洞穴大有裨益。$B$B如果你觉得能够胜任，就尽可能地把它们杀掉，将它们的皮带来作为消灭的证明。
text.progress: How many of the beasts have you slain?
text.completion: Your efforts shall not go unnoticed, $n. Thank you for your dedication.
text.completed: Return to Nalpak.

english.title: Deviate Hides
english.objectives: Nalpak wants 10 Deviate Hides.
