english.description: As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.$b$bThese deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. Their very existence causes great pain to the earth. I believe that slaying them will greatly aid our work in healing the caverns.$b$bIf you feel up to the task, slay as many as you can and bring me their hides as proof of their demise.
english.progress: How many of the beasts have you slain?
english.completion: Your efforts shall not go unnoticed, $n. Thank you for your dedication.
english.completed: Return to Nalpak.

text.title: 先发制人
text.objectives: 纳尔帕克要你收集5朵毒蛇花。
text.description: 这些洞穴里有种药草，具备着难以名状的力量，$N。也许你愿意帮我收集一些来？$B$B它是一种叫做毒蛇花的稀有植物。我相信数量足够的话，它就能够阻止诸如纳拉雷克斯的噩梦再度发生。$B$B不幸的是，毒蛇花只生长在这个地方最黑暗的深处。
text.progress: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom.
text.completion: You have done well, $n. Hopefully we can use these to prevent further nightmares.
text.completed: Return to Nalpak.

english.title: Preemptive Methods
english.objectives: Nalpak wants you to collect 5 Serpentbloom.
english.description: There is an herb in these caverns that holds untold power, $n. Perhaps you wish to help me collect it?$b$bIt is a rare flower called Serpentbloom. I believe that in greater quantities it has the potential to prevent nightmares like Naralex's from ever occuring.$b$bUnfortunately, Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of this place.
english.progress: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom.
english.completion: You have done well, $n. Hopefully we can use these to prevent further nightmares.
english.completed: Return to Nalpak.

text.title: Awakening Naralex
text.objectives: Speak with Muyoh.
text.description: Now that the Fanglords are dead, speak with Muyoh. He will help you awaken Naralex and end this nightmare.

english.title: Awakening Naralex
english.objectives: Speak with Muyoh.
english.description: Now that the Fanglords are dead, speak with Muyoh. He will help you awaken Naralex and end this nightmare.

text.title: 不死的暮光
text.objectives: 杀死12名暮光入侵者和1名被污染的大地狂怒者。
text.description: 暮光教派来了！他们打算阻止仪式！回到两边的房间里帮忙打退他们！
text.progress: We cannot let the binding be interrupted. They need your help in the back rooms - please hurry.
text.completion: The Twilight forces continue to stream in, but it looks like the Earthen Ring defenders can handle them.

english.title: Undying Twilight
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twilight invaders and 1 Desecrated Earthrager.
english.description: The Twilight Cultists are here! They're trying to stop the ritual! Get to the back chambers and help fight them off!
english.progress: We cannot let the binding be interrupted. They need your help in the back rooms - please hurry.
english.completion: The Twilight forces continue to stream in, but it looks like the Earthen Ring defenders can handle them.

text.title: 世界之柱碎片
text.objectives: 将大地之环旗帜插在艾比希昂的巢穴中央，杀死他并获得世界之柱上部碎片。
text.description: 是时候了，$N。我们发现艾比希昂往他的巢穴去了。$B$B暮光之锤也许以为让一条巨龙守护碎片会很安全，但我阅龙无数，知道他们都有一个弱点。骄傲。$B$B凡人都是微不足道的，艾比希昂不会拒绝这样的挑战。$B$B将大地之环的旗帜插在他的巢穴中央。我们击败他后，就把碎片交给玛鲁特。我们必须尽快修复世界之柱。
text.progress: $N!  You've returned!
text.completion: Your efforts in repairing the World Pillar are invaluable, $n.  Once the Temple of Earth's structure is stable again, the rift between the worlds will begin to stabilize.
text.completed: Bring the Upper World Pillar Fragment to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth.

english.title: The World Pillar Fragment
english.objectives: Place the Earthen Ring Banner in the center of Abyssion's Lair, slay him and obtain the Upper World Pillar Fragment.
english.description: It is time, $N.  We have spotted Abyssion making his way to the lair.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer might've thought the fragment would be safe if a dragon guarded it, but I've met enough dragons to know their one weakness.  Pride.$B$BAbyssion's not going to run from a fight with us puny mortals.$B$BPlace the banner of the Earthen Ring in the middle of his lair.  Once we defeat him, bring the fragment to Maruut.  We need to to repair the World Pillar as soon as possible.
english.progress: $N!  You've returned!
english.completion: Your efforts in repairing the World Pillar are invaluable, $n.  Once the Temple of Earth's structure is stable again, the rift between the worlds will begin to stabilize.
english.completed: Bring the Upper World Pillar Fragment to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth.

text.title: The Fragment's Inside
text.objectives: Collect the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
text.description: $N, you need to enter Avalanchion's Vault to the southeast and retrieve the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar!
text.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: The Fragment's Inside
english.objectives: Collect the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
english.description: $N, you need to enter Avalanchion's Vault to the southeast and retrieve the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar!
english.completed: Return to King Oremantle at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 纳拉雷克斯的信徒
text.objectives: 跟哀嚎洞穴里的纳尔帕克谈一谈。
text.description: $C，贫瘠之地曾经是卡利姆多最漂亮的地方之一，充满了生命和希望。$B$B现在，正如你看到的那样，往日的风光已经不再了。它变成了一片折磨与争斗的土地。$B$B纳拉雷克斯的信徒打算净化哀嚎洞穴，还它往日的美丽。跟哀嚎洞穴里的纳尔帕克谈一谈，帮点忙。
text.completion: Yes, $c? What brings you to this place?

english.title: Disciples of Naralex
english.objectives: Speak with Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns.
english.description: $C, the Barrens used to be one of the most beautiful places in all of Kalimdor. It teemed with life and promise.$B$BNow, as you can see, that is no longer true. It is a land of great torment and strife.$B$BThe Disciples of Naralex seek to cleanse the Wailing Caverns and bring them back to their former beauty. Speak with Nalpak just inside the Wailing Caverns to help.
english.completion: Yes, $c? What brings you to this place?

text.title: 纳拉雷克斯的信徒
text.objectives: 跟哀嚎洞穴里的纳尔帕克谈一谈。
text.description: $C, this place is, shall I say, not optimal for my business endeavors. If it were more lively, I have an idea that would make me the richest goblin that's ever lived!$B$BA $c of your stature must see the potential in that, or at least care about the environment or something.$B$BGo talk to Nalpak just inside the Wailing Caverns, he's a Disciple of Naralex and, just between you and me, I think they're going to fix this blasted place for good! It's my big break!

english.title: Disciples of Naralex
english.objectives: Speak with Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns.
english.description: $C, this place is, shall I say, not optimal for my business endeavors. If it were more lively, I have an idea that would make me the richest goblin that's ever lived!$B$BA $c of your stature must see the potential in that, or at least care about the environment or something.$B$BGo talk to Nalpak just inside the Wailing Caverns, he's a Disciple of Naralex and, just between you and me, I think they're going to fix this blasted place for good! It's my big break!

text.title: 寻找塞尔瑞德
text.objectives: Seek out Scout Thaelrid.
text.description: There's something sinister going on within this place, $N. We fear that the rumors of the Naga working with the Twilight's Hammer are true.$B$BI sent Thaelrid, one of our best scouts, further in to investigate the matter, but he hasn't returned.$B$BSeek him out. If he's still alive, find out all that he's learned.
text.completion: Ashelan was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.

english.title: In Search of Thaelrid
english.objectives: Seek out Scout Thaelrid.
english.description: There's something sinister going on within this place, $N. We fear that the rumors of the Naga working with the Twilight's Hammer are true.$B$BI sent Thaelrid, one of our best scouts, further in to investigate the matter, but he hasn't returned.$B$BSeek him out. If he's still alive, find out all that he's learned.
english.completion: Ashelan was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.

text.title: 黑暗深渊中的恶魔
text.objectives: 获得暮光领主克尔里斯的徽记
text.description: 我失去了力量，需要你的帮助！$B$B很久以前这里曾是艾露恩的宏伟神殿。但上古之神的腐化从地底加速蔓延，污染了神圣的月亮井，这里就不幸成为了废墟。$B$B上古之神的仆从阿库麦尔，从井水中复活了。$B$B暮光之锤邪教徒们同纳迦联手，占领了这些地方。一群邪教徒在暮光领主克尔里斯的带领下，把无辜的人献给阿库麦尔以求获得力量。$B$B杀掉克尔里斯，并将他的徽记交给阿舍兰。
text.progress: It is good to see you again, $N. What news do you bring?$B$BWas your foray successful? Did you find Thaelrid?
text.completion: Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.$b$bIt seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him either dead or missing.$b$bBut this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.$b$bTo sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!$b$bYou have done a great deed, $n. I thank you on behalf of Ashenvale.$b$bIf only Thaelrid had survived....
text.completed: Return to Ashelan.
text.giverWindow: Kelris must be stopped!

english.title: Blackfathom Villainy
english.objectives: Get the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
english.description: My strength has left me. I need your help!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from below and tainted the sacred moonwell.$b$bAku'Mai, a servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Ashelan.
english.progress: It is good to see you again, $N. What news do you bring?$B$BWas your foray successful? Did you find Thaelrid?
english.completion: Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.$b$bIt seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him either dead or missing.$b$bBut this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.$b$bTo sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!$b$bYou have done a great deed, $n. I thank you on behalf of Ashenvale.$b$bIf only Thaelrid had survived....
english.completed: Return to Ashelan.
english.giverWindow: Kelris must be stopped!

text.title: 暮光之锤的末日
text.objectives: Obtain 10 Twilight Pendants.
text.description: 通过膜拜混沌的上古之神，暮光之锤的成员们获得了强大的力量，妄图帮助他们的黑暗主人重返这个世界，投下死亡与恐怖的阴影。$B$B我们认为暮光之锤已经与纳迦结盟，并且开始在这里集结。$B$B无论他们在这座古老的神殿深处筹划着怎样邪恶的计划，我们都必须阻止他们。$B$B向暮光之锤发动攻势，并带回一些证据来作为你战功的证明。我们会重赏你的。
text.progress: Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.$b$bHave you made any progress in ridding the temple of their presence?
text.completion: You are no doubt of brave and noble blood, $n. We and all of the people of Ashenvale commend you for your efforts against evil.
text.completed: Return to Aluwyn.

english.title: Twilight Falls
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Twilight Pendants.
english.description: Empowered by the ancient rites of the chaotic Old Gods, the members of the Twilight's Hammer strive to bring about the return of their dark patrons and spread death and terror across the world.$b$bWe believe that the Twilight's Hammer has allied with the naga and are amassing here.$b$bWhatever evil plan brews in the depths of the old temple must be thwarted.$b$bWage war on the Hammer and bring back proof of your deeds. Your efforts will be rewarded handsomely.
english.progress: Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.$b$bHave you made any progress in ridding the temple of their presence?
english.completion: You are no doubt of brave and noble blood, $n. We and all of the people of Ashenvale commend you for your efforts against evil.
english.completed: Return to Aluwyn.

text.title: 研究堕落
text.objectives: 收集8份堕落者的脑干。
text.description: 愚蠢的血精灵，竟然敢跟恶魔法术打交道。他们难道没有看到卡利姆多的纳迦和萨特的下场吗？$B$B我担心血精灵也会落得同样扭曲的下场。艾泽拉斯不能再产生一个新的邪恶种族了。$B$B我打算研究一下萨特和纳迦的脑干，也许可以推断出辛多雷的命运走向。在你杀死他们的时候，尽量不要伤到脑干，我只需要完整的样本。
text.progress: 只要我有了足够的样本，就可以开始真正的研究了。有了这些从黑暗深渊里找到的萨特和纳迦的脑干，我就能找出这两种被魔法扭曲了心智的生物之间的联系。$B$B或许……如果我们对这些东西能有足够的了解，我们就能阻止血精灵步他们的後尘，走向堕落的深渊。
text.completion: You have undoubtedly faced great peril to obtain these.$b$bYour actions have been selfless. It is for the good of all Azeroth that you help me with my research. I thank you, $n, for all that you have done.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me I have much work to do.
text.completed: Return to Relwyn.

english.title: Researching the Corruption
english.objectives: Gather 8 Corrupt Brain Stems.
english.description: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?$b$bI fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.$b$bI wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the sin'dorei are headed toward. Try to avoid harming the stems while you kill them, I won't take anything but perfect specimens.
english.progress: Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.$b$bPerhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
english.completion: You have undoubtedly faced great peril to obtain these.$b$bYour actions have been selfless. It is for the good of all Azeroth that you help me with my research. I thank you, $n, for all that you have done.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me I have much work to do.
english.completed: Return to Relwyn.

text.title: 深渊中的知识
text.objectives: 找到洛迦里斯手稿。
text.description: 作为一名受训的哨兵，我的责任就是为我的上级搜集文献。古老的、强大的文献。能打开大门，落入敌人之手便能唤醒沉睡之人的文献。$B$B谣传说一份古老的文献，洛迦里斯手稿，就在阿斯卡之池底部的铁箱里。那里是我们死去先祖的往日住所。在城市变为废墟之前，他们掌握着伟大的知识。$B$B我的能力不足以继续前进了。请替我寻回那份手稿。
text.progress: Your task is not an easy one, my friend.$B$BBut if you get me the manuscript, $N...then your reward will be great and we will gain a better understanding of what it is that the Twilight's Hammer and the naga are up to.
text.completion: You found the manuscript! What a joyous day this is! I will study it exhaustively and learn all there is to know.$B$BI'll make full sentinel yet!$B$BYour service to us is more than you know, $N. I hope that this gift shows you my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel-trainee Issara.

english.title: Knowledge in the Deeps
english.objectives: Find the Lorgalis Manuscript.
english.description: It is my duty as a trainee to collect lore for my superiors. Old lore. Powerful lore. Lore that opens doorways, and lore that could awaken more of Those Who Sleep if it is mishandled.$B$BThere are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of the Pool of Ask'ar in a Pitted Iron Chest. It is the old dwelling of our long-dead ancestors. They held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.$B$BSearch for the manuscript, please. I'm not skilled enough to venture further!
english.progress: Your task is not an easy one, my friend.$B$BBut if you get me the manuscript, $N...then your reward will be great and we will gain a better understanding of what it is that the Twilight's Hammer and the naga are up to.
english.completion: You found the manuscript! What a joyous day this is! I will study it exhaustively and learn all there is to know.$B$BI'll make full sentinel yet!$B$BYour service to us is more than you know, $N. I hope that this gift shows you my gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel-trainee Issara.

text.title: 不听管教
text.objectives: 杀掉南海工头。
text.description: 海湾东边的那艘该死的船一直在朝我们开炮。看见地精被炮弹打中是挺有意思的，但我们的一些侏儒朋友们也中弹了！$B$B要是你能冒着炮火冲到船上去，那就真的真的太好了。上面有个刻薄的老工头在朝其他水手发号施令，我敢说，如果你把他揍一顿，或是干脆杀掉，他们就会停止炮击了。
text.completion: Wonderful! I hope you didn't get hit with too many cannonballs.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: Going Off-Task
english.objectives: Kill the Southsea Taskmaster.
english.description: That nasty ship on the east side of the cove keeps firing its cannons at us. It's kinda funny seeing all the goblins get hit by cannonballs, but some of my gnome friends are being hit too!$B$BIt'd be really, really nice if you could make your way past those cannons and onto the ship. There's a mean ol' taskmaster yelling at the other deckhands in there, and I'm sure if you beat him up or kill him, they'll stop shooting at us!
english.completion: Wonderful! I hope you didn't get hit with too many cannonballs.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 填满我们的口袋
text.objectives: 从南海火枪手和南海勇夫身上获得20份金料。
text.description: I know we're here to make friends with the Steamwheedle goblins, but those awful Bilgewater goblins are so rude$B$BWhy, I just saw a bunch of them pulling gold fillings out of the teeth of the Southsea musketeers and strongarms. Do they think they can just take that for themselves?$B$BObviously, the nice thing to do is kill those pirates ourselves, take their fillings ourselves, and then give some of them to the Steamwheedle as a thank-you gift! Head on down there and beat those goblins to the punch.
text.progress: Have you got the fillings?
text.completion: More gold! We'll be sure to give some of this to Mister Noggenfogger to smoothly ensure our continued relations. And only a little bit of it will go back to Gnomeregan for experimental weapons development!
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

english.title: Filling Our Pockets
english.objectives: Collect 20 Gold Fillings from Southsea Musketeers or Southsea Strongarms.
english.description: I know we're here to make friends with the Steamwheedle goblins, but those awful Bilgewater goblins are so rude$B$BWhy, I just saw a bunch of them pulling gold fillings out of the teeth of the Southsea musketeers and strongarms. Do they think they can just take that for themselves?$B$BObviously, the nice thing to do is kill those pirates ourselves, take their fillings ourselves, and then give some of them to the Steamwheedle as a thank-you gift! Head on down there and beat those goblins to the punch.
english.progress: Have you got the fillings?
english.completion: More gold! We'll be sure to give some of this to Mister Noggenfogger to smoothly ensure our continued relations. And only a little bit of it will go back to Gnomeregan for experimental weapons development!
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark at Lost Rigger Cove in Tanaris.

text.title: 深渊的噩梦
text.objectives: 杀死阿库麦尔。
text.description: 在黑暗深渊最黑暗的尽头，潜伏着一名上古众神孽生的怪物。我们只知道它叫做阿库麦尔。$B$B上古众神和他们的仆从对我们的世界来说异常危险。很久以前，他们统治着整个艾泽拉斯。如今他们意欲再次征服这个世界，甚至不惜毁掉它。$B$B$N，阿库麦尔是一名语言无法形容的噩梦生物。我们不能让他继续存在。摧毁他。
text.completion: The beast is slain. I can feel his dark presence fading away forever.
text.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea.
text.giverWindow: Foul pet of the Old Gods.

english.title: Nightmare of the Deeps
english.objectives: Kill Aku'mai.
english.description: In the darkest recesses of Blackfathom, a monster spawned by the Old Gods lurks. We know it only as Aku'mai.$B$BThe Old Gods and their servants are incredibly dangerous to our world. Long ago, they ruled over Azeroth and I fear that they seek to do so again, or destroy it while trying.$B$B$N, Aku'mai is a creature of untold nightmare. We simply cannot allow his continued existence. Destroy him.
english.completion: The beast is slain. I can feel his dark presence fading away forever.
english.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea.
english.giverWindow: Foul pet of the Old Gods.

text.title: 都收拾好了
text.objectives: 跟商旅哨站的泽克·磨靴谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，天哪，我们这儿干净多了！$B$B<凯尔希清了清嗓子。>$B$B听着，$N，我非常期盼能够最终逃出这个杀人盒子，这样我就可以远离这些地精和小儿科的工作了。如果你有意继续为诺莫瑞根与联盟的壮大而服务，那就往南到这片地区的商旅哨站去。$B$B跟那里的泽克·磨靴谈一谈，记住，为了塔纳利斯好，在热砂港所做的一切工作，都会对关闭锈水港有所帮助。
text.completion: You know, I'm usually not impressed when I see a $r, but I've heard about what you've been doin' for the Steamwheedle. You're alright, kid.

english.title: All Cheered Out
english.objectives: Talk to Zeke Bootscuff at Bootlegger Outpost.
english.description: Well gosh, we've cleaned up quite a bit here!$B$B<Kelsey clears her throat.>$B$BListen, $n, I'm looking forward to finally vacating this killbox so I can get away from these goblins and drop the cheer-act. If you'd like to continue to advance the interests of Gnomeregan, and by extension the Alliance, in the area, head south to Bootlegger Outpost.$B$BTalk to Zeke Bootscuff there, and remember that any work for the Steamwheedle will help us shut the Bilgewater out of Tanaris for good.
english.completion: You know, I'm usually not impressed when I see a $r, but I've heard about what you've been doin' for the Steamwheedle. You're alright, kid.

text.title: 阿库麦尔水晶
text.objectives: 收集20颗阿库麦尔蓝宝石。
text.description: 大簇的水晶生长在黑暗深渊的外围通道的墙上。我们注意到纳迦开始收集这些水晶，与此同时，他们的武器数量惊人地增长。$B$B那种水晶貌似有着强大的元素之力，只要经过一定的处理，它们就可以被制作成强大的锻造材料。$B$B你愿意帮我吗，$N？黑暗深渊在我们前哨的北边，沿着佐拉姆海岸就能找到。
text.progress: How goes your search for the crystals, $n? Do you think they'll make an item we can use to stop the naga?
text.completion: Excellent! These will do nicely. Here's a reward for your hard work.
text.completed: Return to Dagrun Ragehammer.

english.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai
english.objectives: Collect 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai.
english.description: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, there are large sapphire clusters along the cave walls. We noticed that the naga started harvesting the crystals around the same time their weaponry greatly improved.$B$BThe crystals seem to have great elemental power and, if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful component for my smithing.$B$BWill you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
english.progress: How goes your search for the crystals, $n? Do you think they'll make an item we can use to stop the naga?
english.completion: Excellent! These will do nicely. Here's a reward for your hard work.
english.completed: Return to Dagrun Ragehammer.

text.title: 废墟之间
text.objectives: 提炼深渊之核。
text.description: 暮光之锤进入了月光神殿废墟。他们出现的后果只可能是那些元素生物被迫与我们开战。$B$B$N，找到这里的暮光侦察兵，然后拿到废墟的深渊之石，它应该处于水下某处，多半就在他们的鼻子底下。那里面有一颗深渊之核——正确地读取该装置，就可以显示所有元素活动的历史记录。要是有了它，大地之环和我就可以想办法阻止他们了！
text.progress: 你找到深渊之核了吗?没有它的话，我们就无法得知暮光之锤究竟在那里做什么。
text.completion: 这正是我需要的东西!深渊之核是个非常完美的资讯源，我可以从中获取许多资讯。不管暮光之锤在干什麽─反正肯定不会是什麽好事情─我和我的同事都会努力找出真相。$B$B你干得很好，陶土议会非常感谢你对我们的帮助。同时，你也帮助了整个部落，因此你应该感到光荣。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea.

english.title: Amongst the Ruins
english.objectives: Extract the Fathom Core.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins here.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.$B$B$N, find the Twilight agents here, then find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere underwater, probably right underneath their own noses. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, the Earthen Ring and I can hopefully do something to stop them!
english.progress: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
english.completion: This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover. You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
english.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea.

text.title: 深渊的深处
text.objectives: 杀死加摩拉、萨利维丝，以及格里哈斯特。
text.description: 纳迦和暮光之锤携手，要将我们在这一地区所有的努力化为泡影。更甚的是，耶努告诉我，他感觉到在我们的地底深处有一个上古神灵的存在，久久不肯离去。$B$B如果他们要混沌，那么我们就让他们如愿以偿。$B$B$N，杀掉他们最强壮的战士们，瞧瞧他们有多乐意看到这一切。$B$B仔细寻找，黑暗深渊的洞穴里到处都是水下通路和侧道，你的目标可能就藏身其中。
text.completion: I can hear their cries from here! Maybe this will show them how foolish it is to wish for the return of an Old God.
text.completed: Return to Zeya.

english.title: Deep in the Deeps
english.objectives: Slay Ghamoo-Ra, Lady Sarevess, and Gelihast.
english.description: The Naga and the Twilight's Hammer work together to undo all the progress we've made in this area. What's more, Je'neu tells me that he feels the presence of an Old God lingering far beneath us.$B$BIf they wish to witness chaos, we will give them just that.$B$B$N, cut down their strongest warriors, and we'll see how much they enjoy it.$B$BSearch carefully, Blackfathom Deeps is full of underwater passages and side paths in the caves that may hide your targets.
english.completion: I can hear their cries from here! Maybe this will show them how foolish it is to wish for the return of an Old God.
english.completed: Return to Zeya.

text.title: 黑暗深渊
text.objectives: 与耶努萨克雷交谈。
text.description: There's a task to be done that you're perfect for, $c. We need to secure the area around Blackfathom Deeps to help with that Alliance that are threatening Zoram'gar Outpost west of here.$B$BGo to Blackfathom Deeps, north of Zoram'gar Outpost, and speak with Je'neu of the Earthen Ring. He will have plenty for you to do.

english.title: Blackfathom Deeps
english.objectives: Speak with Je'neu Sancrea.
english.description: There's a task to be done that you're perfect for, $c. We need to secure the area around Blackfathom Deeps to help with that Alliance that are threatening Zoram'gar Outpost west of here.$B$BGo to Blackfathom Deeps, north of Zoram'gar Outpost, and speak with Je'neu of the Earthen Ring. He will have plenty for you to do.

text.title: 黑暗深渊
text.objectives: 与耶努萨克雷交谈。
text.description: The Naga mock us with their defiance. We will drive them and their allies out of this land for good.$B$BTravel north of here to Blackfathom Deeps and speak with Je'neu Sancrea. He's already made his way inside.$B$BBe wary of Zeya, by the way. She can be a bit...temperamental at times.
text.completion: Did Commander Grimfang send you? I've asked him to find suitable recruits to aid me here.

english.title: Blackfathom Deeps
english.objectives: Speak with Je'neu Sancrea.
english.description: The Naga mock us with their defiance. We will drive them and their allies out of this land for good.$B$BTravel north of here to Blackfathom Deeps and speak with Je'neu Sancrea. He's already made his way inside.$B$BBe wary of Zeya, by the way. She can be a bit...temperamental at times.
english.completion: Did Commander Grimfang send you? I've asked him to find suitable recruits to aid me here.

text.title: 雷霆斗技场！
text.objectives: 跟加基森的狄奥维奥博士谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿，朋友，想找刺激吗？冒险呢？金钱呢？暴力呢？$B$B好吧，你最好喜欢暴力，因为他们刚刚在加基森重新开放了雷霆斗技场。看着它长期荒废真叫人伤心，什么伤害诉讼啊，敲诈起诉啊，版权侵犯啊……但现在它回来了，就等着像你一样野蛮强壮的人进去，把最肮脏的对手放倒！$B$B到加基森去，找狄奥维奥博士报名。别忘了告诉你的朋友们！
text.completion: Another proud $c, lured by the promise of fame! Of wealth! Of VIOLENCE! Yes, welcome, friend. Welcome... to THUNDERDROME!

english.title: The Thunderdrome!
english.objectives: Talk to Doctor Dealwell in Gadgetzan.
english.description: Hey, friend, you interested in excitement? Adventure? Money? Violence?$B$BWell, you'd better like violence, because they just reopened the Thunderdrome in Gadgetzan. It was sad to see it unused for so long, what with the injury lawsuits, and the racketeering charges, and the copyright infringement... But it's back, and just waiting for burly, savage folk like you to enter and throw down with the foulest opponents ever!$B$BHead to Gadgetzan and talk to Dr. Dealwell to sign up. And tell your friends!
english.completion: Another proud $c, lured by the promise of fame! Of wealth! Of VIOLENCE! Yes, welcome, friend. Welcome... to THUNDERDROME!

text.objectives: 跟加基森的狄奥维奥博士谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿，朋友，想找刺激吗？冒险呢？金钱呢？暴力呢？$B$B好吧，你最好喜欢暴力，因为他们刚刚在加基森重新开放了雷霆斗技场。看着它长期荒废真叫人伤心，什么伤害诉讼啊，敲诈起诉啊，版权侵犯啊……但现在它回来了，就等着像你一样野蛮强壮的人进去，把最肮脏的对手放倒！$B$B到加基森去，找狄奥维奥博士报名。别忘了告诉你的朋友们！
text.completion: Another proud $c, lured by the promise of fame! Of wealth! Of VIOLENCE! Yes, welcome, friend. Welcome... to THUNDERDROME!

english.objectives: Talk to Doctor Dealwell in Gadgetzan.
english.description: Hey, friend, you interested in excitement? Adventure? Money? Violence?$B$BWell, you'd better like violence, because they just reopened the Thunderdrome in Gadgetzan. It was sad to see it unused for so long, what with the injury lawsuits, and the racketeering charges, and the copyright infringement... But it's back, and just waiting for burly, savage folk like you to enter and throw down with the foulest opponents ever!$B$BHead to Gadgetzan and talk to Dr. Dealwell to sign up. And tell your friends!
english.completion: Another proud $c, lured by the promise of fame! Of wealth! Of VIOLENCE! Yes, welcome, friend. Welcome... to THUNDERDROME!

text.title: 黑暗深渊
text.objectives: 与哨兵阿露温交谈。
text.description: Although our position is exposed, we are safe compared to our friends inside Blackfathom Deeps! They stand mere feet away from the most deadly Naga forces in the area. Speak with Sentinel Aluwyn and give them the aid they desperately need!
text.completion: Thank Elune you're here! We could use all the help we can get.

english.title: Blackfathom Deeps
english.objectives: Speak with Sentinel Aluwyn.
english.description: Although our position is exposed, we are safe compared to our friends inside Blackfathom Deeps! They stand mere feet away from the most deadly Naga forces in the area. Speak with Sentinel Aluwyn and give them the aid they desperately need!
english.completion: Thank Elune you're here! We could use all the help we can get.

text.title: 黑暗深渊
text.objectives: 与哨兵阿露温交谈。
text.description: 我为这些森林感到深深的担忧，$C。形势看来很严峻，但是我宁愿独自面对部落，也不愿眼睁睁看着他们砍伐森林。$B$B到西边的黑暗深渊里面去，找到哨兵阿露温。她是一位值得信赖的朋友，而且她需要帮助。$B$B就在我们说话的这会儿，佐拉姆加前哨站的兽人正在威胁着她的安全。如果他们占领了黑暗深渊，肯定会把所有树都砍倒，为他们的疯狂计划提供燃料。
text.completion: Thank Elune you're here! We could use all the help we can get.

english.title: Blackfathom Deeps
english.objectives: Speak with Sentinel Aluwyn.
english.description: I care deeply about these forests, $c. Things look grim here, but I would rather face the Horde alone than watch them hack and slash their way through the trees.$B$BTravel west to Blackfathom Deeps. Once you're inside, find Sentinel Aluwyn. She's a trusted friend in need of help.$B$BThe orcs in Zoram'gar Outpost threaten her position as we speak. If they take Blackfathom, they will surely cut every tree down to fuel their insanity.
english.completion: Thank Elune you're here! We could use all the help we can get.

text.title: 敌人的敌人就是……
text.objectives: Obtain the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
text.description: Cultists...sacrifice...power...$B$BEnemy...awaken...$B$BOld God...imprison...me...$B$BLord...Kelris...$B$BBring head...revenge...$B$BERADICATE!!!
text.progress: Revenge...reward...
text.completion: I spare your life for your help, $r. Leave now...before I change my...mind.
text.completed: Return to the Flaming Eradicator.
text.giverWindow: Get his head!

english.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
english.objectives: Obtain the head of Twilight Lord Kelris.
english.description: Cultists...sacrifice...power...$B$BEnemy...awaken...$B$BOld God...imprison...me...$B$BLord...Kelris...$B$BBring head...revenge...$B$BERADICATE!!!
english.progress: Revenge...reward...
english.completion: I spare your life for your help, $r. Leave now...before I change my...mind.
english.completed: Return to the Flaming Eradicator.
english.giverWindow: Get his head!

text.title: 阿迦玛甘
text.objectives: Find the Spirit of Agamaggan.
text.description: 我在这些扭曲的荆棘里感应到了一股具有极强力量的存在，$N。它的出现让整个地区都活跃了起来。$B$B它一定就是阿迦玛甘的灵魂！他曾是所有生命中的第一个，也是最强大的存在——野猪人狂热地崇拜他。$B$B是他的血，他为了在上古战争中拯救艾泽拉斯而做出的牺牲，才产生了这些在你眼前蜿蜒于大地上的藤蔓。$B$B如果有某种存在能够让野猪人恢复他们高贵的本性，那就只有他了。$B$B你必须找到他。

english.title: Agamaggan
english.objectives: Find the Spirit of Agamaggan.
english.description: I sense a being of immense power within these twisted thorns, $N. The entire area has come alive at its presence.$B$BIt must be the Spirit of Agamaggan! He was one of the first and most powerful beings to ever live - the Quilboar worship him fervently.$B$BAll the vines you see across the land are a result of his blood; of his sacrifice to save Azeroth in the War of the Ancients.$B$BIf there's any being that could steer the Quilboar towards their noble roots, it would be him.$B$BYou must seek him out.

text.title: 蝙蝠的粪便
text.objectives: 收集1堆沼泽蝙蝠的粪便。
text.description: 剃刀沼泽土生的蝙蝠会分泌一种十分特别的天然物质。它们粪便的恶臭似乎能让野猪人进入一种嗜杀的狂热状态——而这地方全是这股子味道！$B$B我要你找到蝙蝠洞，给我带一份合适的样本来。如果我们能逆转该效果，并制造出解毒剂来，或许就能够拯救野猪人。
text.progress: 啊，你回来了。你得到沼泽蝙蝠的粪便了吗?
text.completion: Well done! This is just what we need, $n.
text.completed: Return to Auld Stonespire.

english.title: Going, Going, Guano!
english.objectives: Extract 1 pile of Kraul Guano.
english.description: The bats native to Razorfen Kraul produce a very peculiar natural substance. Their guano's stench seems to send the Quilboar into a murderous frenzy - and this place reeks of it!$b$bI need you to find the bat cave, and bring me a suitable sample. If we can reverse the effects and produce an antidote, we may be able to save the Quilboar.
english.progress: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?
english.completion: Well done! This is just what we need, $n.
english.completed: Return to Auld Stonespire.

text.title: Get Back to Town Accepted Tracking Event

english.title: Get Back to Town Accepted Tracking Event

text.title: 进口商威利克斯
text.objectives: 护送进口商威利克斯前往剃刀沼泽入口。
text.description: 救援，可算到了！$B$B你根本不知道我在这里被关了多久，我都记不得上次看到外面是什么时候了。$B$B你瞧，我是一个企业家。常言道，一个铜子儿忙死英雄汉。我听到风声，猪嘴在市场上卖价高得离谱。我以为这件事情来得容易走得快。你也看出来了，我有点搞错了！$B$B总而言之，如果你能好心帮我离开这里，我不会让你白干的。
text.completion: 再谢你一次，朋友!我说过我是绝对不会吝啬的。$B$B
text.end: 帮助进口商威利克斯逃离剃刀沼泽
text.completed: Speak to Willix the Importer.

english.title: Willix the Importer
english.objectives: Escort Willix the Importer to the exit of Razorfen Kraul.
english.description: At last, help has arrived!$b$bYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.$b$bYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that pig snouts were selling outrageously high in the market. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!$b$bAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
english.completion: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.
english.end: Help Willix the Importer escape from Razorfen Kraul
english.completed: Speak to Willix the Importer.

text.title: Harnessing the Flames
text.objectives: Speak to Saripal Smolderbrew and learn Immolate, then cast Immolate 5 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: Few people, especially among our allies, truly understand the nature of the power we wield. They shun us for pursuing knowledge that they are too weak to use properly.$B$BLet me show you a conjuration that I find handy. This spell, called Immolate, sets your target aflame, causing damage immediately and over time. Use it well, $N, and your enemies will come to fear you.
text.completion: As you continue to gain power, return to me and I will teach you new spells and techniques.
text.completed: Return to Saripal Smolderbrew at Anvilmar.

english.completed: Return to Saripal Smolderbrew at Anvilmar.

text.title: 阿迦玛甘的授意
text.objectives: 拿到卡尔加·刺肋的精华。
text.description: 仔细听好，凡人。$B$B野猪人是我的孩子。我的血深深地流淌在这片土地上。$B$B卡尔加·刺肋把我的孩子们领入了黑暗，被天灾驱向疯狂。$B$B杀掉她，$N。杀掉她，让我的孩子们睁开眼睛。$B$B给野猪人一个机会，让他们恢复高贵的本性。让他们再次获得我的祝福。$B$B把她的精华带给我！！！$B$B
text.progress: <The Spirit of Agamaggan stares at you patiently.>
text.completion: Take this gift. You have earned my blessing this day.
text.completed: Return to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
text.giverWindow: Bring me her heart!!!

english.title: Agamaggan's Charge
english.objectives: Take Charlga Razorflank's heart.
english.description: Listen closely, mortal.$B$BThe Quilboar are my children. My blood runs deep in these lands.$B$BCharlga Razorflank has steered my children into darkness, driven into insanity by the Scourge.$B$BSlay her, $N. Slay her and open my childrens' eyes.$B$BGive the Quilboar the chance to return to their noble roots. Let them once more earn my blessing.$B$BBring me her heart!!!$B$B
english.progress: <The Spirit of Agamaggan stares at you patiently.>
english.completion: Take this gift. You have earned my blessing this day.
english.completed: Return to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
english.giverWindow: Bring me her heart!!!

text.title: 阿迦玛甘
text.objectives: 跟阿迦玛甘的灵魂谈一谈。
text.description: 我在这些扭曲的荆棘里感应到了一股具有极强力量的存在，$N。它的出现让整个地区都活跃了起来。$B$B它一定就是阿迦玛甘的灵魂！他曾是所有生命中的第一个，也是最强大的存在——野猪人狂热地崇拜他。$B$B是他的血，他为了在上古战争中拯救艾泽拉斯而做出的牺牲，才产生了这些在你眼前蜿蜒于大地上的藤蔓。$B$B如果有某种存在能够让野猪人恢复他们高贵的本性，那就只有他了。$B$B你必须找到他。
text.completion: I've been waiting for you to come here.
text.completed: Test
text.giverWindow: Seek him out.

english.title: Agamaggan
english.objectives: Talk to the Spirit of Agamaggan.
english.description: I sense a being of immense power within these twisted thorns, $N. The entire area has come alive at its presence.$B$BIt must be the Spirit of Agamaggan! He was one of the first and most powerful beings to ever live - the Quilboar worship him fervently.$B$BAll the vines you see across the land are a result of his blood; of his sacrifice to save Azeroth in the War of the Ancients.$B$BIf there's any being that could steer the Quilboar towards their noble roots, it would be him.$B$BYou must seek him out.
english.completion: I've been waiting for you to come here.
english.completed: Test
english.giverWindow: Seek him out.

text.title: 干掉他们！
text.objectives: Kill Aggem Thorncurse, Death Speaker Jargba, Overlord Ramtusk, and Agathelos the Raging.
text.description: Overlord Ramtusk and the Death's Head mobilize for war. It took many scouts' lives, but we have learned of the weapon they intend to use to overtake the rest of the Barrens.$B$BIt is known as Agathelos the Raging, an immense boar outfitted with heavy armor and force-fed the rage-inducing Kraul bat guano.$B$B$R, you must stop them before they take innocent lives!
text.completion: You've done well this day. Agathelos would have taken many lives in its fury.
text.completed: Return to Auld Stonespire.

english.title: Take Them Down!
english.objectives: Kill Aggem Thorncurse, Death Speaker Jargba, Overlord Ramtusk, and Agathelos the Raging.

It took many scouts' lives, but we have learned of the weapon they intend to use to overtake the rest of the Barrens.$B$BIt is known as Agathelos the Raging, an immense boar outfitted with heavy armor and force-fed the rage-inducing Kraul bat guano.$B$B$R, you must stop them before they take innocent lives!
english.completion: You've done well this day. Agathelos would have taken many lives in its fury.
english.completed: Return to Auld Stonespire.

text.title: 棘手
text.objectives: 跟奥尔德·石塔谈一谈。
text.description: 曼科里克的丧妻之怒引起了进一步的关注，$C。$B$B剃刀沼泽的野猪人比曼科里克所要想象得更为残忍，充满了仇恨。$B$B你应该到南边去，和我的老朋友奥尔德·石塔谈一谈。他致力于阻止他们，以免他们蹂躏这块本已虚弱不堪的土地。
text.completion: Only a veteran like you could brave the dangers lurking here.

english.title: Feeling Thorny
english.objectives: Speak to Auld Stonespire.
english.description: Mankrik's furor over his dead wife raises further concerns , $c.$B$BThe quilboar in Razorfen Kraul are far more ruthless and full of hatred than Mankrik could ever imagine.$B$BYou should travel south there and speak with my old friend Auld Stonespire. He works to put an end to their rampage before the land suffers more in its already weak condition.
english.completion: Only a veteran like you could brave the dangers lurking here.

text.title: 石之碎片
text.objectives: 调查密斯莱尔碎片。
text.description: 上古石柱遍布这片土地。元素滋生于附近，保护着它们。$B$B这些地方都蕴含着强大的力量，其中最厉害的在落锤镇的西边。那里无人打扰，但你若是独自前往，可以听到大地本身的低语。$B$B我已经很久没有来这里看看了……可我们的步兵告诉我低语声再度响了起来。你能替我去查查吗？看看石头是不是还在说话？
text.completion: Help...

english.title: The Stone Shards
english.objectives: Investigate the Shards of Myzrael.
english.description: Ancient stones are strewn across this land. The elements flock to them, surrounding them protectively.$B$BThese are sites of great power, and the largest is just west of Hammerfall. Not a soul trespasses, but if you go there alone, you can hear whispers from the earth itself.$B$BI have not visited there in a long while... but our grunts have told me the whispers have started again. Would you look for me? Will you see if the stones still speak?
english.completion: Help...

text.title: 风蚀的信件
text.objectives: 阅读风蚀的信件，然后与北郡山谷中的阿什莉·布兰克交谈。
text.description: 有人把这封信交给我，说是等你消灭黑石间谍之后立即交给你，$N。信封上盖着阿什莉·布兰克的印记，她是这里的猎人训练师。如果我是你的话肯定会毫不犹豫的先看看这信里写了些什么，再去做别的事情。
text.progress: Hello, $n. Is there something I can do for you?
text.completion: So you received my note? Excellent. You've proven yourself quite capable in dealing with those orcs. As you continue to grow in power, I will teach you some new techniques.
text.giverWindow: Ashley Blank can be found just east of Marshal McBride.

english.title: Etched Letter
english.objectives: Read the Etched Letter and speak to Ashley Blank in Northshire Valley.
english.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Ashley Blank, our local hunter trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
english.progress: Hello, $n. Is there something I can do for you?
english.completion: So you received my note? Excellent. You've proven yourself quite capable in dealing with those orcs. As you continue to grow in power, I will teach you some new techniques.
english.giverWindow: Ashley Blank can be found just east of Marshal McBride.

text.title: 密斯莱尔的传说
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地落锤镇的萨鲁克。
text.description: 石头终于安静了下来，但你却隐约感觉到了一股不安。有什么不对劲。$B$B也许你应该把目前的发现告诉斯奎尔图。
text.completion: I know, $n. I should not have sent you. Forgive me... the whispers of the past are sometimes too strong.

english.title: Myzrael's Tale
english.objectives: Return to Zaruk at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: As the stone goes quiet, you're left with a vague sense of unease. Something isn't right.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Zaruk of what you've done so far.
english.completion: I know, $n. I should not have sent you. Forgive me... the whispers of the past are sometimes too strong.

text.title: 被释放的公主
text.objectives: 在密斯莱尔水晶碎块处召唤并打败密斯莱尔。
text.description: 密斯莱尔是个欺诈者。她自上古时代就被封印在此，绝不能被释放出来。$B$B你到第一次同她交谈的密斯莱尔碎片那里面对她。用这个卷轴把她召唤出来，当她完全来到地面时，打败她。从她身上拿到怪异镣铐，将它们放在碎片周围以便将其再一次地绑定在那里。$B$B祝你好运，$N……愿我过去的麻烦不再滋扰你。
text.progress: 现在，密斯赖尔水晶裂片出奇地安静。
text.completion: 你把怪异镣铐放置在水晶裂片周围。从地下很深的地方传来可怕的尖叫声，紧接着传来的是一声怒吼。$B$B密斯赖尔水晶裂片再也没有那种曾经有过的温暖安适的感觉了。现在，它们越来越猛烈地震动着……就像是有一种潜藏在地下的怨怒即将冲破地表一样。$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Shards of Myzrael in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: Set her free... then destroy her.

english.title: The Princess Unleashed
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael.
english.description: Myzrael is a deceiver. She is an ancient force sealed long ago, and must be kept that way.$B$BYou must confront her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Summon her with this scroll, and when she has been fully brought to the surface, defeat her. Then take the Eldritch Shackles from her body and place them on the Shards to keep her fully bound once more.$B$BGood luck, $n... may my past trouble you no more.
english.progress: The Shards of Myzrael are now strangely quiet.
english.completion: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below.  The scream is followed by a roar. The Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did.  Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
english.completed: Return to the Shards of Myzrael in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Set her free... then destroy her.

text.title: Charging into Battle
text.objectives: Speak to Llane Bershere and purchase the Charge ability, then practice using Charge on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
text.description: Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to show you a new combat technique -- charge. As a warrior, it's important to use every advantage at your disposal to get the upper hand in battle.$B$BWhat better way to do that than by charging into battle and stunning your opponent? I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to go try it on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: You're a quick learner, $n. Return to me as you grow stronger and I'll show you other combat techniques.
text.completed: Return to Llane Bershere in the Hall of Arms at Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 自燃
text.objectives: Speak to Drusilla La Salle and purchase the Immolate ability, then practice casting Immolate 5 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
text.description: We must take care in how we speak around the abbey and its environs, but don't let that deter you from the path of power.$B$BI want to show you one of my favorite spells. It will allow you to set an opponent on fire, damaging the enemy immediately and continuing to do more harm over time.  I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to go try it on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: I see you have already mastered Immolation! I look forward to instructing you in the future. Do not forget to return for further lessons as you grow in power.
text.completed: Return to Drusilla La Salle outside Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 最致命的攻击
text.objectives: Speak to Jorik Kerridan and purchase the Eviscerate ability, then find a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey and practice Eviscerate 3 times.
text.description: By now, you know the basics of combat as rogue, but I want to teach you a new skill. As rogues, we are renowned for our ability to execute chains of combat techniques, often saving the most powerful strikes for the end.$B$BLet me show you the basics of Eviscerate. After using Sinister Strike a few times, you can attack with Eviscerate to hit your opponent even harder. I want you to go try it on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: You've caught on quickly, $n, and a quick mind will serve you well. Return to me as you grow in power and I will show you new techniques.
text.completed: Return to Jorik Kerridan outside Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 掌控奥术
text.objectives: Speak to Khelden Bremen and purchase the Arcane Missiles ability, then practice casting Arcane Missiles 2 times on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
text.description: As a mage, you will learn a variety of spells as your understanding grows. I want to show you a new technique that allows you to launch volleys of arcane energy at your opponent, Arcane Missiles. You won't be able to cast this spell all the time, but each time you cast another spell, there's a chance you'll create an opening to use Arcane Missiles.  I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to go try it on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: Have you mastered the use of Arcane Missiles already? You are a quick study in the arcane arts and you have a promising future ahead. Don't forget to return to me for training as you grow in power.
text.completed: Return to Khelden Bremen in the Library Wing of Northshire Abbey.

text.objectives: Speak to Ashley Blank and purchase the Steady Shot ability, then find a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
text.description: I've heard about your help in clearing out some of the orcs. You've shown that you can handle yourself in combat.$B$BI want to show you a new skill.  I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to go try it on one of the training dummies south of the entrance to the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: I knew you would master Steady Shot quickly. I'm looking forward to showing you other techniques as you get more experienced in the ways of the $c.
text.completed: Return to Ashley Blank outside Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 圣光之力
text.objectives: Speak to Brother Sammuel and purchase the Seal of Righteousness and Judgement abilities. Cast Seal of Righteousness on yourself and then use Judgement on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
text.description: I want to teach you a couple of techniques for using the Light's power to boost your combat skills.$B$BThe first technique is applying the Seal of Righteousness. While under the effects of the seal, all of your melee attacks will inflict additional holy damage.$B$BThe second ability, Judgement, can be use periodically to unleash the seal's power and inflict damage.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: You're a quick learner, $n. Return to me as you grow stronger and I'll teach you more about using the Light to vanquish your enemies and strengthen your allies.
text.completed: Return to Brother Sammuel inside the Hall of Arms at Northshire Abbey.

text.title: Healing the Wounded
text.objectives: Speak to Priestess Anetta and purchase the Flash Heal ability, then use Flash Heal 5 times to treat Wounded Trainees inside Northshire Abbey.
text.description: One of your responsibilities as a priest is caring for the wounded. With the power of the Light, you can save those who would otherwise die and speed the healing of wounds.$B$BI want to teach you a simple, quick technique you can use to heal an ally quickly.$B$B I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to use this spell to treat the injuries of wounded trainees around the abbey.
text.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
text.completion: You're a quick learner, $n, and the wounded are fortunate to have your aid. Return to me as you grow stronger and I'll teach you other spells.
text.completed: Return to Priestess Anetta inside Northshire Abbey.

english.title: Healing the Wounded
english.objectives: Speak to Priestess Anetta and purchase the Flash Heal ability, then use Flash Heal 5 times to treat Wounded Trainees inside Northshire Abbey.
english.description: One of your responsibilities as a priest is caring for the wounded. With the power of the Light, you can save those who would otherwise die and speed the healing of wounds.$B$BI want to teach you a simple, quick technique you can use to heal an ally quickly.$B$B I'll show you how it's done, and then I want you to use this spell to treat the injuries of wounded trainees around the abbey.
english.progress: Well, did you give it a try?
english.completion: You're a quick learner, $n, and the wounded are fortunate to have your aid. Return to me as you grow stronger and I'll teach you other spells.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Anetta inside Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 安多哈尔之战
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城里的库尔迪拉·织亡者报告。
text.description: 快，$N……没时间浪费了。$B$B安多哈尔城正处于三方混战，被遗忘者、联盟，还有天灾军团。希尔瓦娜斯女士已经派她最精良的一名死亡骑士上前线督阵，但我敢肯定他肯定不介意多些人手帮忙。阿尔萨斯死后，被遗忘者夺取安多哈尔的最好时机已经来临了。$B$B你准备好了以后就去找蝙蝠管理员提摩西·卡宁汉，他会把你送上头趟航班。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Hurry, $N... there isn't time to waste.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  Lady Sylvanas has sent one of her best death knights to lead the charge for her cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.  With Arthas dead, now is the perfect time for the Forsaken to take Andorhal.$b$bSpeak with the bat handler, Timothy Cunningham, when you are ready, and he will put you on the first flight out there.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 先是天灾……再是联盟
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城里的15名枯骨天灾战士。
text.description: 诅咒教派的黑暗院长加丁率领天灾军团进攻安多哈尔。我的老对头，萨萨里安指挥着联盟部队。若想拿下安多哈尔，我们得把他们都打败，但兵分两路必不能成事。$B$B我很了解萨萨里安，他会先对付天灾军团。我们也一样。$B$B先把天灾军团的寡兵弱将干掉，减少它们的兵力。联盟可以稍后再来对付。
text.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Scourge First... Alliance Later
english.objectives: Slay 15 Desiccated Scourge within Andorhal.
english.description: Darkmaster Gandling of the Cult of the Damned leads the Scourge offensive here in Andorhal.  My old counterpart, Thassarian, leads the Alliance forces.  If we're to win Andorhal, we'll have to defeat both, but we will certainly fail if we take on both at once.$b$bI know Thassarian well enough to know that he will focus on the Scourge first.  We will do the same.$b$bTake out the weaker, desiccated Scourge to reduce their numbers.  The Alliance will have to wait to taste our wrath.
english.completion: You may not act quickly, but at least you do not fail me. Very well.  I will have a more important task for you, $n, when the time is right.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 源源不绝
text.objectives: 用杰尔的手榴弹消灭5具拾骨狂战士，摧毁天灾骨堆法阵。
text.description: 召唤者阿拉基单单用骷髅来给天灾军团固防……这支军队贵多不贵精。他在安多哈尔北塔中架设了骨堆法阵，正以惊人的速度暴骷髅。但我自有妙计！$B$B<杰尔交给你一大把手榴弹。>$B$B很简单的。把手榴弹朝骨堆法阵扔过去……或者，你也可以丢到一堆骷髅当中……就能把它们炸成齑粉。
text.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  Even as a member of the Royal Apothecary Society, I recognize that some problems are not solved by throwing more plague at them.
text.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Endless Flow
english.objectives: Use Jearl's Hand Grenades to kill 5 Stickbone Berserkers and to destroy a Scourge Bone Animus.
english.description: Araj the Summoner is bolstering the Scourge defenses with simple skeletons... an army of weaklings that will overwhelm you before it overpowers you.  He has assembled animi within Andorhal's northern towers that spew these skeletons out at an alarming rate.  But I've got the solution!$b$b<Jearl passes you a handful of grenades.>$b$bTheir function is simple.  Throwing these grenades at a bone animus... or, for that matter, a mob of skeletons... will reduce them to splinters.
english.completion: These grenades are all explosives, nothing more.  Even as a member of the Royal Apothecary Society, I recognize that some problems are not solved by throwing more plague at them.
english.completed: Return to Jearl Donald at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战争机器
text.objectives: 摧毁安多哈尔的6具缝腹巨怪。
text.description: 你们这些蠢货，放着那些憎恶一辈子也别想打赢天灾军团。库尔迪拉尽扯些什么此消彼长的淡话——天灾军团在安多哈尔最好的武器就是这些将亡灵卫兵玩弄于股掌间的大家伙。$B$B我可不吃这套，$N，上战场给我把那些怪物干掉。
text.completion: With the behemoths out of the way, our victory against the Scourge is inevitable. Our current chances against the Alliance aren't quite as favorable... but that's no concern of yours.  Not yet, anyhow.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: War Machines
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Opengut Behemoths in Andorhal.
english.description: You fools will never defeat the Scourge with those abominations running around.  Koltira blathers on about reducing their numbers, but the Scourge's best weapon here in Andorhal can be found in those lumbering brutes that are throwing my deathguards around like ragdolls.$b$bI won't have it.  $N, enter the battlefield and destroy those monsters.
english.completion: With the behemoths out of the way, our victory against the Scourge is inevitable. Our current chances against the Alliance aren't quite as favorable... but that's no concern of yours.  Not yet, anyhow.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 通灵学院
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城内的黑暗院长加丁。
text.description: 通灵学院是天灾在索多里尔河西岸少数的几个据点之一。通灵学院的院长，名唤黑暗院长加丁的邪教徒，最近亲临战场。$B$B这将是他犯下的最后一个错误。$B$B你可以在镇子南头的一个广场上找到加丁，去同他交手，我会帮你把他干掉的。
text.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

english.title: Scholomancer
english.objectives: Kill Darkmaster Gandling within Andorhal.
english.description: The Scholomance is one of the few Scourge holdouts remaining west of the Thondroril.  The headmaster of Scholomance, a cultist by the name of Darkmaster Gandling, has made an appearance on the battlefield.$b$bThis will be his final mistake.$b$bYou will find Gandling in a square near the southern end of town.  I want you to fight and weaken Gandling.  I will join you to help finish him off.
english.completion: Excellently done, $n.  And now, with the leader of the Scourge forces eliminated from Andorhal, we bide our time.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Master of the Scholomance, leader of the Scourge in Andorhal.

text.title: 召唤者阿拉基
text.objectives: 杀掉召唤者阿拉基。你可以用杰尔的手榴弹消灭拾骨狂战士。
text.description: 骨堆法阵被摧毁之后，下一步就是要对付阿拉基本人了。他出没于城镇中心的喷泉附近，说不定你已经见过他了。$B$B带上我的手榴弹，它们对付不了阿拉基，但是如果他打算召唤骷髅，你可以把它们再炸回去。
text.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
text.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  The Royal Apothecary Society has done its part.  As have you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

english.title: Araj the Summoner
english.objectives: Kill Araj the Summoner.  You may use Jearl's Hand Grenades to destroy Stickbone Berserkers.
english.description: With the animus destroyed, the next logical step is to take out Araj himself, and to take a shard of his phylactery.  You've probably already seen him, lurking at the fountain in the center of town.$b$bTake my grenades with you.  They won't do anything to Araj, but if he decides to summon any of those skeletons, you can use them to blow them away.  Again.
english.progress: Araj is a formidable opponent.  Be prepared.
english.completion: Araj dead... this is good.  The Royal Apothecary Society has done its part.  As have you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Remember, use my grenades to take care of his skeletons!

text.title: 暂时的胜利
text.objectives: 到提瑞斯法林地的亡灵壁垒去，向高级执行官德灵顿报到。
text.description: 被遗忘者大获全胜，我们依然兵强马壮。按正常的战略来讲，趁联盟还在恢复元气，我们现在就该打它个出其不意。但是，我另有计较……$B$B我们按兵不动。等时机成熟，再对萨萨里安进行攻击。与此同时，你要与朗达·莫维尔交谈，飞往瘟疫之地西部边境的亡灵壁垒，在那里高级执行官德灵顿会告诉你下一步该怎么做。$B$B等安多哈尔需要你时我自会派人找你。
text.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, the Forsaken has cemented its foothold in Lordaeron.
text.completed: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Victory, For Now
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: The Forsaken are victorious, and our forces are still strong.  Military strategy dictates that we attack the Alliance now, while they are recovering and unaware.  I have other plans, however...$b$bWe will wait.  We attack Thassarian and his troops when the time is right.  In the meantime, speak with Rhonda Molver and take a flight to the Bulwark, on the Plaguelands' western border.  High Executor Derrington will give you your next assignment.$b$bYou will hear from me when you are needed again in Andorhal.
english.completion: Word arrived shortly before you did, $n.  With the Scourge ejected from Andorhal, the Forsaken has cemented its foothold in Lordaeron.
english.completed: Report to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 突然，鱼人来了！
text.objectives: 跟凯娜莉·桶杯谈一谈。
text.description: 穴居人在替狗头人干活，而狗头人在替豺狼人干活。豺狼人一定是从湿地迁徙过来的。$B$B我怎么知道的？是这样，他们带来了朋友，因为洛克湖里到处都是以前从未出现过的蓝腮鱼人。$B$B害虫就是害虫，但这种利害关系让人担忧。我要你去和凯娜莉·桶杯谈一谈。她是这里最好的猎人之一，她知道如何对付鱼人，如果你能让她把酒杯子搁下的话。
text.completion: Murlocs? Sure, I've hunted murlocs.$B$BAnd every single stinkin' one of them deserved what they got! You hear me?

english.title: Suddenly, Murlocs!
english.objectives: Speak with Cannary Caskshot.
english.description: So we've got troggs working for kobolds, and kobolds working for gnolls. The gnolls must've moved in from the Wetlands.$B$BHow do I know? Well, they brought friends, because what's left of the Loch is swarming with Bluegill murlocs that were never there before.$B$BPests are pests, but this coordination is worrying. I need you to talk to Cannary Caskshot. She's one of the best hunters in these parts, and she'll know how to handle murlocs, if you can pull her away from her mug long enough.
english.completion: Murlocs? Sure, I've hunted murlocs.$B$BAnd every single stinkin' one of them deserved what they got! You hear me?

text.title: 闻起来像是个计划
text.objectives: 从洛克湖的蓝腮鱼人身上获得7副鱼人臭腺。
text.description: 鱼人和豺狼人同流合污？太好笑了！现在，光杀掉他们是没有用的。混账东西实在太多了。$B$B但瞧，我有一个计划，用老办法。这些鱼人，他们有种味道，什么东西沾上了，让别的鱼人闻到，就能让他们发狂！对他们而言是相当不错的鱼饵。$B$B总之，他们有一种小小的腺体会散发那个味道。你得去给我弄些来。
text.progress: Now don't you stink all to high hell! I'm assumin' that's because of the murlocs, but it's hard to tell.
text.completion: Phew! Ain't that a stench.$B$BNow you prepare yourself, because I'm about to wow you with what's left of my mental faculties.
text.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Smells Like A Plan
english.objectives: Collect 7 Murloc Scent Glands from any Bluegill Murloc in The Loch.
english.description: Murlocs workin' with gnolls? That's a laugh! Now, just killin' them won't get you anywhere. Too many of the buggers.$B$BBut I've got a plan, usin' the old noggin, see. Those murlocs, they have this smell, they get that smell on stuff, and when another murloc smells it, they go all crazy! Makes great bait for 'em.$B$BAnyway, they've got little glands that have that smell in 'em. You go and get me a bunch of those.
english.progress: Now don't you stink all to high hell! I'm assumin' that's because of the murlocs, but it's hard to tell.
english.completion: Phew! Ain't that a stench.$B$BNow you prepare yourself, because I'm about to wow you with what's left of my mental faculties.
english.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 一群鳄鱼
text.objectives: 获得6块鳄鱼颌骨。
text.description: 你在外头四处奔波，忙活自己事情的时候，是否介意帮我一个忙？$B$B瞧，我以前时常会到洛克湖边去猎鳄鱼，但现在，呃，出于某些原因，我这边抽不出时间。你真有礼貌，没对我的胡说八道发火，谢谢！$B$B看你这位$G绅士:女士;这么好，为什么不帮我弄一些鳄鱼颌骨来呢，作为回报，我会给你些还算是不错的报酬。
text.progress: So did you get those crocolisk things or did I make that up?
text.completion: Mighty kind of you to help out an ol' fool like me. Here's your reward as promised an' all.
text.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: A Load of Croc
english.objectives: Collect 6 Crocolisk Jaws.
english.description: Now while you're runnin' around doin' whatever the heck it is that you do, would you mind helpin' me out a bit?$B$BSee, I usually go out huntin' crocolisks down in the loch, but given certain circumstances, I'd rather sit here right now. Mighty polite of you not to give me grief over it, thanks!$B$BSo seein' as how you're such a $ggentleman:lady;, why don't you bring me back some crocolisk jaws and I'll give you some mostly-clean money in return.
english.progress: So did you get those crocolisk things or did I make that up?
english.completion: Mighty kind of you to help out an ol' fool like me. Here's your reward as promised an' all.
english.completed: Return to Cannary Caskshot at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 追杀十字军
text.objectives: 侦查西瘟疫之地费尔斯通农场东边的血色十字军营地。
text.description: 我们的胜利步步在望，$N。长期迫害被遗忘者的血色十字军，如今也是日暮残阳。尽管他们还盘踞在提瑞斯法的修道院里，可不管是壁炉谷，还是远至东边的提尔之手均已收复。$B$B就在上个星期，报告说血色十字军在费尔斯通农场东边的一个小营地里有所活动，但我有理由相信他们也被消灭了。到那儿帮我去证实一下这个消息。
text.completion: Burning bodies?  No survivors?  I guessed correctly. All the better!  We're better off without the Scarlet taint upon Lordaeron.  They epitomized all the worst things about humans.
text.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: After the Crusade
english.objectives: Scout the Scarlet Crusade camp located east of Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Our victories are quickly piling up, $N.  The Scarlet Crusade, which has long persecuted the Forsaken, is on its last legs.  While they still hold their monastery here in Tirisfal, they no longer occupy Hearthglen, or Tyr's Hand, far to the east.$b$bAs recently as last week, there have been reports of Scarlet Crusade activity at a small camp east of Felstone Field, but I have reason to believe that they too have been eliminated.  Travel there, and verify this information for me.
english.completion: Burning bodies?  No survivors?  I guessed correctly. All the better!  We're better off without the Scarlet taint upon Lordaeron.  They epitomized all the worst things about humans.
english.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 狐狸和猎犬
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地杀死4名联盟猎狐人、4条斗牛猎犬，以及4只白尾狐。
text.description: 联盟在瘟疫之地如入无人之境，好像这儿是他们的一样。决不！这片土地正当归属于黑暗女王！$B$B安多哈尔之战接近尾声，占据瘟疫之地的联盟部队也一团散沙。东边就有一些，正在打狐狸。叫他们明白这是被遗忘者的领土。$B$B把猎人杀了，把猎犬杀了。把他们猎的狐狸也给杀了，算是搭头。
text.completion: It's a relief to have those hunters out of the way.  We're not done killing Alliance, however...
text.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Foxes and Hounds
english.objectives: Kill 4 Alliance Fox Hunters, 4 Bullmastiffs, and 4 Whitetail Foxes in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: These Alliance forces walk around the Plaguelands like they own the place.  Well, they don't!  This land rightfully belongs to the Dark Lady!$b$bAs the battle for Andorhal drew to a close, the Alliance forces occupying the Plaguelands scattered.  Several of them can be found just east of here, hunting foxes.  Prove to them that this is Forsaken territory.$b$bKill the hunters.  Kill their hunting dogs.  And kill the foxes they hunt, for good measure.
english.completion: It's a relief to have those hunters out of the way.  We're not done killing Alliance, however...
english.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 秃鹫滚开
text.objectives: 杀死8只洛克鹫。
text.description: 巨石水坝决堤的时候，把附近的湖水都排干了。可怕的生态灾害。$B$B你别以为就和我们矮人没关系！我们不仅断绝了渔获，满地死亡的蛇颈龙还在太阳暴晒下腐烂。秃鹫闻风而来，也把各种疾病和污染传播到了镇郊。$B$B我不可能叫你把它统统打扫干净，但至少你能不能将秃鹫干掉？就算杀掉几只也是好的。
text.completion: That should help prevent disease and illness from spreading into our remaining water. Many thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

english.title: Buzz Off
english.objectives: Kill 8 Loch Buzzards.
english.description: When the Stonewrought Dam burst, it drained near the entire loch. Horrible ecological devastation.$B$BAnd don't you go thinking it didn't really affect us dwarves! Not only are we plumb out of fish, but there's acres of dead threshadons out there left to rot in the sun. The buzzards are after them, and they're spreading all manner of filth and disease right on the outskirts of town.$B$BI can't ask you to clean it all up, but could you deal with the buzzards? Killin' even just a few will help.
english.completion: That should help prevent disease and illness from spreading into our remaining water. Many thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mountaineer Kadrell at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: 敌人第一
text.objectives: 消灭费尔斯通农场里的9名联盟劳工。
text.description: 在费尔斯通农场里耕地的不是什么农夫，是士兵。$B$B萨萨里安的部队需要粮草，所以他派部分联盟的人从安多哈尔北上，兵屯费尔斯通农场。安多哈尔之战或许结束了，但另一场战争又在酝酿……被遗忘者对人类的战争。消灭那些费尔斯通的士兵，这会给黑暗女王的部队带来决定性的优势。
text.completion: Ha ha!  I hope that they come back as zombies.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Foes Before Hoes
english.objectives: Kill 9 Alliance Laborers on Felstone Field.
english.description: The men who till Felstone Field are no farmers.  They're soldiers.$b$bThassarian's forces needed food, so he sent some of the Alliance north from Andorhal, to tend Felstone Field.  The battle for Andorhal may be over, but another battle looms... Forsaken versus human.  Killing those soldiers that work at Felstone will give the Dark Lady's forces a decided advantage.
english.completion: Ha ha!  I hope that they come back as zombies.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 潜在疾病
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地消灭生病的黑熊，然后采集20团长在它们尸体旁的疫病之团。
text.description: 我需要瘟疫草来……来作实验。可是，银色黎明和可恶的塞纳里奥德鲁伊把瘟疫之地治疗了个差不离，我不走远点儿根本找不到合适的样本。$B$B好在有些当地的野生动物还残留着瘟疫感染。杀死一只生病的黑熊，把长在它腐烂尸体旁的植株收集起来。不是最好的办法，不过聊胜于无。
text.progress: Animal tissue holds onto disease so much better than plant tissue, doesn't it?
text.completion: Glorious!  This is the last bit I need. Actually, stick around, $n.  Let me tell you a little bit more about our plan.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Latent Disease
english.objectives: Kill Diseased Black Bears in Western Plaguelands, then loot 20 Plague Tangles that grow near their corpses.
english.description: I need plagued grass for an... an experiment, of sorts.  Those Argent Crusaders and those infernal Cenarion druids have done too good a job of healing the plaguelands, however... and I can't find proper reagents within a reasonable walking distance.$b$bSome of the local wildlife retain the plague's touch, however.  Kill a diseased black bear, then retrieve the grass that grows where its decaying body lies.  It's not optimal, but it'll do.
english.progress: Animal tissue holds onto disease so much better than plant tissue, doesn't it?
english.completion: Glorious!  This is the last bit I need. Actually, stick around, $n.  Let me tell you a little bit more about our plan.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Dithers at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 北山伐木场
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地北山伐木场的纳萨尼尔·杜马报告。
text.description: 我们不是瘟疫之地唯一的银色黎明十字军。我们的总部壁炉谷，位于北方。再稍近一点地方有一座我们控制的小伐木场。$B$B纳萨尼尔·杜马是那里的主要联系人。我希望你能和他谈谈，他应该就在林子里。
text.completion: Welcome to Northridge, $c.
text.completed: Report to Nathaniel Dumah at the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Northridge Lumber Mill
english.objectives: Report to Nathaniel Dumah at the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: We are not the only Argent Crusaders here in the plaguelands.  Our headquarters, Hearthglen, lies to the north.  Even nearer to the north is a small lumber mill which we also control.$b$bNathaniel Dumah is my main contact at the lumber mill.  I encourage you to speak with him, should you find yourself in that part of the woods.
english.completion: Welcome to Northridge, $c.
english.completed: Report to Nathaniel Dumah at the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 光是死还不够
text.objectives: 杀死8名联盟劳工，让归降的瓦格里将他们变为被遗忘者。
text.description: 德灵顿和他的人不知道，就是我下令污染费尔斯通农场的。我们需要这片地区来进行实践操作。要想赢得安多哈尔的战争，那么我们就必须借助最新式、最牢靠的武器：$B$B瓦格里。$B$B把我那归降的瓦格里带上，$N，把那些还留在费尔斯通傻呵呵的联盟渣滓杀掉。一旦他们死了，她就可以把他们作为我们的一员……带回阳间。$B$B被遗忘者生生不息！
text.completion: I am able to communicate with you through the Val'kyr, $n.  You have done well. Remain on Felstone Field.  We must now teach these newly-converted Forsaken how to fight.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: When Death is Not Enough
english.objectives: Kill 8 Alliance Laborers on Felstone Field so your Enthralled Val'kyr can convert them into Forsaken.
english.description: Derrington and his men don't know it, but it was I who ordered the plaguing of Felstone Field.  We need this area for practice.  If we're to win this war for Andorhal, we need to use our newest, most versatile weapon:$b$bVal'kyr.$b$bTake my enthralled val'kyr with you, $N, and kill the simpering Alliance scum that remain on Felstone.  Once they are dead, she will bring them back to this world... as one of us.$b$bThe Forsaken shall not die out!
english.completion: I am able to communicate with you through the Val'kyr, $n.  You have done well. Remain on Felstone Field.  We must now teach these newly-converted Forsaken how to fight.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 战斗训练
text.objectives: 使用归降的瓦格里的战斗的召唤技能集结费尔斯通农场中5名被遗忘者步兵。然后杀死费尔斯通谷仓里的缝腹憎恶。
text.description: 瓦格里的天性就是服从，而这一只服从于你。我现在让你可以全面控制她，$N。$B$B在农场外围，你可以找到刚被你转化的被遗忘者。我要你用瓦格里至少集结五个。一旦完成，带上你的新建小分队，到费尔斯通的谷仓那儿，杀掉里面的畜牲。今天，他们要学习的是为黑暗女王作战的意义。
text.completion: When Koltira gives his word, I will bring these val'kyr into Andorhal.  We will win.  And yet another piece of Lordaeron will fall to the might of the Forsaken.
text.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Combat Training
english.objectives: Use your Enthralled Val'kyr's Call to Arms ability to mobilize 5 Forsaken Troopers on Felstone Field.  Then slay the Opengut Abomination inside Felstone's barn.
english.description: A val'kyr's only purpose is to serve, and this one serves you.  I am now giving you full control over her abilities, $N.$b$bRoaming around the farm's outskirts, you should find several of the Forsaken that you just created.  I want you to use your val'kyr to gather at least five of them.  Once you have done so, take your newly-formed band of soldiers, bring them into Felstone's barn, and kill the beast inside.  Today, they will learn what it means to fight for the Dark Lady.
english.completion: When Koltira gives his word, I will bring these val'kyr into Andorhal.  We will win.  And yet another piece of Lordaeron will fall to the might of the Forsaken.
english.completed: Return to Lindsay Ravensun at the Charred Outpost in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 地龙特攻队
text.objectives: 杀死粘性辐射尘。
text.description: 你怎么跑到这里来的？$B$B哦，无所谓。我是侏儒战队的莫多克。我们是精锐中的精锐，誓要夺回诺莫瑞根！$B$B在无人可用的情况下，大工匠找到并雇用了我们。$B$B但我们无法独自完成任务！你现在是地龙特攻队的荣誉特种兵了，$N。$B$B拿着这包降落伞，直接跳到下面的齿轮大厅里去，干掉粘性辐射尘。完成这个任务之后，到西边的走廊去找特种兵“坏脾气”巴拉克斯报告。我敢说，你们两个肯定很合得来。
text.completion: I hope that wasn't too much for you. The mission is far from over!
text.completed: Report to Commando B.E Barechus.

english.title: The G-Team
english.objectives: Kill the Viscous Fallout.
english.description: How did you get in here?$B$BOh, it doesn't matter. I'm Murd Doc of the G-Team. We're the best there is, and we're here to retake Gnomeregan!$B$BWhen nobody else could help him, the High Tinker found and hired us.$B$BBut we simply can't do this alone! You're an honorary G-Team Commando now, $N.$B$BTake this parachute, jump down straight ahead into the Hall of Gears, and kill the Viscous Fallout. After you're done, report to Commando B.E Barechus by the west hallway. You two will get along great, I'm sure.
english.completion: I hope that wasn't too much for you. The mission is far from over!
english.completed: Report to Commando B.E Barechus.

text.title: 奥术飞弹
text.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Rhyanda. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using Arcane Missiles twice.
text.description: We are the heirs to a legacy of arcane magic and your path will not be an easy one. Many still hold us responsible for the actions of our forebears, but our talents are needed.$B$BI want to show you a new spell, Arcane Missiles. It allows you to fire volleys of arcane energy, but you won't be able to cast it all the time. Casting other spells has a chance to create an opportunity for you to use Arcane Missiles.$B$BI want you try it. Look for a training dummy near the southeastern edge of Aldrassil.
text.completion: I knew you would master this lesson quickly. You are a credit to the highborn and to all our kin. Remember, as you grow in power, return to me and will instruct you further.
text.completed: Return to Rhyanda in Aldrassil.

english.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Rhyanda. Look for a Training Dummy near, and practice using Arcane Missiles twice.
