The earth flowers, the trees grow tall and green, and the wildlife is beginning to return.  Yet a few remnants of undeath remain.$b$bWhile the trees and grass prosper, the animals are struggling.  Something is preventing them from healing, and I intend to find out what.  Bring me samples from the plagued wildlife so that I may study them more closely.
english.progress: Once the animals are healed, our duties here will be nearly complete.
english.completion: This will be more than enough, $n.  Now, I will need some time to perform my studies.
english.completed: Return to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 熟能生巧
text.objectives: 骑上一匹壁炉谷野马前往北山伐木场，用它的嘶鸣技能吓跑25只北山蜘蛛。
text.description: 啊，能回到北山可真好！我的伐木场，我漂亮的老婆，还有活蹦乱跳的胖儿子……我都把银色黎明十字军给忘了。得给提里奥提供木材支援。$B$B我的伐木工尽心尽力，可直到蜘蛛出现。现在他们都不敢往林子深处去了。$B$B也许你可以帮助我。骑我的马去把蜘蛛吓走。但愿我们能和平解决这件事。
text.completion: Well, it sounds like they're certainly afraid of the mustang, but they're not leaving for good.  I can't have you running around on a horse forever.  Nor do I think you'd want to. Fine.  Bloodshed it is.
text.completed: Return to Nathaniel Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Learning the Ropes
english.objectives: Mount a Hearthglen Mustang at Northridge Lumber Mill, then use its Whinny ability to frighten 25 Northridge Spiders.
english.description: Ah, it's good to be back in Northridge!  I've got my mill, my beautiful wife, a bouncing baby boy... I've even put in my hat with the Argent Crusade.  We'll be supplying Tirion's forces with lumber.$b$bMy lumberjacks were being exceptionally productive, too... up until the point when the spiders came.  Now they refuse to go any deeper in the woods.$b$bMaybe you can help me out.  Hop on one of my horses and use it to frighten those spiders.  Maybe we can avoid bloodshed and just scare them away.
english.completion: Well, it sounds like they're certainly afraid of the mustang, but they're not leaving for good.  I can't have you running around on a horse forever.  Nor do I think you'd want to. Fine.  Bloodshed it is.
english.completed: Return to Nathaniel Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 这就是战争（野生蜘蛛大赶集）
text.objectives: 在北山伐木场附近骑一匹壁炉谷野马，用它的嘶鸣技能将10只北山蜘蛛赶到北山伐木场的壁炉谷新兵那儿。你一次可以多赶几只。
text.description: 大领主好心地把新兵派来守护伐木场。有你的骑术，加上军队的兵力，我们就能轻而易举地解决蜘蛛带来的麻烦。$B$B骑回马上，再去吓唬一次蜘蛛，不过这次，你要把它们统统赶到伐木场来。壁炉谷的新兵们会处理剩下来的事情。
text.completion: That's much more like it!  Now my lumberjacks can get to work again. Nice riding out there, $n.  You cut a pretty impressive silhouette on that mustang.
text.completed: Return to Nathaniel Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.
text.objective1: Northridge Spider lured to Lumber Mill

english.title: This Means WAR (Wild Arachnid Roundup)
english.objectives: Mount a Hearthglen Mustang near the Northridge Lumber Mill, then use its Whinny ability to send 10 Northridge Spiders to the Hearthglen Recruits at the Northridge Lumber Mill.  You can round up several spiders at once.
english.description: The Highlord was generous enough to send some of his recruits to protect us here at the mill.  With your horsemanship skills, and their martial prowess, we can do away with this spider problem easily.$b$bHop back on that mustang and scare those spiders again, but this time, scare them all the way up here to the mill.  These Hearthglen recruits can handle things from there.
english.completion: That's much more like it!  Now my lumberjacks can get to work again. Nice riding out there, $n.  You cut a pretty impressive silhouette on that mustang.
english.completed: Return to Nathaniel Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.
english.objective1: Northridge Spider lured to Lumber Mill

text.title: 觐见大领主
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地壁炉谷的大领主提里奥·弗丁报告。
text.description: 对了，你走之前，$N……我有个口信要给你。壁炉谷有人要见你。他说“久闻大名”。$B$B你可真是发达啦，$N，不是人人都能亲自觐见大领主提里奥·弗丁本人的。从我这儿随便挑匹好马去吧，都是世上最棒的好马。
text.completion: $n.  It is truly a pleasure. I know you are young, and still training, but I've had my eye on you.  We among the Argent Crusade are always looking for promising new recruits, and you have indeed shown great promise.  I have no immediate tasks for you, but merely wished to meet you in person, and see for myself what type of $r you really were. For the time being, the amenities of Hearthglen are yours to enjoy.  I look forward to our next meeting, $n.  You are dismissed.
text.completed: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: An Audience with the Highlord
english.objectives: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Oh, before you go, $N... I have a message for you.  There's someone in Hearthglen who'd like to meet with you.  Said he's "heard your name pop up" a few times already.$b$bConsider yourself lucky, $N.  Not everybody gets a personal audience with Highlord Tirion Fordring.$b$bOh, and feel free to use one of my mustangs for the ride up there.  They're the fastest money can buy.
english.completion: $n.  It is truly a pleasure. I know you are young, and still training, but I've had my eye on you.  We among the Argent Crusade are always looking for promising new recruits, and you have indeed shown great promise.  I have no immediate tasks for you, but merely wished to meet you in person, and see for myself what type of $r you really were. For the time being, the amenities of Hearthglen are yours to enjoy.  I look forward to our next meeting, $n.  You are dismissed.
english.completed: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Hearthglen in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 轻松赚钱
text.objectives: 陪伴埃达尔拉的车队进入奥丹姆。
text.description: 嘿，你好呀！$B$B不管是什么风把你吹来的，真高兴能在这里见到你！虽说我这儿的朋友们嘴硬，但我们真的需要一个帮手。$B$B奥丹姆的整个古老地区都暴露了！你能想象得到的财宝随便拿！$B$B我们只是需要一点护卫，因为有强盗嘛，还有……$B$B你能陪我们走一趟吗？$B$B只要你拖得动，财宝随便拿多少！
text.completion: Smells like someone else was in this cell recently. Gross!
text.completed: Speak to Adarrah in the lost City of Tol'vir.

english.title: Easy Money
english.objectives: Accompany Adarrah's caravan into Uldum.
english.description: Well, hello there!$b$bWhatever brought you, I'm so glad that you're here! My friends will never admit to it, but we could really use a hand.$b$bThe ancient region of Uldum has been exposed! Treasures beyond your wildest dreams, free for the taking!$b$bWe just need a bit of an escort, what with the bandits and all...$b$bYou'll accompany us, won't you?$b$bYou're welcome to all the loot you can haul off!
english.completion: Smells like someone else was in this cell recently. Gross!
english.completed: Speak to Adarrah in the lost City of Tol'vir.

text.title: 暮光的阴谋
text.objectives: 搜集真主之门计划书。
text.description: 我们来这里是为了调查在西南边的真主之门出现泰坦圣物的传闻。$B$B暮光之锤的邪教徒身上一定有他们在这里的行动计划。你得帮我们把它弄到手，$N。$B$B把邪教徒一个个搜过来，直到你找到为止。
text.progress: Those plans are the key to everything.
text.completion: But... but, this is just gibberish! What does this even say? What language is that?
text.completed: Return to Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Twilight Plot
english.objectives: Collect the Masters' Gate Plans.
english.description: We came here to investigate rumors of a Titan artifact up at the Masters' Gate to the southwest.$B$BOne of those Twilight's Hammer cultists must have the plans for what they're doing up there. You're going to have to get them for us, $N.$B$BKeep searching the cultists until you find them.
english.progress: Those plans are the key to everything.
english.completion: But... but, this is just gibberish! What does this even say? What language is that?
english.completed: Return to Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 暮光的阴谋
text.objectives: 搜集真主之门计划书。
text.description: 我们来这里是为了调查在西南边的真主之门出现泰坦圣物的传闻。$B$B暮光之锤的邪教徒身上一定有他们在这里的行动计划。你得帮我们把它弄到手，$N。$B$B把真主之门的邪教徒一个个搜过来，直到你找到为止。
text.progress: Those plans are the key to everything.
text.completion: This is just gibberish! What does this even say? What language is that?
text.completed: Return to Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Twilight Plot
english.objectives: Collect the Masters' Gate Plans.
english.description: We came here to investigate rumors of a Titan artifact up at the Masters' Gate to the southwest.$B$BOne of those Twilight's Hammer cultists must have the plans for what they're doing up there. You're going to have to get them for us, $N.$B$BKill cultists at the Masters' Gate until you find them.
english.progress: Those plans are the key to everything.
english.completion: This is just gibberish! What does this even say? What language is that?
english.completed: Return to Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 飞越
text.objectives: 调查真主之门的中央地带。
text.description: 我打算自己个儿飞过去瞧瞧平台来着，可那些吃三文治的娘娘腔就一直打我，我没法儿靠近咧。$B$B你看来是个会操缰绳的。你干嘛不乘上你那会飞的畜牲去西南那头瞧瞧，那乱糟糟的都是为了啥呀？
text.completion: A waygate?! The culties dug up a Titan waygate?
text.completed: Return to Prospector Brewer at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: Fly Over
english.objectives: Investigate the central area in the back of the Masters' Gate.
english.description: I tried ta fly o'er the terrace an have a look fer myself, but those toastie eatin' pansies kept shootin' at me, an I couldn't get near.$B$BYa look like ya might be handy with the reins. Why don' ya take yer flyin' beastie up there ta the southwest and see what all the fuss is about?
english.completion: A waygate?! The culties dug up a Titan waygate?
english.completed: Return to Prospector Brewer at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 银沼汇合
text.objectives: 前往深岩之洲的上层银沼。
text.description: 干得好极了，$N。我们知道会议地点的确切位置。$B$B上层银沼是东边的一片水银沼泽。通常只有元素居住在那里，偶尔会有一些石头穴居人。但我们的斥候在那一地区目击到了暮光之锤的活动。$B$B到那儿去想办法监听铸炉之主的会议。
text.completion: This is the place.  Our scouts confirmed the presence of high-ranking Twilight officers nearby as well as potential trogg hunting parties. Be on the lookout, $n.
text.giverWindow: We're familiar with the meeting location.

english.title: Silvermarsh Rendezvous
english.objectives: Go to the Upper Silvermarsh in Deepholm.
english.description: Excellent work, $N.  We know exactly where the meeting location is.$B$BThe Upper Silvermarsh is a mercury swamp to the east of here.  It's normally only inhabited by elementals and occasional stone troggs, but our scouts have seen some Twilight activity in the region.$B$BMake your way there and let's find a way to eavesdrop on the Forgemaster's meeting.
english.completion: This is the place.  Our scouts confirmed the presence of high-ranking Twilight officers nearby as well as potential trogg hunting parties. Be on the lookout, $n.
english.giverWindow: We're familiar with the meeting location.

text.title: 飞越
text.objectives: 调查真主之门的中央地带。
text.description: 我算是驾驭飞毯的高手了。不幸的是，当我试图调查邪教徒们在真主之门的发现时，他们差点把我打下来。$B$B你看起来是个能在天上操得一手好缰绳的。你能不能飞到西南边去看看他们到底出土了什么东西？
text.completion: A waygate?! They unearthed a Titan waygate. This is very interesting and potentially very bad.
text.completed: Return to Reliquary Jes'ca Darksun at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: Fly Over
english.objectives: Investigate the central area in the back of the Masters' Gate.
english.description: I'm quite adept at riding my flying carpet. Unfortunately, when I tried to investigate what the cultists had uncovered up at the Masters' Gate, they nearly shot me down.$B$BYou look as if you might be skilled with the flying reins as well. Would you mind flying up there to the southwest to see what they've unearthed?
english.completion: A waygate?! They unearthed a Titan waygate. This is very interesting and potentially very bad.
english.completed: Return to Reliquary Jes'ca Darksun at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 寒冰之王
text.objectives: 杀掉寒冰之王亚门纳尔。
text.description: 寒冰之王亚门纳尔用非常黑暗强大的天灾魔法统治着剃刀高地。我已经成功地在他宝座上方的荆棘里打开了一个缺口，但他的巫术让我无法发动进攻。$B$B如果你能前往荊棘螺旋同他交手，分散他的注意力，足以让我短暂地对他发动进攻，我就能在他使用最致命的魔法之前将其削弱。一旦他被削弱，你就要无情地将其摧毁。
text.completion: A job well done, $n. The Quilboar here can no longer be saved, but at least they are no longer organized for attack, or slaves under Amnennar's tyrannic rule. Leave quickly, please. Razorfen Downs is without hope. It must be purged.
text.completed: Return to Koristrasza.
text.giverWindow: Be wary of his powerful magic!

english.title: The Coldbringer
english.objectives: Kill Amnennar the Coldbringer.
english.description: Amnennar the Coldbringer rules over the Razorfen Downs with very dark and powerful Scourge magic. I have managed to clear an opening in the thorns just above his seat of power, but his sorcery prevents me from launching an assault.$B$BIf you venture up the Spiral of Thorns and engage him, he will be distracted long enough for me to attack him briefly, weakening him before he can use his most deadly spells. Once he is weakened, destroy him without mercy.
english.completion: A job well done, $n. The Quilboar here can no longer be saved, but at least they are no longer organized for attack, or slaves under Amnennar's tyrannic rule. Leave quickly, please. Razorfen Downs is without hope. It must be purged.
english.completed: Return to Koristrasza.
english.giverWindow: Be wary of his powerful magic!

text.title: Quicksilver Submersion
text.objectives: Obtain a Trogg Crate and use it to submerge yourself and eavesdrop on the Twilight's Hammer camp to the east.
text.description: The troggs in Deepholm have proven to be every bit as hostile as the ones in Azeroth.  Yet perhaps their presence will prove useful to our efforts.$B$BThe crates they use for trawling through the mercury will conceal you perfectly if you submerge yourself beneath the marsh.$B$BUse it to approach the Twilight's Hammer camp in the eastern end of the Upper Silvermarsh undetected.
text.completion: We have the information we need.  Let's not tip our hand by engaging the enemy too soon.

english.title: Quicksilver Submersion
english.objectives: Obtain a Trogg Crate and use it to submerge yourself and eavesdrop on the Twilight's Hammer camp to the east.
english.description: The troggs in Deepholm have proven to be every bit as hostile as the ones in Azeroth.  Yet perhaps their presence will prove useful to our efforts.$B$BThe crates they use for trawling through the mercury will conceal you perfectly if you submerge yourself beneath the marsh.$B$BUse it to approach the Twilight's Hammer camp in the eastern end of the Upper Silvermarsh undetected.
english.completion: We have the information we need.  Let's not tip our hand by engaging the enemy too soon.

text.title: 赤松失窃案
text.objectives: 从西瘟疫之地的赤松营地拿回10捆北山木材。
text.description: 再往南边去，你就能发现赤松豺狼人……他们刚来这里不久。也许你在路上遇见过一两只。纳萨尼尔以为它们不会惹是生非，但我可知道得清楚。$B$B我看见它们晚上从伐木场溜出来过。我不知道他们咬木头干什么——这些也不是什么心灵手巧的东西——但架不住它们偷东西啊。到它们的营地去把木料偷回来。
text.progress: Some of the older lumberjacks tell me that the Redpine lived in the area several years ago, but left when the plague arrived.  That doesn't make it OK for them to steal, though.
text.completion: I'll just put this back over in the lumber stores outside.  Nathaniel probably won't even notice it was missing.
text.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Redpine Thievery
english.objectives: Retrieve 10 piles of Northridge Lumber from the Redpine Camp in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Farther to the south, you will find Redpine gnolls... a new arrival to the area.  You probably passed some on your way here.  Nathaniel pretends like they're not a problem, but I know better.$b$bI've seen them running away with our lumber at night.  I don't know what they'd do with lumber - they don't seem particularly handy - but that doesn't stop them from stealing it.  Head down to their camps and steal that lumber back.
english.progress: Some of the older lumberjacks tell me that the Redpine lived in the area several years ago, but left when the plague arrived.  That doesn't make it OK for them to steal, though.
english.completion: I'll just put this back over in the lumber stores outside.  Nathaniel probably won't even notice it was missing.
english.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 解决豺狼人之道
text.objectives: 从赤松豺狼人那里缴获6把赤松之杖和6把赤松之锤。
text.description: 我摸不透这些豺狼人的意图。它们尚没攻击过我们，但数量却日益增多，而且好像总是厉兵秣马。我不是什么军事专家，可我觉得它们太具侵略性了。$B$B也许把武器拿走，它们对伐木场的威胁会稍稍小些。要是你去把他们的兵刃带些回来给我，我会觉得安心些。
text.progress: I don't want to order some sort of mass gnoll genocide because of a mother's worries.  I'd just like to feel safe in my own home.
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  I'll be throwing these in the fire.  We don't want those gnolls just sneaking in and stealing them back.
text.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: A Gnoll's Resolve
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Redpine Staves and 6 Redpine Clubs from Redpine Gnolls.
english.description: I have my doubts about those gnolls' intentions.  They haven't attacked us yet, but their numbers are growing, and they seem to always have their weapons ready.  I'm no military expert, but that seems a little aggressive to me.$b$bMaybe if we took away some of their weapons, they'd be a little less likely to pose a threat to our mill.  I'd feel much better about the whole situation if you went down there and brought some of their weapons back to me.
english.progress: I don't want to order some sort of mass gnoll genocide because of a mother's worries.  I'd just like to feel safe in my own home.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  I'll be throwing these in the fire.  We don't want those gnolls just sneaking in and stealing them back.
english.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 危在旦夕
text.objectives: Kill 12 Rabid Foxes near Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.
text.description: I'm happy for Nathaniel: he's spent so long trying to return to Northridge, and now with the Scarlet Crusade out of the way, he can finally move back home.  It's just... even for such a seemingly-idyllic setting, it's not really the best place to raise a family.$b$bFor example: along this valley's edge, you will find rabid foxes searching for innocent prey.  Every once in a while I catch a glimpse of one looking right at me.$b$bPlease, $c, remove some of these foxes.  I don't feel safe with them near.
text.completion: I feel a bit more relieved, $n.  Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Too Close for Comfort
english.objectives: Kill 12 Rabid Foxes near Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

english.completed: Return to Kelly Dumah at Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 圣洁的信件
text.objectives: 与纳拉其营地中的鸦羽先知交谈。
text.description: 就在刚才，有一位信使来找过你，$N。我相信是牧师训练师鸦羽先知派她来的。如果这封信是鸦羽先知写给你的，那么我建议你尽快去找她。
text.progress: I am pleased to meet you, $n.
text.completion: You have arrived at last. During your training in Camp Narache, I will guide you in the ways of the $c. You have much to learn and I look forward to counting you among my students.

english.title: Hallowed Note
english.objectives: Speak to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
english.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the priest trainer, Seer Ravenfeather. If this note is from the seer, I would go looking for her immediately.
english.progress: I am pleased to meet you, $n.
english.completion: You have arrived at last. During your training in Camp Narache, I will guide you in the ways of the $c. You have much to learn and I look forward to counting you among my students.

text.title: 聖化筆記
text.objectives: Speak to Sunwalker Helaku in Camp Narache.
text.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the paladin trainer, Sunwalker Helaku. If this note is from the sunwalker, I recommend going to see him immediately.
text.progress: I am pleased to meet you, $n.
text.completion: We have much to cover. In time, the ways of the sunwalkers will be as plain and natural to you as the shaman's conversations with the elements.

english.title: Consecrated Note
english.objectives: Speak to Sunwalker Helaku in Camp Narache.
english.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the paladin trainer, Sunwalker Helaku. If this note is from the sunwalker, I recommend going to see him immediately.
english.progress: I am pleased to meet you, $n.
english.completion: We have much to cover. In time, the ways of the sunwalkers will be as plain and natural to you as the shaman's conversations with the elements.

text.title: 猎野猪的乐趣
text.objectives: 杀死10头泥腹野猪。
text.description: 听了别太激动，$N，你眼前的这位是艾泽拉斯最了不起的野猪猎人！$B$B野猪无比狡猾，行动敏捷，力量强大，皮糙肉厚……没错，只有经验最为老道的猎人才能猎野猪。外行可干不来！$B$B呀，我打赌你肯定从没打过如此奇异的野兽吧。我以银币做赌，你永远没可能打破我十只野猪的记录。到洛克湖东岸去试试吧……不过别伤着自己了，菜鸟！
text.completion: You've killed ten already? H...hah! While you were out, I've broken my previous record! To ten... hundred! Yes, ten hundred boars!$B$BA bet is a bet, I suppose... here's your consolation prize, $n!
text.completed: Return to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: The Joy of Boar Hunting
english.objectives: Kill 10 Mudbelly Boars.
english.description: Try to contain your excitement, $n, for you are in the presence of the greatest boar hunter in Azeroth!$B$BTheir cunning intellect, rapid speed, ferocious strength, and resilient hide... yes, boars are the quarry of only the most masterful of hunters. Amateurs need not apply!$B$BWhy, I bet you've never even hunted such an exotic beast. I'll bet silver any day that you can't match my record of ten boars killed. Try the ones on the eastern shore of the loch... but don't hurt yourself now, rookie!
english.completion: You've killed ten already? H...hah! While you were out, I've broken my previous record! To ten... hundred! Yes, ten hundred boars!$B$BA bet is a bet, I suppose... here's your consolation prize, $n!
english.completed: Return to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 遥远的回忆
text.objectives: 前往盖罗恩农场的农舍，收集你能找到的纪念物。
text.description: 还记得以前，我每天在地里干16个小时，每个礼拜天就去安多哈尔的集市把庄稼卖掉。日子过得挺紧，不过我们都这么过来了。$B$B我已经记不大清这些事了。当我回首往事，在我脑海中的是格劳瑞亚的微笑，每次我从地里抬起头，安德里亚就在窗口对我招手。$B$B我的农庄就在东边不远，可我不知道我有没有做好心理准备，$N。我只是想让这些回忆长存心中。
text.progress: I wouldn't expect you to indulge the whims of a nostalgic old man, $N.  Still, if you find yourself in the area...
text.completion: This... Gloria used to read from this prayer book every night!  How had I forgotten?  She was so devout, $n. Oh... This painting... my daughter, Andrea... she loved to... to paint...
text.completed: Return to Del Gahrron at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Memories from a Lost Past
english.objectives: Travel to the farm house in Gahrron's Withering and gather any mementos you can find.
english.description: It's funny the things you remember.  I spent 16 hours a day working the fields, and every seventh day I'd head into bustling Andorhal to sell what I'd grown.  It was a tough life, but we did alright.$b$bBut I barely remember any of that.  When I think back to those days, I think about Gloria's smile, or Andrea waving from the window whenever I'd look up from the plow.$b$bThe farm's just a bit to the east, but I'm not sure I'm ready to go back, $N.  I'd just like to make sure I hold on to these memories.
english.progress: I wouldn't expect you to indulge the whims of a nostalgic old man, $N.  Still, if you find yourself in the area...
english.completion: This... Gloria used to read from this prayer book every night!  How had I forgotten?  She was so devout, $n. Oh... This painting... my daughter, Andrea... she loved to... to paint...
english.completed: Return to Del Gahrron at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 剃刀高地的亡灵天灾
text.objectives: 如果你同意帮助奔尼斯特拉兹，就再跟他谈谈，并将誓言石还给他。
text.description: 干得漂亮！我的名字叫奔尼斯特拉兹，我谢谢你把我救出来。我本已经准备等死……或者更糟：被这些天灾感染的畜生当成美餐。$B$B听着……与其逃跑，我宁愿为了我们搏一把。你是否愿意与我一同坚持到底？也许事情十分危险，但总有人得去做，而且我严重怀疑其他的冒险者是否会游荡到这凄凉的地方来。
text.progress: 我并不是搞政治的;我不在意你是为部落还是为联盟效力。我对解决所有种族直接造成影响的重大威胁更感兴趣……现在我们就有一个很大的威胁。$B$B要是你愿意成为真正的人民英雄，就将我作为承诺的黑曜石还给我吧。对我的族人来说这代表着重要的同意契约。
text.completion: Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type!  We've got our work cut out for us $n, I'm not going to lie to you.  If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.

english.title: Scourge of the Downs
english.objectives: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.
english.description: Outstanding!  My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me.  I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin.$B$BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes.  Would you be up to helping me out to that end?  It's probably dangerous, but somebody needs to do it and I seriously doubt other adventurers will wander into this desolate place.
english.progress: I'm not one for politics; I care not if your affiliations are for either Horde or Alliance.  I am more interested in squelching direct and dire threats to all the races... and we have quite a large one in here. If you're willing to be a true hero for all people, then hand me the oathstone I have given you as a sign of commitment.  I'm... not from around these parts; an oathstone is important to people of my kind as a bond of agreement.
english.completion: Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type!  We've got our work cut out for us $n, I'm not going to lie to you.  If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.

text.title: The First Lesson
text.objectives: Learn Charge from Harutt Thunderhorn. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Charge.
text.description: The time has come for your first lesson in the ways of the warrior, $N, and a fitting lesson it is. I will teach you a technique for gaining the upper hand at the start of battle.$B$BCharge into the fray, surprising your enemy, and stunning him. After we have completed our lesson, I want you to try it for yourself.
text.completion: You have done well, $n. Return to me when you are in need of further training.
text.completed: Return to Harutt Thunderhorn at Camp Narache.

text.title: 猎人之道
text.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Lanka Farshot. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.
text.description: It is time for your first lesson, $N. You have a long way to go to master the ways of the hunter, but each new skill is a step on that path. Let me show you a useful shot.$B$BWhen our lesson is concluded, I want you to try it for yourself.
text.completion: You have done well, $n. Return to me when you are in need of further training.
text.completed: Return to Lanka Farshot at Camp Narache.

english.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Lanka Farshot. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Steady Shot 5 times.

english.completion: You have done well, $n. Return to me when you are in need of further training.
english.completed: Return to Lanka Farshot at Camp Narache.

text.title: 封印神像
text.objectives: 保护奔尼斯特拉兹。
text.description: 在入口处有一个骇人的神像，野猪人用它来做烤炉。他们……事实上，他们把从贫瘠之地绑来的人都吃掉了。我可以关闭神像，让它无法再度使用，但我需要你的协助。我的计划是：护送我到神像那儿去。抵达以后，我将举行一个仪式。到时我将门户大开，几乎无法与你交流。在我关闭神像的时候，你要保护我。$B$B你干不干，$R？我是否能指望你，帮我结束他们的暴行？
text.completion: Belnistrasz's sudden departure has left behind a burning brazier.  As you stare in to the flame, the image of a great-winged red dragon fills your mind.  A more graveled version of Belnistrasz's voice speaks directly to you. "Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be.  Thanks to you the butchery these beasts were perpetrating is a thing of the past.  My faith in your kind has been once more renewed.  Take this as a reward befitting of a hero."
text.end: 在奔尼斯特拉兹进行封印神像的仪式时保护他
text.completed: Return to Belnistrasz's Brazier.

english.title: Extinguishing the Idol
english.objectives: Protect Belnistrasz.
english.description: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; they...they literally consume their abductees from the Barrens.  I can shut down the idol and render it useless, but I need your aid in doing so.  My plan: escort me to the idol.  Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual.  I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself.  Protect me while I shut down the idol.$B$BAre you with me, $r? Can I count on you to help me end their atrocities?
english.completion: Belnistrasz's sudden departure has left behind a burning brazier.  As you stare in to the flame, the image of a great-winged red dragon fills your mind.  A more graveled version of Belnistrasz's voice speaks directly to you. "Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be.  Thanks to you the butchery these beasts were perpetrating is a thing of the past.  My faith in your kind has been once more renewed.  Take this as a reward befitting of a hero."
english.end: Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol
english.completed: Return to Belnistrasz's Brazier.

text.title: The Way of the Sunwalkers
text.objectives: Learn Seal of Righteousness and Judgement from Sunwalker Helaku. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Judgement.
text.description: It is always a pleasure to meet a fellow Sunwalker. We are not as numerous as some of the more ancient orders, but our ways are no less powerful and our members no less respected.$B$BAllow me to teach you one of our most basic techniques -- seals and judgments. Using Seal of Righteousness allows you do deal extra holy damage with each swing and you may periodically use Judgement to inflict additional damage to your opponent.$B$BTry it for yourself.
text.completion: You have made me proud, $n. You will make a fine Sunwalker. Return when you desire further training.
text.completed: Return to Sunwalker Helaku at Camp Narache.

text.title: 罪恶搭档
text.objectives: 杀掉暴食者、火眼莫德雷斯，以及图特卡什。
text.description: 尽管亚门纳尔是这里的主要威胁，但他并不是唯一一个。你必须把他的副手们也都干掉，才能将高地从他们的掌握中解放出来。$B$B暴食者守卫着荆棘螺旋的根源部分。$B$B莫德雷斯站在白骨之堆上，把天灾军团煽动得极度狂热。$B$B图特卡什居住在地下。为了把他引出来，你必须在召唤者之厅的锣上敲三下。$B$B祝你好运，勇敢的英雄。
text.completion: Well done! Without their leaders, the Scourge will pose no significant threat.
text.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

english.title: Partners in Crime
english.objectives: Kill Glutton, Mordresh Fire Eye, and Tuten'kash.
english.description: Although Amnennar is the primary threat here, he is far from the only. You need to slay his lieutenants as well if their hold on the Downs is to be released.$B$BGlutton guards the beginning of the Spiral of Thorns.$B$BMordesh stands atop The Bone Pile inciting the Scourge into a ravenous frenzy.$B$BTuten'kash resides underground. In order to bring him out, you must strike the gong in The Caller's Chamber three times.$B$BGood luck, brave hero.
english.completion: Well done! Without their leaders, the Scourge will pose no significant threat.
english.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

text.title: 处理刺蓟
text.objectives: 采摘6颗刺蓟之种。
text.description: 刺蓟的季节到了！猎人们因为种子而受的伤里，89%都是刺蓟之种所致。$B$B你可以在营地北边的低洼林地里找到刺蓟之种。它们通常长在树根处，会把你扎伤。$B$B我建议你避开它们，不过事实上为了安全起见，我需要有人把它们弄走！帮我把刺蓟之种弄来，这样其他人就不会受伤了。
text.progress: Handle them safely, now!
text.completion: I've been informed there's a bear warning active for the woodlands as well! They love those stabthistle seeds.$B$BIt's a good thing you gathered those so they don't attract more bears!
text.completed: Return to Safety Warden Pipsy at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: Thistle While You Work
english.objectives: Collect 6 Stabthistle Seeds.
english.description: It's stabthistle season! Stabthistle seeds are responsible for up to 89% of seed-related injuries among hunters.$B$BYou'll find stabthistle seeds mostly in the lower woodland just north of the lodge. They're commonly found at the base of trees, and they will stab and hurt you.$B$BI'd advise you to avoid them, but I actually need someone to help remove them for the sake of safety! Bring me back stabthistle seeds so we can make sure others don't get hurt.
english.progress: Handle them safely, now!
english.completion: I've been informed there's a bear warning active for the woodlands as well! They love those stabthistle seeds.$B$BIt's a good thing you gathered those so they don't attract more bears!
english.completed: Return to Safety Warden Pipsy at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 戒备：山猫
text.objectives: 杀死8头山猫。
text.description: 停止一切活动！我注意到营地附近有山猫出没。山猫！$B$B现在提醒你一下，我从没见过山猫，不过它们显然很危险。它们就像是山地狮之类的东西。在该地区安全之前，谁都不准离开！$B$B所有人，但除了你。我会付你报酬，让你帮忙清理这一地区，$C。但别把小命给弄丢了。
text.completion: Okay, yes, I have already been informed that bobcats are much smaller than I was assuming. But that's still pretty dangerous for gnomes! You've done a good thing for the safety of this lodge, $n!
text.completed: Return to Safety Warden Pipsy at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: Defcon: Bobcat
english.objectives: Kill 8 Bobcats.
english.description: Stop everything! It's come to my attention that there's been bobcat sightings near the lodge. Bobcats!$B$BNow mind you, I've never seen a bobcat, but they're surely dangerous. They're like mountain lions or something. I don't want anyone leaving until the area is secure!$B$BAnyone but you, that is. I'll pay you to help secure the area, $c. But don't get your face ripped off.
english.completion: Okay, yes, I have already been informed that bobcats are much smaller than I was assuming. But that's still pretty dangerous for gnomes! You've done a good thing for the safety of this lodge, $n!
english.completed: Return to Safety Warden Pipsy at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 根源打击
text.objectives: Learn Primal Strike from Meela Dawnstrider. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.
text.description: I know you've been busy helping the braves protect Camp Narache from the bristlebacks. We're going to need all the hammers and all the luck we can get. Allow me to teach you a simple combat technique to help you in battle.$B$BPrimal Strike should help you fell your enemies faster. Try it out for yourself.
text.completion: Well done, $n. I see you will have no trouble mastering our more advanced arts as you gain experience. Return to me when you need further training.
text.completed: Return to Meela Dawnstrider at Camp Narache.

english.objectives: Learn Primal Strike from Meela Dawnstrider. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using Primal Strike 3 times.

english.completed: Return to Meela Dawnstrider at Camp Narache.

text.title: 捕猎黄蜂
text.objectives: 收集6扇透明的蜂翅。
text.description: 我们总是在寻找新的猎物。达瑞尔也许喜欢他的野猪，但我们其他人宁可打一些更为奇异的生物。$B$B我倒不是说洛克湖水位下降是件好事，不过的确焉知非福。泥沼的大地带来了新的猎物：黄蜂！$B$B提醒你，那可是巨型黄蜂。不是很多猎人都有同大型昆虫搏斗的经验。相当新奇。$B$B如果你愿意试一试的话，我可以付薪水给你。给我把它们透明漂亮的翅膀带来，我就付钱。
text.progress: How go those wasps?
text.completion: Lovely specimens you've got there! Here's my wager, lad.
text.completed: Return to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: Hornet Hunting
english.objectives: Collect 6 Glassy Hornet Wings.
english.description: We're always looking for new game around here. Daryl may like his boars, but the rest of us prefer things more exotic.$B$BNow, I'd never say the Loch draining was a good thing, but it did have a silver lining. The swampy ground's brought in new prey: Hornets!$B$BGiant hornets, mind you. Not many hunters have tussled with massive bugs before. It's rather novel.$B$BIf you'd like to give it a try, I'll wager with you. Bring me back some of those nice glossy wings of theirs and I'll pay up.
english.progress: How go those wasps?
english.completion: Lovely specimens you've got there! Here's my wager, lad.
english.completed: Return to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 治疗天灾
text.objectives: 收集20根枯缩的獠牙。
text.description: 比起杀掉一拨又一拨的天灾来，找到一个办法防止活物被转化，将更为有效。我想到了一种粉剂，吸入后或许能阻止整个进程。$B$B我需要死去的野猪人身上枯缩的獠牙来制作这种粉末。给我多找些来，我们或许能永远制止天灾的扩张。
text.progress: Do you have the tusks?
text.completion: I have faith that this substance will prevent many future headaches. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

english.title: Cure the Scourge
english.objectives: Collect 20 Withered Tusks.
english.description: Far more effective than killing swarm after swarm of Scourge is finding a method to prevent living creatures from ever being turned into them. I have an idea for a fine powder that, when inhaled, may stop the entire process.$B$BI need withered tusks off the unliving Quilboar here to make this powder. Bring me an ample amount, and we may be able to stop the Scourge's growth for good.
english.progress: Do you have the tusks?
english.completion: I have faith that this substance will prevent many future headaches. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Koristrasza.

text.title: 毛茸茸的狐狸尾巴
text.objectives: 采集7条毛茸茸的狐狸尾巴。
text.description: 最近我们在山里发现狐狸变多了。狡猾的动物。非常适合验证猎人的实力，而且利润也不错！$B$B值钱的是它们的尾巴，$G小子:姑娘;。毛茸茸的又漂亮，挂在腰带上就能不生虱子，也能给有钱的贵族人家做手套衬里。$B$B听我这扯的，我又不是地精，刺激的是打猎！不过你要是能给我带些狐狸尾巴来，我还是会乐意付钱的。你可以在营地北边低洼林地里找到狐狸。
text.progress: What've you got for me?
text.completion: Ahh, you see? Goods of the finest quality. Good work gettin' these.
text.completed: Return to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: Foxtails By The Handful
english.objectives: Collect 7 Fluffy Fox Tails.
english.description: We've seen more foxes in the hills lately. Cunning creatures, they are. A good test of a hunter's skills, and a fine profit to boot!$B$BIt's their tails, $glad:lass;. Fine and fluffy, they're just as good hung on yer belt to ward off fleas as they are to line the gloves of some fancy noble.$B$BListen to me prattle on. I'm no goblin; the thrill's in the hunt! But if you bring me back some foxtails, I'll still gladly pay you for 'em. You'll find the foxes just north of the lodge in the lower woodlands.
english.progress: What've you got for me?
english.completion: Ahh, you see? Goods of the finest quality. Good work gettin' these.
english.completed: Return to Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 飞行呆子
text.objectives: 从金色雄鹰身上收集3根原始翼羽。
text.description: 我受够了旋翼机。是的，它们能飞，可对一个真正的侏儒来说那又怎么足够呢？一个真正的侏儒要飞，就得带着翅膀飞！$B$B我已经研究了多年的鸟类，试图解开这终极的秘密，制造一架像它们那样飞翔的机器。那优雅的呼啸之声，疾风拂过翅膀，啊。$B$B你！你可以帮助我。我需要一些你能找到的最好的翼羽。营地附近盘旋的金色雄鹰或许是个不错的选择……
text.progress: Only the finest feathers will do!
text.completion: Beautiful. you've got an eye for quality!$B$BGreat minds think alike! It's clear you've got an enthusiasm for flight and fowl, so maybe you can help me further...
text.completed: Return to Bingles Blastenheimer at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

english.title: Wing Nut
english.objectives: Collect 3 Pristine Flight Feathers from Golden Eagles.
english.description: I'm through with gyrocopters. Sure, they work, but when has that ever been good enough for a real gnome? I want real flight, with WINGS!$B$BI've been studying birds for years now, trying to unlock the final secret to building a machine that flies just like them. That elegant soaring and swooping, the rush of wind over the wings, ahh.$B$BYou! You can help me. I need the finest flight feathers you can find. The golden eagles circling near the lodge would be a fine choice...
english.progress: Only the finest feathers will do!
english.completion: Beautiful. you've got an eye for quality!$B$BGreat minds think alike! It's clear you've got an enthusiasm for flight and fowl, so maybe you can help me further...
english.completed: Return to Bingles Blastenheimer at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

text.title: 重要的鸟
text.objectives: 在铁翼洞穴里找到生锈的天行者。

english.title: Bird is the Word
english.objectives: Find the Rusted Skystrider inside Ironwing Cavern.

text.title: 天行者之心
text.objectives: 把超级机械传送装置还给旅行者营地的宾格斯·雷管。
text.description: 打开舱盖，你发现一件惹人注目的装置被连接在管线、齿轮和天知道别的什么玩意里。$B$B它很容易就被拆了下来。该将它带回去给宾格斯了。
text.completion: Perfect! Now that I've perfected the wing balance and have all the parts I need, all we need is a pilot.

english.title: Skystrider's Heart
english.objectives: Return the Supermechanical Robo-Widget to Bingles Blastenheimer at the Farstrider Lodge.
english.description: Opening the hatch, you find an imposing looking mechanical device hooked to several wires, gears, and who knows what else.$B$BIt's easily detached. Time to bring it back to Bingles.
english.completion: Perfect! Now that I've perfected the wing balance and have all the parts I need, all we need is a pilot.

text.title: 他那个年纪
text.objectives: 跟洛克湖东侧的安多·雷管谈一谈。
text.description: 我制作天行者不是为了自己，$N。甚至不是为了侏儒。我想让我的儿子来飞它。$B$B我老了，反应大不如前。但我的孩子安多，只要他克服青春期的躁动，就能成为艾泽拉斯最棒的飞行员！$B$B他常坐在洛克湖边，整天盯着天空。有什么事情在困扰着他，他也不愿意跟自己的父亲谈。我没办法！$B$B拜托你，$N，你能不能去跟他谈谈？告诉他我需要他驾驶天行者！
text.completion: I don't care about my father and his silly inventions! It's all just nonsense!

english.title: He's That Age
english.objectives: Speak to Ando Blastenheimer on the east side of the Loch.
english.description: I'm not making the Skystrider for me, $n. Not even for gnomekind. I want my son to be the one to fly it.$B$BI'm old, and my reflexes aren't what they used to be. But my boy Ando could be the best pilot Azeroth's ever seen, if he'd just get over his teenage moodiness!$B$BHe sits out by the loch, staring at the sky all day. Something's been bothering him, and yet he refuses to talk to his own father about it. I'm at a loss!$B$BPlease, $n, could you go talk to him? Tell him I need him to pilot the Skystrider!
english.completion: I don't care about my father and his silly inventions! It's all just nonsense!

text.title: 站出来
text.objectives: 摧毁暮光之锤营地中央的暮光塑地者。
text.description: 看看他们。暮光之锤毁了这片土地！$B$B那个邪教导致了大灾变，破坏了巨石水坝，泄干了整个洛克湖。现在他们在废墟里四处游荡，好像是在自己家里一样！$B$B如果这世上还有正义的话，就得有人到他们营地里去，把他们的神器一劈为二。但我身单力薄，无法做到。$B$B而其他人根本连这个勇气都没有！就连你也一样！你明白吗？这实在太愚蠢了……
text.completion: You did it? You did! You fought them and won! There's hope after all...
text.completed: Return to Ando Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.

english.title: Standing Up
english.objectives: Destroy the Twilight Landshaper at the center of the Twilight's Hammer Camp.
english.description: Look at them. The Twilight's Hammer ruined this land!$B$BThat cult caused this Cataclysm, and broke the Stonewrought Dam, and drained the entire Loch. And now they wander around the ruins like it's their home!$B$BIf there was any justice in this world, someone would march into their camp and break that artifact of theirs in half. But I'm too weak to even try it.$B$BAnd nobody else is brave enough either! Not even you! You see? It's all so stupid...
english.completion: You did it? You did! You fought them and won! There's hope after all...
english.completed: Return to Ando Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.

text.title: 维林的报复
text.objectives: 杀死老黑炭，拿到它的熊头。
text.description: 我想你应该不会对稍稍报复一下那个大块头感兴趣吧？我不得不说，达瑞尔确实有两把刷子。$B$B一年前，一头巨大的熊成了旅行者营地的目标，可没有一个猎人走运。于是，达瑞尔认为自己有能力拿下他。但最后，他辛苦的结果就是眼睛上那条丑陋的伤疤。$B$B把那头熊杀掉，我肯定这一次就算是达瑞尔也会无话可说的。$B$B那头熊，老黑炭，就在北边它自己的洞穴附近。
text.progress: 啊，$N!这麽快就回来了?你一定又去打猎了?遇到挫折也别担心，从长远来看，挫折可以让你变得更加成熟!$B$B(反正你已经够糟的了……)
text.completion: 呃……这是什麽?看起来是一只熊头。$B$B<他下意识地用手指摸了摸脸上的伤疤>$B$B好吧，你能杀了这只熊是挺有意思的，但它应该不是以前那只熊吧……$B$B<他的声音渐渐变小，并且有些发颤>$B$B啊，把这个东西拿走，快拿走!把这个恐怖的东西拿走!$B$B
text.completed: Bring Ol' Sooty's Head to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.
text.giverWindow: Do it for Daryl.

english.title: Vyrin's Revenge
english.objectives: Kill Ol' Sooty and obtain his head.
english.description: I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.$b$bA year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.$b$bKill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.$b$bThe bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the cave to the north.
english.progress: Ah, $n! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!$b$b...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
english.completion: Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it. Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then... Oh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
english.completed: Bring Ol' Sooty's Head to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.
english.giverWindow: Do it for Daryl.

text.title: 维林的报复
text.objectives: 把奥尔苏迪的头交给旅行者营地的维林·疾风。
text.description: 天哪！别把这种东西带到营地里来……它太肮脏，太可怕…太…太肮脏了！$B$B你把它拿出去行不行？没有人想看到你这件血淋淋的战利品！真的！
text.progress: 干得好，$N!这家伙被吓坏了!把这颗头给我吧，我来处理。
text.completion: 谢谢你帮助我完成这个小计画，$N。几个月了，我一直想报复那个傲慢自大的家伙，这次我们做得还不错!拿着这个，这是给你的奖励。$B$B

english.title: Vyrin's Revenge
english.objectives: Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.
english.description: Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!$b$bJust get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
english.progress: Great job, $n! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
english.completion: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, $n. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.

text.title: 遗失的零件
text.objectives: 从暴风城港口收集5个遗失的零件。
text.description: <军士把注意力转向你。>$B$B你瞧，要是你真的想加快进度，就让弗林特洛克别来烦我。一整船攻城坦克的零件都装错地方了，现在遗落在码头上到处都是。$B$B把遗失的零件收集起来交给弗林特洛克让他赶紧完活。他就在路对面那头等着呢。
text.progress: Eh wot? My parts. Where are they? You can't build a tank without parts! If yeh did, it'd be small. An' mostly inner-fectual.
text.completion: Oh aye, 'ere's the stuff. But where's me powder? Everything's here but for the powder. I need explosives, man! You tell the King, no powder, no power. I need me some kersplosions or I ain't leavin' port.
text.completed: Deliver the parts to Fargo Flintlocke in Stormwind Harbor.

english.title: Missing Parts
english.objectives: Gather up 5 Missing Parts from around the Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: <The Sergeant turns his attention to you.>$B$BLook here, if you want to help speed things up around here, get Flintlocke off my back. A whole shipment of siege engine parts was misplaced and now it's scattered all up and down the dock.$B$BGather up the missing parts and get them to Flintlocke so he can finish construction. He's just across the road from me, waiting.
english.progress: Eh wot? My parts. Where are they? You can't build a tank without parts! If yeh did, it'd be small. An' mostly inner-fectual.
english.completion: Oh aye, 'ere's the stuff. But where's me powder? Everything's here but for the powder. I need explosives, man! You tell the King, no powder, no power. I need me some kersplosions or I ain't leavin' port.
english.completed: Deliver the parts to Fargo Flintlocke in Stormwind Harbor.

text.title: 危险的意图
text.objectives: 去找银松森林伊瓦南瓜田的死亡猎手尤瑞克。
text.description: 你知道为什么摩尔图斯在你的名字前面加一个“菜鸟”吗，$N？因为他是一个无能的马屁精，被那顶过大的头盔遮得啥都看不见。“菜鸟”是你的级别代号。你现在是新幽暗城军团的一员。$B$B笑话说够了！两天前我派死亡猎手尤瑞克去执行一个隐秘行动。她的目标是获取吉尔尼斯解放阵线的情报，并将其带回来。三天过去了，她还没有消息。$B$B到西南边的伊瓦南瓜田去找尤瑞克，$N。
text.completion: Belmont gets a little nervous and sends some newbie to look for me? Listen, I've been staking out the old Ivar cottage from inside this outhouse for three days. Your presence threatens the whole damn operation! There's no time to explain. We have to act now or this mission will be compromised.

english.title: Dangerous Intentions
english.objectives: Find Deathstalker Yorick at the Ivar Patch in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: Do you know why Mortuus appends 'nub' to your name, $N? Because he is an incompetent sycophant that has trouble seeing through his oversized helmet. 'NUB' is your classification. You are now part of the NEW UNDERCITY BATALLION.$B$BBut enough with the comedy! I sent Deathstalker Yorick on a shadow operation two days ago. Her goal was to get information on the Gilneas Liberation Front and return. Three days and no word from her.$B$BHead southwest to the Ivar Patch and look for Yorick, $N.
english.completion: Belmont gets a little nervous and sends some newbie to look for me? Listen, I've been staking out the old Ivar cottage from inside this outhouse for three days. Your presence threatens the whole damn operation! There's no time to explain. We have to act now or this mission will be compromised.

text.title: 轻松解密
text.objectives: 解密6份计划书。
text.description: 我们没有能够解开密文计划书的工具。不过，暮光之锤有。$B$B你能不能做件好事，把计划书带回去，在他们的一次性解密装置里破译一下？
text.completion: Ah ha! So, that's it! They're planning on invading Uldum.$B$BWhat's worse is that the pyramid inside the Maker's Terrace at Uldum can be reconfigured to become a weapon. A weapon that is capable of destroying all life on Azeroth!

english.title: Decryption Made Easy
english.objectives: Decrypt 6 plans.
english.description: We don't have the tools to decipher these encrypted plans. The Twilight's Hammer do, though.$B$BWould you be a sweetie and take the plans back up there to run them through their one-time decryption engines?
english.completion: Ah ha! So, that's it! They're planning on invading Uldum.$B$BWhat's worse is that the pyramid inside the Maker's Terrace at Uldum can be reconfigured to become a weapon. A weapon that is capable of destroying all life on Azeroth!

text.title: 轻松解密
text.objectives: 解密6份计划书。
text.description: We don't have the tools to decipher these encrypted plans. The Twilight's Hammer do, though.$B$BWould you take the plans back up there and run them through their one-time decryption engines?
text.completion: Ah ha! So, that's it! They're planning on invading Uldum.$B$BWhat's worse is that the pyramid inside the Maker's Rise at Uldum can be reconfigured to become a weapon. A weapon that is capable of destroying all life on Azeroth!

english.title: Decryption Made Easy
english.objectives: Decrypt 6 plans.
english.description: We don't have the tools to decipher these encrypted plans. The Twilight's Hammer do, though.$B$BWould you take the plans back up there and run them through their one-time decryption engines?
english.completion: Ah ha! So, that's it! They're planning on invading Uldum.$B$BWhat's worse is that the pyramid inside the Maker's Rise at Uldum can be reconfigured to become a weapon. A weapon that is capable of destroying all life on Azeroth!

text.title: 要对付火和水和空气的话……
text.objectives: 获得火、水及空气结界，然后杀死哈辛·考尔。
text.description: 你在那边的时候，听到那个满口胡言的白痴了吗？那就是哈辛·考尔，他们的首领。$B$B那人权欲熏心，已经什么劝说都听不进去了。他通过同元素形成契约的方式，将力量从中直接抽取过来，让他近乎无敌。$B$B要想让你同他匹敌，我能想到的唯一办法就是杀掉所有那些元素，把它们的结界拿到手。这样你就可以免受哈辛的法术伤害了。$B$B好吧，是大部分伤害。
text.completion: That's the ol' spirit! One less nasty in this world that the little ones will have ta worry about when they go ta sleep at night. Not ta mention that we won't have ta be worrying about him none no more neither! Now let's see here. I think we have somethin' in our crates that'll make a fittin' reward fer ya.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Brewer at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: First, get the fire, water, and air wards.  Then slay him!

english.title: Fight Fire and Water and Air with...
english.objectives: Acquire the Fire, Water, and Air Wards, and then slay Haethen Kaul.
english.description: Did ye hear the blatherin' idiot while ye were up there? That's none other than Haethen Kaul, their leader.$B$BThe man's gone daft with power. He's pullin' it straight from them bound elementals, makin' him nigh invincible.$B$BThe only thing I can think of to get ye into proper shape fer a fight with him is fer ye to first kill all o' them elementals, gettin' their wards. That should protect ye from Haethen's spells.$B$BWell, most o' them anyway.
english.completion: That's the ol' spirit! One less nasty in this world that the little ones will have ta worry about when they go ta sleep at night. Not ta mention that we won't have ta be worrying about him none no more neither! Now let's see here. I think we have somethin' in our crates that'll make a fittin' reward fer ya.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Brewer at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: First, get the fire, water, and air wards.  Then slay him!

text.title: 要对付火和水和空气的话……
text.objectives: 获得火、水及空气结界，然后杀死哈辛·考尔。
text.description: Did you hear the man going on with his incessant yelling while you were up there? That's Haethen Kaul, their leader.$B$BIt's a well known fact that he's gone insane from the power he's drawing from their bound elementals. Unfortunately, it makes him nigh invincible.$B$BIf you're to fight him, you'll first have to kill each of the elementals, gaining their wards in the process. That should protect you from Haethen's magic.$B$BWell, most of it anyway.
text.completion: An excellent display of $c prowess. I believe that a reward is in order. Something appropriate for a powerful man such as yourself.
text.completed: Return to Reliquary Jes'ca Darksun at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: First, get the fire, water, and air wards.  Then slay him!
