english.objectives: Collect 10 Ancient Tablet Fragments.
english.description: This unfortunate pygmy was in the wrong place at the wrong time.$b$bAs you ponder his bad luck, you take notice of the symbols covering his shield - far too elaborate for pygmy scrawl.$b$bConfident that Doctor Jones will find such objects of interest, you set out to find more fragments like this one.
english.progress: What'dya have there, $gfriend:young lady;?
english.completion: These tablets are covered with titan writings. There's never-before seen information here, $n! Missing pieces to an ancient puzzle... Good work!
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

text.title: 逝者的荣耀
text.objectives: 在被遗忘者老兵尸体上获取6个被遗忘者的徽记。
text.description: 今天早些时候，一队老兵护送着被遗忘者投石车试图穿过南边奥森农场时遭到了伏击。他们全军覆没，所有士兵被杀，投石车也都被摧毁了。$B$B血牙的狼群要为这次伏击负责，虽然他们貌似已经全部逃回到了山上，谋划着下一次懦弱的进攻。他们的末日会到来的，但现在我要你到奥森农场去，向我们的阵亡者致敬。$B$B把他们的被遗忘者徽记拿回来。
text.progress: Have you recovered the insignias?
text.completion: I will see to it that these insignias are returned to the Undercity at once. The registrar will place their names in our records so that their sacrifice may never be forgotten.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Honor the Dead
english.objectives: Recover 6 Forsaken Insignias from Veteran Forsaken Trooper corpses.
english.description: A convoy of veteran troopers and Forsaken catapults were ambushed earlier today while attempting to cross Olsen's Farthing, directly south of here. It was a total loss: all troopers were killed and all catapults destroyed.$B$BBloodfang's pack was responsible for the ambush, though likely they have all fled back into the hills, preparing their next cowardly strike. Their day will come, but for now I want you to go to Olsen's Farthing and honor our fallen.$B$BRecover their Forsaken insignias.
english.progress: Have you recovered the insignias?
english.completion: I will see to it that these insignias are returned to the Undercity at once. The registrar will place their names in our records so that their sacrifice may never be forgotten.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 洗刷污点
text.objectives: 杀死10名血牙猎手。
text.description: 看来有一队伏击者落在了后面。让他们为自己的傲慢付出代价！杀掉奥森农场里所有的血牙猎手。为了希尔瓦娜斯！为了部落！
text.completion: You have avenged the fallen, $n, but there is more to be done.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
text.turninWindow: These dogs will soon learn the price of their arrogance!

english.title: Excising the Taint
english.objectives: Kill 10 Bloodfang Stalkers.
english.description: It looks like a group of the ambushers stayed behind. Make them pay for their insolence! Kill all of the Bloodfang stalkers at Olsen's Farthing. For Sylvanas! For the Horde!
english.completion: You have avenged the fallen, $n, but there is more to be done.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.turninWindow: These dogs will soon learn the price of their arrogance!

text.title: 女巫岭的隐士
text.objectives: 跟水光庄园的“沼泽之眼”加尔谈一谈。
text.description: 沼泽似乎对人类似乎有某种奇怪的效果。有人只是因为住在这里就发疯了。$B$B任何居住在水光庄园的人都不知怎么变得疯狂起来，它最新的主人“沼泽之眼”加尔已经表现出了一定的迹象。$B$B我不是很清楚那里到底有些什么，如果你去查看一下的话，我会对你表示真挚的感谢。$B$B庄园就在沼泽的东部边界，向东穿过蓝色沼泽和北点哨塔，庄园就在那座闹鬼的女巫岭上。
text.completion: Have you come here to spy on me? No? Perhaps you have an appreciation for fine cuisine, then? Good, you can help!

english.title: The Hermit of Witch Hill
english.objectives: Speak with "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: The marsh seems to have a strange effect on humans. Some grow mad simply by living here.$B$BAnyone who has ever settled at Swamplight Manor has gone mad in a spectacular way. The latest owner, one "Swamp Eye" Jarl, is already showing signs.$B$BI don't completely understand what's happening there, you'd have my thanks for looking into it.$B$BThe manor is at the eastern edge of the swamp. Trek east across Bluefen and past North Point Tower. The manor is in a haunted patch of land called Witch Hill.
english.completion: Have you come here to spy on me? No? Perhaps you have an appreciation for fine cuisine, then? Good, you can help!

text.title: 沼泽蛙的腿
text.objectives: 从大型沼泽蛙身上收集10条沼泽蛙的腿。
text.description: 我喜欢烧菜，喜欢沼泽地里特产的美食，比如油炸绿青蛙腿之类的。$B$B我的青蛙腿都用完了。不过庄园附近到处都是青蛙。大型沼泽蛙。你觉得你能帮我弄些青蛙腿吗？很简单，只需要殴打它们的脑袋，帮我带回蛙腿就可以了。$B$B然后我就可以做出好吃的东西来，好好地饱餐一顿，还能给你一些。$B$B你想尝尝吗？
text.progress: 啊，调味料!给我们的生活来那么一丁点调味料是大有好处的……你说是吧?
text.completion: 啊，就是这个!你马上就可以吃到沼泽炖肉了!
text.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Marsh Frog Legs
english.objectives: Collect 10 Marsh Frog Legs from Giant Marsh Frogs.
english.description: I like cooking.  Good swamp cooking.  Fried green frog legs and the like.$B$BAnd I'm all out of legs. The manor is overrun with frogs, though. Giant marsh frogs. Think you could bring me some of those legs? Nothin' to it, really. Just bop 'em on the head and bring me the legs.$B$BThen I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.$B$BDo you like stew?
english.progress: Spice.  We could all use some spice in our life.  You agree?
english.completion: Ah, that's the spice!  Now here's some swampy good stew.
english.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 加尔和蜘蛛眼
text.objectives: 从黑雾蜘蛛身上收集20颗黑雾蜘蛛的眼球。
text.description: 用眼睛制成饮料的味道非常好，可惜很多生物都只有两只眼睛。$B$B不过蜘蛛有很多眼睛，很多很多。黑雾蛛眼汁很好喝，醇美而味咸！真是没有比那更好的饮料了……$B$B黑雾蜘蛛就在西边的黑雾洞穴里活动。你说这些蜘蛛的名字是来自这个洞的名字呢，还是有别的什么说法？
text.progress: 我要的眼睛在哪儿?
text.completion: 你找到眼睛了!美味无比的蜘蛛眼!$B$B有些眼睛……你瞪着它看，它也会瞪着你看，这种眼睛就要等到最後再吃，在这沼泽地里，只有它们可以和你做伴……$B$B你好啊，小蜘蛛眼!你吃起来就像鸡肉一样，粘粘的，咸咸的鸡肉!$B$B啧啧，太美味了……$B$B
text.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Jarl Needs Eyes
english.objectives: Collect 20 Unpopped Darkmist Eyes from Darkmist spiders.
english.description: Eye juice is good juice for drinking.  Too bad most critters only have two eyes.$B$BBut spiders have lots of eyes.  Lots and lots.  And Darkmist eye juice is tasty.  Smooth and salty!  Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.$B$BDarkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern.  You figure the spiders are named after the cave... or is it the other way around?
english.progress: Where are those eyes?
english.completion: You got the eyes!  You got the eyes!  Tasty, tasty spider eyes! Some eyes... when you stare at them they stare back. Eat those last.  They keep you company... out in the swamp. Hello, little spider eyes.  Hello!  You taste like chicken.  Gooey, salty chicken! Mmmh.
english.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 破坏竞争
text.objectives: 杀死复生的铸锤师。
text.description: 瞧，我不打算跟你玩花样。血色十字军的红衣铸锤师从前不值一提，可如今他们成了巴纳扎尔的复生者，那该死的恐惧领主把所有强大恶魔武器的制法都传授给了他。$B$B事情很简单。找到他们的锻造设计图，杀掉前来拿图纸的复生的铸锤师，这样他们的军队就没有恶魔军火可供应了。别让他们变得更加强大了！
text.completion: Nicely done, lad! Without them new weapons, they're just as easy t' kill as they were when they were alive!
text.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Wilhelm.

english.title: Cutting the Competition
english.objectives: Kill the Risen Hammersmith.
english.description: Look, I'm not about t' play games with ye. The Scarlet Crusade's Crimson Hammersmith was nothin' worth mentionin' before, but now that they're Balnazzar's Risen, the damned dreadlord has taught him t' make all sorts of powerful demonic weaponry.$B$BIt's simple. Find their blacksmithing plans and kill the Risen Hammersmith when he comes for 'em, so that we can make sure their army doesn't get their hands on demon armaments. They're powerful enough as it is!
english.completion: Nicely done, lad! Without them new weapons, they're just as easy t' kill as they were when they were alive!
english.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Wilhelm.

text.title: 加尔的剑
text.objectives: 获得刺脊的剑。
text.description: 我要切点东西，呃……我不能告诉你我要切什么，不过……反正我需要一把刀。一把特别的刀……$B$B有人叫它剑，我叫它快剑。$B$B你能帮帮我吗？那些鱼人，你知道，像鱼的人，像人的鱼，它们之中有一个名叫刺脊的，手里有一把大剑，它就在这里北边的海滩附近。$B$B不过，不要等到明天再去找。我切的东西可不能放太久……
text.progress: 你找到我要的剑了??
text.completion: 这真是把好剑，用起来很顺手，锋利无比!谢谢你。谢谢你谢谢你谢谢你!!!现在让我来试试……$B$B嗯，我还是等会儿再试吧。不过正如我所说的，谢谢你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Jarl Needs a Blade
english.objectives: Obtain Razorspine's Sword.
english.description: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a sword.  I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me?  Those fish-men, you know, murlocs or whatever they're called.... There's one they call Razorspine, carries a big sword, lives north of here near the beach. That's the sword I need!$B$BBut don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
english.progress: You have my blade??
english.completion: That's a good blade.  It has a good swing.  It's a good swing blade.  Thank you.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!  Now I want to try it....   Later.  I'll try it later.  But like I was saying... thanks.
english.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 让世界更美好
text.objectives: 杀死12头赖皮土狼。
text.description: 土狼，不管怎么看，这些畜生都是祸害。$B$B这个肮脏的物种有个特别令人恶心的天赋，就是擅长传播着各种疾病，堪称犬类王国的耻辱。$B$B帮这个世界一个忙，把这些污秽的威胁从奥丹姆的沙漠里除掉。
text.completion: The world is a better place because of your deeds here today.

english.title: Do the World a Favor
english.objectives: Kill 12 Mangy Hyenas.
english.description: Hyenas, on their best day, are a nuisance.$b$bThese foul specimens have a particularly nasty disposition, are riddled with all manner of disease, and are simply a blight on the face of dogdom.$b$bDo the world a favor and rid the deserts of Uldum of this mangy menace.
english.completion: The world is a better place because of your deeds here today.

text.title: 女巫岭的幽灵
text.objectives: 打败10个复活的躯壳或复活的游魂，从它们身上收集情报。
text.description: 我长途跋涉来到这里拜访加尔的新家，但无尽的恐惧一直在笼罩着我！这里肯定有什么东西有问题，并不是只有我的感觉有问题而已……$B$B你看到那些在女巫岭附近游荡的鬼魂和尸体了吗？如果说有人会知道这里曾经发生过了什么，我想也只有他们了。在这附近寻找复活的躯壳和复活的游魂，打败他们，让他们安静下来，在这些恶魔吞噬掉加尔之前，看看你能从他们身上了解到什么！
text.completion: From your findings, the spirits in this place must amount to everyone who ever lived on this land, not just the previous occupants. Something has been corrupting and killing them. Those who follow don't learn the truth until it's too late. We have to put an end to this, $n!
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: What's Haunting Witch Hill?
english.objectives: Gather information by defeating 10 Risen Husks or Risen Spirits.
english.description: I traveled out here to pay Jarl a visit at his new home and it's been a nonstop horror show ever since! There's something seriously wrong here and I can't be the only one who sees it...$B$BHave you seen the ghosts and corpses shambling about Witch Hill? I've a feeling that if anyone knows what happened here, it is them. Seek out these risen husks and risen spirits in the surrounding area, grant them rest through combat, and see what you can learn from them before this evil consumes Jarl!
english.completion: From your findings, the spirits in this place must amount to everyone who ever lived on this land, not just the previous occupants. Something has been corrupting and killing them. Those who follow don't learn the truth until it's too late. We have to put an end to this, $n!
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 除巫草
text.objectives: 在女巫岭附近采集9根除巫草。
text.description: 在我身为草药师的这么多年里，我观察到大自然可以为大部分烦人的问题提供完美的解决方案。我曾经读到流浪法师和巫医经常使用一种被称为“除巫草”的草药，它的烟能将恶魔从隐藏的暗处驱赶出来。$B$BI如果这是真的，那么除巫草应该就生长在女巫岭的浅水附近。它有着阔叶和红色茎秆，你应该很容易就能分辨出来。把你能找到的药草都带回来给我吧，$N。它可能是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: Were you able to gather any of the herb? We must work quickly, before whatever evil is behind this infestation consolidates its hold on this area.
text.completion: These match the description exactly! I prepared the torch while you were out. All that remains is to fasten the herbs to the end here.
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Witch's Bane
english.objectives: Collect 9 sprigs of Witchbane near Witch Hill.
english.description: In my years as an herbalist, I've often observed that nature will provide subtle cures to the most vexing of problems. I've read that hedge mages and witch doctors often use the smoke of an herb known as witchbane to draw evil from its hiding places.$B$BIf true, this would mean witchbane should be growing near the shallow waters of Witch Hill. You should be able to identify it by its broad leaves and reddish central stalk. Bring me any of the herb you can find, $N. It may be our only hope.
english.progress: Were you able to gather any of the herb? We must work quickly, before whatever evil is behind this infestation consolidates its hold on this area.
english.completion: These match the description exactly! I prepared the torch while you were out. All that remains is to fasten the herbs to the end here.
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 净化女巫岭
text.objectives: 将除巫火炬放置在码头的尽头，击败出没于女巫岭的邪恶。
text.description: 火把已经准备好了。把它插在码头的尽头，对可能出现的一切情况做好准备吧。$B$B我不知道火把的浓烟会带来什么……如果真的有东西出现的话。我必须说，我对这种民间魔法是有所怀疑的，但现在我们也没有时间来想其它办法了。看在你和加尔的份上，祝你好运。
text.progress: Is it over?
text.completion: It worked? I mean... it worked! Jarl and I are in your debt, $n. Now the only remaining problem is my friend's taste in furniture, and I'm afraid that won't be solved as easily.
text.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Cleansing Witch Hill
english.objectives: Plant the Witchbane Torch at the end of the dock and defeat the evil haunting Witch Hill.
english.description: The torch is ready. Plant it at the end of the dock and be prepared to face whatever comes forth.$B$BI have no idea what the torch's smoke may reveal... if anything emerges at all. I must say, I have my doubts about this kind of folk magic, but we haven't time for anything else. For your sake and Jarl's, I wish you luck.
english.progress: Is it over?
english.completion: It worked? I mean... it worked! Jarl and I are in your debt, $n. Now the only remaining problem is my friend's taste in furniture, and I'm afraid that won't be solved as easily.
english.completed: Return to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 跟食人魔一样饿
text.objectives: 从黑鳍鱼人身上获得8条泥鳍小鱼。
text.description: 有时你能在这里碰上其他人。好人。有一次我碰见过一个食人魔。食人魔跟我一样会肚子饿。$B$B我永远忘不了他所说的话。他说：“姆德大食人魔。我饿。去打鱼。给姆德带吃的。你喂姆德吃东西，不然姆德就吃你。”$B$B于是我给他弄了几条鱼，他都吃光了。从那以后我也这样了。小鱼是最好吃的，湿乎乎的。$B$B别现在就把那些小鱼宰了。它们会难过的。难过的小鱼不好吃。给我高兴的小鱼，我吃起来也高兴。
text.progress: Jarl's hungry. Just like that ogre.
text.completion: Wonder what it's like to be an ogre. Big people have to eat more. Ogres must be even hungrier than me. That doesn't sound very fun.
text.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Hungry as an Ogre!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Mirefin Heads from Mirefin Murlocs.
english.description: You meet some people out here sometime. Nice people. Met an ogre once. Ogres get hungry just like me.$B$BI'll never forget what he said. He said "Mud big ogre. Me hungry. Go bash fishy. Bring Mud food. You feed Mud or Mud eat you."$B$BSo I got him those fish and he ate 'em up. That's when I started too. The heads are the best part, all soggy-like.$B$BDon't crush those heads now. It makes them sad. Sad heads aren't good eating. Get me happy heads and I'll eat them and be happy too.
english.progress: Jarl's hungry. Just like that ogre.
english.completion: Wonder what it's like to be an ogre. Big people have to eat more. Ogres must be even hungrier than me. That doesn't sound very fun.
english.completed: Return to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 弗拉斯·希亚比
text.objectives: Recover a box of Fras Siabi's Premium Tobacco.$B$B
text.description: Men as far as Kul Tiras spoke of the legendary Fras Siabi's premium tobacco. It was a delicacy enjoyed by every single person of importance that visited Stratholme. King Terenas, Uther the Lightbringer, Highlord Fordring...yes, they all enjoyed Siabi's specialty.$B$BSadly, Fras stayed in his shop when Stratholme was invaded, swearing on his life that the Scourge would never touch his tobacco. Venture forth and see if even one bit remains here...it is worth it's weight in gold, I assure you.
text.progress: Did you find any?$B$B
text.completion: Truly, you have uncovered the snuff of legends. It is nearly impossible to place a value on this historical tobacco. Here, have a few coins.
text.completed: Return to Packmaster Stonebruiser.

english.title: The Great Fras Siabi
english.objectives: Recover a box of Fras Siabi's Premium Tobacco.$B$B
english.description: Men as far as Kul Tiras spoke of the legendary Fras Siabi's premium tobacco. It was a delicacy enjoyed by every single person of importance that visited Stratholme. King Terenas, Uther the Lightbringer, Highlord Fordring...yes, they all enjoyed Siabi's specialty.$B$BSadly, Fras stayed in his shop when Stratholme was invaded, swearing on his life that the Scourge would never touch his tobacco. Venture forth and see if even one bit remains here...it is worth it's weight in gold, I assure you.
english.progress: Did you find any?$B$B
english.completion: Truly, you have uncovered the snuff of legends. It is nearly impossible to place a value on this historical tobacco. Here, have a few coins.
english.completed: Return to Packmaster Stonebruiser.

starters.name: 马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤

enders.name: 马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤

text.title: 搜寻与摧毁
text.objectives: 搜索奥森农场的农舍。
text.description: <女妖之王的声音再一次侵入到你的脑中。>$B$B搜索附近的农舍，寻找联盟掉队的士兵。留意任何可能让我们找到克罗雷和血牙狼人的情报。搜索并毁灭所有挡住你去路的人，$N！
text.progress: What is your status?
text.completion: This book documents a recent meeting with Ivus Bloodfang. The location mentioned is the Deep Elem Mine. I know of this place. It has only one entrance. We shall corner and crush them!
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: Search the farmhouses!
text.turninWindow: They will be cornered and crushed!

english.title: Seek and Destroy
english.objectives: Search the Farmhouses at Olsen's Farthing.
english.description: <The Banshee Queen's voice invades your thoughts once more.>$B$BSearch the nearby farmhouses for Alliance stragglers. Keep an eye out for any information that could lead us to Crowley and Bloodfang. Seek and destroy all that would stand in your way, $N!
english.progress: What is your status?
english.completion: This book documents a recent meeting with Ivus Bloodfang. The location mentioned is the Deep Elem Mine. I know of this place. It has only one entrance. We shall corner and crush them!
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Search the farmhouses!
english.turninWindow: They will be cornered and crushed!

text.title: 走投无路！
text.objectives: 去找银松森林埃利姆矿洞的士官长弗尔特斯基 。
text.description: <女妖之王在你脑海中说道。>$B$B我们必须赶快行动，$N。不能给他们逃跑的机会。我已经派了一队最强大的士兵前往埃利姆矿洞，同时也派了个骑手同行以防万一。到奥森农场东边的埃利姆矿洞去见他，把那些老鼠们碾死！
text.completion: I 'spose we're to corner them first then crush, eh?
text.giverWindow: Go to the Deep Elem Mine.

english.title: Cornered and Crushed!
english.objectives: Report to Master Forteski at the Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: <The Banshee Queen speaks through your mind.>$B$BWe must act quickly, $N. They mustn't be given the chance to flee. I am dispatching a squadron of my most powerful troopers to the Deep Elem Mine. I'm also sending the Horseman with them to ensure that nothing goes wrong. Meet him at the Deep Elem Mine, east of Olsen's Farthing, and CRUSH those rats.
english.completion: I 'spose we're to corner them first then crush, eh?
english.giverWindow: Go to the Deep Elem Mine.

text.title: 无处可跑
text.objectives: 护送士官长弗尔特斯基通过埃利姆矿洞。
text.description: 女主人让我来负责这地方。我们的主要任务是去把耗子堵住，将它们都解决掉，包括伊瓦·血牙在内。$B$B你把情报带来已经为我们提供了莫大的帮助，$N。分享这荣誉，和我们一起对敌人发动最后的总攻！$B$B准备好了就告诉我，我来下令冲锋。
text.completion: WHAT!? CROWLEY!!!!! Bastards. Those were some of our strongest soldiers. I have underestimated Crowley and Bloodfang for the last time. Clearly they are an enemy the likes of which we have never seen - willing to sacrifice their own to set a trap like this... unheard of in Alliance warfare.
text.end: 护送士官长弗尔特斯基通过埃利姆矿洞。
text.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Nowhere to Run
english.objectives: Escort Master Forteski through the Deep Elem Mine.
english.description: The mistress has put me in charge of this lot. Our primary mission is to get in there, corner the rats, and kill 'em all, including Bloodfang.$B$BYou've done us a solid service in gettin' the information, $N. Join in the glory and help us drive a sword through their miserable skulls!$B$BLet me know when you're ready and I'll call for the charge.
english.completion: WHAT!? CROWLEY!!!!! Bastards. Those were some of our strongest soldiers. I have underestimated Crowley and Bloodfang for the last time. Clearly they are an enemy the likes of which we have never seen - willing to sacrifice their own to set a trap like this... unheard of in Alliance warfare.
english.end: Escort Master Forteski through the Deep Elem Mine.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 大事件
text.objectives: 陪伴哈里森·琼斯前往群星之厅。
text.description: 你干得真是了不起！对一个没有上过我的课的人来说尤其出色。$B$B这些石板在几个主题上为我们提供了新的信息。$B$B它们表明这些方尖碑是一种巨大远古装置的一部分，可以将这整个地区掩藏起来不为人知。$B$B上面同时描绘了为该装置充能的方法，也就是用你的辰星之柄……$B$B准备好，$N。我们要创造历史了。
text.completion: Would you get a load of this place!
text.completed: 与群星之厅的哈里森·琼斯谈谈。
text.objective1: Accompany Harrison Jones to the Chamber of the Stars

english.title: On to Something
english.objectives: Accompany Harrison Jones to the Chamber of the Stars.
english.description: This is remarkable work you've done! Especially for someone who hasn't taken my courses.$b$bThese tablets provide new information on several subjects.$b$bThey indicate that these obelisks are part of an enormous ancient mechanism that once kept this whole region masked from the rest of the world.$b$bThey also depict how to recharge the mechanism, which is where your Shaft of the Stars comes in...$b$bGet ready, $n. We have some history to make!
english.completion: Would you get a load of this place!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.
english.objective1: Accompany Harrison Jones to the Chamber of the Stars

text.title: 战斗又打响了！
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地安多哈尔城的萨萨里安报告。
text.description: 安多哈尔来消息了，$N。战斗又打响了。$B$B貌似在联盟中你这安多哈尔初阵大捷的英雄已经妇孺皆知了。萨萨里安要你马上前去。
text.completion: Word has it that you helped those farmers arm themselves.  Well, now they've initiated the attack without my order!  They've forced my hand. The battle has resumed.  This time, we fight the Forsaken... and I fight Koltira, my old brother of the Ebon Blade.
text.completed: Report to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Battle Resumes!
english.objectives: Report to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Word is in from Andorhal, $N.  The battle has resumed.$b$bIt has become somewhat well-known among the Alliance forces that you're a hero of the first battle of Andorhal.  Thassarian has requested your presence immediately.
english.completion: Word has it that you helped those farmers arm themselves.  Well, now they've initiated the attack without my order!  They've forced my hand. The battle has resumed.  This time, we fight the Forsaken... and I fight Koltira, my old brother of the Ebon Blade.
english.completed: Report to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 支援部队
text.objectives: 消灭15名安多哈尔亡灵卫兵。
text.description: 我不是什么军事专家，但看起来咱们占了上风。我们的防御者同他们的亡灵卫兵旗鼓相当。但农民军从后方打了他们个措手不及。为了联盟！$B$B不过，我们还是要为了赢得胜利尽心尽力。到安多哈尔东侧去，消灭同我们作战的被遗忘者亡灵卫兵。只要他们死了，我们就能尽早收复安多哈尔。
text.completion: You fight well, $n.  I wish I had your ability... and your bravery.
text.completed: Return to Lang Loosegrip at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Supporting the Troops
english.objectives: Slay 15 Andorhal Deathguards.
english.description: I'm no military expert, but this battle looks to be in our favor.  Our defenders are equally matched with their deathguards, but the farmers' militia has taken them by surprise from the rear.  For the Alliance!$b$bStill, we should all do what we can to make sure that we win.  Travel east into Andorhal and slay the Forsaken deathguards that are fighting with our men.  The sooner they die, the quicker we can re-take Andorhal!
english.completion: You fight well, $n.  I wish I had your ability... and your bravery.
english.completed: Return to Lang Loosegrip at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 尘归尘，土归土
text.objectives: 杀死3名亡灵卫兵战地队长。
text.description: 在东边，安多哈尔城被遗忘者扼守的部分，你能找到他们的指挥官。这些人不参加战斗，而是在马背上发号施令。$B$B把他们找出来杀掉，$N。被遗忘者胜算渺茫。
text.completion: Well done.  With them out of the way, I have no more excuses. Soon, I must battle Koltira, for honor and for Andorhal.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Ashes to Ashes
english.objectives: Slay 3 Deathguard War-Captains.
english.description: To the east, deep within Forsaken-held Andorhal, you will find their commanders.  They do not fight, but call out orders from horseback.$b$bHunt down and slay these commanders, $N.  The Forsaken won't stand a chance.
english.completion: Well done.  With them out of the way, I have no more excuses. Soon, I must battle Koltira, for honor and for Andorhal.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 海妖之歌
text.objectives: 杀死奥菲莉亚，高地的海妖。
text.description: 她还活着……奥菲莉亚，高地的海妖！她的歌声能诱使你堕入深海。我留了下来，发誓为死去的船员报仇，$C。如果你愿意与我同行，尽管开口吧。$B$B我们得将自己紧紧地绑在桅杆上，必须这么做。然后闭上双眼，用蜡糊住双耳。当她那美丽的幻影消失时……就是发动攻击的时候。$B$B你想试试吗？
text.completion: She had me under her spell, $n. I wouldn't have made it out of there alive if it weren't for you. Thank you! Maybe the rest of the Alliance fleet can finally anchor here in peace...
text.completed: Talk to Ephram Hardstone at the Obsidian Breakers in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Siren's Song
english.objectives: Slay Ophelia, the Siren of the Highlands.
english.description: She's still out there... Ophelia, the Siren of the Highlands! Her terrible song will lure you to the depths. I've vowed to stay behind and avenge my fallen crewmates, $c. If you want to join me, just say the word.$B$BWe'll lash ourselves to the mast, we will. We'll shut our eyes. We'll stuff our ears with wax. And when her beautiful illusion drops... we'll strike.$B$BAre you in?
english.completion: She had me under her spell, $n. I wouldn't have made it out of there alive if it weren't for you. Thank you! Maybe the rest of the Alliance fleet can finally anchor here in peace...
english.completed: Talk to Ephram Hardstone at the Obsidian Breakers in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 瓦格里进犯
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城内的9只低阶瓦格里。
text.description: 瓦格里一度是天灾军团的主力军。不仅仅是因为它们的作战能力，还因为它们可以将尸体转化成天灾的手下。想到希尔瓦娜斯居然为了被遗忘者让自己降到这种水准……$B$B我们必须在瓦格里把我们的部队消灭，让他们对付自己人之前阻止它们。只要找到一只就杀掉。带几个民兵去，要是他们能活下来，也算是有一定战斗经验了。
text.completion: For every val'kyr you slay, you save dozens of our men... and prevent the Forsaken forces from growing. Still, they press on.  We may not win this battle after all.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Val'kyr Incursion
english.objectives: Kill 9 Lesser Val'kyr within Andorhal.
english.description: The val'kyr were one of the Scourge's primary weapons.  Not only were they skilled in battle, but they could be used to convert corpses into Scourge minions.  To think that Sylvanas is stooping to such levels for the sake of the Forsaken...$b$bWe need to stop the val'kyr before they wipe us out and turn our army against us.  Slay as many as you can find.  And bring some of these minutemen with you.  If they've survived this long, then they must have some battle skill.
english.completion: For every val'kyr you slay, you save dozens of our men... and prevent the Forsaken forces from growing. Still, they press on.  We may not win this battle after all.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 兄弟反目
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔城里的20名被遗忘者步兵。
text.description: 我们的民兵几乎全军覆没。只有我和这几个农夫活了下来。$B$B那些长翅膀的……它们把我们人的尸体……变成了亡灵行尸！我们每牺牲一个，他们就多一份兵力。$B$B我必须痛心地承认，除了亡灵卫兵和瓦格里，你也不得不和他们作战。和生前一样，他们呈团队出击，所以带上我的民兵去。
text.completion: You fought valiantly, but we're getting nowhere.  Every body that falls just fuels their forces.
text.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Brother Against Brother
english.objectives: Kill 20 Forsaken Troopers within Andorhal.
english.description: Our militia has been nearly wiped out.  Only I and these few farmers remain.$b$bThose winged creatures... they took the bodies of our men and... and turned them into walking, undead corpses!  With every one of our men they took, they bolstered their own ranks.$b$bIt pains me to admit it, but you will need to fight them too, along with the deathguards and val'kyr.  As they did in life, they hunt in packs, so take some of my minutemen with you.
english.completion: You fought valiantly, but we're getting nowhere.  Every body that falls just fuels their forces.
english.completed: Return to Thurman Grant at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 大漩涡
text.objectives: 通过传送门前往大漩涡，跟萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 感谢神灵，你来了，$N。$B$B我们不清楚还能把大漩涡里的裂隙控制住多久。$B$B萨尔领导着我们最强大的成员，仅仅只能阻止它的撕裂。$B$B我听到的最新消息是，只有从缺口处进去，到另一边把它稳定下来，才是我们唯一的希望。$B$B我会施放一道传送门。尽快穿过去同萨尔谈谈。
text.completion: 见到你很高兴，$N。

english.title: The Maelstrom
english.objectives: Go through the Portal to the Maelstrom and speak to Thrall.
english.description: Thank the spirits you're here, $N.$B$BWe're not sure how much longer we can maintain the rift in the Maelstrom.$B$BOur most powerful members, led by Thrall, are barely preventing the tear.$B$BLast I heard, our only hope was to go through the breach and attempt to stabilize it from the other side.$B$BI will conjure a portal.  Take it and report to Thrall as soon as you can.
english.completion: It is good to see you, $n.

text.title: 阿娜德尼
text.objectives: 杀死安多哈尔西侧塔顶的阿娜德尼。
text.description: 胜利的最后希望就全靠消灭瓦格里了。你一直都干得不错……但你只是孤身一人，而战场上肆虐的敌人却有无以计数。$B$B南边的一座高塔上盘踞着一只硕大的瓦格里……你在这儿都能瞧见。也许我们消灭了她，其他的就会作鸟兽散。$B$B这是我们唯一的希望。带上格兰特的一些人，这一战你需要他们的帮助。
text.completion: I watched your victory from below.  Well-fought, but ultimately, it was for naught. The val'kyr and the Forsaken press on; soon, they will overtake us.  We have lost Andorhal.
text.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: She leads the val'kyr in Andorhal.  This is our only hope...

english.title: Aradne
english.objectives: Slay Aradne atop the tower in western Andorhal.
english.description: Our last hope of victory lies in defeating the val'kyr.  You've done well up until now... but you're only one $g man: woman; and there are literally dozens of them raining destruction on the battlefield.$b$bOne enormous val'kyr sits atop the tower to our south... you can see her from here.  Perhaps if we eliminate her, the remaining val'kyr will dissipate.$b$bThis is our only hope.  Bring some of Grant's men with you.  You'll need their protection for this battle.
english.completion: I watched your victory from below.  Well-fought, but ultimately, it was for naught. The val'kyr and the Forsaken press on; soon, they will overtake us.  We have lost Andorhal.
english.completed: Return to Thassarian at Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: She leads the val'kyr in Andorhal.  This is our only hope...

text.title: 被遗忘者的败落
text.objectives: 查看萨萨里安在瞧什么。
text.description: 我们差不多要赢了，$N。我感觉胜利在握，被遗忘者毫无……$B$B那是什么鬼东西！？
text.completion: Val'kyr?  Koltira brought val'kyr to this fight?  Has he gone mad? No, this is not Koltira's work.  This was Sylvanas.
text.completed: Speak with Thassarian about what you just saw.

english.title: The Depravity of the Forsaken
english.objectives: Find out what Thassarian is looking at.
english.description: We nearly have this battle won, $N.  I can taste victory.  The Forsaken never stood a...$b$bWhat the hell is that!?
english.completion: Val'kyr?  Koltira brought val'kyr to this fight?  Has he gone mad? No, this is not Koltira's work.  This was Sylvanas.
english.completed: Speak with Thassarian about what you just saw.

text.title: 啊，安多哈尔！
text.objectives: 向指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特汇报安多哈尔战况。
text.description: 去南边，寒风营地。告诉指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯这儿发生的一切。$B$B我？我要往西，去提瑞斯法。$B$B我的战斗还没有结束，我同那个自称女妖之王的妖女约好了……我要查明她对库尔迪拉都干了什么。
text.completion: Lost?  No... next, they'll be coming for Chillwind, I suppose.  This was a major strategic blow to the Alliance's plans for Lordaeron. Very well.  I will report the results of this battle to King Wrynn.  I don't expect him to be happy.
text.completed: Report to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Alas, Andorhal
english.objectives: Report the events of the battle of Andorhal to Commander Ashlam Valorfist.
english.description: Head south, to Chillwind Camp.  Tell Commander Ashlam Valorfist everything that happened here.$b$bMe?  I'm going west, into Tirisfal.$b$bMy battle's not over yet.  I've got an appointment with that harpy that calls herself a Banshee Queen... and I'm finding out what she did to Koltira.
english.completion: Lost?  No... next, they'll be coming for Chillwind, I suppose.  This was a major strategic blow to the Alliance's plans for Lordaeron. Very well.  I will report the results of this battle to King Wrynn.  I don't expect him to be happy.
english.completed: Report to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

enders.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: 狂风骤起，有待扑灭
text.objectives: 杀死萨尔萨隆王子，并通知暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军。
text.description: 就是那东西操纵风暴袭击了我的城市？$B$B那家伙的块头和口气都不小，但今天就是他完蛋的日子。等我们取得胜利，请转告马库斯·乔纳森将军这里发生的事情。我要确保民众恢复安宁，城市得以重建，一切都归于常态。
text.completion: A massive prince of the wind, you say? The herald of Al'Akir, the Windlord? Madness. All of it. Stormwind is in your debt, hero.
text.completed: Inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City of Prince Sarsarun's death.

english.title: This Blows
english.objectives: Slay Prince Sarsarun and inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
english.description: Is THAT what's behind the storms assailing my city?$B$BLet's push on. That towering windbag can bellow and blow all he likes, but this is the end of him. Tell General Marcus Jonathan what's happened here when we've gotten back; I'll need to oversee the return of the citizenry, repairs, and so on.
english.completion: A massive prince of the wind, you say? The herald of Al'Akir, the Windlord? Madness. All of it. Stormwind is in your debt, hero.
english.completed: Inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City of Prince Sarsarun's death.

text.title: 恐惧领主巴纳扎尔
text.objectives: 杀死巴纳扎尔。
text.description: 当血色十字军倒台的时候，他们伪装起来的恶魔首领巴纳扎尔放弃了大十字军战士达索汉的躯体，并开始亲自大开杀戒，把那里所有剩下的十字军都杀害了。然后他用其通灵之力把他们变成了邪恶的亡灵奴隶。$B$B巴纳扎尔将他新的军队称为复生者。我们不能让他扩大这支军队——他们异常强大，而且不像阿尔萨斯的天灾，巴纳扎尔的军队不会有所保留。趁我们还有机会，把他杀掉，$C。
text.completion: It's good we stopped Balnazzar now. Before long, his army would have overtaken all of Stratholme, giving him a powerful center for his new unholy empire.
text.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
text.giverWindow: Lord of the Risen

english.title: The Dreadlord Balnazzar
english.objectives: Kill Balnazzar.
english.description: With the fall of the Scarlet Crusade, their disguised demon leader, Balnazzar, released the possessed body of Grand Crusader Dathrohan and went on a rampage, killing every remaining crusader here. He then used his necromantic power to raise them all as vile undead slaves.$B$BBalnazzar refers to his new army as the Risen. We cannot let him grow this army - they are extremely powerful and, unlike Arthas' Scourge, Balnazzar will not hold his forces back. Kill him while we still have a chance, $c.
english.completion: It's good we stopped Balnazzar now. Before long, his army would have overtaken all of Stratholme, giving him a powerful center for his new unholy empire.
english.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
english.giverWindow: Lord of the Risen

text.title: 狂风骤起，有待扑灭
text.objectives: Slay Prince Sarsarun and inform Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: So. This is what evil lies behind the attacks on fair Thunder Bluff.$B$BLet us move forward. It is time to put an end to this abomination.$B$BTell Hamuul Runetotem what has happened here upon our return; I'll need to oversee the return of my people, repairs, and the like.
text.completion: A massive prince of the wind, you say? The herald of Al'Akir, the Windlord? Madness. All of it. All of Thunder Bluff is in your debt, $c.
text.completed: Inform Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff of Prince Sarsarun's death.

english.title: This Blows
english.objectives: Slay Prince Sarsarun and inform Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: So. This is what evil lies behind the attacks on fair Thunder Bluff.$B$BLet us move forward. It is time to put an end to this abomination.$B$BTell Hamuul Runetotem what has happened here upon our return; I'll need to oversee the return of my people, repairs, and the like.
english.completion: A massive prince of the wind, you say? The herald of Al'Akir, the Windlord? Madness. All of it. All of Thunder Bluff is in your debt, $c.
english.completed: Inform Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff of Prince Sarsarun's death.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 叛徒
text.objectives: 在塞拉摩面对5名叛逃煽动者。
text.description: 见到你很荣幸，$C。我来到塞拉摩是为了帮忙解决这些叛逃者的麻烦。他们不仅到处张贴宣传海报，甚至已经有一些人渗透进了我们的城镇。$B$B这些叛逃者正到处散布着谣言和宣传资料，希望能说服其他人加入他们的队伍。$B$B事实上，从城镇到码头的每个岗哨附近都能看到他们的身影。找到他们，揭露他们，然后羞辱他们。在现在这个节骨眼上，任何事情都有可能给他们带来更多的同情者。
text.completion: Well done, $n. I think we managed to catch them off guard. Their agents probably thought themselves safe within the city walls. Given time, the agitators will return and spread their lies again. We'll use the time you've bought to shut out the deserters further.
text.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Traitors Among Us
english.objectives: Confront 5 Deserter Agitators in Theramore.
english.description: It's good to meet you, $c. I've come to Theramore to help eliminate the problem of the deserters. Not only have some of the men abandoned their posts, but some have filtered back into the town.$B$BThese deserter agents are spreading lies and propaganda, hoping to convince others to join their ranks.$B$BThey're at virtually every guard post throughout the town and the docks. Find them, expose them, and discredit them. At this point, anything more risks inspiring more sympathy for them.
english.completion: Well done, $n. I think we managed to catch them off guard. Their agents probably thought themselves safe within the city walls. Given time, the agitators will return and spread their lies again. We'll use the time you've bought to shut out the deserters further.
english.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 宣传战
text.objectives: 在塞拉摩码头尽头的船上获得叛逃者传单。
text.description: 这些叛逃者并非只是在和卫兵闲谈。我们还在码头的一艘船上发现了大量传单，不知道叛逃者是怎么偷运进来的。$B$B那艘运送传单的船现在还停泊在塞拉摩，就在最远的那个码头。如果你能潜入那艘船，夺走他们的宣传资料，他们的人就会失去最有力的工具。不过要小心！这艘船被一群经验丰富的海盗控制着，而且货物很可能被藏在船长室里。
text.progress: Did you manage to find and capture the remaining propaganda leaflets?
text.completion: Excellent. All that remains is to discredit the deserters so that they'll never gain a foothold in Theramore again, and I have just the plan to do it.
text.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Propaganda War
english.objectives: Obtain the Deserter Propaganda from the boat at the end of the Theramore docks.
english.description: The deserter agents were doing far more than just chatting up the guards. We've found a number of leaflets the deserters somehow managed to smuggle in on a ship in the docks.$B$BThe ship used to transport the leaflets is still in Theramore, at the farthest dock. If you can sneak aboard and capture the rest of their propaganda documents, their agents will lose their most powerful tool. Be careful! The ship is manned by seasoned privateers and the cargo is probably being kept in the captain's quarters.
english.progress: Did you manage to find and capture the remaining propaganda leaflets?
english.completion: Excellent. All that remains is to discredit the deserters so that they'll never gain a foothold in Theramore again, and I have just the plan to do it.
english.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 羞辱叛逃者
text.objectives: 向6个塞拉摩卫兵发放修改过的传单。
text.description: 我已经把你从叛逃者的雇佣兵朋友手中夺来的传单修改了。现在，任何人读到这些传单，都会得到一个和他们的本意截然相反的观点。$B$B如果我们将这些传单分发给足够多的卫兵，那样这些叛逃者在我们的领地里就会陷入空前的窘境。$B$B<加莉亚递给你一叠修改过的传单。>$B$B你为什么不在我策划下一步行动的时候赶紧行动起来呢？
text.progress: I thought I heard laughter coming from the barracks. Did you distribute those leaflets I gave you?
text.completion: Just as I'd hoped! I think it's safe to say any deserter agents who try to infiltrate Theramore will be laughed right out of town!
text.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Discrediting the Deserters
english.objectives: Distribute the Altered Leaflets to 6 Theramore Guards.
english.description: I've altered the leaflets you captured from the deserters' mercenary friends at the docks. Now, anyone who reads them will get an entirely different view of the deserters and their aims.$B$BIf we distribute these to enough of the guards, the deserters will be too embarrassed to ever reestablish their presence within our walls.$B$B<Calia hands you a stack of the altered leaflets.>$B$BWhy don't you get started while I plan our next move?
english.progress: I thought I heard laughter coming from the barracks. Did you distribute those leaflets I gave you?
english.completion: Just as I'd hoped! I think it's safe to say any deserter agents who try to infiltrate Theramore will be laughed right out of town!
english.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 叛逃者的末日
text.objectives: 打败塞拉摩东南方船上的贾维斯·格雷希德。
text.description: 现在我们已经把这些叛逃者从塞拉摩扫了出去，是时候完成最后一击了。我的线人告诉我，叛逃者们在一艘船上部署着行动，它就停泊在码头东南面的小岛旁。$B$B逮捕他们的首领贾维斯·格雷希德，这样就会让其他人丧失战斗意志。去船上找到他，并说服他投降。如果他表现出战意的话，我一点都不惊讶。不过当他知道自己不可能获胜的时候，一定会投降的。
text.completion: Gavis' request isn't as outlandish as it might sound. With the proper handling, Lady Jaina can return the deserters to the fold, but that is her decision, of course. It's been a pleasure working with you, $n. Without your help, I doubt the operation would've gone so smoothly. When I make my report in Stormwind, it will name you as the $c who ended the deserter threat.
text.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
text.giverWindow: Former lieutenant of the Theramore militia.

english.title: The End of the Deserters
english.objectives: Defeat Gavis Greyshield aboard the ship southeast of Theramore.
english.description: Now that we've eliminated the deserters from Theramore, it's time to complete this operation. My local contacts have reported that the deserters base their operations in a ship moored on a small island to the southeast of the docks.$B$BArresting their leader, Gavis Greyshield, should cause the others to lose their will to fight. Find him within the ship and convince him to surrender. I wouldn't be surprised if he puts up a bit of a fight for show, but then surrenders when he understands he can't win.
english.completion: Gavis' request isn't as outlandish as it might sound. With the proper handling, Lady Jaina can return the deserters to the fold, but that is her decision, of course. It's been a pleasure working with you, $n. Without your help, I doubt the operation would've gone so smoothly. When I make my report in Stormwind, it will name you as the $c who ended the deserter threat.
english.completed: Return to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.giverWindow: Former lieutenant of the Theramore militia.

text.title: 麻烦的事态
text.objectives: 向警戒哨岗的维摩尔上尉报到。
text.description: 我们的斥候最近带回来了一条非常令人困扰的消息。他们说最近有一群戴着红色面巾的迪菲亚兄弟会出现在了塞拉摩北部城墙外的恐惧海岸。$B$B那附近的一些船只残骸说明，他们所乘坐的船只很可能遭遇了海难，不过我们的情报还是不够完全。本城北部的重要哨塔——警戒岗哨的维摩尔上尉目前正在找人协助情报的收集和调查工作。
text.completion: So you've heard about the recent shipwreck off the coast? Good, I could use some help confirming my suspicions about the survivors. Welcome aboard, $n.

english.title: A Disturbing Development
english.objectives: Report to Captain Wymor at Sentry Point.
english.description: Reports from our scout patrols have recently taken a disturbing turn. They tell of men wearing red Defias bandanas walking the Dreadmurk Shore north of Theramore's walls.$B$BWreckage in the area suggests they may be survivors of a shipwreck, but our information is limited. Captain Wymor at Sentry Point, a guard tower to the north of the city, is looking for help in following up on the reports.
english.completion: So you've heard about the recent shipwreck off the coast? Good, I could use some help confirming my suspicions about the survivors. Welcome aboard, $n.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 水光庄园的隐士
text.objectives: 跟水光庄园的“沼泽之眼”加尔谈一谈。
text.description: 有这么一个家伙，他独自住在沼泽里，当地人叫他“沼泽之眼”加尔。前段时间水光庄园的前任主人神秘失踪了，他就“接管”了那里。$B$B我想时不时地找人查看一下他的状况。你知道吗？他让我想起了我的祖父。有人说他脑子不太正常。$B$B如果你朝西北走，沿着塞拉摩外的大路，就能在道路转向西边之前在女巫岭地区找到水光庄园。
text.completion: Get off my lawn... unless, that is, you want to help old "Swamp Eye" with a little bit of cooking. Whad'ya say?

english.title: The Hermit of Swamplight Manor
english.objectives: Speak to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
english.description: There's a fellow the locals know as "Swamp Eye" Jarl, who lives alone out in the swamp. Sometime ago he "took over" Swamplight Manor after the previous owners disappeared under mysterious circumstances.$B$BI like to send someone to check up on him every once in a while. He kind of reminds me of my grandfather, you know? Some say he's not quite right in the head.$B$BIf you're headed northwest on the road out of Theramore, you'll find Swamplight Manor in the Witch Hill area, before the road turns west.
english.completion: Get off my lawn... unless, that is, you want to help old "Swamp Eye" with a little bit of cooking. Whad'ya say?

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 破旧的灯塔
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩东边岛屿上灯塔的巴布·菲兹托克谈一谈。
text.description: 东边的旧灯塔已经坏了很久了，可巴布·菲兹托克不知道哪根筋不对非要修好它。$B$B我不知道她打算怎么做，但她声称这样船只和货物就能更为迅速地泊进码头，那么我也不好反对。和上前线比起来，在码头上抽税也没什么好抱怨的，你说是吧？
text.completion: Good. I can use all the help you can offer. My first priority is to get that lamp re-lit.

english.title: This Old Lighthouse
english.objectives: Speak to Babs Fizzletorque at the lighthouse on the island east of Theramore.
english.description: The old lighthouse out to the east hasn't worked for some time, but Babs Fizzletorque has gotten it into her head to get it working again.$B$BI don't know how she plans to do it by herself, but she claims that it'll make the movement of ships and goods into the docks smoother, so I can't really object. Drawing duty on the docks is really nothing to complain about when you could be on the front lines, you know?
english.completion: Good. I can use all the help you can offer. My first priority is to get that lamp re-lit.

text.title: 蛇颈龙油
text.objectives: 从塞拉摩码头下的黑色蛇颈龙身上获取4瓶蛇颈龙油。
text.description: 灯塔里古老的日志上记载着，油灯的燃料用的是生活在附近海岸的蛇颈龙的油。$B$B<巴布在提起这种过时的技术时，皱了一下鼻子。>$B$B我想这会有用的，虽然只能算是个土办法。日志上还写着，最年幼的黑色蛇颈龙是最好的选择，而那些家伙就生活在塞拉摩的码头下面。$B$B如果你有意的话，是否能帮我弄点灯塔所需的燃料？
text.progress: Were you able to get any of that thresher oil?
text.completion: Well, I have my doubts, but this is the only solution available right now. Once we have it up and running, I'm sure there will be time to look at other ways to fuel the lamp.
text.completed: Return to Babs Fizzletorque at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Thresher Oil
english.objectives: Collect 4 containers of Thresher Oil from Murk Threshers beneath the Theramore docks.
english.description: The old log in the lighthouse indicates that the lamp was fueled with oil from the threshers that live along the coast here.$B$B<Babs wrinkles her nose at the mention of such outdated technology.>$B$BI suppose it's a practical, if inelegant solution. The log says that the oil taken from the youngest murk threshers works the best, and those live right underneath the docks of Theramore.$B$BIf you're up for it, would you help resupply the lighthouse with fuel?
english.progress: Were you able to get any of that thresher oil?
english.completion: Well, I have my doubts, but this is the only solution available right now. Once we have it up and running, I'm sure there will be time to look at other ways to fuel the lamp.
english.completed: Return to Babs Fizzletorque at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 深海中的卑劣生物
text.objectives: 把《深海中的卑劣生物》交给塞拉摩码头上的“脏鬼”迈克尔·克罗维。
text.description: 要知道，能在这座古老的灯塔里面找到这东西实在是太棒了。在我点亮了灯以后，我发现某个旧箱子里有本书。$B$B<巴布拿起书，激动地读着书名。>$B$B《深海中的卑劣生物》！$B$B啊，我想若是看到里面所说的生物之一，我可能吓昏过去！我肯定这本书很好笑，不过现在我完全没时间去读它。$B$B然而，你知道谁会感兴趣吗……就是码头上的那个鱼商，“脏鬼”迈克尔·克罗维。他收藏旧书。
text.progress: What'll it be today? The snook is quite good.
text.completion: Well, now, that was thoughtful o' Babs to send that over. I don't know if you've leafed through it or not, but there's a lot of truth to the tales in that book. Sailors didn't just make it all up, you know.
text.completed: Speak to "Dirty" Michael Crowe at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Dastardly Denizens of the Deep
english.objectives: Bring Dastardly Denizens of the Deep to "Dirty" Michael Crowe on the Theramore docks.
english.description: You know, it's amazing what you can find in that old lighthouse. After I lit the lamp, I noticed this book in one of the old trunks up there.$B$B<Babs holds up the book and reads the title dramatically.>$B$B"Dastardly Denizens of the Deep!"$B$BWhy, I think I might swoon if I ever saw one of these! I'm sure it's good for a laugh or two, but I simply don't have time for reading right now.$B$BYou know who might enjoy it, though... that fishmonger on the docks, "Dirty" Michael Crowe. He collects old books.
english.progress: What'll it be today? The snook is quite good.
english.completion: Well, now, that was thoughtful o' Babs to send that over. I don't know if you've leafed through it or not, but there's a lot of truth to the tales in that book. Sailors didn't just make it all up, you know.
english.completed: Speak to "Dirty" Michael Crowe at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 这是真的吗？
text.objectives: 跟尘泥沼泽纳特的码头的纳特·帕格谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，我相信你和巴布肯定觉得这本书中的奇异描述和草图很可笑，但是你有没有想过，那可能是一些传说的真相？$B$B如果仔细听，我想你仍然可以听到水手们谈论泰瑟尔，书上说这只海洋生物就住在这里！当然，如果你想加以确信，可以去问问老纳特·帕格。$B$B他在尘泥海湾西南边狂潮湾对面的小岛上有个不大的钓鱼营地。
text.completion: So you want to know about sea monsters? Hmm... well, I'll make you a deal, but it's going to involve a lot of alcohol and some embarrassment on your part.

english.title: Is it Real?
english.objectives: Talk to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: Oh, I'm sure you and Babs had a good laugh over the outlandish descriptions and sketches in the book, but have you stopped to consider there might be some truth to the legends?$B$BIf you listen closely enough, I bet you can still hear sailors talk about Tethyr, the sea creature the book says lives right here! Of course, if you wanted to know for sure, you could always ask old Nat Pagle.$B$BHe's got a small fishing camp on a little island in Tidefury Cove, which is southwest across Dustwallow Bay.
english.completion: So you want to know about sea monsters? Hmm... well, I'll make you a deal, but it's going to involve a lot of alcohol and some embarrassment on your part.

text.title: 纳特的交易
text.objectives: 把帕格的超粘稠鱼肉酱涂在身上，然后游进狂潮湾。
text.description: 这么说来你找到了一本《深海中的卑劣生物》，是吗？好吧，以我的经验来看，一切都是真的。我甚至还亲眼见过几个。$B$B不过你想知道有关泰瑟尔的事情。这样吧，我和你来做笔交易，我正在研制一种新的鱼饵，但我还没有机会来测试它。$B$B只要把这些鱼肉酱——没错，它闻上去有点臭——粘在你身上，然后游到西南方狂潮湾的深处去。让我知道它的效果如何！
text.progress: Remember, the deal is "don't come back until something bites you."
text.completion: Not bad at all, but you know, I think I'd get a bath in as soon as possible, if I was you. Now, about your sea monster... Help yourself to a brew or two in the meantime.
text.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Nat's Bargain
english.objectives: Smear Pagle's Fish Paste, Extra Strength on yourself, then swim into Tidefury Cove.
english.description: So you found a copy of Dastardly Denizens of the Deep, did you? Well, I can tell you from experience, it's all true. I've even seen a few of 'em with my own eyes.$B$BBut you want to know about Tethyr.  I said I'd make you a deal, so here's what I want you to do. I'm working on a new line of baits, but I haven't tested this one yet.$B$BJust take this paste -- yeah, it smells a little foul -- smear it on yourself, and swim into the deep part of Tidefury Cove to the southwest. Let me know how it works!
english.progress: Remember, the deal is "don't come back until something bites you."
english.completion: Not bad at all, but you know, I think I'd get a bath in as soon as possible, if I was you. Now, about your sea monster... Help yourself to a brew or two in the meantime.
english.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 果然是真的
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩码头的米尔斯少校谈一谈。
text.description: 是的，泰瑟尔真的存在，而且他就在塞拉摩附近的水域里。$B$B他对亮光有着特别的爱好，这就是他们关闭灯塔的原因……$B$B如果你再次点亮灯塔的话，他马上就会游回来。不过一个神智正常的人是不会这么做的。$B$B啊哈！那肯定就是你的计划了！很高兴能和你喝两杯，不过如果泰瑟尔真的把你变成了鱼饵，不要抱怨老纳特没有提醒过你。如果你确定要这么做的话，先去和塞拉摩港口的米尔斯少校商量一下吧。
text.completion: Well, it sounds like we've got our work cut out for us. I'll make the preparations.

english.title: Oh, It's Real
english.objectives: Speak with Major Mills at the docks in Theramore.
english.description: Yes, Tethyr is certainly real, and he lives in the waters off Theramore.$B$BHas a thing for bright lights. He's the reason they shut down the lighthouse in the first place, you know...$B$BAnd if you light it up again, he'll come right back. But no one in their right mind would do that.$B$BSo that must be your plan! It's been good sharing a drink with you, but don't blame ol' Nat if Tethyr REALLY turns you into fish bait. If you're going to do this, make sure you consult Major Mills at the Theramore docks.
english.completion: Well, it sounds like we've got our work cut out for us. I'll make the preparations.

text.title: 击败泰瑟尔！
text.objectives: 用迫击炮击败泰瑟尔。
text.description: 不管海怪是不是真的存在，我们都不准备让船只去冒险。我已经命令最棒的神射手做好与泰瑟尔交战的准备了。炮兵已经在码头增加了三门迫击炮。$B$B我将下令点亮灯塔。如果泰瑟尔进攻的话，你的任务就是在那个怪兽杀害所有神射手之前，用迫击炮打倒它。它多半不会老是呆在一个地方，用迫击炮吸引它的注意。
text.completion: Well done, $n! I'll admit, when I caught my first glimpse of that beast, I had doubts about our ability to defend the docks, but you held together the defenders brilliantly!
text.completed: Return to Major Mills at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Take Down Tethyr!
english.objectives: Use the mortars to defeat Tethyr.
english.description: Sea monster or no, we're not going to risk the safety of our shipping. I've ordered our best marksmen to prepare for a confrontation with this Tethyr. The artillerymen have augmented the dock's defenses with three mortars.$B$BI'm going to order the lighthouse's lamp illuminated. If Tethyr does attack, it will be your job to operate the mortars and take down the beast before it can kill all of the marksmen. I wouldn't stand in one place too long, though. Using the mortars is likely to draw its attention.
english.completion: Well done, $n! I'll admit, when I caught my first glimpse of that beast, I had doubts about our ability to defend the docks, but you held together the defenders brilliantly!
english.completed: Return to Major Mills at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 惩戒
text.objectives: 杀死不可宽恕者和悲惨的提米。
text.description: 在市场区和节日小道交界的地方，你可以找到不可宽恕者。如果你清理掉整个十字军广场，就能把悲惨的提米给逼出来。这两个前勇士为了获得邪恶之力，对这里无辜的群众犯下了十恶不赦的罪行。$B$B你必须把他们两个从斯坦索姆中除掉。要当心，他们生前就是强大的战士，他们新的黑暗之力只会令其如虎添翼。
text.completion: You may have this as a suitable reward. I found it nestled in the armor of one of the scourge here.
text.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.

english.title: Retribution
english.objectives: Kill The Unforgiven and Timmy the Cruel.
english.description: Where Market Row meets Festival Lane, you will encounter The Unforgiven. If you slay the entirety of Crusaders' Square, you will coax out Timmy the Cruel. Both of these former champions committed heinous acts against innocents here in the name of gaining unholy power.$B$BYou must destroy both of them and rid Stratholme of their foul presence. Take caution, for they were powerful fighters in life, and their new dark powers will only have made them even more deadly.
english.completion: You may have this as a suitable reward. I found it nestled in the armor of one of the scourge here.
english.completed: Return to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.

text.title: 安德尔·杰曼的召唤
text.objectives: 跟暴风城指挥中心的安德尔·杰曼谈一谈。
text.description: 安德尔·杰曼捎话来说，他非常赞赏你驾驭武器的能力以及你对联盟的贡献。赶往暴风城，从南门出旧城区，就是他的指挥中心。去那里找他吧。我也不清楚他要跟你谈什么，但是看来你所取得的进展给他留下了深刻的印象。
text.completion: It's good to see that you received my message. I have something important I wish to discuss with you.

english.title: A Summons from Ander Germaine
english.objectives: Speak to Ander Germaine in Stormwind's Command Center.
english.description: Ander Germaine has sent word that he wishes to honor you for your mastery of arms and your dedication to the Alliance. Make your way to Stormwind, leave the Old Town district through the south exit, and speak with him in his Command Center. I do not know what he has planned, but it sounds like he has been impressed with your rapid progress.
english.completion: It's good to see that you received my message. I have something important I wish to discuss with you.

text.title: 解醉酒
text.objectives: 弄醒8名兽人水兵。
text.description: 感谢酋长，你来了，$N。我在调遣水兵时犯了一个致命的错误，需要你来帮忙扭转战局。$B$B你瞧，我竟然让那些神智清醒的酒鬼水兵去阻击从芬里斯岛进犯的狼人。他们朝那些野兽发动了进攻，结果却飞快地赔上了自己的小命。很多人都战死了，但还有一些幸存者在苟延残喘。$B$B把这桶啤酒带到东边的破败原野去，给那些倒下水兵们强行灌下。
text.progress: Don't let my sea dogs die!
text.completion: A-HA! I knew it! Lesson learned, I suppose. We will not fail again. I will be sure to have some ale on hand at the front lines.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Hair of the Dog
english.objectives: Rouse 8 Orc Sea Dogs.
english.description: Thank the Warchief that you're here, $N. I've made a critical error with the sea dogs and need your help to rectify the situation.$B$BYou see, I sent them out against the worgen coming from Fenris Isle stone cold sober. They attacked the beasts and promptly got their butts handed to them. Many of them died, but a few still live, barely clinging on to dear life.$B$BTake this barrel of ale to the Decrepit Fields, east of here, and force it down the throats of fallen sea dogs.
english.progress: Don't let my sea dogs die!
english.completion: A-HA! I knew it! Lesson learned, I suppose. We will not fail again. I will be sure to have some ale on hand at the front lines.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Torok at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 奥里克斯·瑞文戴尔领主
text.objectives: 杀掉奥里克斯·瑞文戴尔领主。
text.description: 这座礼拜堂是黑暗中的最后一线圣光。在巫妖王的注视下，莱斯·霜语于屠宰场里自绝性命，将最后一抹狰狞的笑容凝固在了脸上。他随后被巫妖王复活成了巫妖，游荡在通灵学院里。$B$B这一暴行之地如今成了天灾的圣地，被巫妖王用最为黑暗的魔法所祝福着。斯坦索姆的新统治者奥里克斯·瑞文戴尔领主，如今守卫着它，继续着其主人的邪恶行径。立刻将他杀掉。
text.completion: Stratholme will become a paragon of all that is good in this world. You have my thanks for your part in this mission.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
text.giverWindow: He has fallen too far to be left standing.

english.title: Lord Aurius Rivendare
english.objectives: Kill Lord Aurius Rivendare.
english.description: This Chapel is the last Light amongst so much darkness. Ras Frostwhisper took his own life in the slaughterhouse, carving his face into a macabre smile in front of the Lich King, who raised him into the Lich that now haunts Scholomance.$B$BThe ground where that atrocity occured is now Scourge holy ground, blessed by the Lich King with the very darkest magic. Lord Aurius Rivendare, new ruler of Stratholme, now guards it and continues his master's evil work. Slay him without pause.
english.completion: Stratholme will become a paragon of all that is good in this world. You have my thanks for your part in this mission.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer.
english.giverWindow: He has fallen too far to be left standing.

text.title: 对抗憎恶
text.objectives: 宰杀吞咽者拉姆斯登。
text.description: 吞咽者拉姆斯登在斯坦索姆城的深处。我无法提起那怪物都犯下了怎样的暴行。只要知道这一点——他理应领教无数丧命灵魂的愤怒，这愤怒将由你带给他。$B$B不要手软。不要让你的怒火冷却。
text.completion: I respect the power you demonstrated in killing Ramstein. With proper rage backing your actions, I think even the Scourge can know fear.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax.
text.giverWindow: Slaughter!

english.title: Man Against Abomination
english.objectives: Slaughter Ramstein the Gorger.
english.description: Deep within, you will find Ramstein the Gorger. I cannot bear to tell you the atrocities this monster has commited. Know only this - he deserves to feel the full wrath of countless lost souls, a wrath you will bring upon him.$B$BHave no mercy. Be unwavering in your fury.
english.completion: I respect the power you demonstrated in killing Ramstein. With proper rage backing your actions, I think even the Scourge can know fear.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax.
english.giverWindow: Slaughter!

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 砸扁蛛后
text.objectives: 取得黑雾巢穴女王的触肢。
text.description: <硕大的字体这么写道：>$B$B北方洞穴的蜘蛛很坏。毒害食人魔。食人魔病了。很坏！$B$B洞穴里大大的蜘蛛可以变出更多的蜘蛛。更多的蜘蛛很坏！$B$B杀掉大蜘蛛，阻止更多的蜘蛛。杀掉大蜘蛛，拿大赏钱！很好！$B$B<旁边是一副粗糙的图画。>
text.progress: Are you here about the sign? I don't want to talk about it unless you've got proof of a kill.
text.completion: By Grom, I'm glad that's over with. If you read that sign you may have some idea how desperate I got after trying to communicate to these lumbering oafs.
text.completed: Report to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
text.giverWindow: NEED SMASHED SOON

english.title: SMASH BROODQUEEN
english.objectives: Obtain the Broodqueen Pedipalp.
english.description: <The following is written in very large print.>$B$BSPIDERS IN NORTH CAVE BAD. POISON OGRES. OGRES GET SICK. BAD!$B$BBIG BIG SPIDER IN CAVE MAKE MORE SPIDERS. MORE SPIDERS BAD!$B$BKILL BIG SPIDER, STOP MORE SPIDERS. KILL BIG SPIDER, GET BIG PRIZE! GOOD!$B$B<A crude drawing accompanies this.>
english.progress: Are you here about the sign? I don't want to talk about it unless you've got proof of a kill.
english.completion: By Grom, I'm glad that's over with. If you read that sign you may have some idea how desperate I got after trying to communicate to these lumbering oafs.
english.completed: Report to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.giverWindow: NEED SMASHED SOON

text.title: 战争的武器
text.objectives: 杀死黑衣守卫铸剑师。
text.description: 天灾十分擅长为他们的士兵铸造强力的武器，让他们变得难以对付！在安娜丝塔丽男爵夫人的通灵塔附近，有一些锻造设计图，他们的首席铸剑师打算用它们来为奥里克斯领主制造一件极其强大的武器。$B$B我们要一石二鸟，既不能让这件武器被造出来，也要阻止他们的军火流水线！去拿到设计图，趁黑衣守卫铸剑师前来保卫它们的时候将其杀掉，这样就能让我们的任务变得简单一些。
text.completion: Great! Without a steady flow of their weapons, we'll win through attrition!
text.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Wilhelm.

english.title: Weapons for War
english.objectives: Kill the Black Guard Swordsmith.
english.description: The Scourge are adept at forging powerful armaments for their soldiers, making it difficult for our men to kill 'em! There are blacksmithing plans near the Baroness Anastari's ziggurat that their chief swordsmith plans to use for an extremely powerful weapon for Lord Aurius.$B$BWe're going to prevent that weapon from being made and stop their regular arms flow with one blow! Go take the plans and kill the Black Guard Swordsmith when he comes to defend 'em, and it'll make our mission much easier.
english.completion: Great! Without a steady flow of their weapons, we'll win through attrition!
english.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Wilhelm.

text.title: Reinforcements from Fenris
text.objectives: Kill 10 Hillsbrad Worgen.
text.description: Those that survived your assault on Fenris managed to drink the blood of the wolf. They turned into ferocious worgen, hell-bent on vengeance. Now they paddle across Lordamere Lake and assault my sea dogs. Many have already been killed. The worgen monsters must be stopped!$B$BMake your way to the Decrepit Fields, east of here, and kill the Hillsbrad Worgen that infest the area. Once you've killed them all, make your way to the Horde communication panel, located at the docks. I'll be in touch.
text.completion: Hatchet here, are they all dead?
text.completed: Find the Horde Communication Panel at the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest.
text.turninWindow: That was only the first wave!

english.title: Reinforcements from Fenris
english.objectives: Kill 10 Hillsbrad Worgen.
english.description: Those that survived your assault on Fenris managed to drink the blood of the wolf. They turned into ferocious worgen, hell-bent on vengeance. Now they paddle across Lordamere Lake and assault my sea dogs. Many have already been killed. The worgen monsters must be stopped!$B$BMake your way to the Decrepit Fields, east of here, and kill the Hillsbrad Worgen that infest the area. Once you've killed them all, make your way to the Horde communication panel, located at the docks. I'll be in touch.
english.completion: Hatchet here, are they all dead?
english.completed: Find the Horde Communication Panel at the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest.
english.turninWindow: That was only the first wave!

text.title: 血染湖水……
text.objectives: 用部落大炮杀死50名希尔斯布莱德狼人。
text.description: <通讯器嗡嗡响着。>$B$B你杀掉的那些狼人只是斥候小队。成百个援兵正在赶来！看起来就像是克罗雷和血牙把狼人之血传染给了洛丹伦的每个人类。$B$B坐上一门部落大炮，让他们都去见造物主吧。让洛丹米尔湖水被他们的血染红！
text.completion: Though you killed a large number of the newly turned worgen, many more are sure to appear. Still, their assault will have softened. Well done, $n!
text.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: The waters of Lordamere Lake will run red with the blood of the worgen!

english.title: The Waters Run Red...
english.objectives: Kill 50 Hillsbrad Worgen with the Horde Cannon.
english.description: <The communication console hums.>$B$BThose worgen you killed were the scouting party. There are hundreds more incoming! Looks like Crowley and Bloodfang made the blood offering to every human in Lordaeron.$B$BGet in one of those Horde cannons and send them all back to their makers. Let the waters of Lordamere Lake run red with their blood!
english.completion: Though you killed a large number of the newly turned worgen, many more are sure to appear. Still, their assault will have softened. Well done, $n!
english.completed: Return to Admiral Hatchet at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: The waters of Lordamere Lake will run red with the blood of the worgen!

text.title: 治愈者营地
text.objectives: 向西瘟疫之地治愈者营地的战地特工卡尔缇舍报告。
text.description: 我可以接手这里的训练。要是你想找事情做的话，我建议你去西北边。塞纳里奥德鲁伊和银色黎明十字军设立了一处营地，就在达尔松的旧农场。也许他们能让你忙上一阵子，直到我们再度需要人手。
text.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
text.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: The Menders' Stead
english.objectives: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: I can handle training from here.  If you're looking for something else to do, I recommend heading up the road to the northwest.  The Cenarion druids and Argent Crusade have a small camp set up there, at Dalson's old farm.  Maybe they can keep you busy until we need your help again.
english.completion: Welcome, $c.  As you can see, our camp is a joint expedition between Argent Crusade members and Cenarion Circle druids, but we welcome all who wish to help heal the land.
english.completed: Report to Field Agent Kaartish at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 尘泥沼泽有迪菲亚兄弟会？
text.objectives: 从加恩·马瑟斯手中夺得迪菲亚命令书。
text.description: 我手下的斥候前几天报告说，有一条受了重创的远航帆船搁浅在了东北方的海滩上。不过，海难并不是那条船上唯一不寻常的地方，报告还指出，船上的全部幸存者都戴着红色的头巾……迪菲亚兄弟会的标志！$B$B据说他们的头目就在哨塔东北边海岸对面的那座大型岛屿上。杀死他，把他那里的所有文件都带回来。
text.progress: Were you able to track down their leader?
text.completion: What in the world could 'precious cargo' refer to? The Defias have done some small time smuggling back in Stormwind, but this seems out of their league. The language of these orders suggests a wealthy or noble patron.
text.completed: Return to Captain Wymor at Sentry Point in Dustwallow Marsh.
text.giverWindow: Garn Mathers, Defias Lieutenant

english.title: Defias in Dustwallow?
english.objectives: Obtain the Defias Orders from Garn Mathers.
english.description: My scouts have reported a shipwreck just off the beach to the northeast. Shipwrecks aren't all that unusual out here, but the reports also indicated the survivors were all wearing red bandanas... the symbol of the Defias!$B$BThe reports indicate their leader resides on a large island just off the coast to the northeast of the tower. Kill him and retrieve any documents you find in his possession.
english.progress: Were you able to track down their leader?
english.completion: What in the world could 'precious cargo' refer to? The Defias have done some small time smuggling back in Stormwind, but this seems out of their league. The language of these orders suggests a wealthy or noble patron.
english.completed: Return to Captain Wymor at Sentry Point in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.giverWindow: Garn Mathers, Defias Lieutenant

text.title: 雷恩·米克基尔
text.objectives: 将迪菲亚命令书交给恐惧海岸水域里的雷恩·米克基尔。
text.description: 根据你带来的这些命令书所说，这些迪菲亚的家伙们目前第一优先要做的事情，就是找到并确保那个什么货物的安全。$B$B暴风城军情七处有一位救援潜水员名叫雷恩·米克基尔，目前正在塞拉摩工作。他听说海难的消息之后，就前往北方，在迪菲亚兄弟会占据的那座小岛附近潜了下去。$B$B如果我们想从迪菲亚兄弟会手里搞到这个所谓的货物，就必定需要他的帮助。在你之前拜访过的那座岛屿北边，有一座小岛，到那里东北方的水域去找他。
text.progress: Well met, $c. What brings you out here?
text.completion: So there was valuable cargo on board! We have to locate it before the Defias recover it. These guys are no divers, but we're going to need some of their gear if you're to help me find the cargo.
text.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Renn McGill
english.objectives: Bring the Defias Orders to Renn McGill in the waters off the Dreadmurk Shore.
english.description: From the wording of the orders you recovered, it looks like the first priority of the Defias will be to locate and secure whatever cargo they possessed.$B$BSI:7 has had a salvage diver named Renn McGill working out of Theramore for some time. When he heard about the shipwreck, Renn went north to dive near the islands the Defias now occupy.$B$BIf we're to beat the Defias to this cargo, we'll need his help. Look for him in the waters northeast of a small island just north of the island you visited earlier.
english.progress: Well met, $c. What brings you out here?
english.completion: So there was valuable cargo on board! We have to locate it before the Defias recover it. These guys are no divers, but we're going to need some of their gear if you're to help me find the cargo.
english.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 二手潜水设备
text.objectives: 将工具包和损坏的潜水设备交给尘泥沼泽的雷恩·米克基尔。
text.description: 从这里到奥卡兹岛周围的海底，到处都散布着那条船的残骸与碎片。而且，迪菲亚那边已经派出了一些潜水员在附近搜索着些什么。只要穿上他们的装备，我们也能让你加入搜索。不过，首先你得想办法“借”一点他们的东西过来。$B$B搜索这座岛屿，给我找一箱潜水设备，再带些修理工具回来，我马上就能把你的装备准备好！
text.progress: Let's see what you managed to "borrow" from the Defias.
text.completion: Wow, this is in worse shape than I'd thought, and these tools... Well, I said I'd get this back into working condition for you, so I'd better get to work.
text.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Secondhand Diving Gear
english.objectives: Bring the Tool Kit and Damaged Diving Gear to Renn McGill in the Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: There's plenty of wreckage strewn across the bottom of the water from here to Alcaz, and the Defias have already got divers out there looking around. With the help of some of their gear, we can get you suited up and ready to join the hunt, but you'll have to do some creative "borrowing" first.$B$BSearch this island for a crate of diving gear and something to repair it with. When you've got them, bring them to me and I'll have your gear ready in no time!
english.progress: Let's see what you managed to "borrow" from the Defias.
english.completion: Wow, this is in worse shape than I'd thought, and these tools... Well, I said I'd get this back into working condition for you, so I'd better get to work.
english.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 找回货物！
text.objectives: 获得1只打捞上来的保险箱。
text.description: 呃，我能把这东西修一修，让你好歹能潜下去。只是……我觉得它撑不了多久。$B$B沉船的残骸目前遍布整个海底，在这座岛屿东边的海岸直到奥卡兹岛之间几乎都是。趁这顶头盔还能撑住，去两座岛之间的海底找到那些残骸的位置。用这个打捞设备来搜索残骸，看看有没有那货物的踪迹。小心点，别太接近奥卡兹岛，那些多头蛇非常危险。
text.progress: Did your search of the wreckage reveal anything about the Defias cargo?
text.completion: Good work. Now, let's see if our 'precious cargo' is in here....
text.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Recover the Cargo!
english.objectives: Collect 1 Salvaged Strongbox.
english.description: Well, I was able to make enough repairs to this gear to let you dive for awhile, anyway. I wouldn't count on it holding out for a long time, though.$B$BThe wreckage of the ship is strewn along the bottom from the east coast of this island out toward Alcaz Island. While that helm holds out, locate pieces of the wreckage on the bottom between this island and Alcaz. Use this salvage kit to search the wreckage for pieces of the cargo. Be careful not to venture too close to Alcaz Island. Those hydra are fierce.
english.progress: Did your search of the wreckage reveal anything about the Defias cargo?
english.completion: Good work. Now, let's see if our 'precious cargo' is in here....
english.completed: Return to Renn McGill at Dreadmurk Shore in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 通知吉安娜
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩的吉安娜·普罗德摩尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须立刻把我们的发现通报给吉安娜女士，刻不容缓！假设迪菲亚兄弟会正在运送某个囚犯，而我们尚不清楚那个囚犯的身份，以及他是否还活着！$B$B不过有一点很肯定，$N。这个囚犯十分重要，不然迪菲亚兄弟不会如此大动干戈。吉安娜女士一定对这一发现的意义更加清楚，你必须立刻到塞拉摩中央的法师塔顶上去找她。
text.completion: You and Renn have done excellent work in bringing this information to light and reporting it immediately. Now, we must confirm your findings. The implications are too great if we are wrong.

english.title: Jaina Must Know
english.objectives: Speak with Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
english.description: You must bring news of our findings to Lady Jaina without delay! If the Defias were transporting a prisoner, there's no telling who it might be or if the person is still alive!$B$BOne thing is for certain, $N. The Defias wouldn't go to all this trouble for some petty grudge. Their prisoner must have been someone of importance. Lady Jaina would know better than anyone else what these findings mean. You'll find her at the top of the mage tower at Theramore's center.
english.completion: You and Renn have done excellent work in bringing this information to light and reporting it immediately. Now, we must confirm your findings. The implications are too great if we are wrong.

text.title: 调查奥卡兹岛
text.objectives: 跟卡萨·赤翼谈一谈，乘坐她的一头狮鹫调查奥卡兹岛。
text.description: 看来，雷恩对奥卡兹岛的直觉是对的。我们必须调查那座岛，不过那样的话，恐怕得派整整一个旅的兵力帮我们开道。$B$B问题是，塞拉摩的防务很紧张，没有多余的兵力。我已经安排了这里飞行管理员的学徒卡萨·赤翼来协助你，她会用她的狮鹫送你去进行空中侦查。$B$B奥卡兹岛上隐藏着迪菲亚兄弟会有关这次绑架的秘密。
text.completion: A rune circle, dragonkin? The Defias have allied themselves with HER? The traitor?
text.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Survey Alcaz Island
english.objectives: Speak to Cassa Crimsonwing and use one of her gryphons to survey Alcaz Island.
english.description: It looks like Renn's hunch about Alcaz Island was right. We need to survey that island, but it would take a whole brigade of troops to fight our way in there.$B$BTheramore's defenses can't weather such a hit, so I've arranged with Cassa Crimsonwing, the apprentice to Theramore's gryphon master, to allow you to use one of her beasts to survey Alcaz from the air.$B$BAlcaz Island holds the key to the mystery of the Defias' involvement in this kidnapping.
english.completion: A rune circle, dragonkin? The Defias have allied themselves with HER? The traitor?
english.completed: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: Proof of Treachery
text.objectives: Speak with Jaina to travel to Stormwind and meet with King Varian Wrynn.
text.description: Although Onyxia has been exposed and removed from the court, the Defias who carried out her plan must be punished. Carry word to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind castle that the Defias are the ones who carried out his kidnapping. I have little doubt that the king will mete out swift and terrible justice to those involved.$B$BI can use my magic to expedite your trip to Stormwind. Just speak to me when you're prepared to go, $N.
text.completion: So it was the Defias who served as the hands of Onyxia in this plot? You and Lady Jaina have done Stormind a great service this day. The traitors will not live long enough to regret their crimes.

english.title: Proof of Treachery
english.objectives: Speak with Jaina to travel to Stormwind and meet with King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: Although Onyxia has been exposed and removed from the court, the Defias who carried out her plan must be punished. Carry word to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind castle that the Defias are the ones who carried out his kidnapping. I have little doubt that the king will mete out swift and terrible justice to those involved.$B$BI can use my magic to expedite your trip to Stormwind. Just speak to me when you're prepared to go, $N.
english.completion: So it was the Defias who served as the hands of Onyxia in this plot? You and Lady Jaina have done Stormind a great service this day. The traitors will not live long enough to regret their crimes.

text.title: 返回吉安娜身边
text.objectives: 跟塞拉摩的吉安娜·普罗德摩尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我得制定一个剿灭迪菲亚兄弟会余孽的计划。请你回到塞拉摩，转达我对吉安娜女士的谢意。一直以来，她都是我们忠诚的伙伴和坚定的盟友。$B$B你可以去城西法师区的法师塔下寻找大法师马林，他可以用法术迅速将你送回塞拉摩。
text.completion: I have no doubt that the king meant every word when he told you he plans to destroy the Defias once and for all. He does not make promises lightly, and the enemies of Stormwind should know it.

english.title: Return to Jaina
english.objectives: Return to Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore.
english.description: I must make plans to destroy the remnants of the Defias. Please convey my thanks to Lady Jaina, back in Theramore. She has ever been a loyal friend and steadfast ally.$B$BGo to the Mage Quarter at the western end of the city and speak with Archmage Malin at the foot of the tower there. He will speed your return to Theramore.
english.completion: I have no doubt that the king meant every word when he told you he plans to destroy the Defias once and for all. He does not make promises lightly, and the enemies of Stormwind should know it.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 捕捉迅猛龙
text.objectives: 使用结实的绳子捕获6条血沼迅猛龙或血沼尖啸龙。
