text.title: 历史文书
text.objectives: 找到历史文书。
text.description: 在舒哈鲁神话里，骨鸣响器连接着历史文书和战争之鼓。它们都是强大的牛头人神器。$B$B要想找到另外两件，我们必须擦亮眼睛。假如传说是真的，那么文书看起来应该像是某种象形文字卷轴。
text.progress: We'll need the actual writ, not just any tauren scroll hanging.
text.completion: I'm fairly certain that's it. This is very intriguing, $n. What are they doing here? Are they being used as a weapon? The wind serpent flew northwest to that next bluff. Maybe that's where the drums are?
text.completed: Give the Writ of History to the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

english.title: The Writ of History
english.objectives: Collect the Writ of History.
english.description: In shu'halo myth, the Rattle of Bones is connected with the Writ of History and the Drums of War. They are supposed to be powerful tauren artifacts.$B$BWe must keep our eyes peeled if we're to find the other two. The writ will most likely look like some kind of pictographic scroll if the stories are to be believed.
english.progress: We'll need the actual writ, not just any tauren scroll hanging.
english.completion: I'm fairly certain that's it. This is very intriguing, $n. What are they doing here? Are they being used as a weapon? The wind serpent flew northwest to that next bluff. Maybe that's where the drums are?
english.completed: Give the Writ of History to the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 历史文书
text.objectives: 找到历史文书。
text.description: The Rattle of Bones is a part of shu'halo ancient myth. It is always connected with the Writ of History and the Drums of War. They are supposed to be powerful tauren artifacts; gifts from the Earth Mother if the tales are to be believed. I cannot imagine Her being connected with the drums, though.$B$BWe must be vigilant if we are to find the other two. The writ will look like a pictographic scroll if memory serves.
text.progress: We will need the actual writ, and not just any scroll hanging.
text.completion: This is very exciting and also worrisome, $n. What are these artifacts doing here? Are they being used as a weapons against us by the Grimtotem? The wind serpent flew northwest to that next bluff. Maybe that's where the drums are?
text.completed: Give the Writ of History to the Freewind Bravel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

text.title: Korok the Colossus
text.objectives: Take Korok's Second Head to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
text.description: The monstrosity has fallen, granting a brief reprieve to the Forsaken soldiers on the front lines.$B$BTake Korok's second head and return it to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command.
text.progress: Korok is dead?
text.completion: That towering behemoth has killed hundreds of Forsaken soldiers. You've done a great thing, $n.

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：格鲁迪格·黑云
text.objectives: 杀死格鲁迪格·黑云。
text.description: 一名臭名昭著的石爪山脉恐怖图腾首领回来了。$B$B我们得抓住机会，别让他跑别处去。
text.completion: What is it with you? Why do they all seem spooked by you being here?
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: Nobility of Darkcloud Pinnacle. His name must end with him.

english.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: Grundig Darkcloud
english.objectives: Slay Grundig Darkcloud.
english.description: One of the infamous Grimtotem leaders of the Stonetalon Mountains has returned home.$B$BWe should take this opportunity to make sure that he doesn't go anywhere else.
english.completion: What is it with you? Why do they all seem spooked by you being here?
english.completed: Speak with the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Nobility of Darkcloud Pinnacle. His name must end with him.

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：格鲁迪格·黑云
text.objectives: 杀死格鲁迪格·黑云。
text.description: One of the most accomplished Grimtotem leaders of the Stonetalon Mountains has returned home.$B$BWe must make the most of this chance and put an end to his campaign of terror once and for all.
text.completion: There is something special about you, $n. That much is certain.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的乱风岗卫士谈一谈。

text.title: 战争之鼓
text.objectives: 找到战争之鼓。
text.description: 不管恐怖图腾用来做什么，我们都不希望他们拥有战争之鼓。$B$B别担心，$N，我们会有办法的。但首先，我们得搜集到这一谜题的所有部分。
text.progress: The tauren love their drums. I can only imagine the Drums of War will be somehow different from the others.
text.completion: Surely that was the voice of the Elder Crone! We must be very careful, $n. Great danger lies ahead if Magatha Grimtotem has taken notice of you.
text.completed: Give the Drums of War to the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

english.title: The Drums of War
english.objectives: Collect the Drums of War.
english.description: Whatever the Grimtotem are doing with these Drums of War, we don't want them to have them.$B$BDon't worry, $N, we'll figure it all out. But first, we need to gather all of the pieces of the puzzle.
english.progress: The tauren love their drums. I can only imagine the Drums of War will be somehow different from the others.
english.completion: Surely that was the voice of the Elder Crone! We must be very careful, $n. Great danger lies ahead if Magatha Grimtotem has taken notice of you.
english.completed: Give the Drums of War to the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

text.objectives: 找到战争之鼓。
text.description: Whatever it is that the Grimtotem are doing with the Drums of War, we do not want them to keep them.$B$BDo not worry, $N, we will figure out what is going on here. But first, we need to gather all of the artifacts.
text.progress: War is not an activity to engage in for those who are faithful to the Earth Mother's teachings.

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：酋长之首
text.objectives: 杀死阿纳克·恐怖图腾。
text.description: 现在是解决黑云峰所有恐怖图腾的首领：阿纳克·恐怖图腾的时候了。$B$B据说他是巫婆长老、恐怖图腾氏族主母玛加萨·恐怖图腾的不肖侄子。据信，他的轻率鲁莽导致了双方的疏远。$B$B不过现在那些都不重要。重要的是我们要杀了他。做个了断。
text.completion: For some reason they all think that you've been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. I know it must have something to do with that wind serpent that's been hanging around. Doesn't matter. Their leader is dead. It's only a matter of time before the tauren of Freewind Post regain their home. If I were them, I'd push back a little to teach the Grimtotem a lesson, but they probably won't. They're tauren.
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的菲拉斯哨兵谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

english.title: Grimtotem Chiefs: The Chief of Chiefs
english.objectives: Slay Arnak Grimtotem.
english.description: And now the time has come to take out the leader of all of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BIt is said that he's the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Supposedly, his indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BBut none of that matters right now. All that matters is that we kill him. For good this time.
english.completion: For some reason they all think that you've been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. I know it must have something to do with that wind serpent that's been hanging around. Doesn't matter. Their leader is dead. It's only a matter of time before the tauren of Freewind Post regain their home. If I were them, I'd push back a little to teach the Grimtotem a lesson, but they probably won't. They're tauren.
english.completed: Speak with the Feralas Sentinel at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

text.title: 恐怖图腾酋长：酋长之首
text.objectives: 杀死阿纳克·恐怖图腾。
text.description: The time has come to deal with the leader of the Darkcloud Pinnacle Grimtotem: Arnak Grimtotem.$B$BHe is the disgraced nephew of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. His indiscretions have left him in a state of disfavor with her.$B$BNone of that matters now. All that matters is that we deal with him. Once and for all.
text.completion: They all believed that you have been sent by Magatha Grimtotem. There is no arguing that her pet, Arikara, has been lurking about. It does not matter. Arnak is dead. It is only a matter of time before we take back Freewind Post. Perhaps now we will be able to establish a lasting peace with the Grimtotem?
text.completed: 跟千针石林黑云峰的乱风岗卫士谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: Nephew of the Elder Crone. The Chief of Chiefs. Slay him!

text.title: 打草惊蛇
text.objectives: 打败阿利卡拉。
text.description: 我熟悉这些神器。我相信它们是由玛加萨·恐怖图腾亲自带来的。不过她并没有同黑云峰的恐怖图腾混迹一处。她来这里不久就消失了，没有人知道去了哪里。$B$B也许我们可以找到她。$B$B把响器、文书和战鼓带到阿利卡拉针石里去。假如我的猜测没错，风蛇一定会再次出现。你必须打败它，才能知道玛加萨的藏身之处。
text.completion: So, she's been taken prisoner by the Twilight's Hammer. I can't say that I feel sorry for her, but she might prove even more dangerous in their hands.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: Familiar of Magatha Grimtotem.

english.title: Invoking the Serpent
english.objectives: Defeat Arikara.
english.description: I am familiar with these artifacts. I believe that they were brought here by Magatha Grimtotem herself. But she's not amongst the Grimtotem on Darkcloud Pinnacle. She disappeared right after she arrived, and no one knows where she is now.$B$BMaybe we can find out.$B$BTake the rattle, the writ, and the drum out to Arikara's Needle. If my guess is correct, the wind serpent will appear again. You'll have to defeat it to gain knowledge of where Magatha is hiding.
english.completion: So, she's been taken prisoner by the Twilight's Hammer. I can't say that I feel sorry for her, but she might prove even more dangerous in their hands.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Familiar of Magatha Grimtotem.

text.title: The Seer's Call
text.objectives: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
text.description: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $N. Seer Liwatha has asked for you to return to the city as quickly as you are able. Her message didn't include any other information, and the matter seemed urgent.$B$BLook for Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
text.completion: Thank you for coming to see me, $n.

text.title: Seek the Shadow-Walker
text.objectives: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
text.description: Shadow-Walker Zuru requires your presence in Orgrimmar right away, $N. Do not keep him waiting, as it sounds like a matter of some importance.$B$BYou can find the shadow-walker in the Valley of Spirits inside Orgrimmar.
text.completion: The spirits knew that you would answer my call, $n.

english.title: Seek the Shadow-Walker
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
english.description: Shadow-Walker Zuru requires your presence in Orgrimmar right away, $N. Do not keep him waiting, as it sounds like a matter of some importance.$B$BYou can find the shadow-walker in the Valley of Spirits inside Orgrimmar.
english.completion: The spirits knew that you would answer my call, $n.

text.title: 失地
text.objectives: 杀死12名狼人抵抗军战士。
text.description: 我不知道我们还能坚持多久，$N。克罗雷和血牙手下的狼人了解吉尔尼斯的每一个藏身之处。一分钟前他们还站在你面前，下一分钟他们就消失了！在他们的游击偷袭下，就算是有压倒性的军事实力，我们也会输掉这场战争。$B$B但是自古只有孬种将军没有孬种士兵！被遗忘者要战斗到最后一刻，我的朋友。$B$B到西边的海角去，帮助我们前线上的士兵。杀掉进攻的狼人抵抗军！
text.completion: If I could still breathe I'd let out a sigh of relief. Don't get too comfortable, though, $n, your mission here has just begun.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: Losing Ground
english.objectives: Kill 12 Worgen Rebels.
english.description: I don't know how much longer we can hold out for, $N. Crowley and Bloodfang's worgen know every hidey hole and safe spot in Gilneas. One minute they're standing in front of you and the next minute they're gone! We're gonna lose this war to attacks of opportunity, even though we have a superior military presence.$B$BBut momma didn't raise no quitter! Forsaken until the end, my friend.$B$BHead west into the headlands and help our soldiers on the front line. Kill the attacking worgen rebels!
english.completion: If I could still breathe I'd let out a sigh of relief. Don't get too comfortable, though, $n, your mission here has just begun.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: Dark Cleric Cecille
text.objectives: Speak with Dark Cleric Cecille in Grommash Hold inside Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
text.description: I just received a message from Dark Cleric Cecille in Orgrimmar. She requests that you join her in the audience chamber in Grommash Hold, where you can find her with the delegation from Undercity. The cleric didn't mention the purpose of your visit, but it is clearly important. Make haste, $N.
text.completion: There you are, $n. I was beginning to think my message hadn't found you.

english.title: Dark Cleric Cecille
english.objectives: Speak with Dark Cleric Cecille in Grommash Hold inside Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
english.description: I just received a message from Dark Cleric Cecille in Orgrimmar. She requests that you join her in the audience chamber in Grommash Hold, where you can find her with the delegation from Undercity. The cleric didn't mention the purpose of your visit, but it is clearly important. Make haste, $N.
english.completion: There you are, $n. I was beginning to think my message hadn't found you.

text.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
text.objectives: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
text.description: A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from Tyelis, a priest trainer and emissary from Silvermoon.$B$BHe asks you to meet him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. You should make your way there immediately, $N. It sounds important.
text.completion: Welcome, $n. I'm glad that you accepted my invitation. We have much to discuss.

english.title: Journey to Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
english.description: A messenger just asked me to pass along an invitation. It is from Tyelis, a priest trainer and emissary from Silvermoon.$B$BHe asks you to meet him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. You should make your way there immediately, $N. It sounds important.
english.completion: Welcome, $n. I'm glad that you accepted my invitation. We have much to discuss.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 恐怖图腾的武器
text.objectives: 将被捕获的图腾插在地上，在其附近杀死10头尘泥杂斑鳄鱼或尘泥利齿鳄鱼以测试其效应。
text.description: 我在上次恐怖图腾进攻的时候受伤了，不过在受伤之前，我从敌人那里夺取了一根奇怪的图腾。$B$B那个东西在战斗中会发射纯粹的能量箭，不过我实验了这么久，还是想不出它是怎么运作的。如果你愿意帮我测试一下那图腾的话，我很愿意把它借给你。$B$B那些令人讨厌的尘泥杂斑鳄鱼和尘泥利齿鳄鱼把农场周围的泥沼地当成了自己的家。试着在图腾附近和鳄鱼战斗。
text.progress: Have you had any luck testing the totem?
text.completion: A haze and some lightning? That's it? There's got to be more to the totem than just that! The Grimtotems aren't likely to bring something like this to the battlefield unless it has some kind of utility.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Grimtotem Weapon
english.objectives: Use the Captured Totem to set it on the ground, and kill 10 Mottled Drywallow Crocolisks or Drywallow Daggermaws near it to test its effects.
english.description: During the last Grimtotem attack, I was wounded, but not before I managed to capture a curious totem our enemies were using against us.$B$BIt seemed to be emitting raw bolts of energy during the battle, but in all my experiments, I haven't managed to figure out how it works. I'll loan the totem to you if you agree to help me test it.$B$BThe watery areas surrounding the farm are home to pesky mottled drywallow crocolisks and drywallow daggermaws. Try fighting the crocolisks near the totem.
english.progress: Have you had any luck testing the totem?
english.completion: A haze and some lightning? That's it? There's got to be more to the totem than just that! The Grimtotems aren't likely to bring something like this to the battlefield unless it has some kind of utility.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 称心如意的武器
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从席瓦莱恩男爵那里夺得席瓦莱恩家族佩剑，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: $N，自从你开始冒险，你的导师们就已经看出你远超常人的天赋。你所取得的进步以及你执着的奉献精神让你成为联盟的榜样。$B$B为了表彰你对国家的忠诚，乌瑞恩国王命令皇家铁匠为你打造一件特殊的武器。$B$B传说在银松森林里那座被诅咒的影牙城堡里有打造武器所需的材料。去那里弄来遗失的席瓦莱恩家族佩剑、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Ander told me to expect you. It's quite an honor to be crafting a weapon for you, $n. With these materials, it will be a fine blade indeed.
text.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

english.title: A Fitting Weapon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Silverlaine Family Sword from Baron Silverlaine, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: From your earliest days, $N, your trainers identified you as a natural talent. Your rapid progress and dedication have made you an example.$B$BIn recognition of your service, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal armorer to forge a special weapon.$B$BLegend has it that the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is home to a variety of materials that you will need. Travel there and find the lost Silverlaine family sword, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Ander told me to expect you. It's quite an honor to be crafting a weapon for you, $n. With these materials, it will be a fine blade indeed.
english.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

text.title: 海滩上的水兵
text.objectives: 向暮光高地暮光海滩的海军上尉埃姆利报到。
text.description: 高地的形势瞬息万变。我们的目标是突袭暮光堡垒，但是就算部落不来找麻烦，海滩登陆点的安全性也难以确保。$B$B我需要清理战舰的残骸，而前方的海滩需要防御力量。$B$B向暮光海滩的海军上尉埃姆利报到，帮助他手下的水兵击退部落的攻击吧！
text.completion: Keep your head down 'fore you lose it, $c! This is MY beach. The Horde WANTS my beach. They will NOT have my beach. Is the beach situation clear?
text.completed: Report to Lieutenant Emry at the Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Our Boys on the Shore
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Emry at the Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The situation here in the Highlands changes by the minute. Our objective is to storm the Bastion of Twilight, but I can't even secure a landing zone on the shore without the blasted Horde creating trouble.$B$BWhile I scrape together the remains of the fleet, I need men on the shore securing the beach head.$B$BReport to Lieutenant Emry on the shore and help his marines to beat back the Horde!
english.completion: Keep your head down 'fore you lose it, $c! This is MY beach. The Horde WANTS my beach. They will NOT have my beach. Is the beach situation clear?
english.completed: Report to Lieutenant Emry at the Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 沼泽中的毒药
text.objectives: 从暗牙爬行者或毒性切割者身上收集6瓶沼泽毒药。
text.description: 如果你指望学徒莫兰恩去做些什么的话，我想他所能做的也只有对着材料发牢骚了。$B$B我通常都是无视他，但根本不起作用。这次，我要试些不同的方法。$B$B如果我在他发现之前把缺少的材料补上，也许他就能让我安静一会。我们最常用的材料是沼泽毒药，那东西可以从农场北面沼泽的暗牙爬行者和毒性切割者身上得到。如果你能帮我弄来毒药，我就可以在莫兰恩发现前把它放回去。
text.progress: Did you get that venom? Morlann's going to discover that it's gone any moment now...
text.completion: This is absolutely perfect! He'll never know the difference.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: The Reagent Thief
english.objectives: Collect 6 vials of Marsh Venom from Darkfang Creepers or Noxious Shredders.
english.description: If there's one thing you can count on Apprentice Morlann to do, it's whine about reagents.$B$BNormally, I just ignore him, and it never works. This time, I'm going to try something different.$B$BMaybe if I replace the missing reagents before he notices, he'll leave me alone. The most common reagent we both use is marsh venom, which comes from the darkfang creepers and noxious shredders in the marsh north of the farm. If you bring me the venom, I'll replace it before Morlann notices it's gone.
english.progress: Did you get that venom? Morlann's going to discover that it's gone any moment now...
english.completion: This is absolutely perfect! He'll never know the difference.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 恐角袭击者
text.objectives: 在恐角岗哨消灭12名恐怖图腾。
text.description: 恐怖图腾的成员聚集在北面的恐角岗哨，现在他们真是越来越大胆了。在晚上，你能常常听到他们在颂唱与这里的居民战斗的“事迹”。$B$B他们决心把我们从农场上赶走，但是塔贝萨在这里训练了一代代的学徒，怎么会说走就走呢？我们尽全力保护着农场，但学徒加里奥在上次战斗中受伤了。$B$B去恐角岗哨消灭你能找到的所有恐怖图腾！必须阻止他们的进攻！
text.completion: Good. Can't say I'll miss the company, if you can call it that. You'd think at least in the middle of the swamp you'd get some privacy, you know?
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Morlann at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Direhorn Raiders
english.objectives: Kill 12 Grimtotem in Direhorn Post.
english.description: The Grimtotems up at Direhorn Post, just to the north, are getting bolder by the day. At night, you can often hear them chanting about their deeds in battle against people who've tried to settle here.$B$BThey're determined to drive us from Tabetha's farm even though she's trained generations of apprentices here. We've defended the farm as best we can, but Apprentice Garion was wounded in the last attack.$B$BGo to Direhorn Post and kill any Grimtotem you can find! The attacks must stop.
english.completion: Good. Can't say I'll miss the company, if you can call it that. You'd think at least in the middle of the swamp you'd get some privacy, you know?
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Morlann at Tabetha's Farm in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 侦查海滩
text.objectives: 侦查暮光海滩的滩头控制点。你不必占领控制点，但是成功占领的话，你会被标记为开启PvP状态，且你所在的营地可以获得作战优势。
text.description: 有他们就没我们，$C。只有一方能拥有这片海滩的控制权。$B$B此地以北的小山丘可以鸟瞰整个海岸线。如果能占领它，就可以取得海滩战的绝对优势！$B$B我需要知道目前的形势。侦查滩头控制点，就是那座插有大旗的小山丘，然后回来向我汇报。$B$B你不必占领它，除非你想干一架……
text.completion: That's the lay of the land, soldier. If you're having trouble fighting here on the coast, you might consider pitching in and helping us take and hold that hill.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shore in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Scouting the Shore
english.objectives: Scout the Beach Head Control Point on the Twilight Shore. You don't need to capture it, but doing so will give your side a combat advantage and flag you for PvP.
english.description: It's them or us, $c. Only one of us can command this beach.$B$BNorth of here you'll see a small hill with a commanding view of the shoreline. Whoever controls that hill will have the upper hand up and down the shore!$B$BI need to know what the current situation is. Scout the beach head control point, marked by that enormous flag, and return to me.$B$BYou don't have to try to capture it, unless you're spoiling for a fight...
english.completion: That's the lay of the land, soldier. If you're having trouble fighting here on the coast, you might consider pitching in and helping us take and hold that hill.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shore in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 迟早，一切都会清楚的
text.objectives: 采集6份破狼草。
text.description: 黑暗女王派你和阿尔苏拉来，有一个十分特别的目的。在我进一步告诉你之前，我们必须做一些准备。$B$B到东边吉尔尼斯的森林里去，在大树和石头附近寻找该地区一种特别的植物：破狼草。尽你所能把破狼草采来给我。$B$B我们在这里的任务所关乎到的，远远不止整个战场，$N。迟早，一切都会清楚的。
text.progress: Did you gather the wolfsbane?
text.completion: Good. Now just do as Forward Commander Onslaught commands. Try your best to fit in with the rest of the soldiers. We don't want the Gilneas Liberation Front to get suspicious. Oh, you  didn't know they were watching us? Right now there are five different worgen spies looking down on our position. Just be calm and follow orders. I'll let you know when we are ready to proceed.
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: In Time, All Will Be Revealed
english.objectives: Collect 6 Wolfsbane.
english.description: The Dark Lady has sent you and Arthura here for a very specific purpose. Before I tell you more, we must make preparations.$B$BHead east into the forest of Gilneas and search near the trees and rocks of the region for a special plant known as wolfsbane. Gather as much of the wolfsbane as you can carry and return to me.$B$BOur mission here goes far beyond the scope of the battlefield, $N. In time, all will be revealed.
english.progress: Did you gather the wolfsbane?
english.completion: Good. Now just do as Forward Commander Onslaught commands. Try your best to fit in with the rest of the soldiers. We don't want the Gilneas Liberation Front to get suspicious. Oh, you  didn't know they were watching us? Right now there are five different worgen spies looking down on our position. Just be calm and follow orders. I'll let you know when we are ready to proceed.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: 圣光之手
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从指挥官斯普林瓦尔那里夺得指挥官的神圣符记，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: $N，我一直在观察你的成长。我只能说，圣光照耀着你前进的道路。你将成为$C中的楷模。$B$B乌瑞恩国王命令皇家铸甲师为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B只有银松森林那座被诅咒的影牙城堡里有打造武器所需的材料。去那里弄来指挥官斯普林瓦尔的的神圣符记、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Do you have the materials for your weapon?
text.completion: Lord Grayson has told me much about you and your dedication to the Light and the Alliance. It will be a great honor to craft a hammer for you, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

english.title: The Hand of the Light
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: I have been watching your progress, $N, and I can only conclude that the Light shines brightly upon you. You are becoming an exemplary $c.$B$BTo honor your dedication, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal armorer to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe materials to make your weapon are unique, and only found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and recover the holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Do you have the materials for your weapon?
english.completion: Lord Grayson has told me much about you and your dedication to the Light and the Alliance. It will be a great honor to craft a hammer for you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

starters.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 应得的奖励
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，获得高弗雷的水晶瞄准镜，还有5捆月触之木和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: $N，你所取得的成就不仅给我留下了深刻的印象，就连乌瑞恩国王都赞叹你使用弓箭和驾驭宠物的技术，还有你对联盟的忠心。$B$B国王命令皇家弓箭手为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B银松森林中那座被诅咒的影牙城堡里有很多独一无二的材料。去那里弄来高弗雷勋爵枪上的水晶瞄准镜、一些月触之木，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Who knew that cursed old keep hid such valuable items? I'll be honored to craft them into a fine weapon for you.
text.completed: Speak to Frederick Stover in Stormwind's Trade District.

english.title: A Well-Earned Reward
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Godfrey's Crystal Scope from Lord Godfrey, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: I am not the only one impressed by your progress $N. Your mastery of bow and pet and your dedication to the Alliance have reached the ears of King Wrynn.$B$BIn recognition of your service, the king has commissioned the royal bowyer to craft a special weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is home to the unique materials needed for your weapon. Travel there and obtain the scope from Lord Godfrey's gun, a supply of moontouched wood, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Who knew that cursed old keep hid such valuable items? I'll be honored to craft them into a fine weapon for you.
english.completed: Speak to Frederick Stover in Stormwind's Trade District.

text.title: 死亡通讯器
text.objectives: 找到被遗忘者的通讯装置。
text.description: 我们同所有前线哨所的通讯都中断了，$N。现在我根本不清楚我们的部队在吉尔尼斯状况如何。我们得重新建立起联络。$B$B我要你到西边的海角去，找到我们在海岸上的哨所。目前那里的士兵很可能已经都死了，但他们的死亡通讯器或许还在工作。把那装置拿来给我。
text.progress: Recover the F.C.D.
text.completion: With this device I will be able to communicate with you in the field. Now to check the rest of our frontline outposts.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: The F.C.D.
english.objectives: Recover the Forsaken Communication Device.
english.description: Communications are down with all of our frontline outposts, $N. As of right now I don't have a damn clue as to the status of our troops in Gilneas. We need to re-establish communications.$B$BI need you to head west into the headlands and find our outpost on the coast. By now the soldiers there are likely all dead, but their F.C.D. might be operational. Grab the device and get back to me.
english.progress: Recover the F.C.D.
english.completion: With this device I will be able to communicate with you in the field. Now to check the rest of our frontline outposts.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 坠毁的飞艇
text.objectives: 跟比吉尔的飞艇残骸的莫希·斯蒂格里谈一谈。
text.description: Not long ago, a goblin zeppelin crashed to the east. A representative of the Steamwheedle Cartel passed through here a few days ago.$B$BShe was looking for information about the zeppelin's cargo and it's pilot, Beezil, but none of us really got a good look at the crash. I doubt she'll be able to clean up after the wreck by herself, much less recover whatever cargo the vessel might have carried.$B$BIf you have time, you may want to check up on her out at Beezil's Wreck, due east of here, near the mountains.
text.completion: So those hermit mages sent you? How can I be sure that I can trust you? I suppose I can use the help. There's not much here a mage would be interested in, anyway.

english.title: The Zeppelin Crash
english.objectives: Speak with Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck.
english.description: Not long ago, a goblin zeppelin crashed to the east. A representative of the Steamwheedle Cartel passed through here a few days ago.$B$BShe was looking for information about the zeppelin's cargo and it's pilot, Beezil, but none of us really got a good look at the crash. I doubt she'll be able to clean up after the wreck by herself, much less recover whatever cargo the vessel might have carried.$B$BIf you have time, you may want to check up on her out at Beezil's Wreck, due east of here, near the mountains.
english.completion: So those hermit mages sent you? How can I be sure that I can trust you? I suppose I can use the help. There's not much here a mage would be interested in, anyway.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 阻止腐蚀
text.objectives: 莫希·斯蒂格里希望你去溶解10只软泥怪，然后回到比吉尔的飞艇残骸旁向她复命。
text.description: 看看这个地方！到处都是软泥怪，要是我不想点什么办法控制它们的话，它们就会腐蚀掉残骸和飞艇的货物！$B$B我不能空手回去，$C！在这些软泥怪消化掉所有东西之前，帮我消灭它们吧！$B$B这台设备充电后可以将能量集中到这些泥浆怪身上，让它们爆炸。飞艇的能量核心碎片应该可以给这台设备提供能量，靠近主坠毁点的那个始终可以正常工作，不过其它的时好时坏。
text.progress: Did you make any progress against those oozes?
text.completion: Well, it does look a little cleaner out there... I suppose it's time to get down to the business of salvaging this wreckage.
text.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Corrosion Prevention
english.objectives: Moxie Steelgrille wants you to dissolve 10 oozes and report back to her at Beezil's Wreck.
english.description: Just look at this area! It's swarming with oozes. If I don't find some way to keep them under control, they'll corrode the wreckage and the zeppelin's cargo!$B$BI can't go back empty-handed, $c! Help me dissolve these oozes before they've digested everything!$B$BThis device, when powered, will concentrate energy on the slimes, causing them to explode. The zeppelin's fragmented power core should power the device. The one near the main crash works all the time, but the others flicker on and off.
english.progress: Did you make any progress against those oozes?
english.completion: Well, it does look a little cleaner out there... I suppose it's time to get down to the business of salvaging this wreckage.
english.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 回收货物！
text.objectives: 比吉尔的飞艇残骸处的莫希·斯蒂格里要你找回8件飞艇上的货物。
text.description: 这艘飞艇运送了足足6个月的补给品给我们的泥链镇！当然，他们可以靠这些撑上一会儿，但没法坚持太久。$B$B我被派到这里来寻找任何我能找到的货物，但飞船的残骸支离破碎地散落在这块区域。我确信有很多货物没能在坠毁中保住，但你能不能尽可能地帮我把货物找来？
text.progress: Did the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
text.completion: Wow! You certainly found a lot more than I expected would be out there. I'm not sure how much Drazzit thought we were going to find out here, but he's going to have to be happy with this for now.
text.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

english.title: Secure the Cargo!
english.objectives: Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck wants you to recover 8 pieces of Zeppelin Cargo.
english.description: This zeppelin was carrying six months' worth of supplies to us at Mudsprocket! Sure, they've been able to barter for some of what they need, but they won't hold out forever.$B$BI've been sent out here to recover what I can of the cargo, but the wreckage is scattered all over the marsh in this area. I'm sure a lot of the cargo didn't survive the crash, but are you willing to help me recover what we can?
english.progress: Did the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
english.completion: Wow! You certainly found a lot more than I expected would be out there. I'm not sure how much Drazzit thought we were going to find out here, but he's going to have to be happy with this for now.
english.completed: Return to Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

text.title: 联络中断：恐惧之卫哨所
text.objectives: 调查恐惧之卫哨所。
text.description: 我就跟你说实话吧，$N。我要你去做的事情无异于自杀。失败的可能大概是95%。$B$B来自恐惧之卫哨所的所有通讯都中断了。狼人时常骚扰，我们无法前往恐惧之卫照应我们的士兵。我要你到南边的哨所去，看看我们士兵们的情况。从现在起我会通过被遗忘者的通讯装置——死亡通讯器——来和你保持联系。$B$B一定要避开主路。
text.completion: Dreadwatch is lost? This is bad, $n. Real bad. If Dreadwatch is compromised it means we've lost Gilneas City.
text.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
text.turninWindow: Dreadwatch was our most fortified outpost.

english.title: Break in Communications: Dreadwatch Outpost
english.objectives: Investigate Dreadwatch Outpost.
english.description: I'm not gonna lie to you, $N. What I'm about to ask you to do is suicide. Chance of failure is about 95%.$B$BAll communication from Dreadwatch Outpost has been severed. With the worgen constantly rushing us we have no means by which to get to Dreadwatch to check on our soldiers. I need you to head south to the outpost and check on our soldiers. I'll keep in contact through the Forsaken communication device - F.C.D. - from here on out.$B$BKEEP CLEAR OF THE MAIN ROAD.
english.completion: Dreadwatch is lost? This is bad, $n. Real bad. If Dreadwatch is compromised it means we've lost Gilneas City.
english.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.turninWindow: Dreadwatch was our most fortified outpost.

text.title: 联络中断：拉特萨克营地
text.objectives: 去找吉尔尼斯废墟拉特萨克营地的拉特萨克队长。
text.description: <死亡通讯器嗡嗡作响。>$B$B我们要去的下一个哨所叫做拉特萨克营地，就在恐惧之卫正东。到拉特萨克营地去的时候，避开狼人突袭者，$N。你是不会想要单枪匹马地对付这些怪物的。$B$B如果你能活着到那儿，就找拉特萨克队长。$B$B做好最坏的打算便是。
text.completion: Th... Af... After we lost Gilneas City, the port fell. HU... HUM... HUMANS ARE HERE! Reinforcements from Stormwind! They slaughtered my men. Left me alive to witness their strength. To tell high command... To tell them that the 7th Legion are here...
text.giverWindow: Rutsak's Guard protected our right flank.

english.title: Break in Communications: Rutsak's Guard
english.objectives: Find Captain Rutsak at Rutsak's Guard in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.description: <The F.C.D. hums.>$B$BOur next outpost is Rutsak's Guard, located due east of Dreadwatch. Make your way to Rutsak's while avoiding the worgen rushers, $N. You don't want to deal with those monsters by yourself.$B$BIf you make it there in one piece, look for Captain Rutsak.$B$BJust be prepared for the worst.
english.completion: Th... Af... After we lost Gilneas City, the port fell. HU... HUM... HUMANS ARE HERE! Reinforcements from Stormwind! They slaughtered my men. Left me alive to witness their strength. To tell high command... To tell them that the 7th Legion are here...
english.giverWindow: Rutsak's Guard protected our right flank.

text.title: 皇家的奖励
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从指挥官斯普林瓦尔那里夺得斯普林瓦尔的磨刀石，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 军情七处一直在关注你。你对联盟的贡献得到了军情七处首领的赞扬，你的英雄事迹甚至传到了国王的耳朵里。$B$B乌瑞恩国王命令皇家铸甲师为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B银松森林里那座被诅咒的影牙城堡有打造武器所需的材料。去那里弄来指挥官斯普林瓦尔的磨刀石、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: It was quite an honor to receive the commission for your weapon, $n. When Tony mentioned using so many exotic materials, I had my doubts, but it seems you managed to find them all. This will be a fine reward for all you've done for the Alliance.
text.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

english.title: A Royal Reward
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Springvale's Sharpening Stone from Commander Springvale, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: SI:7 has been watching your progress with interest. You service to the Alliance is well-known and tales of your deeds have reached the king's ears.$B$BIn recognition of your service, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal armorer to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is home to the exotic materials for your weapon. Travel there and recover Commander Springvale's sharpening stone, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: It was quite an honor to receive the commission for your weapon, $n. When Tony mentioned using so many exotic materials, I had my doubts, but it seems you managed to find them all. This will be a fine reward for all you've done for the Alliance.
english.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

text.title: 液体黄金
text.objectives: 找到一瓶斯坦索姆圣水。
text.description: 正当天灾如瘟疫般横扫斯坦索姆的时候，白银之手的骑士们制造了圣水来对付入侵者。他们将它和其他重要物资一起放在小箱子中，分发到整个城市。不幸的是，这些补给还没来得及使用，市民就被变成了天灾的援兵！$B$B这些补给箱将对我们十分有用。给我带一瓶斯坦索姆圣水来，我们要进行大规模的复制。
text.progress: Is that the vial of Stratholme Holy Water?$B$BWait, is that just regular water? Don't play games with ol' Stonebruiser!
text.completion: Excellent! I think the holy water will prove devastating in large volumes.
text.completed: Return to Packmaster Stonebruiser.

english.title: Liquid Gold
english.objectives: Find a vial of Stratholme Holy Water.
english.description: As the Scourge swept through Stratholme like a plague, the Knights of the Silver Hand manufactured holy water to use against the invaders. They stored it inside small crates along with other vital supplies, and distributed them throughout the city. Unfortunately, the citizens turned into Scourge reinforcements before the supplies could ever be used!$B$BThese supply crates will prove extremely useful to our efforts. Bring me a vial of Stratholme Holy Water, we need to have it replicated in mass quantities.
english.progress: Is that the vial of Stratholme Holy Water?$B$BWait, is that just regular water? Don't play games with ol' Stonebruiser!
english.completion: Excellent! I think the holy water will prove devastating in large volumes.
english.completed: Return to Packmaster Stonebruiser.

starters.name: 马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤

enders.name: 马队管理者布鲁斯·石锤

text.title: 元素的祝福
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，夺取沃登的护符，还有迷失灵魂之书和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: $N，你的天赋引起了萨满祭司界的关注。你驾驭元素之力的能力以及你对联盟的忠心已经传到了皇族的耳朵里。$B$B乌瑞恩国王命令皇家铸甲师为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B银松森林里那座被诅咒的影牙城堡有打造武器所需的材料。去那里弄来沃登勋爵的护符、迷失灵魂之书，以及在城堡中游荡的幽灵身上的精华吧。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I have rarely had the chance to work with such exotic materials, but even I can sense the power residing within them. I will have the honor of crafting an incredible weapon for you, $n. The farseer did not underestimate your abilities when she told me about you.
text.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

english.title: Blessings of the Elements
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Walden's Talisman, the Book of Lost Souls, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: Your talent has attracted much attention in shamanic circles, $N. Word of your mastery of the elements and dedication to the Alliance has even reached the palace.$B$BIn recognition of your service, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal armorer to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe materials for your weapon can only be found in Silverpine Forest's cursed Shadowfang Keep. Travel there and retrieve Lord Walden's talisman, the Book of Lost Souls, and the essence of the ghosts haunting the castle.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I have rarely had the chance to work with such exotic materials, but even I can sense the power residing within them. I will have the honor of crafting an incredible weapon for you, $n. The farseer did not underestimate your abilities when she told me about you.
english.completed: Speak to Therum Deepforge in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

text.title: 掌控奥术
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从席瓦莱恩男爵那里夺得席瓦莱恩魔化水晶，并收集5捆月触之木和5个幽灵精华。
text.description: 你已经证明了自己是个聪慧的学徒，以及联盟的忠实拥护者。就连国王也听说了你的事迹。$B$B乌瑞恩国王命令皇家附魔师为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B但打造武器所需的材料只有银松森林那座被诅咒的影牙城堡里才能找到。去那里寻找席瓦莱恩家族失落的遗物、月触之木和幽灵精华吧。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Ah, I have been expecting you, $n. Maginor Dumas has spoken highly of you and the royal commission only confirms his words. It is an honor to be able to craft a staff for you.
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: Mastering the Arcane
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Silverlaine's Enchanted Crystal from Baron Silverlaine, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: You have proven yourself a brilliant student and a dedicated servant of the Alliance. Word of your accomplishments has even reached the ears of the king.$B$BIn recognition of your service, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal enchanter to create a special weapon.$B$BThe materials required for your staff are found only in Silverpine Forest's cursed Shadowfang Keep. Travel there and find a lost heirloom of the Silverlaine family, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Ah, I have been expecting you, $n. Maginor Dumas has spoken highly of you and the royal commission only confirms his words. It is an honor to be able to craft a staff for you.
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 皇室的恩赐
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从高弗雷勋爵那里夺得晦暗之球，还有迷失灵魂之书和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 在你的努力下，国王逐渐注意到我们的力量以及我们对联盟的价值。或许他已经开始接纳我们了。$B$B乌瑞恩国王命令皇家附魔师为你打造一件特殊的武器以示表彰。$B$B银松森林的影牙城堡里有打造武器所需的材料。去那里弄来高弗雷勋爵手中的晦暗之球、迷失灵魂之书，以及在城堡中游荡的幽灵身上的精华吧。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I won't ask what you had to do to come by such rare and powerful materials, but I'm glad to have the chance to work with them. Your weapon will be magnificent!
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage District.

english.title: A Boon for the Powerful
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Tenebrous Orb from Lord Godfrey, the Book of Lost Souls, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: The king is finally beginning to take note of our power and our value to the Alliance, thanks to your deeds. Perhaps they are beginning to accept our kind.$B$BKing Wrynn has commissioned the royal enchanter to create a powerful weapon in recognition of your achievements.$B$BThe materials you will need come from Silverpine Forest's Shadowfang Keep. Travel there and obtain the tenebrous orb held by Lord Godfrey, the Book of Lost Souls, and the essence of the ghosts haunting the castle.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I won't ask what you had to do to come by such rare and powerful materials, but I'm glad to have the chance to work with them. Your weapon will be magnificent!
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage District.

text.title: 议会的未来
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从沃登勋爵那里夺取沃登的药剂，还有5捆月触之木和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 塞纳里奥议会对你的功绩十分满意。$N。你是所有德鲁伊的自豪，我们将你和你的同辈视作议会的未来。$B$B议会决定为你制作一把特殊的法杖以兹嘉奖。$B$B你这把法杖的材料稀有而强大，只能从银松森林的影牙城堡里获得。去那里弄来沃登勋爵配制的药剂、一些月触之木，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your staff?
text.completion: Ah, you must be the $c Loganaar was talking about. It is a pleasure to finally meet you. Loganaar and other members of the circle speak highly of you. It will be an honor to make a weapon for such a $c.
text.completed: Speak to Narianna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: The Circle's Future
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain Walden's Elixirs from Lord Walden, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: The Cenarion Circle is pleased with your progress, $N. You are a credit to all druids and we look to you and your peers as the future of of our brotherhood.$B$BThe circle has decided to honor you with the creation of unique staff.$B$BThe rare and powerful materials needed for your staff can only be found in Shadowfang Keep inside Silverpine Forest. Travel there and retrieve Lord Walden's collection of elixirs, a supply of moontouched wood, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your staff?
english.completion: Ah, you must be the $c Loganaar was talking about. It is a pleasure to finally meet you. Loganaar and other members of the circle speak highly of you. It will be an honor to make a weapon for such a $c.
english.completed: Speak to Narianna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 压寨夫人
text.objectives: 跟千针石林黑云峰的拉克塔·风歌谈一谈。
text.description: 当然了！拉克塔·风歌！我之前怎么没有想到呢？$B$B阿纳克多年前就曾经绑架过拉克塔，强迫她做他的新娘。拉克塔一度成功逃脱，但在最近攻打乱风岗的混乱中，她再度被他俘虏。$B$B拉克塔肯定就在这儿附近。在这几年里她成为了一个称职的秘法师。我猜她知道该拿这些牛头人的神器怎么办。
text.completion: It is embarrassing to have been kidnapped by Arnak again. I heard the fighting outside. Did you kill him? I am happy to be free once more. Now, how can I help you, $r?

english.title: The Captive Bride
english.objectives: Speak with Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Of course! Lakota Windsong! Why didn't I think of this before?$B$BArnak kidnapped Lakota years ago and tried to force her into being his bride. She managed to escape, but in the chaos of the recent attack on Freewind Post, he took her again.$B$BShe has to be around here somewhere. She's become quite the mystic in recent years. I'm guessing she'll know what to do with these tauren artifacts.
english.completion: It is embarrassing to have been kidnapped by Arnak again. I heard the fighting outside. Did you kill him? I am happy to be free once more. Now, how can I help you, $r?

text.title: 压寨夫人
text.objectives: 跟千针石林黑云峰的拉克塔·风歌谈一谈。
text.description: 拉克塔·风歌！我之前怎么没有想到呢？$B$B阿纳克多年前就曾经绑架过拉克塔，强迫她做他的新娘。在他人的帮助下，拉克塔一度逃脱，但在最近攻打乱风岗的混乱中，她再度被他俘虏。$B$B拉克塔肯定就在这儿附近。在这几年里她成为了一个称职的萨满。我肯定她明白响器、文书和战鼓的奥秘所在。
text.completion: It is embarrassing to have been kidnapped by Arnak again. I heard the fighting outside. Did you kill him? I am happy to be free once more. Now, how can I help you, $c?

english.title: The Captive Bride
english.objectives: Speak with Lakota Windsong at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Lakota Windsong! Why did I not think of this before?$B$BArnak kidnapped Lakota years ago and tried to force her to be his bride. With help, she was able to escape, but in the chaos of the recent attack on Freewind Post, he took her again.$B$BShe must be near. She has become quite the shaman in recent years. I am sure that she will understand the significance of the rattle, the writ, and the drums.
english.completion: It is embarrassing to have been kidnapped by Arnak again. I heard the fighting outside. Did you kill him? I am happy to be free once more. Now, how can I help you, $c?

text.title: 银色援兵
text.objectives: 获取4份女妖精华。
text.description: 天灾启用了某种结界，阻止我打开传送门，我们的援兵无法前来帮忙攻城！它就好像我的脑袋里有种永无休止的尖啸！啊！$B$B我在尽可能地用这道屏障挡住噪声，维持理智。我猜是女妖们在负责防御。如果你能把她们的精华带一些给我，我想我可以用它们来反制结界，把我们的人送进去！
text.progress: Were you able to obtain the essences? Be careful, they're deadly spellcasters.
text.completion: Oh my... the banshees are very tortured souls indeed. Merely holding their essence is emotionally painful... Enough of that for now. I'll get to work on counteracting their magic, then we'll have a portal up and running in no time. Stratholme will be ours soon, I just know it.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Angela Dosantos.

english.title: Argent Reinforcements
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Banshee Essences.
english.description: The Scourge have some sort of ward in place that's preventing me from opening a portal so that our reinforcements can help us take the city! It's like a neverending screaming inside of my head! Agh!$B$BI'm doing all I can to retain my sanity from that noise with this barrier. My best guess is that the banshees are maintaining the defense. If you could bring me some of their essences, I think I can use them to counteract the ward and get our boys in here!
english.progress: Were you able to obtain the essences? Be careful, they're deadly spellcasters.
english.completion: Oh my... the banshees are very tortured souls indeed. Merely holding their essence is emotionally painful... Enough of that for now. I'll get to work on counteracting their magic, then we'll have a portal up and running in no time. Stratholme will be ours soon, I just know it.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Angela Dosantos.

starters.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 为我们的士兵们复仇
text.objectives: 杀死10名第七军团潜水员。
text.description: 第七军团……他们在深夜对我们发动突袭。潜水员把我的人都给杀掉的时候，他们的队长在大声发号施令。然后他到我跟前，把脸凑上来，说了我永远不会忘记的话：$B$B“我是军士长皮亚托·扎伦，第七军团的军官。当你在噩梦中看见你的士兵被宰杀——假如你还会做梦的话——记住我的名字，然后颤抖吧。”$B$B为我的士兵们复仇！杀掉西南边占领吉尔尼斯城教堂区的第七军团。
text.completion: Though we were shamed in battle, the enemy was not victorious. I will not soon forget this, $n. If I make it back to Silverpine I will likely retire from the service. War is not in my blood.
text.completed: Return to Captain Rutsak at Rutsak's Guard in the Ruins of Gilneas.

english.title: Vengeance for Our Soldiers
english.objectives: Kill 10 7th Legion Submariners.
english.description: 7th Legion... They rushed us in the dead of the night. Their captain barked orders as the submariners slaughtered my men. Then he came to me, put his face in mine, and said something I'll never forget:$B$B"The name's Master Sergeant Pietro Zaren, officer in the 7th Legion. When you see your soldiers being slaughtered in your nightmares - if you even still dream - remember my name and tremble."$B$BAvenge my soldiers! Kill the 7th Legion occupying the Cathedral Quarter of Gilneas City, southwest of here.
english.completion: Though we were shamed in battle, the enemy was not victorious. I will not soon forget this, $n. If I make it back to Silverpine I will likely retire from the service. War is not in my blood.
english.completed: Return to Captain Rutsak at Rutsak's Guard in the Ruins of Gilneas.

text.title: 圣光的眷顾
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 圣光的确照耀着你，以及你为联盟做出的牺牲，$N。你为牧师同袍们做出了榜样。$B$B为了嘉奖你的杰出，乌瑞恩国王已委托皇家附魔师制作一把特殊的法杖。$B$B这把武器的材料只能从银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡里获得。去那里将失落的指挥官的神圣符记找到，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: Favored of the Light
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: The Light truly shines in you and your dedication to the Alliance, $N. You serve as an example to your fellow priests and comrades in arms.$B$BIn recognition of your deeds, King Wrynn has commissioned the royal enchanter to create a special staff.$B$BThe materials for such a weapon can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and ghostly essence from the spirits haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 艾露恩的眷顾
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 你是艾露恩真正的仆人，我们人民的榜样，联盟的忠实公仆。月神殿和暴风城教廷希望能够表彰你的成就。$B$B我们已经委托皇家附魔师为你制作一把法杖。$B$B这把法杖的材料只能从银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡里获得。去那里将失落的指挥官斯普林瓦尔的神圣符记找到，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: Favored of Elune
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: You are a true servant of Elune, an example to our people, and stalwart servant of the Alliance. The Temple of the Moon and the court of Stormwind wish to honor your achievements.$B$BWe have commissioned the royal enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe materials for your staff can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and ghostly essence from the spirits haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 崭露头角的医师
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 你证明了自己是一名优秀的牧师、诺莫瑞根人民的骄傲。大工匠和暴风城国王希望能够荣誉表彰你的贡献。$B$B他们已经委托皇家附魔师制作一把特殊的法杖。$B$B这把武器的材料只能从银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡里获得。去那里将失落的指挥官的神圣符记找到，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
text.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: A Budding Young Surgeon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: You have shown yourself to be a capable priest and a credit to the people of Gnomeregan. The high tinker and the king of Stormwind wish to honor your contribution to the Alliance.$B$BThey have commissioned the royal enchanter to create a special staff.$B$BThe materials for such a weapon can only be found in the cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and ghostly essence from the spirits haunting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: I can't believe you managed to get all those materials. I wouldn't think of venturing into Shadowfang Keep! The stories about that place are horrific. Enough of that, though. This is a time to recognize your achievements, not prattle on about my silly fears.
english.completed: Speak to Lucan Cordell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 谁下的令？
text.objectives: 获得高级指挥官的命令。
text.description: <死亡通讯器响起了一阵蜂鸣声。>$B$B第七军团乃是一支精英特种军团。几乎联盟的每一次主要进攻和军事冲突，幕后总有他们。这是个坏消息。他们是怎么绕过我们的战舰的？是谁下的命令让他们来的？$B$B我们得弄到他们的命令。这个叫皮亚托的人物毫无疑问有着重要情报。在吉尔尼斯城教堂区找到他，把他干掉。在他的尸体上寻找线索。
text.progress: 情况如何?
text.completion: An Alliance armada is en route? How could this have happened? You've got to hurry, $n. We're being overrun up here at Forward Command.
text.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
text.giverWindow: Zaren is your next target.

english.title: On Whose Orders?
english.objectives: Recover the Orders from High Command.
english.description: <The F.C.D. buzzes.>$B$BThe 7th Legion are an elite special ops regiment. They've been there, behind the scenes, for almost every major offensive and military engagement the Alliance has ever done. This is bad news. How did they get past our warships? And on whose orders are they here?$B$BWe need to get our hands on their orders. This Pietro character will undoubtedly have vital information. Find him at the Cathedral Quarter in Gilneas City and take him out. Search his corpse for clues.
english.progress: Status?
english.completion: An Alliance armada is en route? How could this have happened? You've got to hurry, $n. We're being overrun up here at Forward Command.
english.completed: Speak with Forward Commander Onslaught at Forsaken Forward Command in the Ruins of Gilneas.
english.giverWindow: Zaren is your next target.

text.title: 称心如意的武器
text.objectives: 进入影牙城堡，从席瓦莱恩男爵那里夺得席瓦莱恩家族佩剑，还有5箱月钢锭和5束不死肌腱。
text.description: 从一开始，你的训练师就看出来你终有一日将在部落的留下你自己的印记。你战斗英勇，敌人闻风而惧。$B$B作为你献身精神的奖赏，酋长已经委托他的私人工匠为你铸造一把特殊的武器。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里弄来席瓦莱恩家族佩剑、一些月钢锭，还有在城堡里出没的食尸鬼和恶鬼的肌腱。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Grezz Ragefist told me to expect you. Those materials will make a fine sword. Always use it for the glory of the Horde.
text.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: A Fitting Weapon
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Silverlaine Family Sword from Baron Silverlaine, 5 crates of Moonsteel Ingots, and 5 Deathless Sinew.
english.description: From your earliest days, your trainers always knew you would make your mark on the Horde. You have fought bravely and given our enemies reason to fear.$B$BAs a reward for your dedication, the warchief has commissioned his personal smith to forge a special weapon.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost Silverlaine family sword, a supply of moonsteel ingots, and sinew from the ghouls and geists infesting the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Grezz Ragefist told me to expect you. Those materials will make a fine sword. Always use it for the glory of the Horde.
english.completed: Speak to Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 夺取海滩
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光海滩干掉12名斧咬陆战队员。
text.description: 海滩上到处都是部落的斧咬陆战队员。$B$B<海军上尉埃姆利指向北面的海滩。>$B$B干掉他们。
text.completion: Dead? By the dozen? It's a start, $c. It's a start.
text.completed: Report your success to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Landgrab
english.objectives: Slay 12 Axebite Marines on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Horde's Axebite Marines are all up in my precious, precious beach.$B$B<The Lieutenant points north, along the shore.>$B$BKill them.
english.completion: Dead? By the dozen? It's a start, $c. It's a start.
english.completed: Report your success to Lieutenant Emry on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 吉德文·金须
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地的吉德文·金须。
text.description: 我爱我的小伙子们，别想歪了。但我告诉他们，我需要五分钟来歇歇马，他们干了些什么呢？他们打了一个愚蠢的赌，然后就跑掉了！我就知道……这种事情总是有。$B$B吉德文是那个矮个子的。他沿着河朝北边去了。要是你往那个方向走的话，能不能叫他回来？我们得赶去圣光之愿礼拜堂，其实我倒是不反对撇下他。
text.completion: Tarenar?  Is that you? Whoever you are, would you mind helping me out of this thing?
text.giverWindow: Help me find Gidwin!

english.title: Gidwin Goldbraids
english.objectives: Find Gidwin Goldbraids in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I love my boys, don't get me wrong.  But I TOLD them that I needed FIVE MINUTES to water and brush the horses, and what did they do?  They made a stupid bet with each other and ran off!  I should have known better... this always happens.$b$bGidwin's the short one.  He headed north, along the river.  If you're headed that direction, would you tell him to come back?  We've got to get to Light's Hope Chapel, and I'm not against leaving without him.
english.completion: Tarenar?  Is that you? Whoever you are, would you mind helping me out of this thing?
english.giverWindow: Help me find Gidwin!

text.title: 缚手缚脚
text.objectives: 从恶蛛隧道中的蛛魔身上收集8瓶地穴蛛魔胆汁。
text.description: 你应该看到我的战绩了吧！我杀的肯定至少有六只怪物，在我……$B$B噢，等等，你会数数儿的，对吧？那么好吧。我杀了四只，然后第五只用网困住了我。更糟糕的是，当它把这堆粘稠的蛛网液体喷向我的时候，我的嘴正好是张开的！$B$B看样子我是扯不断这张网了，换作是你估计也不行。所以你得从那些亡灵蜘蛛肚子里弄点胃液来，就可以融掉蛛网了。
text.progress: Oh boy... Fiona is going to be madder than a wet harpy.  You'd better hurry.
text.completion: You're back?!  Thank the Light! Before you throw that acid on me, I need to ask: Are you the guy who was here before, or are you one of those eight-legged cowards?  I need to know whether or not I should smack you on my way out.
text.completed: Return to Gidwin Goldbraids at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Just Encased
english.objectives: Obtain 8 vials of Crypt Bile from nerubians in Terrorweb Tunnel.
english.description: You should have seen me fight!  I must have killed six of those beasts, when...$b$bOh wait, you can count the bodies, can't you?  OK, fine.  I killed four of them, when the fifth one shot me with this web.  To make things even worse... when he blasted me with web juice, my mouth was open!$b$bI can't seem to break these webs, and I doubt you'll be able to, either.  No, you'll have to get some of the stomach juice from those undead spider-things.  That'll do the trick.
english.progress: Oh boy... Fiona is going to be madder than a wet harpy.  You'd better hurry.
english.completion: You're back?!  Thank the Light! Before you throw that acid on me, I need to ask: Are you the guy who was here before, or are you one of those eight-legged cowards?  I need to know whether or not I should smack you on my way out.
english.completed: Return to Gidwin Goldbraids at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 讨好之举
text.objectives: 在索多里尔河沿岸采集10朵女妖之铃。
text.description: 很抱歉，我还以为你是那些蜘蛛怪物假扮的$R呢。$B$B你好，我是吉德文·金须，很乐意为你效劳。我急着赶回马车那里去，不过你能不能再帮我最后一个忙？我的伙伴菲奥拉开了一家小店，她可能用得到生长在河岸边的一种草药。$B$B如果我们给她一些上等草药的话，她就不大可能宰了我啦。反正，我是这么打算的。
text.progress: Giddy's got you mixed up in all of this now?
text.completion: I'll tear that pint-size paladin to shreds before he... wait a minute are those Banshee's Bells?  You brought these for me? Oh, Gidwin asked you to get them for me!  That sweet little guy.  Alright.  He's off the hook for now.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Western Plaguelands.

english.title: Greasing the Wheel
english.objectives: Loot 10 Banshee's Bells from the shore of the Thondroril River.
english.description: Sorry about that.  I was pretty sure you were one of those spider-beasts, doing a bad $r impression.$b$bHow do you do?  Gidwin Goldbraids, at your service.  I'm in a bit of a hurry back to my caravan, but I was wondering if you might do me one last favor?  My pal Fiona runs a small shop, and she could probably use some of these herbs that grow along the river shore.$b$bI'm thinking if we give her some nice herbs, she'll be MUCH less likely to murder me.  That's the plan, anyway.
english.progress: Giddy's got you mixed up in all of this now?
english.completion: I'll tear that pint-size paladin to shreds before he... wait a minute are those Banshee's Bells?  You brought these for me? Oh, Gidwin asked you to get them for me!  That sweet little guy.  Alright.  He's off the hook for now.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 塔伦纳·射日者
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地死亡小径的塔伦纳·射日者。
text.description: 我们一停下来，他们就打了一个什么“看谁能在五分钟里杀的亡灵多”的赌。$B$B一小时过去了，而我还在等他们回来。$B$B我看见塔伦纳·射日者朝东南跑了。不幸的是，我不能丢下马车不管。要是你正好往那个方向去的话，能不能找到他，然后叫他回来找我？
text.completion: I've found them, $r.  The Scourge.  How I've longed for this day.
text.giverWindow: Help me find Tarenar!

english.title: Tarenar Sunstrike
english.objectives: Find Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: As soon as we stopped, they made a bet about "who could kill the most undead in five minutes."$b$bIt's been an hour, and I'm still waiting for them to come back.$b$bI saw Tarenar run off to the southeast.  Unfortunately, I can't leave the caravan here by itself.  If you end up traveling in that direction, could you find him and send him back to me?
english.completion: I've found them, $r.  The Scourge.  How I've longed for this day.
english.giverWindow: Help me find Tarenar!

text.title: 我最擅长的事
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的死亡小径杀死5只死亡小径畸形怪。
text.description: 我还记得，在我年轻的时候，就经常潜入幽魂之地打僵尸，一打就是好几个小时。那时候可没人付钱给我，而我一直乐此不疲。$B$B现在，看看周围，都是些凶猛的僵尸。我准备把它们也收拾了，你要一起来吗？
text.completion: Five should be good enough. Yikes, look at the time!  I need to head back to camp.
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: What I Do Best
english.objectives: Kill 5 Death's Step Miscreations at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I remember when I was young, I would sneak off into the Ghostlands and just beat up zombies for hours on end.  Nobody even PAID me.  I just did it.$b$bNow, look in front of you.  Those are some serious zombies.  I was just about to start beating them up, too.  Care to join me?
english.completion: Five should be good enough. Yikes, look at the time!  I need to head back to camp.
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Death's Step in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 给菲奥拉的礼物
text.objectives: 收集10份天灾犬之血。
text.description: 我的旅伴菲奥拉用她的马车开了一家小店。她和我，外加我们的朋友吉德文，正在前往圣光之愿礼拜堂的路上。如果你愿意的话，也可以跟我们同行……不过菲奥拉没准会生我的气。$B$B如果你能送礼物给菲奥拉的话，她立刻就会转怒为喜了。干掉这里北边的天灾犬，把它们的血交给马车旁的菲奥拉，她就在河边。她肯定会喜欢的。我一会儿会在那边等你。
text.progress: I should have guessed it.  Tarenar made you get me a gift?  That thoughtless idiot!$b$bUmm... what was the gift, anyhow?
text.completion: Why, this is exactly what I needed!  Fine, I'll forgive Tarenar for running off. $n, you're welcome to join us anytime.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: A Gift For Fiona
english.objectives: Obtain 10 samples of Plaguehound Blood.
english.description: My traveling companion, Fiona, runs a small vendor's shop out of her caravan.  She and I, along with our friend Gidwin, are all on our way to Light's Hope Chapel.  I'm sure you can join us, if you like... though Fiona might be a little mad at me.$b$bFiona always forgets why she's mad if you give her a gift.  Kill some of the plaguehounds north of here, then bring their blood to Fiona at the caravan, down by the river.  She'll love it.  We'll talk again there.
english.progress: I should have guessed it.  Tarenar made you get me a gift?  That thoughtless idiot!$b$bUmm... what was the gift, anyhow?
english.completion: Why, this is exactly what I needed!  Fine, I'll forgive Tarenar for running off. $n, you're welcome to join us anytime.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 前往圣光之愿礼拜堂
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的索多里尔河搭乘菲奥拉的马车。
text.description: 既然伙计们都回来了，我们就出发吧。你也要去东边吗？$B$B请跟我们一起走吧！我坚持这个要求！昨天在治愈者营地的时候，我就跟塔伦纳说，“我们有两个圣骑士和一个店主，你知道我们还缺什么吗？还缺个$C！”$B$B别那么看着我！我是认真的！来吧，跳上车来。
text.completion: Hope the ride wasn't too bumpy for you. Have a look around the tower while the horses rest.  It's no Light's Hope Chapel, but I'm sure you can find some way to keep yourself busy.
text.completed: Speak with Fiona at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Onward, to Light's Hope Chapel
english.objectives: Board Fiona's Caravan at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Now that the boys are back, we can head out.  You headed east?$b$bPlease, join us!  I insist!  Yesterday, we were in the Menders' Stead, and I was telling Tarenar, "We have two paladins and a shopkeeper, but you know what we really need?  A $c!"$b$bDon't look at me that way!  I'm serious!  Come on, hop in the cart.
english.completion: Hope the ride wasn't too bumpy for you. Have a look around the tower while the horses rest.  It's no Light's Hope Chapel, but I'm sure you can find some way to keep yourself busy.
english.completed: Speak with Fiona at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 疯狂之喉
text.objectives: 跟元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。
text.description: 我不敢相信，$N。我的亲生儿子——我的亲骨血！同那些暮光之锤的恶魔混在一起。你看见了吗？他都变了什么样，打算毁掉婚礼。哦……为什么？为什么？$B$B是那个畜生，$N。从西边地里出现的巨大的嘴。“疯狂之喉！”我的儿子说它能和他交谈，但我认为那只是一个噩梦。$B$B大地之环打算把它消灭掉。去找西边的唤地者托伦斯卡，看你能帮什么忙！
text.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

english.title: The Maw of Madness
english.objectives: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements.
english.description: I can't believe it, $N. Me own son - me own flesh and blood! Throwing his lot in with those fiends from the Twilight's Hammer. Did you see what he became when he tried to destroy the wedding? Oh ... why? Why?$B$BIt's that beast, $N. The enormous mouth emerging from the earth to our west. "The Maw of Madness!" My son said it spoke to him, but I thought it was just nightmares.$B$BThe Earthen Ring is trying to destroy it. Go to Earthcaller Torunscar, west of here, and see how you can help!
english.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

text.title: 流脓的伤口
text.objectives: 跟元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。
text.description: 一头野兽，$N！我看到了一头野兽。一头胃口更大、更饥饿的。他们可能不知道自己把什么东西给放出来了。$B$B它就在这儿。它那无形而且可怕的身躯正在高地里出没。$B$B我在预言中看到了你，$N。你同大地之环一起，想要将那畜生制服。你将会面对黑暗。$B$B现在去吧，趁那畜生还没有变得更强。跟西北方德拉卡戈废墟远处山脊顶端元素法阵的唤地者托伦斯卡谈一谈。赶快！
text.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

english.title: The Weeping Wound
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements.
english.description: A beast, $N! I saw a beast. A great maw, an even greater hungering. They can't possibly know what they unleashed.$B$BIt is here. Its terrible shapeless body is erupting right into the Highlands.$B$BI saw you in my vision, $N. You struggle with the Earthen Ring to contain the beast. You will face the darkness.$B$BGo now, before the beast grows in power. Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Circle of the Elements, northwest of here atop the ridge beyond the ruined Drakgor Encampment. Hurry!
english.completion: Welcome, brotha. You've chosen a harsh time to be joinin' us, but that is to our fortune. We could use ya help.

text.title: 厄索拉斯之喉
text.objectives: 骑一头狮鹫加入对厄索拉斯的进攻。
text.description: 我们已经做好攻打那畜生的准备了。首先，我们需要摧毁它的触须，然后耶法会举行一个仪式，召唤一只强大的火元素，我们则会将其扔到它的胃里去。$B$B我要你和我们的第一组人马飞出去展开进攻。稳住阵脚，等待时机，然后加入战局，和其他萨满一起把触须砍断。$B$B做好进攻的准备后，就随意挑一头狮鹫出发吧。
text.completion: The tentacles swept us off of our gryphons as well! They were far more nimble than we anticipated. No matter. We were prepared for this possibility. I can summon the elemental from here if you can keep me safe.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'rath in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Maw of Iso'rath
english.objectives: Mount a gryphon to join the attack on Iso'rath.
english.description: We are ready to attack the beast. First, we need to destroy it's tentacles, then Yevaa will perform a ritual to summon a powerful fire elemental that we will drop into its maw.$B$BI want you to fly out with our first group attack. Hold steady until an opportunity presents itself, then join the battle with the rest of the shaman in cutting the tentacles down.$B$BTake any one of the gryphons when you're ready to join the assault.
english.completion: The tentacles swept us off of our gryphons as well! They were far more nimble than we anticipated. No matter. We were prepared for this possibility. I can summon the elemental from here if you can keep me safe.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'rath in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 消化
text.objectives: 保护你和唤地者耶法免受厄索拉斯防御机制的伤害。
text.description: 虽然我们知道这畜生可能会保护自己，但我们不知道它会如何做到这一点。厄索拉斯的身体对我们的威胁迅速地作出了反应。$B$B我可以在这里完成召唤，但是你必须击退厄索拉斯的防御力量。别让它们靠近！我们能活下来！
text.completion: I've brought you back from the brink of death, hero! Deathwing is upon us! We need your help.
text.completed: Speak to Thrall at the Maelstrom.

english.title: Devoured
english.objectives: Defend yourself and Earthcaller Yevaa from Iso'rath's bodily defenses.
english.description: We knew this was a possibility, but we had no idea how the beast would defend itself. Iso'rath's body is reacting quickly to our threat.$B$BI can complete the summoning from here, but only if you can hold back Iso'rath's defenses. Keep them busy! We will survive this!
english.completion: I've brought you back from the brink of death, hero! Deathwing is upon us! We need your help.
english.completed: Speak to Thrall at the Maelstrom.

text.title: 灭世者
text.objectives: 打败死亡的化身，死亡之翼。
text.description: 没时间了！死亡之翼趁我们不备发动了进攻。你不阻止他的话，大地之环今日便要休矣！
text.completion: You're awake! Thank the elements. I'd almost lost all hope.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: You are the only one left who can stand against the Worldbreaker. If you fail, all of Azeroth is doomed.
text.turninWindow: Nightmares threaten to swarm and consume all within Iso'noth.

english.title: The Worldbreaker
english.objectives: Defeat Deathwing, the Aspect of Death.
english.description: There's no time! Deathwing struck before we could form against him. If you do not stop him, the Earthen Ring will end this day!
english.completion: You're awake! Thank the elements. I'd almost lost all hope.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: You are the only one left who can stand against the Worldbreaker. If you fail, all of Azeroth is doomed.
english.turninWindow: Nightmares threaten to swarm and consume all within Iso'noth.

text.title: The Terrors of Iso'rath
text.objectives: Rescue Hargoth Dimblaze, Earthmender Duarn, Stormcaller Jalara, and Stormcaller Mylra.$B$BReturn to the safety of the other shaman if Iso'rath's defenses are eating away at you.
text.description: We need you! You were stuck in some kind of nightmare. So are many of the other shaman.$B$BIt doesn't matter... our plan is falling apart. Some of our shaman are channeling protective auras that should combat the digestive juices and keep you alive, but we need you to rescue the other shaman from the tentacles.  We won't be able to defeat Iso'rath without them!$B$BDon't stay out in the stomach without the other shaman for too long or you'll be digested alive!
text.progress: The battle is not over. The shaman within Iso'rath need you!
text.completion: United with the Earthen Ring, we can survive the horrors of Iso'rath. Now it is time to turn our vengeance upon him!
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Terrors of Iso'rath
english.objectives: Rescue Hargoth Dimblaze, Earthmender Duarn, Stormcaller Jalara, and Stormcaller Mylra.$B$BReturn to the safety of the other shaman if Iso'rath's defenses are eating away at you.
english.description: We need you! You were stuck in some kind of nightmare. So are many of the other shaman.$B$BIt doesn't matter... our plan is falling apart. Some of our shaman are channeling protective auras that should combat the digestive juices and keep you alive, but we need you to rescue the other shaman from the tentacles.  We won't be able to defeat Iso'rath without them!$B$BDon't stay out in the stomach without the other shaman for too long or you'll be digested alive!
english.progress: The battle is not over. The shaman within Iso'rath need you!
english.completion: United with the Earthen Ring, we can survive the horrors of Iso'rath. Now it is time to turn our vengeance upon him!
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Yevaa within the stomach of Iso'roth in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 梦魇
text.objectives: 摧毁厄索拉斯之脑。
text.description: 厄索拉斯的大脑露出来了！你救出来的萨满应该可以让你从他的防御体系中活下来。$B$B向大脑展开攻击，消灭厄索拉斯！
text.completion: You saved many of my closest allies today, $n. I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed within Iso'rath, but you have the thanks of all of the Earthen Ring.
text.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Host of Nightmares.

english.title: Nightmare
english.objectives: Destroy the Brain of Iso'rath.
english.description: Iso'rath's brain is revealed! The shaman you've saved should keep you somewhat safe amidst his defenses.$B$BStrike at the brain and destroy Iso'rath!
english.completion: You saved many of my closest allies today, $n. I can only imagine what horrors you witnessed within Iso'rath, but you have the thanks of all of the Earthen Ring.
english.completed: Speak to Earthcaller Torunscar at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Host of Nightmares.

text.title: 旅伴
text.objectives: 在皇冠哨塔找到愿意与你们同行的人。
text.description: 既然我们要在这里等一会儿，不如看看还有没有什么人要去圣光之愿礼拜堂的。人多了才热闹嘛！$B$B四下问问谁愿意跟我们一起走吧。我相信你肯定可以找到同行的旅伴。
text.completion: Argus Highbeacon... that old guy on the top of the tower?  Great! A man his age must have been in the Argent Crusade for a long time.  Maybe he can put in the good word for us at Light's Hope.
text.completed: Return to Tarenar at Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Traveling Companions
english.objectives: Find someone at Crown Guard Tower who will join your caravan.
