english.completion: I had no doubt that you would succeed, $n. I hope you can understand why I kept the true purpose of your mission a secret. Should Crowley and Bloodfang have found out about our plan, they would have surely gotten to Godfrey first and disposed of the body. Stand by, $n. The time of their rebirth is at hand.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 圣光之杖
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: 你很有才干，迅速地成为了一名圣光与银月城的的仆从，$N。你对部落和我们人民的忠诚值得学习。$B$B为了嘉奖你的杰出，酋长已委托他的大附魔师为你制作一把法杖。$B$B银松森林被诅咒的影牙城堡是唯一一个可以获得你所需材料的地方。去那里将失落的指挥官的神圣符记找来，并收集一些月触之木，以及在城堡里游荡的鬼魂的精华来。
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: Tyelis mentioned that you were visiting Shadowfang Keep to find the materials for your new staff. Few would venture into the keep, even to retrieve such valuable things. Your new staff will be a fitting reward for your bravery.
text.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

english.title: Staff of the Light
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: You are quickly becoming a talented servant of the Light and of Silvermoon, $N. Your loyalty to our people and to the Horde are exemplary.$B$BIn recognition of your dedication, the warchief has commissioned his master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts that haunt the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: Tyelis mentioned that you were visiting Shadowfang Keep to find the materials for your new staff. Few would venture into the keep, even to retrieve such valuable things. Your new staff will be a fitting reward for your bravery.
english.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

text.title: 巨魔，食人魔，还有兽人。天哪！
text.objectives: 杀死指挥官沃恩、欧莫克大王和维姆萨拉克。
text.description: 黑色龙人维姆萨拉克管理着黑石塔下层的军队，随时准备向更深处的黑铁矮人发动全面攻势。我们绝对不能让黑龙军团控制这座山脉！$B$B你必须杀死指挥官沃恩、欧莫克大王和维姆萨拉克。他们的死亡将会导致军队陷入瘫痪，为我们争取宝贵的时间。
text.completion: Pardon my saying so, but I am surprised you completed the task set out before you alive. Those monsters were responsible for the deaths of countless thousands, a great many of them heroes still spoken highly of to this day. You have earned my respect and a reward for your courage.
text.completed: Return to Acride.
text.giverWindow: Their vicious leader.

english.title: Trolls, Ogres, and Orcs, Oh My!
english.objectives: Kill War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak.
english.description: The black dragonkin Overlord Wyrmthalak oversees the forces of the Lower Spire, who are nearly prepared to launch a full assault on the Dark Iron Dwarves far below. We simply cannot allow the black dragonflight to gain control of the mountain!$B$BYou must kill War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Their deaths will cause the army's momentum to grind to a halt and will buy us valuable time.
english.completion: Pardon my saying so, but I am surprised you completed the task set out before you alive. Those monsters were responsible for the deaths of countless thousands, a great many of them heroes still spoken highly of to this day. You have earned my respect and a reward for your courage.
english.completed: Return to Acride.
english.giverWindow: Their vicious leader.

text.title: A Seer's Staff
text.objectives: 去影牙城堡指挥官斯普林瓦尔处收集指挥官的神圣符记，还有5捆月触之木和5份幽灵精华。
text.description: I hear that word of your deeds in service to the Horde has even reached the ears of the warchief. I think he might see the error of his earlier judgment about us.$B$BHe has agreed to allow Orgrimmar's master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts that haunt the keep.
text.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
text.completion: You must be the $c that Brother Silverhallow mentioned. Welcome, $n. Let me see those materials you gathered from halfway around the world. They seem well worth the travel and you will not be disappointed with your staff.
text.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

english.title: A Seer's Staff
english.objectives: Go to Shadowfang Keep and obtain the Commander's Holy Symbol from Commander Springvale, 5 bundles of Moontouched Wood, and 5 Ghostly Essence.
english.description: I hear that word of your deeds in service to the Horde has even reached the ears of the warchief. I think he might see the error of his earlier judgment about us.$B$BHe has agreed to allow Orgrimmar's master enchanter to create a staff for you.$B$BThe cursed Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest is the only place to get the materials you'll need. Travel there and find the lost holy symbol of Commander Springvale, a supply of moontouched wood, and the essence of the ghosts that haunt the keep.
english.progress: Did you bring the materials I'll need for your weapon?
english.completion: You must be the $c that Brother Silverhallow mentioned. Welcome, $n. Let me see those materials you gathered from halfway around the world. They seem well worth the travel and you will not be disappointed with your staff.
english.completed: Speak to Godan in Orgrimmar's Drag district.

text.title: 多线作战
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛西部大地神殿的先知克洛伽交谈。
text.description: We find ourselves in a much better position against our enemies in Vashj'ir than before you arrived.  Don't get me wrong, your aid is still needed here, but perhaps other fronts are in an even more urgent situation.$B$BI've been informed that our allies in the Earthen Ring have put out a call for aid in a matter I've been assured is most critical.$B$BSpeak to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar for further instructions.
text.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

english.title: The War Has Many Fronts
english.objectives: Speak to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar.
english.description: We find ourselves in a much better position against our enemies in Vashj'ir than before you arrived.  Don't get me wrong, your aid is still needed here, but perhaps other fronts are in an even more urgent situation.$B$BI've been informed that our allies in the Earthen Ring have put out a call for aid in a matter I've been assured is most critical.$B$BSpeak to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar for further instructions.
english.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

text.title: 多线作战
text.objectives: 与暴风城东部大地神殿的地语者纳拉特交谈。
text.description: 在你抵达之前，我们在瓦丝琪尔的境况已经好多了。别误会了我的意思，我们仍然需要你的帮助，但是其它交战区的情势也许更加危急。$B$B我得到消息说，大地之环的盟友发出了请求增援的信号，我想这事态一定是非常紧急。$B$B到暴风城的东部大地神殿去，找地语者纳拉特谈谈下一步的行动吧。
text.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

english.title: The War Has Many Fronts
english.objectives: Speak to Earthspeaker Naraat at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.
english.description: We find ourselves in a much better position against our enemies in Vashj'ir than before you arrived.  Don't get me wrong, your aid is still needed here, but perhaps other fronts are in an even more urgent situation.$B$BI've been informed that our allies in the Earthen Ring have put out a call for aid in a matter I've been assured is most critical.$B$BSpeak to Earthspeaker Naraat at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City for further instructions.
english.completion: Your aid is most timely, $n.

text.title: 伪酋长
text.objectives: 杀死雷德·黑手酋长。
text.description: 雷德·黑手是一位兽人酋长的儿子。奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤杀死了雷德的父亲，并取代他成为了酋长。现在，雷德是黑暗部落名义上的领袖，奈法利安和他的黑龙军团在背后支持他。$B$B这个蠢货声称，部落也应归他管辖，而且扬言要凭武力夺取部落的控制权！我们绝对不能容忍这种事情发生。在上层黑石塔找到这个冒牌酋长，把他彻底干掉，$C。
text.progress: Rend will not fall without a fight.
text.completion: You saw Nefarian when you fought Rend?$B$B<Acride sighs.>$B$BI wish I had accompanied you, then. I could have faced him unaware, outside his lair...but no matter. Nefarian will die by my claw.$B$BYou've done well.
text.completed: Return to Acride.
text.giverWindow: Kill the false warchief!

english.title: The False Warchief
english.objectives: Kill Warchief Rend Blackhand.
english.description: Rend Blackhand was the son of an Orc Warchief. His father was slain by Orgrim Doomhammer, who became the new Warchief over the young orc. Rend now stands as the supposed leader of a false Horde of Blackrock orcs, backed by Nefarian and his army of dragons.$B$BThe fool claims that the Horde is also his by birthright, and threatens to take it by force! We cannot allow this to occur in light of his master's influence. Find him in the Upper Spire and bring an end to the false warchief, $c.
english.progress: Rend will not fall without a fight.
english.completion: You saw Nefarian when you fought Rend?$B$B<Acride sighs.>$B$BI wish I had accompanied you, then. I could have faced him unaware, outside his lair...but no matter. Nefarian will die by my claw.$B$BYou've done well.
english.completed: Return to Acride.
english.giverWindow: Kill the false warchief!

text.title: 达基萨斯将军
text.objectives: 杀死达基萨斯将军。
text.description: 奈法利安的基地在山脉顶部的黑翼之巢中。虽然我们可以通过上层黑石塔进入那里，但是如果使用旁边的传送宝珠，就可以快速派遣大批部队进去。不过，我们必须先用另一枚宝珠给自己刻上特殊的烙印。$B$B奈法利安的军队由达基萨斯将军统制，他亲自保卫着这第二枚宝珠。除掉他，这样我们就可以使用他的宝珠了。达基萨斯将军在上层黑石塔的塔顶王座里。
text.completion: Excellent! It is only a matter of time before the son of Deathwing feels my claws.
text.completed: Return to Acride.
text.giverWindow: We need to get to him to get to Nefarian.

english.title: General Drakkisath, Hand of Nefarian
english.objectives: Kill General Drakkisath.
english.description: Nefarian makes his domain further up the mountain in Blackwing Lair. Though there is a way in through the Upper Spire, we may bring a far larger force if we use the teleportation orb close by. However, we cannot teleport until we brand ourselves with a different orb.$B$BDrakkisath, General of Nefarian's armies, personally guards this second orb. Eliminate him and secure his orb for our use. You will find him in the Spire Throne within the Upper Spire.
english.completion: Excellent! It is only a matter of time before the son of Deathwing feels my claws.
english.completed: Return to Acride.
english.giverWindow: We need to get to him to get to Nefarian.

text.title: 塔纳利斯在召唤
text.objectives: 跟塔纳利斯加基森的凯尔希·钢烁谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿呀，$N，塔纳利斯的凯尔希·钢烁给了你一条留言。她说加基森的侏儒听说了你在这里的事迹。$B$B总之，大灾变也让他们吃尽了苦头。虽然没有我们惨，但我想他们还是需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Greetings and salutations, friend. Welcome to Tanaris!

english.title: Tanaris is Calling
english.objectives: Speak with Kelsey Steelspark at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
english.description: Heya, $N, Kelsey Steelspark down in Tanaris left a message for you. She says that the gnomes down there in Gadgetzan heard about what you've been doing up here.$B$BAnyway, the Cataclysm hit them hard, too. Not as hard as us, but I'm certain they could use your help.
english.completion: Greetings and salutations, friend. Welcome to Tanaris!

text.title: 塔纳利斯在召唤
text.objectives: 跟塔纳利斯加基森的梅格斯·碎纸机谈一谈。
text.description: 嘿呀，$N，塔纳利斯的梅格斯·碎纸机给了你一条留言。她说加基森的地精听说了你在这里的事迹。$B$B总之，大灾变也让他们吃尽了苦头。虽然没有我们惨，但我想他们还是需要你的帮助。$B$B另外，那梅格斯是个大美人儿！
text.completion: Well hello there, $c. Welcome to Tanaris!

english.title: Tanaris is Calling
english.objectives: Speak with Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
english.description: Heya, $N, Megs Dreadshredder down in Tanaris left a message for you. She says that the goblins down there in Gadgetzan heard about what you've been doing up here.$B$BAnyway, the Cataclysm hit them hard, too. Not as hard as us, but I'm certain they could use your help.$B$BBesides, that Megs is a hottie!
english.completion: Well hello there, $c. Welcome to Tanaris!

text.title: 继续旅行
text.objectives: 等你准备前往下一座哨塔时，就登上菲奥拉的马车。
text.description: 马匹应该已经准备好了。阿尔古斯·海毕肯，一位与银色北伐军共事的绅士，曾跟我聊过。他会跟我们结伴而行。这可真让我高兴！我会为他安排好座位。$B$B我知道你很忙，所以不用着急，等你准备好了，就到马车上来，我们一起前往下一座哨塔。
text.completion: We've enjoyed having you ride with us, $n.  Hopefully, once Gidwin and Tarenar join the Argent Crusade, we can continue to travel together.
text.completed: Speak with Fiona at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Trek Continues
english.objectives: Board Fiona's Caravan when you are ready to move to the next tower.
english.description: I believe the horses are ready.  Argus Highbeacon, the gentleman who works with the Argent Crusade, spoke with me earlier.  I understand he will be coming with us... that's great!  I'll make room for him.$b$bI know that you are busy, so there's no hurry.  Whenever you're ready, hop into the caravan, and we will proceed to the next tower.
english.completion: We've enjoyed having you ride with us, $n.  Hopefully, once Gidwin and Tarenar join the Argent Crusade, we can continue to travel together.
english.completed: Speak with Fiona at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 荣耀与力量
text.objectives: 通过维克斯图的力量试炼。
text.description: 我叫维克斯图，我观察过你在战斗中的表现，$R。你很强。$B$B你杀了我的主人塞达尔，不过我不介意。与对他的忠诚相比，我更看重力量。与任何东西相比，我都更看重力量。$B$B再向我证明一次你的力量，$R。然后，我就会把我的力量借给你，随便你怎么运用它。
text.completion: Yes, you are indeed strong... and I submit to you. I will join you and your friend, the worgen.  My strength is yours.
text.completed: Speak with Vex'tul at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Honor and Strength
english.objectives: Pass Vex'tul's test of strength.
english.description: My name is Vex'tul, and I have watched you fight, $r.  You are strong.$b$bYou killed my master, Zaeldarr, but this does not bother me.  I value strength over any loyalty that I held for him.  I value strength over anything else.$b$bProve to me one final time your strength, $r.  Do so, and I will lend you MY strength for whatever purpose you may desire.
english.completion: Yes, you are indeed strong... and I submit to you. I will join you and your friend, the worgen.  My strength is yours.
english.completed: Speak with Vex'tul at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 弗雷德里克的海鲜梦
text.objectives: 在魔刃之痕收集8条疫病河豚、8只痕湖蜗牛和8只痕湖凿孔蟹。
text.description: 我爱大海。没错，就是我——弗雷德里克·卡尔斯通，在西南边的那片湖泊中放养了海洋生物。我原本希望这样就能在瘟疫之地里为十字军提供一些新鲜的食物。$B$B但是，有一些鱼变成了掠食动物，并且威胁到了其它的动物。如果我们不加以关注，它们就会变成把湖中的所有生物都杀掉！$B$B游到魔刃之痕的湖底去，抢救一些蜗牛、螃蟹和河豚。
text.progress: Did... did you bring the fish?
text.completion: Hmm... they didn't survive the trip out of the water as well as I had hoped. Oh well!  Seafood salad for Frederick tonight!
text.completed: Return to Frederick Calston at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Frederick's Fish Fancy
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Plague Puffers, 8 Infectis Inchers, and 8 Infectis Scuttlers from the Infectis Scar.
english.description: I love the sea.  Yes, it was I, Frederick Calston, who introduced the sea life to that lake in the southwest.  I had hoped to provide the Crusade with a source of fresh food from within the borders of the Plaguelands.$b$bHowever, some of the fish turned out to be predators, and they now terrorize the other animals.  If we're not careful, they will kill them all!$b$bSwim down to the bottom of the scar and save some snails, crabs, and pufferfish before it's too late.
english.progress: Did... did you bring the fish?
english.completion: Hmm... they didn't survive the trip out of the water as well as I had hoped. Oh well!  Seafood salad for Frederick tonight!
english.completed: Return to Frederick Calston at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 杀戮的理由
text.objectives: 前往南方的考林路口，消灭聚居在镇上的天灾亡灵。收集7份生命腐质，然后使用研钵和捣杵，把生命腐质磨成凝固腐质。
text.description: 你好，陌生人！你已经进入了瘟疫之地的中心地带。我希望你随身带着杀亡灵用的装备。$B$B最近，瘟疫的散播速度慢了许多，所以诅咒教派的人加快了生产速度，力求让这片土地维持死气沉沉的状态，他们喜欢那种感觉。我有一个计划可以阻止他们。拿着我的研钵和捣杵，到东南边的考林路口去处理一些亡灵怪物身上的生命腐质。我们要为诅咒教徒准备一点小礼物！
text.progress: How are things looking in Corin's Crossing?
text.completion: Hello!  It's me.  Hope you don't mind a little home-brewed magic to allow me to communicate with you in the field.  It'll save us both some time. We're going to incorporate that living rot into a mixture that'll ruin their next batch of plague.  That'll show them!
text.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: To Kill With Purpose
english.objectives: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the south and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
english.description: Greetings, stranger!  You've entered the heart of the Plaguelands.  I hope you brought your undead-killing gear with you.$b$bThe plague spreads more slowly these days, so the Cult of the Damned has stepped up production in order to keep the land brown and dead, as they like it.  I've got a plan to stop them.  Take my mortar and pestle, and use it on living rot from the undead creatures in Corin's Crossing to the southeast.  We're going to make a little present for the cultists!
english.progress: How are things looking in Corin's Crossing?
english.completion: Hello!  It's me.  Hope you don't mind a little home-brewed magic to allow me to communicate with you in the field.  It'll save us both some time. We're going to incorporate that living rot into a mixture that'll ruin their next batch of plague.  That'll show them!
english.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 黑暗之衣
text.objectives: 从考林路口的教徒身上夺取死亡教徒的头饰和死亡教徒的长袍。
text.description: 我的某些敌人曾告诉过我，这片土地想要恢复健康，但是一些高阶亡灵——以及诅咒教派——不允许这种事情发生。也就是说，我们必须阻止他们！我已经有了一个计划，但首先，你得去搞一件教徒的衣服来进行伪装。$B$B到东南方的考林路口去，从镇子中的人类教徒身上剥一件衣服下来。等你完成了这一步任务之后，我会联系你的。
text.progress: Everything going alright so far, $N?
text.completion: You've got both pieces!  Good.  These will help when trying to sneak into their death camp.
text.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.turninWindow: This is going to be great!

english.title: Dark Garb
english.objectives: Obtain Death Cultist Headwear and Death Cultist Robes from cultists within Corin's Crossing.
english.description: Some of my counterparts have told me that the land wants to heal, but several high-ranking undead - along with the Cult of the Damned - are not allowing it to.  That means we have to stop them!  I've got a plan, but first, you're going to need a cultist disguise.$b$bHead southeast into Corin's Crossing, and take the clothing from the human cultists that roam through the town.  I'll contact you when you've completed this step.
english.progress: Everything going alright so far, $N?
english.completion: You've got both pieces!  Good.  These will help when trying to sneak into their death camp.
english.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.turninWindow: This is going to be great!

text.title: 催化剂
text.objectives: 对米雷达尔湖里的水元素使用贝蒂娜的药剂瓶，收集8瓶活性液态疫病药剂。
text.description: 凝固腐质本身就已经很有效了，不过我们还需要一些东西来激活它的潜能……一种催化剂。你可以在南边的米雷达尔湖中找到这种催化剂。$B$B如果你往自己的背包里看看的话，会惊喜地发现我趁你不注意的时候往你包里塞了一些小瓶子。对湖中的水元素使用这些瓶子，它们体内那些被腐蚀的活性水正是完美的催化剂！
text.progress: We're nearly ready to strike, $n.
text.completion: Uh oh... it looks like we may have gathered a little too much coagulated rot.  Oh well, we'll just have to improvise, then! What could possibly go wrong?
text.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.turninWindow: Uh oh... it looks like we made the solution too strong.

english.title: Catalysm
english.objectives: Use Betina's Flasks on living elementals within Lake Mereldar to obtain 8 Active Liquid Plague Agents.
english.description: Coagulated rot is potent on its own, but we need something to activate its concealed powers... a catalyst.  You can find just such a catalyst to the south, in Lake Mereldar.$b$bIf you look down, you'll notice that I slipped a set of flasks into your bags while you weren't looking.  These flasks can be used on the water elementals in the lake.  The living, corrupted water that flows through their bodies will be the perfect catalyst!
english.progress: We're nearly ready to strike, $n.
english.completion: Uh oh... it looks like we may have gathered a little too much coagulated rot.  Oh well, we'll just have to improvise, then! What could possibly go wrong?
english.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.turninWindow: Uh oh... it looks like we made the solution too strong.

text.title: 只需一滴
text.objectives: 穿上死亡教徒的伪装，进入死亡教徒营地，然后将贝蒂娜的溶液倒入米雷达尔天灾之锅。
text.description: 现在，把少量腐质倒入水中搅拌……均匀地搅拌。行了，这就够了。这样一来，溶液的效果仍然很强，而且我们只需要一丁点就够了。$B$B在湖的东南岸有一口天灾之锅，周围还有些教徒。穿上你的教徒伪装服，靠近那口天灾之锅，往锅里滴上一滴你配制的溶液——一滴就行了，不然你没准性命不保！
text.completion: It should take them weeks to get their operation running again.  Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Just a Drop in the Bucket
english.objectives: Use your Death Cultist Disguise to enter the Death Cultist Base Camp, then put Betina's mixture into the Mereldar Plague Cauldron.
english.description: Now, mix a tiny amount of rot into the water, and mix thoroughly.  There, that's it.  This solution will still be very powerful, and we only need a little bit of it.$b$bOn the lake's southeastern border, you will find a plague cauldron with several cultists nearby.  Put on your cultist disguise, then approach the cauldron and put in ONE DROP of the solution you made.  No more, or you may risk your very life!
english.completion: It should take them weeks to get their operation running again.  Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Betina Bigglezink at Light's Shield Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 本性难移的大男孩
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的圣光之愿礼拜堂找到吉德文·金须。
text.description: 我们刚刚抵达圣光之盾哨塔，那两个呆头鹅圣骑士就跑去圣光之愿礼拜堂了。我们还有一段路要赶，不过只要跟着在各个哨塔之间巡逻的阿尔古斯一起走，很快就能到了。$B$B你能去看看他们是否一切顺利吗？我知道他们能自己照顾自己，不过我得在这边照顾马车，有你看着他们，我会更放心一些。
text.completion: I can't believe it.  We're literally FEET away from becoming sworn members of the Argent Crusade. We'd be in there already if it weren't for Tarenar's dallying.  If he doesn't quit chatting with the locals soon, I'm going to head in there myself.

english.title: Boys Will Be Boys
english.objectives: Find Gidwin Goldbraids at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: As soon as we arrived here at Light's Shield Tower, those two lunkhead paladins ran off to Light's Hope Chapel.  It's still a ways away, but if we're going to follow Argus along his tour of the towers, this is about as close as we're going to get.$b$bCheck in on them and make sure they're alright?  I know they can handle themselves, but still, it'd make me feel better to know that you were watching over them while I'm stuck here with the caravan.
english.completion: I can't believe it.  We're literally FEET away from becoming sworn members of the Argent Crusade. We'd be in there already if it weren't for Tarenar's dallying.  If he doesn't quit chatting with the locals soon, I'm going to head in there myself.

text.title: 收集虫肉
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地寻找腐肉虫和腐肉吞噬者，杀死它们，收集15份食腐虫肉块。
text.description: 在这遥远的东方，要保持食物补给真是难上加难。$B$B这附近唯一没有受到瘟疫污染的动物就是食腐虫了。虽然这种虫子的肉吃起来可以说是味同嚼蜡，但它的优点是可以储藏好几个月。我们还需要几百磅肉才能完成储备目标。$B$B瘟疫之地到处都是食腐虫，不过在礼拜堂南边数量最多。另外别忘了：虫子越大，肉越多。
text.progress: You will grow to tolerate the taste, $r.  I did.
text.completion: May the Earthmother watch over you! Bless you, young one.
text.completed: Return to Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Gathering Some Grub(s)
english.objectives: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
english.description: We have problems maintaining our food supplies here in the far east.$B$BAround here, the only manner of beast unaffected by the ravages of the plague are the carrion worms. While rather bland in taste, the meat of the worms can easily be preserved to last for months. We will need several hundred more pounds to be fully-stocked.$b$bWhile you can find carrion worms all over the Plaguelands, they can be found in particularly high density to the south of the chapel.  And remember: larger worms mean more meat.
english.progress: You will grow to tolerate the taste, $r.  I did.
english.completion: May the Earthmother watch over you! Bless you, young one.
english.completed: Return to Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 及时的联盟
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地东墙哨塔的菲奥拉。
text.description: 有你帮忙储藏食物，我目前的任务就算是完成了。$B$B接下来我要往北，到病木林去。我知道你可能跟我同路。$B$B你介意我们一起上路吗？$B$B我会到西北边的东墙哨塔去。要是你愿意组队，就到那里去找我。
text.completion: You brought us a shaman!  From the Earthen Ring, no less! I have no idea how we'll fit him in the caravan, but we'll find a way.  Welcome aboard, Rimblat Earthshatter!

english.title: An Opportune Alliance
english.objectives: Check in with Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: With your contributions to the food stores, my current assignment is complete.$b$bI will be heading north, to the Plaguewood, next.  I understand you may be headed in the same direction.$b$bDo you mind if I join you on the road?$b$bI will head northwest, to Eastwall Tower.  If you're interested in teaming up, you can meet up with me there.
english.completion: You brought us a shaman!  From the Earthen Ring, no less! I have no idea how we'll fit him in the caravan, but we'll find a way.  Welcome aboard, Rimblat Earthshatter!

text.title: 烟鬼和绷带
text.objectives: 从布洛米尔的史蒂芬·布劳曼那里获得布劳曼的包裹物。
text.description: 嘿！想赚点外快吗？$B$B我需要弄卷绷带。嗯，事实上，是我有一个朋友需要弄卷绷带。呃，事实上……说起来有点复杂，总之你去弄卷绷带来，你就能拿钱。而且我也能。还有我的朋友。也许还有其他人。$B$B史蒂芬·布劳曼以前是北边磨坊的主人，如今他死了，变成了一个僵尸。上峰想要布劳曼尸体上的包裹物。$B$B怎么啦，你不喜欢钱吗？
text.progress: You've been fightin' undead.  Did ya find Browman?
text.completion: Well well well!  Someone who goes and gets things done!  Here's your cut, chief.  I'll be seein' you around.
text.completed: Return to Smokey LaRue at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Smokey and the Bandage
english.objectives: Obtain Browman's Wrappings from Stephen Browman at Browman's Mill.
english.description: Hey there!  Interested in makin' a buck?$b$bI need to get a bandage.  Well, actually, I got a friend who needs to get a bandage.  Well actually... let's just say it's complicated, but if you go get this bandage, you make money.  And so do I.  And my friend.  Possibly other people.$b$bStephen Browman used to own the mill to the north, now he's dead.  A zombie.  The guy at the top wants to have the wrappings from Browman's body.$b$bWhat's the matter, you don't like money?
english.progress: You've been fightin' undead.  Did ya find Browman?
english.completion: Well well well!  Someone who goes and gets things done!  Here's your cut, chief.  I'll be seein' you around.
english.completed: Return to Smokey LaRue at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 圣光兄弟会
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。
text.description: 圣光兄弟会一向行事轻率，不经头脑。他们弥补了血色十字军和银色黎明的空白。当其他人止步不前的时候，他们是头一个冲进诺森德的。$B$B不过，他们也有把事情办成、令我敬佩的时候。他们现在两线作战：一处在斯坦索姆，另一处就是眼下南边的提尔之手。$B$B我建议你去和提尔之手的安吉拉·杜萨图斯谈谈。你可以帮上忙。
text.completion: A $c!  Just what we needed.  Your arrival couldn't have been more timely.

english.title: The Brotherhood of Light
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The Brotherhood of Light has a history of brash, thoughtless decisions.  They bridged a gap between the Scarlet Crusade and the Argent Dawn.  They were among the first to plunge into Northrend, while many of us lingered behind.$b$bHowever, they also have a history of getting results, which I respect.  They fight on two fronts now: one battle in Stratholme, and another, more immediate battle to the south at Tyr's Hand.$b$bI suggest you speak with Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand.  You may be of service.
english.completion: A $c!  Just what we needed.  Your arrival couldn't have been more timely.

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 软着陆
text.objectives: 在提尔之手杀死任意10个血色十字军生物。
text.description: 我们只有一百个人来完成这个任务，而且已经少了一个。我们的斥候被派到敌营里去除掉巡逻的卫兵，点燃信号弹以便我们能里应外合。剩下来的九十九个已经准备好了，就等着信号。我需要一个像你这样能干的$C摸进提尔之手，尽可能干掉他们的守卫，然后点燃信号弹。$B$B你干不干？
text.completion: The flare is fully assembled, and the matches lie unused next to the fuse. The fallen Argent centurion got much closer to setting off this flare than you had guessed.
text.completed: Set off the Crusader's Flare behind the chapel in Tyr's Hand.

english.title: Soft Landing
english.objectives: Kill any 10 Scarlet Crusade creatures within Tyr's Hand.
english.description: We were only given one hundred men to complete this mission, and we're already down by one.  Our scout was sent into the enemy stronghold to clear out some of the guards that patrol the area, and to send off a flare so we could enter with a coordinated attack.  Our ninety-nine remaining men lie at the ready, waiting for that flare.  I need a talented $c like you to sneak into Tyr's Hand, take out as many of their guards as possible, and then set off that flare.$b$bAre you up to it?
english.completion: The flare is fully assembled, and the matches lie unused next to the fuse. The fallen Argent centurion got much closer to setting off this flare than you had guessed.
english.completed: Set off the Crusader's Flare behind the chapel in Tyr's Hand.

starters.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 拿下修道院
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手修道院外的指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者。
text.description: 血色十字军在提尔之手西边洼地的修道院里严防死守。要想进一步攻占要塞，一定要先拿下修道院。
text.completion: Well met, $n.  Can I trust you to assist me in taking this abbey away from these abominations?

english.title: To Take the Abbey
english.objectives: Report to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer outside the abbey at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: The Scarlet Crusade maintains a well-fortified abbey in the lower western tier of Tyr's Hand.  The abbey will need to be secured before proceeding any further into the stronghold.
english.completion: Well met, $n.  Can I trust you to assist me in taking this abbey away from these abominations?

text.title: 拿下兵营
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手兵营前面的指挥官科尔法克斯。
text.description: 提尔之手里的关键工事之一就是兵营，它就位于这信号弹旁边。圣光兄弟会和他们的百夫长们需要尽可能多的帮手去把它攻下来。
text.completion: I'll be handling things from here, $c. Fine, you want an assignment?  I suppose I can afford to send you in on a mission or two.

english.title: To Take the Barracks
english.objectives: Report to Crusade Commander Korfax in front of the Barracks at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: One of the key fortifications within Tyr's Hand is the barracks, which lies right next to this flare.  The Brotherhood of Light and their centurions will need all the help they can get in sacking it.
english.completion: I'll be handling things from here, $c. Fine, you want an assignment?  I suppose I can afford to send you in on a mission or two.

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 儿时的梦想
text.objectives: 与圣光之愿礼拜堂里的玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵交谈。
text.description: 我一直梦想加入银色北伐军，正因为如此我才成为了一名圣骑士。数年的艰苦磨炼之后……我终于准备好了。$B$B塔伦纳也认为他已经准备好了，不过我不太确认这一点。他有点爱显摆，而且从来都不认真上课。不过我们仍然承诺要一起加入北伐军，现在我们来了。$B$B我们该到礼拜堂里去了吧？
text.completion: Welcome to Light's Hope Chapel. You wish to join the Crusade?  Very well.  We have plenty of tasks for new recruits. But first, a test.

english.title: A Boyhood Dream
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus within Light's Hope Chapel.
english.description: I've always wanted to join the Crusade.  It's the reason I became a paladin.  Years of practice, honing my craft... I'm finally ready.$b$bTarenar thinks he's ready, too, but I'm not sure.  He's a bit of a showboat, and he never took his lessons seriously.  Still, we promised we'd do this together, and here we are.$b$bShall we head into the chapel now?
english.completion: Welcome to Light's Hope Chapel. You wish to join the Crusade?  Very well.  We have plenty of tasks for new recruits. But first, a test.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 银色召唤：墓穴的试炼
text.objectives: 进入圣光之愿礼拜堂后面的墓穴，阅读银白卷轴，然后完成他的试炼。
text.description: 在我们的礼拜堂后面，你可以找到一座小墓穴，里面埋葬着光荣牺牲的英雄，他们都是为了与天灾作战而付出生命的。$B$B他们的灵魂已经安息，但他们会时常回来检验骑士团的新成员。$B$B你们三人可以一起参加试炼。进入墓穴，阅读这张卷轴。雷蒙德·乔治勋爵——我的前任——会主持你们的试炼。
text.completion: Remember that your ancestors always watch over you.  As a brother of the Argent Crusade, you will join a family that has a long line of such fallen ancestors.  Their vigil and protection will be your strength as you press forward against the Scourge. Congratulations Tarenar, Gidwin, and $n.  Welcome to the Argent Crusade.
text.completed: Return to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Argent Call: The Trial of the Crypt
english.objectives: Enter the Crypt behind Light's Hope Chapel, read from the Argent Scroll, then complete his test.
english.description: Behind our chapel, you will find a small crypt.  Interred within are the bodies of our fallen heroes; those who gave their lives in the war against the Scourge.$b$bTheir spirits are at peace, but they return intermittently to test new members of the order.$b$bThe three of you may test together.  Enter the crypt, then read from this scroll.  Lord Raymond George - my predecessor - will preside over your test.
english.completion: Remember that your ancestors always watch over you.  As a brother of the Argent Crusade, you will join a family that has a long line of such fallen ancestors.  Their vigil and protection will be your strength as you press forward against the Scourge. Congratulations Tarenar, Gidwin, and $n.  Welcome to the Argent Crusade.
english.completed: Return to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 银色召唤：剧毒林地
text.objectives: 在布洛米尔和剧毒林地杀死16个天灾和8个教徒。如果塔伦纳或吉德文被杀的话，就返回圣光之愿礼拜堂。
text.description: 北边的布洛米尔已被亡灵占据，更北边的剧毒林地中的亡灵比布洛米尔还多。他们距离圣光之愿礼拜堂可以说是近在咫尺，但我们一直没能彻底清剿他们。$B$B保持警惕是非常关键的。进入剧毒林地，消灭你发现的一切亡灵……以及在那里游荡的教徒。$B$B记得要避开在谷中巡视的血肉巨人加基诺克斯。我觉得你们还没有强大到足以击败他。
text.completion: You've returned sooner than I expected.  Excellent. We will continue our path into the north.  Next, you will be completing a similar task - this time, in Northdale.
text.completed: Return to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Argent Call: The Noxious Glade
english.objectives: Slay 16 Scourge and 8 Cultists within Browman Mill and the Noxious Glade.  Return to Light's Hope Chapel if Tarenar or Gidwin is slain.
english.description: Browman's Mill, to the north, is infested with undead.  The Noxious Glade, even farther to the north, is even more heavily infested.  Despite their proximity to our chapel, we have been unable to completely remove them.$b$bVigilance is key.  Travel into the Noxious Vale and slay as many undead as you can find... and the cultists that roam among them.$b$bWhile there, make sure to avoid Garginox, the flesh giant that roams the vale.  I suspect you are not strong enough to defeat him.
english.completion: You've returned sooner than I expected.  Excellent. We will continue our path into the north.  Next, you will be completing a similar task - this time, in Northdale.
english.completed: Return to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 银色召唤：北谷
text.objectives: 与东瘟疫之地东墙哨塔的菲奥拉交谈。
text.description: 泰罗索斯给了我们下一个任务：去北谷干掉更多亡灵。吉德文非常兴奋，不过我觉得更加小心一点总没错。$B$B我们先去跟菲奥拉会合吧。她应该在下一座哨塔那里……东墙哨塔，应该是这个名字。那地方挺近的，就在圣光之愿礼拜堂的西北边。我们可以在那里稍事休整，筹备一下进攻北谷的计划。
text.completion: Hello, $n!  Glad to see you've rejoined the caravan! Tarenar and Gidwin arrived here before you.  Tarenar's just right there, and Gidwin's... well... he's in a little bit of a mood right now.  I think he's in the tower.

english.title: Argent Call: Northdale
english.objectives: Speak with Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Tyrosus has given us our next task: slaying more undead in Northdale.  Gidwin is excited to move forward, but I think we should show a little more caution.$b$bLet's meet up with Fiona.  She should be at the next tower by now... Eastwall Tower, I think it's called.  It's close by, to the northwest of Light's Hope.  We can rest there, and plan our attack on Northdale.
english.completion: Hello, $n!  Glad to see you've rejoined the caravan! Tarenar and Gidwin arrived here before you.  Tarenar's just right there, and Gidwin's... well... he's in a little bit of a mood right now.  I think he's in the tower.

text.title: 光触之刃
text.objectives: 将光触之刃插进10个被杀死的天灾士兵的尸体中。
text.description: 剧毒林地是一片泥潭，无论从字面上还是外观上来说都是这样。那里的天灾多到可以让咱们下半辈子都杀不过啦。$B$B当那些较弱的天灾倒下时，他们会被复活，重新变得生龙活虎起来，$N。如果我们不做点什么的话，这事就没完了。$B$B拿着这些刀子，把它们刺进天灾士兵的尸体中。这种刀很简单，不过它们附了魔法，可以阻止那些死者复活——使它们永远都无法复活。
text.completion: Our duty for the day is done. It is only a matter of time before we defeat the Scourge.  Today, we made progress.
text.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Omarion at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Buried Blades
english.objectives: Bury the Light-Touched Blades in the bodies of 10 Slain Scourge Troopers.
english.description: The Noxious Glade is a quagmire, both literally and figuratively.  There's enough Scourge up there to give us trouble for the rest of both of our lifetimes.$b$bThey can re-animate the weaker ones when they die, $N.  They will never stop coming if we don't do something.$b$bTake these blades and drive them through the corpses of any Scourge troopers you find.  The blade is simple, but its enchantment will prevent the dead bones from being reanimated.  Forever.
english.completion: Our duty for the day is done. It is only a matter of time before we defeat the Scourge.  Today, we made progress.
english.completed: Return to Master Craftsman Omarion at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 修理攻城坦克
text.objectives: 跟站在受损的滩头堡攻城坦克上的攻城坦克指挥官谈一谈。确保工程技师在修理坦克期间不受干扰。
text.description: 我们必须逐个修理攻城坦克。带上你收集到的零件，将它们交给站在受损坦克上的攻城坦克指挥官。$B$B然后在工程技师修理期间，确保他们不受干扰。$B$B$C，去吧！希望你能成为我的骄傲！
text.progress: Rocks an' stumps an' hills an' mud... Bah. I hate nature.
text.completion: Yep, one more tank limpin' back home for repairs. All these trees an' stumps an' mud an' rock - you couldnae drive a golfball into this turf, much less a tank. We're gonna need a new approach.
text.completed: Talk to Fargo Flintlocke at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Siege Tank Rescue
english.objectives: Speak with a Siege Tank Commander standing on top of a crippled Highbank Siege Tank. Defend the tank while engineers make repairs.
english.description: One by one, we're gonna have to pull our siege tanks outta the muck. Take these 'ere spare parts you've collected and give 'em to a siege tank commander who's standing on top of a gimped-up machine.$B$BThen defend the tank while engineers de-gimpify it.$B$BGo an' make me proud, $c!
english.progress: Rocks an' stumps an' hills an' mud... Bah. I hate nature.
english.completion: Yep, one more tank limpin' back home for repairs. All these trees an' stumps an' mud an' rock - you couldnae drive a golfball into this turf, much less a tank. We're gonna need a new approach.
english.completed: Talk to Fargo Flintlocke at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 另一侧的朋友
text.objectives: 找到阿克莱德。
text.description: Oi, what're ye doin' here in my camp? Bloody hell, why're ye in the Burnin' Steppes at all? *hic*$B$BBah, it don't matter anyway.$B$BListen, I was adventurin' the other day, as I often do, an' I was ambushed by orcs from Blackrock Mountain! 'Cept one of 'em was different...dressed all funny an' spoke all sophisticated like. Called hisself Acride, I think...$B$BYou ought to go to the Blackrock Spire and find that orc...just be watchin', pretty much all of the others will want t' kill ya. Tell him I sent ye!
text.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? I'm sorry, who sent you? I'm afraid I've never heard of such a dwarf.

english.title: Friends on The Other Side
english.objectives: Find Acride.
english.description: Oi, what're ye doin' here in my camp? Bloody hell, why're ye in the Burnin' Steppes at all? *hic*$B$BBah, it don't matter anyway.$B$BListen, I was adventurin' the other day, as I often do, an' I was ambushed by orcs from Blackrock Mountain! 'Cept one of 'em was different...dressed all funny an' spoke all sophisticated like. Called hisself Acride, I think...$B$BYou ought to go to the Blackrock Spire and find that orc...just be watchin', pretty much all of the others will want t' kill ya. Tell him I sent ye!
english.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? I'm sorry, who sent you? I'm afraid I've never heard of such a dwarf.

text.title: 潜在的盟友
text.objectives: 找到阿克莱德。
text.description: 人人都知道，我们跟黑石山里面那帮兽人不是一伙的，但我们仍然要谨慎地关注他们的一举一动。那座山中的一切，我都了如指掌，$C。$B$B最近，黑石山里出现了一个不太一样的兽人。他就住在黑石塔中，而且他不知道出于什么目的，竟然想推翻奈法利安和他的整个兽人军队。通常来说，我不会相信他们，但这一次我们的目标是一样的。去找到他，他叫阿克莱德。
text.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? So Overseer Oilfist sent you? Listen carefully, we have much to discuss in little time.

english.title: A Potential Ally
english.objectives: Find Acride.
english.description: It is no secret that we aren't fans of the orcs in Blackrock Mountain, but we do carefully watch their every move. Nothing happens in that Mountain without me knowing about it, $c.$B$BRecently, a different sort of orc came into Blackrock. He resides just inside Blackrock Spire, and I know he's somehow planning to overthrow Nefarian and his whole army of orcs. Normally I wouldn't trust their kind, but we share a common goal for the time being. Find him, he's called Acride.
english.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? So Overseer Oilfist sent you? Listen carefully, we have much to discuss in little time.

text.title: 黑石山的怪事
text.objectives: 找到阿克莱德。
text.description: 黑石塔里有一个与众不同的兽人。他谈吐之间展现出的智慧远远超越他外表的年龄，而且他不像其他兽人那样与我们为敌。$B$B你必须到西北方的黑石塔去，找到这个兽人，我们只知道他叫阿克莱德。也许他就是阻止兽人军队的关键。也许我们可以在一切都无可挽回之前阻止奈法利安……
text.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? So you come at the will of Miss Brightwing, do you? Very interesting indeed.

english.title: Blackrock Anomaly
english.objectives: Find Acride.
english.description: There is an orc inside Blackrock Spire much unlike the others. He speaks with the intelligence and wisdom of one beyond his appeared years, and does not fight against our soldiers like the others do.$B$BYou must travel northwest to Blackrock Spire and find this orc, known only to us as Acride. Perhaps he is the key to stopping the orcish army. Perhaps we can stop Nefarian before it is too late...
english.completion: Hello, what is your business in a place like this? So you come at the will of Miss Brightwing, do you? Very interesting indeed.

text.title: 复活吧，高弗雷
text.objectives: 在希尔瓦娜斯·风行者接纳高弗雷勋爵和他的人时站在她身边。
text.description: 你对被遗忘者忠贞不二，$N。你为我们——为部落所做的一切都不会被漠视。只要高弗雷勋爵和他的人复原，我们对吉尔尼斯解放阵线和剩下来的联盟狗就有了天大的优势。$B$B现在站在我身边，让高弗雷勋爵重生为我们的一员。我们将一同把他和他的人重新带回这个世界。
text.completion: Today marks a new beginning for the Forsaken and the end of the Alliance in Lordaeron!
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Rise, Godfrey
english.objectives: Stand by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner as she initiates Lord Godfrey and his men.
english.description: You are unwavering in your loyalty to the Forsaken, $N. Know that what you have done for us - for the Horde - will not go unnoticed. With Lord Godfrey and his men recovered, we will have a great advantage over the Gilneas Liberation Front and the rest of the Alliance dogs.$B$BNow stand by my side as Lord Godfrey is reborn as one of us. Together we will bring him and his men into the fold.
english.completion: Today marks a new beginning for the Forsaken and the end of the Alliance in Lordaeron!
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 动荡的铁炉堡
text.objectives: 跟铁炉堡的风暴召唤者米尔拉谈一谈。
text.description: 铁炉堡的形势愈发严峻，$N。请跟铁炉堡的风暴召唤者米尔拉谈一谈，看看你能不能帮上忙。
text.completion: It is good that you've come, $n.  We need all the help we can get with the situation here.
text.completed: 跟铁炉堡的风暴召唤者米尔拉谈一谈。

english.title: What's Shaking in Ironforge
english.objectives: Speak with Stormcaller Mylra in Ironforge.
english.description: Things have grown worse in Ironforge, $n.  Please, speak with Stormcaller Mylra in Ironforge and see if you can lend a hand in some way.
english.completion: It is good that you've come, $n.  We need all the help we can get with the situation here.
english.completed: Speak with Stormcaller Mylra in Ironforge.

text.title: 突破屏障
text.objectives: 找到安伯米尔圣典。
text.description: 当高弗雷和我为进攻吉尔尼斯做准备的时候，我要你带人攻打东边的安伯米尔。$B$B安伯米尔的前任达拉然大法师升起了一道障眼的魔法屏障。他们如今安坐在某种微缩空间中，等待着联盟下达开始进攻的命令。我们必须先下手为强，阻止他们的攻击。前往安伯米尔，搜索能让我们找到法师的情报。
text.progress: Have you found anything yet?
text.completion: Clever mages. The codex is sealed by a magical ward. Pity that they weren't clever enough to realize that former archmages of Dalaran are now Forsaken.
text.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Breaking the Barrier
english.objectives: Find the Ambermill Codex.
english.description: While Godfrey and I make preparations for our assault upon Gilneas, I want you to lead our attack upon Ambermill, directly east of here.$B$BThe former Dalaran magi of Ambermill have erected a magical barrier that somehow cloaks them from vision. They currently reside within some type of pocket dimension, awaiting orders from the Alliance to begin their attack. We must prevent their assault by making a pre-emptive strike. Venture to Ambermill and find information that would grant us access to the mages.
english.progress: Have you found anything yet?
english.completion: Clever mages. The codex is sealed by a magical ward. Pity that they weren't clever enough to realize that former archmages of Dalaran are now Forsaken.
english.completed: Return to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 不屈的仆从
text.objectives: 获取6颗仆从之核。
text.description: The magi of Ambermill have employed foul magic to keep us away. Elemental servitors created with immunities that we cannot breach protect their territory.$B$BVenture east to Ambermill and slay the unyielding elemental servitors that guard the town and recover their cores. Bring their cores back to me so that I may devise a method by which we are able to destroy them all!
text.progress: Have you recovered the servitor cores?
text.completion: Well done, $n. The praise the Banshee Queen lavishes upon you is apparently not unfounded.
text.completed: Return to Daschla at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Unyielding Servitors
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Servitor Cores.
english.description: The magi of Ambermill have employed foul magic to keep us away. Elemental servitors created with immunities that we cannot breach protect their territory.$B$BVenture east to Ambermill and slay the unyielding elemental servitors that guard the town and recover their cores. Bring their cores back to me so that I may devise a method by which we are able to destroy them all!
english.progress: Have you recovered the servitor cores?
english.completion: Well done, $n. The praise the Banshee Queen lavishes upon you is apparently not unfounded.
english.completed: Return to Daschla at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 达拉尔·道恩维沃尔
text.objectives: 把安伯米尔圣典交给银松森林瑟伯切尔的达拉尔·道恩维沃尔。
text.description: 把圣典带到北边的瑟伯切尔，去找那里的达拉尔·道恩维沃尔。达拉尔是一名前任肯瑞托大法师。他肯定能够把圣典上的保护结界破除，将它的秘密给挖出来。$B$B动作快点，$N。
text.progress: 什麽?那是什麽?
text.completion: The Dark Lady requires my expertise? Well of course! Give it here, boy.

english.title: Dalar Dawnweaver
english.objectives: Deliver the Ambermill Codex to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: Take the codex and travel north to the Sepulcher. Once there, find Dalar Dawnweaver. Dalar is a former archmage of the Kirin Tor. Surely he will be able to bring down the protective wards surrounding this codex and pry its secrets loose.$B$BHurry, $N.
english.progress: Yes? What is it?
english.completion: The Dark Lady requires my expertise? Well of course! Give it here, boy.

text.title: 肥大的食腐虫
text.objectives: 在东瘟疫之地的北部荒野中找到淤血虫，并消灭它。
text.description: 在此处以北，北谷以西，你可以找到一条肥胖的巨虫——淤血虫。$B$B那个怪物让我损失了整整一个团的人。它的体型简直是毫无限制！它吃得越多，就长得越肥……$B$B就算那条虫子吞了你，我一点也不会伤心，不过我更愿意看到你凯旋。毕竟，淤血虫以吞噬那些想要猎杀它的人而知名。
text.completion: Keep this up and I may have to keep you here at Eastwall, $r.
text.completed: Return to Gamella Cracklefizz at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: You.  It's what's for dinner.

english.title: The Corpulent One
english.objectives: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him.
english.description: North of here and west of Northdale, you will find the corpulent maggot beast, Borelgore.$B$BI've lost entire regiments to that monster. His size knows no bounds! The more he eats the greater his girth becomes...$B$BWhile I would not suffer any emotional harm should the beast devour you, I would prefer that you were the victor.  Borelgore has been known to devour others who tried to hunt him.
english.completion: Keep this up and I may have to keep you here at Eastwall, $r.
english.completed: Return to Gamella Cracklefizz at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: You.  It's what's for dinner.

text.title: 圣物守护者莱利斯
text.objectives: 找到达拉然大法师的图章指环。
text.description: 黑暗女王估计得没错，我的确能够解开圣典。不幸的是，我需要达拉然大法师的一枚图章指环才能做到。我自己的指环呢，在我多年前死去的时候就被拿走了，但或许还有另一个办法。$B$B达拉然飘走的时候，城市的外围还留在原地。东边远处坐落着达拉然废墟。你可以在那里找到一名叫做莱利斯的大法师，把他的图章指环“拿”来给我。$B$B你可以用我身后的传送门前往巨坑。
text.progress: Did you recover a Dalaran Archmage's Signet Ring?
text.completion: Perfect. I hope this wasn't too much trouble to come by, $n. Relios was a pupil of mine back when I was a mortal man thereby making him a competent and formidable adversary. I suppose I could have warned you ahead of time. Now, let us see the ring. There we are...
text.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: Relios has the signet ring.

english.title: Relios the Relic Keeper
english.objectives: Find a Dalaran Archmage's Signet Ring.
english.description: The Dark Lady is correct in her assertion that I am able to unlock the codex. Unfortunately, I need a signet ring from a Dalaran archmage to do it. My own ring was taken when I died many years ago, but there still might be a way.$B$BWhile Dalaran has floated away, the outskirts of the city remain. Far to the east lie the ruins of Dalaran. It is there that you will find an archmage known as Relios. "Take" his signet ring and bring it back to me.$B$BYou may use the portal behind me to get to the crater.
english.progress: Did you recover a Dalaran Archmage's Signet Ring?
english.completion: Perfect. I hope this wasn't too much trouble to come by, $n. Relios was a pupil of mine back when I was a mortal man thereby making him a competent and formidable adversary. I suppose I could have warned you ahead of time. Now, let us see the ring. There we are...
english.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Relios has the signet ring.

text.title: 正义之怒
text.objectives: 从祖玛沙尔的烂苔巨魔身上获得30份烂苔巨魔的魔精。
text.description: 祖玛沙尔的烂苔巨魔公然藐视圣光！他们食尸、犯罪、弃善从恶！我建议你狠狠地教训他们，让这些恶棍付出沉重的代价！$B$B你要到北方去，降下正义之怒的制裁，$N。圣光对他们的愤怒，将通过你的双手来释放。
text.progress: <Deacon Andaal is deep in prayer.>
text.completion: Oh, hallelujah, and praise, praise be to the Light, my brother!
text.completed: Return to Deacon Andaal at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Righteous Indignation
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Mossflayer Eyes from Mossflayer trolls in Zul'Mashar.
english.description: The Mossflayers of Zul'Mashar spit in the face of the Light!  They cannibalize, they criminalize, they prioritize the forces of evil over good!  I advise that you remove their eyes, and give rise to the demise and the goodbyes of the unwise!$b$bYou will travel north, and you will rain down on them with righteous justice and indignation, $N.  The fury that they have wrought in the eyes of the Light shall be channeled through you.
english.progress: <Deacon Andaal is deep in prayer.>
english.completion: Oh, hallelujah, and praise, praise be to the Light, my brother!
english.completed: Return to Deacon Andaal at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 地脉能量
text.objectives: 获得8份奥术残渣。
text.description: 奥术残渣里有奇怪的能量在脉动。也许你应该多找一些。达拉尔肯定会对这样的发现感兴趣的。
text.progress: What's that you've got there, $n?
text.completion: Smart boy! I can most definitely use these arcane remnants in my studies. Indeed, Dalaran was built upon a massive ley line. It's no wonder, then, that such things exist at the crater.
text.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Ley Energies
english.objectives: Recover 8 Arcane Remnants.
english.description: The arcane remnant pulses with strange energy. Perhaps you should search for more remnants. Surely Dalar would be interested in such a find.
english.progress: What's that you've got there, $n?
english.completion: Smart boy! I can most definitely use these arcane remnants in my studies. Indeed, Dalaran was built upon a massive ley line. It's no wonder, then, that such things exist at the crater.
english.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 金字塔之上
text.objectives: 得到督军塔雷金之躯。
text.description: 我要请你帮个忙了，$N。$B$B在东墙哨塔的北边很远的地方，有一座隐藏在丘陵中的烂苔巨魔之城，祖玛沙尔。我在那里出生，也在那里死去。$B$B叛徒督军塔雷金就坐在祖玛沙尔的金字塔顶端。那原本是属于我的位置，但是他通过背叛与欺骗夺走了它。他并不强大。他很弱。$B$B我会在祖玛沙尔与你会合，我们一起杀了他。
text.progress: I have waited long for this day.
text.completion: My duty is not over yet.  In many ways, this was the easy step.
text.completed: Return to Vex'tul at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: Thresh'jin is an absolute monster.  He kills his own kind for sport.

english.title: Out of the Ziggurat
english.objectives: Obtain the Body of Warlord Thresh'jin.
english.description: It is time that I asked a favor of you, $N.$b$bFar to the north of Eastwall Tower, hidden among the hills, is the Mossflayer capital city of Zul'Mashar.  It was here that I was born, and here that I died.$b$bThe traitor, Thresh'jin, sits atop Zul'Mashar's ziggurat.  It was my every right to be there, but he took the seat from me with treachery and deceit.  He is not strong.  He is weak.$b$bI will meet you in Zul'Mashar, and we will kill him.  Your strength and mine.  Together.
english.progress: I have waited long for this day.
english.completion: My duty is not over yet.  In many ways, this was the easy step.
english.completed: Return to Vex'tul at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Thresh'jin is an absolute monster.  He kills his own kind for sport.

text.title: 进入火焰
text.objectives: 你准备好和维克斯图离别的话，就把督军塔雷金之躯扔到祖玛沙尔神塔顶部的篝火里去。
text.description: 这将是你最后一次见到我，$N。我就要离开车队了。$B$B要是你还想继续和我一起战斗，就别把督军塔雷金之躯弄丢了。我可以再多等一会儿。你做好分别的准备后，就把躯体扔进祖玛沙尔神塔顶部的篝火里。$B$B谢谢你的陪伴，$N。你很强大。
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Into the Flames
english.objectives: When you are ready to part with Vex'tul, throw Warlord Thresh'jin's body into the bonfire atop Zul'Mashar's ziggurat.
english.description: This is the last time you will see me, $N.  I am leaving the caravan.$b$bIf you want to continue fighting by my side, hang on to Thresh'jin's body.  I can wait for a while longer.  When you are ready to say goodbye, throw the body into the bonfire atop Zul'Mashar's ziggurat.$b$bThank you for your companionship, $n.  You were strong.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 实用主义的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死12名达拉然人类。
text.description: 通常情况下，我并非一个睚眦必报的人。事实上，我更是一名实用主义者。你瞧，实践性是同复仇背道而驰的。大部分的报仇行动都展现出高度的不切实际。$B$B但……既然你已经要前往达拉然的废墟——或许你愿意杀掉所有你见到的与达拉然有关的人类。我要他们死的理由从仇恨到愤怒到背叛都有，但我向你保证，它们都是合乎情理的不满情绪。你为我这么做的话，我将大大地奖赏你。
text.completion: I thought for sure that with the death of a dozen of my most hated enemies I would feel a great burden lifted from my shoulders. Sadly, I do not feel a thing. Perhaps I am a psychopath.
text.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Practical Vengeance
english.objectives: Kill any 12 Dalaran humans.
english.description: Under ordinary circumstances I am not a vengeful man. In fact, I am somewhat of a pragmatist. You see, practicality is a paradoxical notion to vengeance. Most revenge ploys are highly impractical.$B$BBUT... in this case - since you're already going to the ruins of Dalaran - you might as well kill every Dalaran affiliated human that you see. The reasons that I want them dead range from hatred to anger to betrayal, but I assure you they are all legitimate gripes. Do this for me and I will pay you handsomely.
english.completion: I thought for sure that with the death of a dozen of my most hated enemies I would feel a great burden lifted from my shoulders. Sadly, I do not feel a thing. Perhaps I am a psychopath.
english.completed: Use the portal in the Dalaran Crater to return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 只有一个人能进
text.objectives: 把达拉然大法师的图章指环交给银松森林被遗忘者先锋军的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。
text.description: <达拉尔翻阅着圣典。>$B$B哈哈！$B$B哦……那可真糟糕。$B$B<达拉尔合上圣典看着你。>$B$B这枚指环只允许一个人进入安伯米尔的微缩空间。然后那个人要从法师大军中杀出一条路来，干掉里面发动相位的大法师才行。那时，微缩空间才会展开，把所有的法师都弹出来。$B$B通往那里的传送门隐藏在博伦的巢穴的一座洞穴深处。$B$B我所知道的就这么多了。把指环带给希尔瓦娜斯吧。
text.progress: What have you learned?
text.completion: Only one may enter? I know just the person for this mission. I will prepare our forces and have them at the ready.

english.title: Only One May Enter
english.objectives: Take the Dalaran Archmage's Signet Ring to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: <Dalar flips through the codex.>$B$BHAHAH!$B$BOh... That's bad.$B$B<Dalar closes the codex and looks up at you.>$B$BWith this ring only ONE may enter the pocket dimension at Amber Mill. That person will then need to fight through an army of magi and kill the archmage that is generating the phase from the inside. Only then will the dimension fold, ejecting all of the magi.$B$BThe portal to entry is hidden at the back of a cave in Beren's Peril.$B$BThat's all I know. Take the ring back to Sylvanas.
english.progress: What have you learned?
english.completion: Only one may enter? I know just the person for this mission. I will prepare our forces and have them at the ready.

text.title: 热烈欢迎
text.objectives: 去找朱红庇护所的莉拉斯塔萨。
text.description: 真高兴你回来了！我肯定，你是去拯救世界或别的什么了。$B$B我被派来同这一地区的红龙建立联系，但我发现这一群不像龙眠联军的那些好说话。然而，我听说你十分擅长解决此类问题。$B$B你就是专门来解决麻烦的。$B$B去西南的朱红庇护所赢得莉拉斯塔萨的信任如何？只要能说服她，剩下的就好办了。
text.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
text.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Warm Welcome
english.objectives: Meet with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: I'm glad you're back! Saving the world or something, I'm sure.$B$BI was dispatched to establish relations with the red dragons in the area, but I'm finding this bunch somewhat less accommodating than the ones at Wyrmrest were. I have, however, been told that you are the type that solves problems.$B$BA problem solver as it were.$B$BCare to take a crack at earning a bit of trust with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt to the southwest? Anything that might soften her up a bit for me would be lovely.
english.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
english.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 热烈欢迎
text.objectives: 去找朱红庇护所的莉拉斯塔萨。
text.description: Good. You're back. Saving the world again I assume.$B$BI was dispatched to establish relations with the red dragons in the area, but I'm finding this bunch somewhat less accommodating than the ones at Wyrmrest were. I have, however, been told that you are the type that solves problems.$B$BA problem solver as it were.$B$BI need you to gain the trust of Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt to the southwest. Our association with the Dragonmaw has complicated things, but I'm hoping you can ease relations.
text.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
text.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

english.title: Warm Welcome
english.objectives: Meet with Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt.
english.description: Good. You're back. Saving the world again I assume.$B$BI was dispatched to establish relations with the red dragons in the area, but I'm finding this bunch somewhat less accommodating than the ones at Wyrmrest were. I have, however, been told that you are the type that solves problems.$B$BA problem solver as it were.$B$BI need you to gain the trust of Lirastrasza at Vermillion Redoubt to the southwest. Our association with the Dragonmaw has complicated things, but I'm hoping you can ease relations.
english.completion: I'm glad Lira didn't scare you off. I won't say her concerns aren't warranted, but we have a common enemy. She is perhaps a bit overzealous.
english.completed: Speak with Calen at Vermillion Redoubt.

text.title: 冥界领主埃克斯拉尔
text.objectives: 击败冥界领主埃克斯拉尔和他的10个爪牙。
text.description: 我知道我们应该去北谷，但这事不是很急，对吧？而且，这个可爱的小地精刚刚告诉我，这附近就有一些天灾余孽。$B$B是这样的，有个名叫埃克斯拉尔的蛛怪领主，在巫妖王死后就一直想要确立自己的势力，他在我们的北边建立了一座亡灵营地。$B$B当然，泰罗索斯想让我们去北谷杀女妖，没问题。不过我们可以先去干掉这个蛛魔，反正很近嘛！
text.completion: I couldn't stop him.  While you and Tarenar were out, Giddy ran north all alone! Tarenar, you should have known better!  Gidwin gets so impatient sometimes, and you only egg him on.  If Giddy gets into any trouble, I'm blaming you for this.
text.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Ix'lar the Underlord
english.objectives: Kill Ix'lar the Underlord and 10 of his minions.
english.description: I know we're supposed to head to Northdale, but that can wait, right?  Besides, this lovely little goblin was just telling me about some Scourge that are even closer by.$b$bSo apparently there's this nerubian underlord named Ix'lar that has been trying to make a name for himself ever since the Lich King was slain.  He's set up a camp of undead to our north.$b$bSure, Tyrosus wants us to kill banshees in Northdale.  We'll get to that.  But let's kill this nerubian first, while we're close!
english.completion: I couldn't stop him.  While you and Tarenar were out, Giddy ran north all alone! Tarenar, you should have known better!  Gidwin gets so impatient sometimes, and you only egg him on.  If Giddy gets into any trouble, I'm blaming you for this.
english.completed: Return to Fiona at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 急躁
text.objectives: 在北谷里寻找吉德文·金须。
text.description: 那个天杀的矮人。他总是让我跟菲奥拉闹矛盾。看看她吧！她都懒得理我了！$B$B我要待在这里，弥补我跟这位狼人朋友之间的友谊。你能去看看吉德文的情况吗？我相信他是不会出事的，他肯定知道怎么照顾自己。吉德文朝北边去了，应该没有走远。
text.progress: Northdale is home to a few ghosts and banshees.  Nothing ol' Giddy can't handle.
text.completion: You didn't see him?  Where could he have gone then? His... his prayer book?  Why would he leave that behind? Oh... By the Light, what have I done?
text.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Impatience
english.objectives: Search for Gidwin Goldbraids in Northdale.
english.description: Damn that dwarf.  He's always getting me in trouble with Fiona.  Look at her!  She won't even TALK to me!$b$bI'm going to stay here and try to mend my friendship with our worgen friend.  Would you mind going out and making sure Gidwin is alright?  I'm sure he's fine; he knows how to take care of himself.  He headed north, and he can't have gone far.
english.progress: Northdale is home to a few ghosts and banshees.  Nothing ol' Giddy can't handle.
english.completion: You didn't see him?  Where could he have gone then? His... his prayer book?  Why would he leave that behind? Oh... By the Light, what have I done?
english.completed: Return to Tarenar Sunstrike at Eastwall Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: 全都怪我
text.objectives: 跳上菲奥拉的马车，前往北地哨塔。
text.description: 这是我的错。我……我忽略了他的警告，他的抱怨，我全都忽略了。我控制不住自己——我看到哨塔那边的天灾士兵，就……就忍不住杀过去了。$B$B阿尔古斯说吉德文被带到了西北方，我们只有这一条线索，所以我们只能朝那边去。$B$B该死的北谷和银色北伐军！我们必须从那些天灾渣滓手中夺回吉德文。
text.progress: We have no time, $N!  We must press on!
text.completion: Time is wasting, $n.  Every minute we waste gives the Scourge another chance to kill Gidwin.  If he isn't dead already. Not that I think he is.  Giddy may be a stick-in-the-mud, but when it comes down to it, he can swing the Light like a champion.
text.completed: Speak with Tarenar Sunstrike at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.objective1: Ride Fiona's Caravan to Northpass Tower

english.title: Nobody to Blame but Myself
english.objectives: Hop in Fiona's Caravan and ride to Northpass Tower.
english.description: This is my fault.  I... I ignored his warnings, his complaints, everything.  I couldn't help myself - I saw those Scourge just beyond the tower, and I... I HAD to go kill them.$b$bArgus says that Gidwin was taken northwest, and that's our only lead, so that's where we'll head.$b$bNorthdale and the Argent Crusade be damned!  We're getting Gidwin back from those Scourge trash.
english.progress: We have no time, $N!  We must press on!
english.completion: Time is wasting, $n.  Every minute we waste gives the Scourge another chance to kill Gidwin.  If he isn't dead already. Not that I think he is.  Giddy may be a stick-in-the-mud, but when it comes down to it, he can swing the Light like a champion.
english.completed: Speak with Tarenar Sunstrike at Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.objective1: Ride Fiona's Caravan to Northpass Tower

text.title: 空降军情七处
text.objectives: 从安古斯·巍山那里接收一支蛮锤恶徒小队，护送他们前往暮光之门里的空降点。
text.description: 马迪亚斯·肖尔和军情七处的特工来到了这里支援我们在暮光堡垒的行动，我要派你护送他们过去。$B$B蛮锤矮人为我们提供了运输设备。不过特工们还要先去暮光之门那里办一些事情。$B$B去跟安古斯·巍山谈谈，让他派一支小队给你。你负责把他们运送到目的地，就是有一个蓝色X标记的地方。
text.completion: That must have been deadly. While I don't approve of their methods, no one can question the effectiveness of Master Mathias Shaw and his SI:7. Not to mention that you're here. Our victory is all but assured.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: SI:7 Drop
english.objectives: Get a Wildhammer Hellions squad from Angus Stillmountain and then escort them to the drop off point in the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Mathias Shaw and the SI:7 are here to assist us with operations up top in the Twilight Citadel. I need you to escort them there.$B$BThe Wildhammer are being kind enough to give us a lift in. The agents have some things that they need to do down in the Twilight Gate area first, though.$B$BSpeak with Angus Stillmountain and get yourself a squad to drop off. You'll fly them in. A big blue X marks the spot.
english.completion: That must have been deadly. While I don't approve of their methods, no one can question the effectiveness of Master Mathias Shaw and his SI:7. Not to mention that you're here. Our victory is all but assured.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: Kor'kron Drop
text.objectives: Get a Crushblow Wind Rider squad from Jon-Jon Jellyneck and then escort them to the drop off point in the Twilight Gate.
text.description: Garona and a detachment of the Kor'kron are here to assist us with operations up top in the Twilight Citadel. I need you to escort them there.$B$BI've called upon a local tribe of trolls to give us a lift in with their wind riders. The assassins have some things that they need to do down in the Twilight Gate area first, though.$B$BSpeak with the troll chief, Jon-Jon Jellyneck and get yourself a detachment of Kor'kron to drop off. You'll fly them in. A big red X marks the spot.
text.completion: That must have been exciting. Despite any losses that the Kor'kron may have incurred along the way, no one will be able to doubt their effectiveness, nor that of Garona. And with you in the mix, it's only a matter of time before victory is ours.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 食人魔和双头魔
text.objectives: Slay 10 ogres or ettins at the Twilight Gate.
text.description: As with any offensive, you first need to soften them up. We've been having a heck of a time getting in there. But someone like you... well, let's just say I have no doubt in my mind that you can get into the Twilight Gate to the southwest and teach the Bloodeye Clan ogres and ettins a thing or two!
text.completion: That's the spirit, lad! Today's already shaping up to be a good one.
text.completed: Return to Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

But someone like you... well, let's just say I have no doubt in my mind that you can get into the Twilight Gate to the southwest and teach the Bloodeye Clan ogres and ettins a thing or two!

text.title: 食人魔和双头魔
text.objectives: Slay 10 Bloodeye Clan ogres or ettins at the Twilight Gate.
text.description: I want you to get in there past those boulders to the northwest at the Twilight Gate. Kill every Bloodeye Clan ogre and ettin in sight. Think you can handle that for me, $N?
text.completion: And here I thought that today couldn't get any better. I enjoy being wrong, occasionally.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Zaela at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 移山
text.objectives: 引爆隐藏的炸药，将碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开。
text.description: 在攻打暮光之门之前，我们必须先把碎颅者魔山引开！$B$B在你们的军情七处特工出发之前，我让他们拿了一些炸药并藏在暮光之锤的箱子里。现在，他们应该已经把炸药安放在通往堡垒顶部的台阶上了。$B$B我要你去引爆炸药，然后等那个怪物跑出去查看的时候给我们发信号。$B$B届时我们就会发动攻击，解决这个食人魔的据点！
text.completion: Success!

english.title: Move the Mountain
english.objectives: Detonate the Hidden Explosives to lure Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate.
english.description: If the Twilight Gate is to fall, we need to get Skullcrusher the Mountain out of there!$B$BBefore they left, I saw to it that your SI:7 agents took some explosives hidden in a Twilight's Hammer crate. By now, they will have planted them on the steps leading up to the upper portion of the Citadel.$B$BI want you to set the explosives off and then signal us when that monster's out of the way.$B$BThat's when we'll attack and finish off the ogre compound!
english.completion: Success!

text.title: 呼叫炮火
text.objectives: 在暮光之门里使用炮火信号弹标记北部、东北部、西南部和南部的建筑物。
text.description: 其实我更喜欢堂堂正正的对决。我们本该手刃这些该死的怪物，但是眼下的局势要求我们动用更凶狠的手段。$B$B拿着这把信号枪，标记西南边的暮光之门里面的四座建筑物。我们的火炮会好好修理他们一番的。
text.completion: Thanks to you, our cannoneers hit their marks. Tell me about the situation within the Twilight Gate.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Call in the Artillery
english.objectives: Use the Artillery Flare to target the Northern, Northeastern, Southwestern, and Southern buildings at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: I prefer a stand up honorable fight. These monsters deserve nothing better than to be destroyed by the weapons in our hands. However, this particular situation calls for the use of more powerful measures.$B$BTake this flare and mark each of the four buildings within the Twilight Gate to the southwest. Our cannons will handle the rest.
english.completion: Thanks to you, our cannoneers hit their marks. Tell me about the situation within the Twilight Gate.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 呼叫炮火
text.objectives: 在暮光之门里使用炮火信号弹标记北部、东北部、西南部和南部的建筑物。
text.description: A pity that we're no longer allowed to drop the Plague on our enemies. It would prove quite effective in this situation. Oh well, at least we have war machines to destroy their precious gates.$B$BI want you to take this flare. Use it to mark each of the four buildings within the Twilight Gate to the northwest. The war machines will handle the rest.
text.completion: I must say that I rather enjoyed the sight of their buildings being hit.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.objectives: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
text.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, it's time to signal your forces at Victor's Point to attack!
text.completion: The horns have been sounded. Victor's Point should launch their attack at any moment.$B$BNow there's only one thing left to take care of.

text.title: 四个总比没有好
text.objectives: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
text.description: Now while the attack upon the Twilight Gate is launched, there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BYou're fairly certain that Cassius and Kurdran will want proof of their deaths.
text.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack?
text.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead. Regardless, thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 前往暮光堡垒
text.objectives: 跟军情七处战队指挥官谈一谈，然后护送军情七处战队。
text.description: 攻击行动已经展开，是时候前往暮光壁垒了。不介意的话，我想请你护送军情七处的军队抵达马迪亚斯·肖尔大师的所在。$B$B他就躲在高地的某处。你可以向军情七处战队指挥官打听他的具体位置。$B$B谢谢你，$N。我们希望能与你一同打响暮光壁垒的攻击战！
text.completion: Oh no!

english.title: Up to the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with the SI:7 Squad Commander and then escort the SI:7 squad.
english.description: Now that the attack is underway, it's time to deal with the Twilight Citadel. If you don't mind, I'd like for you to escort the SI:7 forces to Master Mathias Shaw.$B$BHe's hiding somewhere up top. The SI:7 squad commander can tell you where.$B$BThank you, $N. We look forward to joining you in the assault upon the Citadel!
english.completion: Oh no!

If you don't mind, I'd like for you to escort the Kor'kron forces up to Garona.$B$BShe's hiding somewhere up top. The Kor'kron squad commander can tell you where.$B$BThank you, $N. We look forward to joining you in the assault upon the Citadel!
text.completion: This can't be good!
