text.title: 第七军团作战计划
text.objectives: 缴获第七军团作战计划。
text.description: 摧毁焚木村无疑能让我们在战场上占据上风，但我们在这里的真正目的，还是要把联盟打残。$B$B第七军团在格雷迈恩之墙的西南方建立了营地。我们要搜索营地，寻找作战计划。有了第七军团的作战计划，我们就能清晰的了解联盟部队在银松森林里的所有活动。
text.progress: Search every filthy dwarven corpse.
text.completion: It looks like the reinforcements from the ships in Gilneas are marching soon. Crowley and Bloodfang have set up an encampment to the southeast for the Gilneas Liberation front.
text.completed: Speak with Lord Walden in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: 7th Legion Battle Plans
english.objectives: Recover the 7th Legion Battle Plan.
english.description: While destroying Pyrewood will certainly garner us an advantage over the Alliance upon the field of battle, our true purpose here is to leave them crippled.$B$BSouthwest of here, near the Greymane Wall, lies the 7th Legion Base Camp. We must search the base camp for battle plans. With the 7th Legion battle plans we will be able to pinpoint all Alliance troop advancement in Silverpine Forest.
english.progress: Search every filthy dwarven corpse.
english.completion: It looks like the reinforcements from the ships in Gilneas are marching soon. Crowley and Bloodfang have set up an encampment to the southeast for the Gilneas Liberation front.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Walden in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 摩根的成果
text.objectives: 杀死达格兰·索瑞森大帝。
text.description: 达格兰·索瑞森大帝在前面的王座上掌控着整座城市。如果我们想要阻止他的军队，就必须终结这位皇帝的统治。$B$B你必须击败他的贴身卫士，包括一个名叫玛格姆斯的巨人，才能接近他。你的行动要尽可能地快——否则整座城里的敌人都会涌向他的王座。$B$B注意，只有当你从持火者手中抢过火炬并点燃火盆之后，讲学厅的大门才会打开。祝你好运。
text.completion: You've done it! You've actually done it! Morgan's years of planning and waiting have finally come to fruition. She may have lost her land and family when Ragnaros tore this land asunder, but with the Dark Iron crippled we'll be able to safely build a new kingdom of our own in the Burning Steppes. Not even the Firelord himself will be able to breech the capital's walls! Make sure you come back someday when we've finished, you'll be our guest of the highest honor. I thank you with all my heart, $n.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Maxwell.
text.giverWindow: His time has come.

english.title: Morgan's Fruition
english.objectives: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
english.description: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan has total control over the city from his throne ahead. If we are to stop his armies, we're going to have to end their emperor's reign.$B$BYou'll need to get past his personal guard, including the giant Magmus, to reach him. Move as quickly as possible - if word gets out before you finish, the entire city will descend upon his throne.$B$BNote that the doors across the Lyceum will only open once you've lit the braziers with torches from the flamekeepers. Good luck.
english.completion: You've done it! You've actually done it! Morgan's years of planning and waiting have finally come to fruition. She may have lost her land and family when Ragnaros tore this land asunder, but with the Dark Iron crippled we'll be able to safely build a new kingdom of our own in the Burning Steppes. Not even the Firelord himself will be able to breech the capital's walls! Make sure you come back someday when we've finished, you'll be our guest of the highest honor. I thank you with all my heart, $n.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Maxwell.
english.giverWindow: His time has come.

text.title: 进入监狱
text.objectives: 找到雷克斯洛特。
text.description: 暮光之锤来这里是有原因的。我们不知道究竟是什么原因，但萨特拉克让你加入了我们的秘密行动——潜行者雷克斯洛特就潜伏于审讯官格斯塔恩所在的大厅外面，准备伺机刺杀她。$B$B不过她太过聪明了，恐怕没法下手，所以你得直截了当的进去干一票，你说呢？去跟雷克斯洛特谈谈，告诉他这个计划。我想他应该没有意见。
text.completion: Get over here. If you blow my cover, I swear to the Warchief I'll kill you where you stand.

english.title: Into the Prison
english.objectives: Find Lexlort.
english.description: Da Twilight's Hammer be here for some reason. We don't know why, but Thal'trak be lettin' you in on a lil' secret of ours - da rogue Lexlort waits outside da hall where High Interrogator Gerstahn be so he can kill her if he gets da chance.$B$BShe's too smart for dat, though, so you gonna go in an' do it, ya? Go talk to Lexlort and let him know. I'm sure he be ok with it.
english.completion: Get over here. If you blow my cover, I swear to the Warchief I'll kill you where you stand.

text.title: 动摇军心
text.objectives: 刺杀战石将军。
text.description: 联盟援军在银松地区的西南建起了桥头堡，叫作第七军团营地。我们在营地的主要目标就是动摇军心。这是一个迅雷不及掩耳的刺杀任务，目标是他们的战地指挥官战石将军。他的死不会阻止联盟的推进，但肯定能够大挫他们的士气。
text.completion: The rest of the Alliance fleet will arrive shortly, only to find their base camp decimated. Now for the second and most important part of our battle plan.
text.completed: Speak with Lord Godfrey in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: General Marstone: Wildhammer Shaman

english.title: Sowing Discord
english.objectives: Assassinate General Marstone.
english.description: The Alliance reinforcements have established a foothold in the southwest region of Silverpine called 7th Legion Base Camp. Our primary goal at the base camp is to sow discord amongst the troops. This is a lightning fast assassination mission to kill their field commander, General Marstone. His death won't stop the Alliance advance, but it will certainly soften their ranks.
english.completion: The rest of the Alliance fleet will arrive shortly, only to find their base camp decimated. Now for the second and most important part of our battle plan.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Godfrey in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: General Marstone: Wildhammer Shaman

text.title: 暮光？不行！
text.objectives: 杀死审讯官格斯塔恩。
text.description: 格斯塔恩身边侍卫林立，而且她很聪明，不会孤身出行，所以我不打算去杀她了。$B$B你去。$B$B我会扔点我从卫兵身上偷到的东西进去，帮你分散一点他们的注意力。
text.completion: The Twilight's Hammer's presence only complicates our mission here further, but you've done your part for now.  You've earned a reward for your efforts...and some rest. Let's get out of here.
text.completed: Return to Lexlort.
text.giverWindow: "Interrogate" the lead interrogator.

english.title: Twilight?! No!
english.objectives: Kill High Interrogator Gerstahn.
english.description: Gerstahn is too heavily guarded and too smart to leave her post, so I'm not going to kill her.$B$BYou are.$B$BI'll throw in a little something I picked up off of a guard to make it worth your while.
english.completion: The Twilight's Hammer's presence only complicates our mission here further, but you've done your part for now.  You've earned a reward for your efforts...and some rest. Let's get out of here.
english.completed: Return to Lexlort.
english.giverWindow: "Interrogate" the lead interrogator.

text.title: 潜入暗炉城
text.objectives: 与拉扎布雷德交谈。
text.description: 恐怕，我们正在输掉这场战争。单单是对付黑铁矮人就足够费劲的了，而他们的元素盟友又给他们派来了实力强大的战士，我们根本不是他们的对手。$B$B我希望你能潜入他们的地盘，尽可能多地刺杀他们的重要领袖。希望这样可以扰乱他们的军心，为我们赢得优势。去向拉扎布雷德报到，听取进一步的指示吧。他就在这扇大门另一侧的右边。
text.completion: Beyond this door lies the commander of the Dark Iron Army, surrounded by trained soldiers. Are you up for a little killing?

english.title: Infiltrating Shadowforge City
english.objectives: Speak to Razal'blade.
english.description: We're fighting a losing battle right now, I'm afraid. The Dark Irons would be difficult to defeat on their own, but their elemental allies have given them new bleeding edge warriors that we simply can't compete with.$B$BI need you to help us infiltrate their domain and kill as many of their vital leaders as possible. Hopefully that will shock their forces and turn the tide in our favor. Report to Razal'blade for further instruction. He's stationed beyond this gate and to the right.
english.completion: Beyond this door lies the commander of the Dark Iron Army, surrounded by trained soldiers. Are you up for a little killing?

text.title: 北部保卫战
text.objectives: 向暮光高地爬蛇海湾的格拉洛克报到。
text.description: 我已下令在爬蛇海湾的北部海岸处部署了环形的防御线。据斥候说，纳迦试图在那里登陆。$B$B格拉洛克负责整个防御工事——向他报到，保护海滩！
text.completion: Warlord Zaela sent you? Good. If you Horde are as strong as your Warchief promised, I expect to see some bloodshed on these shores.
text.completed: Report to Gralok at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Northern Flank
english.objectives: Report to Gralok at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: I have ordered a defensive perimeter set up on our northern coast, at the Slithering Cove. Our scouts reported that the naga were trying to make landfall there.$B$BGralok is in charge of the operation - report to him and secure that beach!
english.completion: Warlord Zaela sent you? Good. If you Horde are as strong as your Warchief promised, I expect to see some bloodshed on these shores.
english.completed: Report to Gralok at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 血之浪
text.objectives: 任意击败15名黑鳞强夺者或黑鳞女士。
text.description: 纳迦渣滓们企图转移到河流上流，增援暮光堡垒。我们要彻底扫清那些蛇皮怪。$B$B<格拉洛克将手中的大刀插入泥土中。>$B$B摧毁黑鳞纳迦！
text.completion: You're a true fighter, $n. I liked watching you work. Perhaps the Dragonmaw really DO belong in your Horde.
text.completed: Return to Gralok at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Blood in the Surf
english.objectives: Slay any combination of 15 Blackscale Raiders or Blackscale Mistresses.
english.description: These naga scum think to move upriver to reinforce the Bastion of Twilight. We will RIP off their fish heads and PULL OUT their SPINES.$B$B<Gralok drives his broadsword into the dirt.>$B$BDestroy the Blackscale!
english.completion: You're a true fighter, $n. I liked watching you work. Perhaps the Dragonmaw really DO belong in your Horde.
english.completed: Return to Gralok at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 第109师
text.objectives: 杀死怒炉将军和傀儡统帅阿格曼奇。
text.description: 怒炉将军和傀儡统帅阿格曼奇是导致卡加斯远征军109师遭到屠杀的罪魁祸首。那支部队中有许多优秀的巨魔和兽人，很多都是我亲密的战友。$B$B嗯，年轻的$R，为我死去的兄弟们报仇的时刻终于到了。$B$B打开暗炉之锁，然后上楼左转，一直到西部兵营去。干掉怒炉将军和阿格曼奇，不要对他们有丝毫的怜悯。
text.completion: Up ahead is the Grim Guzzler. A disgusting bar full of all our enemies, intoxicated and therefore unfit for proper battle. Ripe for the slaughter.
text.completed: Report to Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.

english.title: The 109th Division
english.objectives: Kill General Angerforge and Golem Lord Argelmach.
english.description: General Angerforge and Golem Lord Argelmach are directly responsible for the horrific slaughter of the 109th Division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. There were a lot of good trolls and orcs in that division, many of them my close friends.$B$BWell, young $r, it's time for our fallen brothers to at last have their revenge.$B$BUnlock The Shadowforge Lock, go up the stairs and bear left until you reach the West Garrison. Kill Angerforge and Argelmach, and don't you dare show them any mercy.
english.completion: Up ahead is the Grim Guzzler. A disgusting bar full of all our enemies, intoxicated and therefore unfit for proper battle. Ripe for the slaughter.
english.completed: Report to Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.

text.title: 海滩上的炮弹
text.objectives: 在爬蛇海湾的沿海地带收集8枚未引爆的迫击炮弹。
text.description: 我们的飞船在龙喉港上空发生了爆炸，我设法从残骸中找回了这些迫击炮。但是弹药却十分短缺！$B$B如果你正要去海滩的话，不妨顺便帮我个忙，收集一些未引爆的迫击炮弹。$B$B未引爆的炮弹是最好的啦——你永远不会知道它们什么时候会爆炸。它们是令敌人惊慌失措的绝妙武器！
text.progress: Do you have the shells? Hand them here!$B$B...Gently!
text.completion: Oh yeah. YEAH! These are DEFINITELY going to kill somebody. Probably naga.
text.completed: Bring the shells to Fergus Gearchum at the Sliterhing Cove in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Shells on the Sea Shore
english.objectives: Gather 8 Unexploded Mortar Shells along the beach at Slithering Cove.
english.description: I salvaged these mortars from the wreck of our airship when she detonated above Dragonmaw Port. But ammunition is in short supply!$B$BWhile you're running along the beach, do me a favor and pick up any unexploded mortar shells you find.$B$BUnexploded shells are the best kind - you never know WHEN they're going to go off. Perfect for surprising an enemy!
english.progress: Do you have the shells? Hand them here!$B$B...Gently!
english.completion: Oh yeah. YEAH! These are DEFINITELY going to kill somebody. Probably naga.
english.completed: Bring the shells to Fergus Gearchum at the Sliterhing Cove in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 有敌意的美味
text.objectives: 从沼岸龙虾人身上收集6条完整的沼岸之尾。
text.description: 你知道，我有个麻烦，或许你可以帮上忙，就在这儿。$B$B瞧，除了追求上好的武器交易，我还试图挑起沼桨镇的娱乐大梁。北边水域里的这些大群的龙虾人显然对我们在海滩上举办的狂野派对不是非常习惯。$B$B它们这是引火烧身。我可不会听凭大个头的龙虾摆布，它们就是我下一个收益来源！你去把它们的尾巴给我弄些来，我们就能把麻烦变成利润。
text.progress: You got those tails? Don't be tryin' to push no hacked-up ones on me!
text.completion: I can see it now: our own famous Bogpaddle Lobster-Poppers! Made fresh from the sea! Oh, it's like this stuff writes itself... Your help is very much appreciated, my friend. I'll start seeing if I can't cut your people a favorable arrangement, eh?
text.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Maliciously Delicious
english.objectives: Collect 6 Intact Swampshore Tails from Swampshore Makrura.
english.description: You know, I've got a problem you might be able to help me out with, here.$B$BSee, in addition to the fine pursuit of arms dealing, I'm trying to liven up the entertainment here in Bogpaddle. Apparently there's a bunch of these makrura things in the north waters that don't take kindly to the wild beach parties we've been throwing.$B$BJoke's on them. I'm not gonna be pushed around by giant lobsters; they're my next source of revenue! You bring me some of their tails and we'll turn a problem into profit.
english.progress: You got those tails? Don't be tryin' to push no hacked-up ones on me!
english.completion: I can see it now: our own famous Bogpaddle Lobster-Poppers! Made fresh from the sea! Oh, it's like this stuff writes itself... Your help is very much appreciated, my friend. I'll start seeing if I can't cut your people a favorable arrangement, eh?
english.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 发出攻击信号
text.objectives: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
text.description: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知我们的部队发起进攻吧！

english.title: Signal the Attack
english.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

text.title: 黑铁酒吧
text.objectives: 与霍尔雷·黑须、普拉格和雷布里·斯库比格特交手。
text.description: 黑铁酒吧里的每个人都是烂醉如泥，所以很容易激怒他们。我想，我们可以在这里制造一场混乱，给他们找点麻烦。$B$B我要你去跟这间酒吧里最臭名昭著的三个顾客打架。打碎酒桶就可以激怒霍尔雷·黑须；在普拉格身边偷取桌上的物品就可以让他发飙；至于容易头脑发热的雷布里·斯库比格特……只需要跟他交谈一下就足够了。等你结束了打斗之后，去告诉奥弗斯。
text.completion: I hear quite the commotion coming from the Grim Guzzler. I see you've been hard at work. If you'll direct your attention opposite me, you'll notice that we have bigger issues to worry about than toying with drunkards.
text.completed: Report to Thunderheart.

english.title: The Grim Guzzler
english.objectives: Fight Hurley Blackbreath, Plugger Spazzring, and Ribbly Screwspigot.
english.description: Everyone inside the Grim Guzzler is absolutely hammered and, therefore, easily angered. I think we can seriously hinder the Dark Irons by causing a bit of chaos here.$B$BI need you to start a fight with three of the bar's infamous patrons. Damage the kegs and Hurley Blackbreath will come running. Steal items off the tables near Plugger Spazzring and he'll fight. As for Ribbly Screwspigot...just talk to the little hothead. Report to Thunderheart when you're done.
english.completion: I hear quite the commotion coming from the Grim Guzzler. I see you've been hard at work. If you'll direct your attention opposite me, you'll notice that we have bigger issues to worry about than toying with drunkards.
english.completed: Report to Thunderheart.

text.title: 发出攻击信号
text.objectives: 到暮光之门中的某座哨塔顶部去，发出攻击信号。
text.description: 既然你已经把碎颅者魔山从暮光之门引开了，现在就赶快发信号通知我们的部队发起进攻吧！

english.title: Signal the Attack
english.objectives: Use the Attack Signal from atop one of the towers at the Twilight Gate.
english.description: Now that you've lured Skullcrusher the Mountain away from the Twilight Gate, I need you to signal our forces to attack!

text.title: 黑铁的契约
text.objectives: 杀死弗莱拉斯大使和杜姆雷尔。
text.description: 弗莱拉斯大使就在这间屋子里。他是炎魔拉格纳罗斯派到黑铁矮人这边来的使者。在那间屋子后面，是召唤者之墓，将拉格纳罗斯召唤到我们这个世界来的七位黑铁矮人先贤的灵魂就盘踞在墓中。$B$B也许你对炎魔之王并不了解，但是如果我们不去阻止他的话，艾泽拉斯世界就会被他毁灭。刚才我提到的这些人是他控制黑铁矮人的关键，把他们全都干掉，这个邪恶的同盟才能终结。
text.completion: I cannot proceed any further alone, regardless of my combat experience. The Lyceum has proven too difficult for me. If you are here, though...you might be the key to all of this.
text.completed: Report to Warlord Goretooth.

english.title: The Dark Iron Pact
english.objectives: Kill Ambassador Flamelash and Doom'rel.
english.description: Inside this chamber lies Ambassador Flamelash. He is the ambassador to the Dark Iron Nation from Ragnaros the Firelord. Beyond that chamber is the Summoners' Tomb, home to the spirits of the seven Dark Iron patriarchs who summoned Ragnaros into our world.$B$BYou may not know of the Great Fire, but he will be the end of Azeroth if he is not stopped, and these individuals are directly tied to his hold over the Dark Iron. Slay them all, and may this unholy union cease.
english.completion: I cannot proceed any further alone, regardless of my combat experience. The Lyceum has proven too difficult for me. If you are here, though...you might be the key to all of this.
english.completed: Report to Warlord Goretooth.

text.title: 加冰饮料
text.objectives: 从淤泥蟹身上获得10瓶被偷走的银罐冰酒。
text.description: 能帮个忙吗，“老兄”！咱们一时兴起搞起的海滩派对举行到一半，却发生了可怕的事情，“哥们儿”！$B$B我有一整箱银罐冰酒，贸易巨头的饮料之选，可淤泥蟹把它们给偷走了！我还没见过螃蟹会喝酒的，可他们把喝的拖到水里去了！我们需要某个了不起的英雄来帮我们拿回最爱的品牌特酿！$B$B<布朗诺盯着你。>$B$B说的就是你，“老弟”！
text.progress: You got the goods, "bro"?
text.completion: Our ice-cold, refreshing Silversnap Ice! I can't thank you enough, "dawg", for this entirely spontaneous act of heroism! Here, have your very own bottle as a totally sincere gesture of thanks! Be sure to tell ALL YOUR FRIENDS how good it is.
text.completed: Return to Brono Goodgroove in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Drinks on the Rocks
english.objectives: Collect 10 bottles of Stolen Silversnap Ice from Silt Crawlers.
english.description: What's up, "bro"! We were just in the middle of our completely spontaneous beach party when something terrible happened, "dude"!$B$BI had a whole case of Silversnap Ice, the Baron's own drink of choice, until the silt crawlers stole them! I've never seen crawlers drink, but they took them right into the water and down the beach! We need some sort of awesome hero who can help retrieve our specifically-branded favorite beverage!$B$B<Brono stares at you a moment.>$B$BThat means you, "brah"!
english.progress: You got the goods, "bro"?
english.completion: Our ice-cold, refreshing Silversnap Ice! I can't thank you enough, "dawg", for this entirely spontaneous act of heroism! Here, have your very own bottle as a totally sincere gesture of thanks! Be sure to tell ALL YOUR FRIENDS how good it is.
english.completed: Return to Brono Goodgroove in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 卡加斯远征军的重生
text.objectives: 杀死达格兰·索瑞森大帝。
text.description: 达格兰·索瑞森大帝在前面的王座上掌控着整座城市。如果我们想要阻止他的军队，就必须终结这位皇帝的统治。$B$B你必须击败他的贴身卫士，包括一个名叫玛格姆斯的巨人，才能接近他。你的行动要尽可能地快——否则整座城里的敌人都会涌向他的王座。$B$B注意，只有当你从持火者手中抢过火炬并点燃火盆之后，讲学厅的大门才会打开。祝你好运。
text.completion: A true $c if I've ever seen one! You've done the impossible! I knew we could count on you. And with that, I'd like for you to be the first to know that the Kargath Expeditionary Force is now officially back in business! I extend to you my personal gratitude for your efforts here. Remember always our motto: "First in, last out, always victorious. Remember always Kargath." You are dismissed.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Goretooth.
text.giverWindow: His time has come.

english.title: Rebirth of the K.E.F.
english.objectives: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
english.description: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan has total control over the city from his throne ahead. If we are to stop his armies, we're going to have to end their emperor's reign.$B$BYou'll need to get past his personal guard, including the giant Magmus, to reach him. Move as quickly as possible - if word gets out before you finish, the entire city will descend upon his throne.$B$BNote that the doors across the Lyceum will only open once you've lit the braziers with torches from the flamekeepers. Good luck.
english.completion: A true $c if I've ever seen one! You've done the impossible! I knew we could count on you. And with that, I'd like for you to be the first to know that the Kargath Expeditionary Force is now officially back in business! I extend to you my personal gratitude for your efforts here. Remember always our motto: "First in, last out, always victorious. Remember always Kargath." You are dismissed.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Goretooth.
english.giverWindow: His time has come.

text.title: 女王密令
text.objectives: 俘虏指挥官罗娜·克罗雷，将其带给银松森林被遗忘者先锋军的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。
text.description: 罗娜·克罗雷，她是达利乌斯·克罗雷领主之女，目前就在东南边格雷迈恩之墙附近的吉尔尼斯解放阵线营地里。$B$B我们的主要任务是潜入营地并活捉她。黑暗女王认为可以把罗娜当做跟克罗雷讲价的筹码。要我说，咱们干脆就杀掉她，把她变成被遗忘者，但我们得服从黑暗女王的命令。$B$B趁联盟的其余部队还没有到，我们得赶紧动手。
text.completion: You have done it! Finally, everything is in place. Should Crowley not accept our terms, his daughter will be turned.
text.completed: Return Commander Lorna Crowley to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
text.giverWindow: Our Bargaining Chip

english.title: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
english.objectives: Capture Commander Lorna Crowley and return her to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: Lorna Crowley, daughter of Lord Darius Crowley, is currently at the Gilneas Liberation Front camp, located near the Greymane Wall, to the southeast.$B$BOur primary mission is to infiltrate the camp and capture her alive. The Dark Lady believes that she will be able to use Lorna as a bargaining chip against Crowley. I say we just kill her and bring her back as Forsaken, but we must do as the Dark Lady commands.$B$BWe must hurry before the rest of the Alliance forces arrive.
english.completion: You have done it! Finally, everything is in place. Should Crowley not accept our terms, his daughter will be turned.
english.completed: Return Commander Lorna Crowley to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the Forsaken Front in Silverpine Forest.
english.giverWindow: Our Bargaining Chip

text.title: 先知哈达西
text.objectives: 去找奥西斯的先知哈达西。
text.description: 先知哈达西是奥西斯部落最睿智和最年长的一员。$B$B但他还没有被解决掉，而他的存在至关重要。$B$B到奥西斯去找他。如果他遭到伤害，那将是奥拉基尔的一大幸事。
text.completion: Who... who are you?  Sent here... to rescue my people and fight our enemies.

english.title: The Prophet Hadassi
english.objectives: Find the Prophet Hadassi in Orsis.
english.description: Prophet Hadassi is the wisest and eldest member of the Orsis tribe.$B$BHe has not been accounted for and his well-being is of vital importance.$B$BGo into Orsis and find him.  A great day of reckoning will come to the Al'Akir's lackeys if he's been hurt.
english.completion: Who... who are you?  Sent here... to rescue my people and fight our enemies.

text.title: 山脉之心
text.objectives: 获得山脉之心。
text.description: 数年来，我一直在寻找一颗特殊的宝石——山脉之心。这颗宝石有你的拳头那么大！黑铁矮人把它锁在他们的保险柜里，而且就算我去找他们谈判，他们也肯定不会把它卖给我。$B$B所以我只能动武了。$B$B杀进工艺之厅旁边的黑色宝库中去，突破它的层层安保，拿到山脉之心。具体说来，你必须击败卫兵杜格瑞普，而要让他出现，你就必须把宝库里面的所有古物宝库都打开！$B$B祝你好运。
text.progress: 你拿到山脉之心了吗?对我来说，它是无价之宝。
text.completion: 你拿到山脉之心了!太让我惊讶了!它比我想像中的还要漂亮!$B$B请你请收下这个作为报酬!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Maxwort Uberglint.

english.title: The Heart of the Mountain
english.objectives: Obtain the Heart of the Mountain.
english.description: For years I have sought a certain gem.  It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist!  The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.$B$BSo I must resort to force.$B$BFight your way to The Black Vault near the Hall of Crafting, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart.  To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!$B$BGood luck.
english.progress: Do you have the Heart of the Mountain?  To me, its value is without limit.
english.completion: You have the heart!  Amazing!  It is even more beautiful than I imagined! Please, $n, take this as payment!
english.completed: Return to Maxwort Uberglint.

text.title: 疯狂的拉里
text.objectives: 去找沼桨镇东南的疯狂的拉里。
text.description: 你越来越对路了，$N。你帮我，我就帮你。好吧，更像是我帮你们整个军队，而且比另一边的要难帮一点！太复杂了？$B$B我的意思是，有好多人要帮。所以就要你也帮帮我一会儿。偷走那些地雷的人刚刚在东边海岸对我的小子们动手了。$B$B到东南边我们的营地去，找疯狂的拉里，你到了那边以后，他自有安排。
text.completion: Silversnap sent you?! I'm DOOMED! Oh, he sent you to help me! That's different, haha!

english.title: Crazy Larry
english.objectives: Find Crazy Larry to the southeast of Bogpaddle.
english.description: You're gettin' it, $n. You scratch my back, I scratch yours. Well, more like I scratch the back of your whole army, and just a little harder than the backs of the other side! Was that too complicated?$B$BWhat I'm sayin' is, that's a lot of backs. So I'm gonna have to ask you to scratch mine a few more times. Whoever stole those landmines may have just hit our boys on the eastern shore.$B$BHead to our camp to the southeast and check on Crazy Larry; he'll fill you in when you get there.
english.completion: Silversnap sent you?! I'm DOOMED! Oh, he sent you to help me! That's different, haha!

text.title: 收拾海地精
text.objectives: 干掉7个海地精猎手。
text.description: 海地精！$B$B<拉里一言不发地瞪你了一会儿。>$B$B你从来没见过海地精吗？他们是疯子！比我还要疯！我炸东西是为了过日子，这些家伙是有毛病！$B$B不知道他们从哪儿来，但他们就像可怕的地精鱼！有鱼鳃和别的一切！他们把我们留在海滩上的人都干掉了，还抢了我们的货船！$B$B你得帮帮忙！他们就在东边，去除掉那些海地精！
text.completion: That'll show those fish-faced freaks! Good work!
text.completed: Return to Crazy Larry at the Sorrowmurk in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Kill Gil
english.objectives: Slay 7 Gilblin Stalkers.
english.description: Gilblins!$B$B<Larry stares at you silently for a while.>$B$BYou never seen a gilblin before? They're crazy! Crazier than me! I just blow stuff up for a living, these guys are WHACKED!$B$BDunno where they came from, but they're like awful fish goblins! Gills and everything! They wiped out all my men down at the beach, and they took our shipping freighter!$B$BYou gotta help! They're just down to the east, go on and get rid of those gilblins!
english.completion: That'll show those fish-faced freaks! Good work!
english.completed: Return to Crazy Larry at the Sorrowmurk in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 死不带去
text.objectives: 从死亡的沼桨私掠水手身上收集6个杂物袋。
text.description: 我剩下来的船员，只要是你没在营地周围见到的，就都死了！他们是好地精，可糟糕的是他们还在外头！真是悲剧！$B$B我是说，他们的东西还在他们身上，真是悲剧！一想到那些上好的材料和钱币就那么泡在水里，就叫人惊恐。$B$B嘿！你可以帮我一个忙！要是你打算把那儿的海地精杀掉，不如也把我以前船员们的杂物袋也拿来！$B$B得了吧，他们又不需要了！现实点儿！
text.progress: You get those ditty bags? I hope you left the goblins there!
text.completion: WOW! I don't know why I said that. I'm excitable! But man, there was a lot of stuff on these guys, check it out! Here, you want this?
text.completed: Return to Crazy Larry at the Sorrowmurk in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Can't Take It With Them
english.objectives: Collect 6 Ditty Bags from Deceased Bogpaddle Privateers.
english.description: Any shipping crew I had that you don't see hanging around this camp are DEAD! Those were some fine goblins, but what's worse is they're all still out there! It's a TRAGEDY!$B$BI mean, it's a tragedy they still have all their stuff! It's horrifying to think of all the perfectly good materials and coins sitting out there in the water.$B$BHey! You can do me a favor! If you're killing gilblins out there, go get the ditty bags off my old crewmen!$B$BC'mon, they're not gonna need it anymore! Be real!
english.progress: You get those ditty bags? I hope you left the goblins there!
english.completion: WOW! I don't know why I said that. I'm excitable! But man, there was a lot of stuff on these guys, check it out! Here, you want this?
english.completed: Return to Crazy Larry at the Sorrowmurk in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 人间大炮
text.objectives: 跟小狂人杰瑞谈一谈，登上船，然后取得所有三件疯狂的拉里的重要物资。
text.description: 我们的商船还在外面，船上全是海地精！啊！$B$B不好意思，我失态了。不过说真的！我们得想办法过去把东西拿回来。船上都是好货！好货！就像我的中间名！$B$B你真走运，我有个主意！从营地径直往外，沿着北墙走……我的儿子杰瑞会用大炮把你送过去！我是说，如果他有好好练习过的话！
text.progress: You got it? Did you get it? Did you try the cannon? You didn't explode!
text.completion: My high-grade fuse! My imported blasting powder! And my--hello there! I'll just be taking that! Those are all worth more gold than what you're wearing, you know! Thanks for your help!
text.completed: Return to Crazy Larry in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: In With a Bang
english.objectives: Speak with Lil' Crazy Jerry to board the ship, then retrieve all three of Crazy Larry's important goods.
english.description: Our trade frigate's still all the way out there on the water, swarming with Gilblins! AHH!$B$BSorry about that. But really! We need a way to get you out there and get back our stuff. There's quality goods left on that ship! QUALITY! LIKE MY MIDDLE NAME!$B$BLucky for you, I have an idea! Head right outside the camp and check along the north wall... my son Jerry'll get you over there with our cannon! If he's been practicing, that is!
english.progress: You got it? Did you get it? Did you try the cannon? You didn't explode!
english.completion: My high-grade fuse! My imported blasting powder! And my--hello there! I'll just be taking that! Those are all worth more gold than what you're wearing, you know! Thanks for your help!
english.completed: Return to Crazy Larry in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 死灰之城
text.objectives: 随希尔瓦娜斯·风行者左右，前往战场击败联盟！
text.description: 我们的军队在战场上所向披靡。克罗雷和他的部队节节败退，并且尚不知罗娜·克罗雷的命运。我们到战场中央去找克罗雷和他的同胞，我向他们提出投降的条件。他们要么接受，要么我们把他们都杀光，把城市焚为灰烬。$B$B作为我最信任的士兵，你将随侍我左右，完成这场交易。你做好出发的准备之后，就告诉我。
text.completion: This... is not over. Godfrey and his traitorous allies will pay for what they have done as will the remaining Alliance forces occupying Lordaeron. Our work has only just begun.
text.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: Cities in Dust
english.objectives: Accompany Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to the Battlefield and defeat the Alliance!
english.description: Our armies clash across the battlefield. Crowley and his forces are losing ground and they do not yet know the fate of Lorna Crowley. We will meet with Crowley and his compatriots at mid field and I will present them with terms of their surrender. They will either accept or we will kill them all and leave their cities in dust.$B$BAs my most trusted soldier, you are to stand by my side during the exchange. Tell me when you are prepared to leave.
english.completion: This... is not over. Godfrey and his traitorous allies will pay for what they have done as will the remaining Alliance forces occupying Lordaeron. Our work has only just begun.
english.completed: Speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 先知的遗言
text.objectives: 找到圣器。
text.description: 我们……发誓……要保护……奥西斯的节杖。$B$B听好，$C，我的时间不多……了。$B$B去城市的南面……找到圣器。$B$B不要……让它……落入他们的……手里……
text.completion: Though the chest is locked, there is a plaque bearing interesting hieroglyphs above it.

english.title: The Prophet's Dying Words
english.objectives: Find the Sacred Receptacle.
english.description: We... are... bound by oath... to protect the scepter of Orsis.$B$BListen, $c, I don't have much time... left.$B$BFind the sacred receptacle... in the southern end of the city.$B$BDo not... let it... fall into their... hands...
english.completion: Though the chest is locked, there is a plaque bearing interesting hieroglyphs above it.

text.title: 封闭的大门
text.objectives: 杀死贝尔加。
text.description: 在黑铁大道一端的尽头，矗立着一扇巨门，与另一端尽头通往暗炉城的那扇门很像。不过，我们不知道这扇门后面是什么！$B$B我们只知道它被铁怒巡逻队和熔岩巨人贝尔加重兵把守着。你的任务很简单，去除掉他们，然后看看有没有办法把门撬开！$B$B想象一下吧，门后会是什么呢……也许是整座城市的另一半，而我们对它一无所知！也许什么都没有！天知道是什么！$B$B不过，总会有点东西吧……
text.completion: Darn it! I simply HAVE to know what's behind that gate! This could be the discovery that makes my career, you know! Hmm....maybe a couple good explosions would do the trick...
text.completed: Return to Tinkee Steamboil.
text.giverWindow: What's behind his gate?

english.title: The Sealed Gate
english.objectives: Kill Bael'gar.
english.description: At one end of the Dark Iron Highway stands a massive gate much like the one that protects Shadowforge City on the opposite side. However, we have no idea what's behind it!$B$BAll we know is that it's heavily guarded by Anvilrage patrols and the molten giant Bael'gar. You simply must dispose of them and see if you can pry that gate open!$B$BJust imagine what could lie behind it...there could be an entire other half of the city we never knew about! Or nothing! Who knows!$B$BThough, it's probably something...
english.completion: Darn it! I simply HAVE to know what's behind that gate! This could be the discovery that makes my career, you know! Hmm....maybe a couple good explosions would do the trick...
english.completed: Return to Tinkee Steamboil.
english.giverWindow: What's behind his gate?

text.title: 预言者迦玛兰
text.objectives: 获得预言者迦玛兰的徽记。
text.description: 预言者迦玛兰，阿塔莱和哈卡莱巨魔的领袖，获得了一小部分夺灵者哈卡的血液。他们将其注射到绿龙的体内，用以制造大量血液，好把哈卡召唤到我们的世界里来。$B$B我们不能允许这样的事情发生。在事态进一步发展之前，杀掉迦玛兰和他的牧师！
text.progress: Were you able to kill Jammal'an? I'll need proof that the deed is done.
text.completion: Excellent! I suspect that without Jammal'an's leadership, the trolls will fall to infighting and Hakkar will never set his eyes upon our world.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

english.title: Jammal'an the Prophet
english.objectives: Obtain Jammal'an the Prophet's Head.
english.description: Jammal'an the Prophet, leader of the Atal'ai and Hakkari trolls, has obtained a small amount of Hakkar the Soulflayer's blood. They are injecting it into the green dragons to use their bodies to produce the massive quantities of blood necessary to summon Hakkar into our world.$B$BWe cannot allow this to come to pass. Slaughter Jammal'an and his priests before they get any further in their efforts!
english.progress: Were you able to kill Jammal'an? I'll need proof that the deed is done.
english.completion: Excellent! I suspect that without Jammal'an's leadership, the trolls will fall to infighting and Hakkar will never set his eyes upon our world.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

text.title: 被变形的伊兰尼库斯
text.objectives: 杀死伊兰尼库斯。
text.description: 阿塔莱巨魔注射在绿龙身体里的哈卡之血，对巨龙本身有着毁灭性的作用。看起来这些巨龙、阿塔莱巨魔的前任狱卒，已经被哈卡的精华从内部腐蚀，变成了噩梦生物。$B$B伊瑟拉的主要配偶、神庙的看守长伊兰尼库斯摄入的血液最多，遭受的扭曲超出了想象。迦玛兰死后，找到伊兰尼库斯，除掉他。
text.completion: You only defeated Eranikus' Shade? This is most troubling... Let us hope that his full form does not still exist outside the Temple. Only Ysera herself is stronger than him in our flight.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

english.title: Eranikus
english.objectives: Kill Eranikus.
english.description: The Hakkar blood the Atal'ai have been injecting into the green dragons has had devastating effects on the dragons themselves. It appears that these dragons, former jailors of the Atal'ai, have been corrupted by its presence in their bodies and have become creatures of Nightmare.$B$BEranikus, Ysera's primary consort and lead watcher over the temple, was infused with the largest quantities of blood and has become twisted beyond imagination. After Jammal'an is dead, find Eranikus and end him.
english.completion: You only defeated Eranikus' Shade? This is most troubling... Let us hope that his full form does not still exist outside the Temple. Only Ysera herself is stronger than him in our flight.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

text.title: Blast Him!
text.objectives: Blow the Heth'Jatari Conch next to a Heth'Jatari Banner. Kill Fathom-Lord Heth'Jatar. Luring him into incoming mortar fire will help.
text.description: 我们去钓鱼，$N！现在迫击炮已经准备好了，我们可以拿出这个入侵的领袖。$B$Bfathom-Heth'Jatar掌管着Blackscale战士种姓。到这里东北方向的Heth'Jatari横幅，听到这个海螺壳。这就像一个狗哨子。对于鱼$B$B当赫斯塔尔出现时，我会命令迫击炮集中火力。你会看到进入炮弹的目标。$B$BLure Heth'Jatar进入我们的迫击炮火力，并将他击倒！
text.completion: Boom baby, boom! What? You killed the Fathom-Lord already? I suppose we should stop shelling his corpse, then.
text.completed: Return to Fergus Gearchum at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Kill Heth'Jatar! We'll support you with artillery. Lure him into the blasts.

english.title: Blast Him!
english.objectives: Blow the Heth'Jatari Conch next to a Heth'Jatari Banner. Kill Fathom-Lord Heth'Jatar. Luring him into incoming mortar fire will help.
english.description: Let's go fishing, $N! Now that the mortars are ready, we can take out the leader of this invasion.$B$BFathom-Lord Heth'Jatar rules over the Blackscale warrior caste. Go to the Heth'Jatari Banners just northeast of here and honk this conch shell. It's like a dog-whistle. For fish.$B$BWhen Heth'Jartar shows up, I'll order the mortars to concentrate fire. You'll see the targets of the incoming shells.$B$BLure Heth'Jatar into our mortar fire and pummel him into submission!
english.completion: Boom baby, boom! What? You killed the Fathom-Lord already? I suppose we should stop shelling his corpse, then.
english.completed: Return to Fergus Gearchum at the Slithering Cove in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Kill Heth'Jatar! We'll support you with artillery. Lure him into the blasts.

text.title: 南部保卫战
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地暮光海滩的洛克塔尔谈一谈。
text.description: 与部落结盟将导致氏族和联盟发生正面冲突。$B$B那就来吧。$B$B联盟正在向半岛进军，龙喉港的处境十分危险。$B$B去南边找洛克塔尔——我相信他已经在船只残骸处设立了指挥岗，并确保我们拥有暮光海滩的控制权。
text.completion: Good timing, $c. We were just about to unleash a counter-attack.
text.completed: 跟暮光高地暮光海滩的洛克塔尔谈一谈。

english.title: The Southern Flank
english.objectives: Speak with Rok'tar at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Our new arrangement with the Horde will put my people in direct conflict with the Alliance.$B$BBring. Them. On.$B$BAs we speak, the Alliance moves up the peninsula to threaten Dragonmaw Port.$B$BFind Rok'tar to the south - I believe he has set up a command post on one of the shipwrecks - and ensure that the Twilight Shores remain in our control.
english.completion: Good timing, $c. We were just about to unleash a counter-attack.
english.completed: Speak with Rok'tar at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 四个总比没有好
text.objectives: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
text.description: 进攻暮光之门的战斗即将打响，还有最后一点小麻烦要处理：扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德，古加尔的信徒。$B$B情报显示，他们就在信徒之穴里面，那是暮光之门西南角的一座小型的食人魔洞穴。$B$B你能回去把他们除掉吗？
text.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack?
text.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead. Regardless, thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Four Heads are Better than None
english.objectives: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.
english.description: We're about to launch the attack upon the Twilight Gate, but there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BWould you go back in there and kill them?
english.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack?
english.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead. Regardless, thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Cassius the White at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 四个总比没有好
text.objectives: 收集扎布鲁克斯和毕布伏德的四枚徽记。
text.description: Now, while we're about to launch the attack upon the Twilight Gate, there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BPlease head back in and kill them.
text.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack? I hope that it's not yours.
text.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead, though I do appreciate the extra effort. Thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
text.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Four Heads are Better than None
english.objectives: Collect the four heads of Za'brox and Beeble'phod.
english.description: Now, while we're about to launch the attack upon the Twilight Gate, there is one last loose end to tie up: Za'brox and Beeble'phod, the disciples of Cho'gall.$B$BIntelligence has placed them within the Den of the Disciples, a small ogre cave at the southwest corner of the Twilight Gate.$B$BPlease head back in and kill them.
english.progress: Is that blood dripping from your pack? I hope that it's not yours.
english.completion: That's quite a gruesome trophy collection you have there. I would have believed you if you had simply said they were dead, though I do appreciate the extra effort. Thank you for having the foresight to take care of them. The Twilight Gate will soon be ours. Time to move up to the Twilight Citadel.
english.completed: Return to Lady Cozwynn at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 侦查海滩
text.objectives: 侦查暮光海滩的滩头控制点。你不必占领控制点，但是成功占领的话，你会被标记为开启PvP状态，且你所在的营地可以获得作战优势。
text.description: If the Alliance gains control of this peninsula, they will threaten Dragonmaw Port. Not going to happen.$B$BSouth of here you'll see a small hill with a commanding view of the shoreline. Whoever controls that hill will have the upper hand all along the shore!$B$BRush over there and scout the beach head control point. It's marked by that enormous flag. Then return to me.$B$BYou don't have to capture it, unless you're spoiling for a fight with the Alliance.
text.completion: Good work, $c. Now you know the lay of the land. If you're ever having difficulty fighting here on the Twilight Shores, remember that capturing and holding the Beach Head will give all Horde forces here a combat advantage!
text.completed: Return to Rok'tar at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Scouting the Shore
english.objectives: Scout the Beach Head Control Point on the Twilight Shore. You don't need to capture it, but doing so will give your side a combat advantage and flag you for PvP.
english.description: If the Alliance gains control of this peninsula, they will threaten Dragonmaw Port. Not going to happen.$B$BSouth of here you'll see a small hill with a commanding view of the shoreline. Whoever controls that hill will have the upper hand all along the shore!$B$BRush over there and scout the beach head control point. It's marked by that enormous flag. Then return to me.$B$BYou don't have to capture it, unless you're spoiling for a fight with the Alliance.
english.completion: Good work, $c. Now you know the lay of the land. If you're ever having difficulty fighting here on the Twilight Shores, remember that capturing and holding the Beach Head will give all Horde forces here a combat advantage!
english.completed: Return to Rok'tar at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: Blood on the Sand
text.objectives: Slay 12 Highbank Marines on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
text.description: Our objective in the Twilight Highlands is to storm the Bastion of Twilight, but the Alliance have decided to make war.$B$BSo we will give them war!$B$BSlay their marines until the lesson is learned.
text.completion: Good, good. Let them reap what they sow!
text.completed: Return to Rok'tar on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Blood on the Sand
english.objectives: Slay 12 Highbank Marines on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Our objective in the Twilight Highlands is to storm the Bastion of Twilight, but the Alliance have decided to make war.$B$BSo we will give them war!$B$BSlay their marines until the lesson is learned.
english.completion: Good, good. Let them reap what they sow!
english.completed: Return to Rok'tar on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 内部攻破
text.objectives: 打开提尔之手修道院藏书房和武器大厅的银色传送门。
text.description: 在试图打开这座修道院里的传送门时，我们损失了几个人。你证明了自己不仅身手敏捷，而且身经百战……现在我要你再接再厉。$B$B修道院有两部分：藏书房和武器大厅。在这两部分里，你都可以找到一扇传送门。$B$B在传送门上用这颗钥石。如此一来就能强行打开它们，让我们余下的突击部队拿下这座修道院。
text.completion: The abbey will fall shortly.  We can soon move on, deeper into Tyr's Hand.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.objective1: Open portal within Hall of Arms

english.title: Victory From Within
english.objectives: Open the Argent Portals in the Library Wing and the Hall of Arms within the abbey in Tyr's Hand.
english.description: A few of our men didn't make it through portals which were supposed to open inside this very abbey.  You've already proven your elusiveness and battlehardiness... now I need you to do so again.$b$bThe abbey has two wings: a library, and a hall of arms.  In each wing, you should find a portal.$b$bUse this keystone on these portals.  Doing so should force them open, allowing our remaining shock troopers to take this abbey.
english.completion: The abbey will fall shortly.  We can soon move on, deeper into Tyr's Hand.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.objective1: Open portal within Hall of Arms

text.title: 刺客
text.objectives: 干掉提尔之手修道院钟楼里的杀手洛汗。
text.description: 血色十字军的命运是悲剧的，也是讽刺的。他们曾经冲在人类对抗亡灵的最前线。而现在，他们就像往日自己猎杀的那些行尸走肉一般。是什么让他们堕落成活死人一般，这点还无人得知，但他们依然危险这点是不变的。$B$B他们中最致命的是一个叫做洛汗的杀手。我们有情报称他就在这座修道院的钟楼顶上。找到他把他杀掉，$N。尽量别死在路上了。
text.completion: The death of Rohan eases my spirits a bit. I once fought beside him, you know.  He was an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade; one of the few that deigned to join us in our battle against Kel'thuzad, so many years ago.  How quickly things change.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: A master rogue, bereft of honor.

english.title: The Assassin
english.objectives: Kill Rohan the Assassin within the abbey bell tower in Tyr's Hand.
english.description: The fate of the Scarlet Crusade is tragic, if somewhat ironic.  At one point, they led the charge of humanity against the undead.  Now, they resemble those corpses that they once hunted.  What caused their descent into undeath isn't certain, but it doesn't make them any less dangerous.$b$bOne of their deadliest was an assassin who went by the name of Rohan.  We have intel that places him atop the bell tower in this very abbey.  Find him and kill him, $N.  And try not to die on the way.
english.completion: The death of Rohan eases my spirits a bit. I once fought beside him, you know.  He was an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade; one of the few that deigned to join us in our battle against Kel'thuzad, so many years ago.  How quickly things change.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: A master rogue, bereft of honor.

text.title: 抢救血色财产
text.objectives: 获得赤红野猪、莉安娜的宝石串、乌瑟尔的罩布以及格文拉德的图章。
text.description: This battle was won before it started.  Right now, we're just shooting for style points.$b$bWithin these barracks, the sniveling Scarlet Crusaders cling to their priceless artifacts, even though some of the objects are too holy for their now-undead hand to touch.  So they keep them in chests, hidden from the world.$b$bYou will find these artifacts, and bring them back to me.  They belong to be among the Argent Crusade.  They belong in the hands of the righteous.
text.progress: I hope you gave them a fight.
text.completion: Well done, $n.  I will deliver these to Tyrosus when we return.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Scarlet Salvage
english.objectives: Obtain the Crimson Boar, Lihanna's Strand, the Shroud of Uther, and Gavinrad's Sigil.
english.description: This battle was won before it started.  Right now, we're just shooting for style points.$b$bWithin these barracks, the sniveling Scarlet Crusaders cling to their priceless artifacts, even though some of the objects are too holy for their now-undead hand to touch.  So they keep them in chests, hidden from the world.$b$bYou will find these artifacts, and bring them back to me.  They belong to be among the Argent Crusade.  They belong in the hands of the righteous.
english.progress: I hope you gave them a fight.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  I will deliver these to Tyrosus when we return.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 愤怒者
text.objectives: 杀死愤怒者玛塔乌斯。
text.description: 血色十字军一个更为邪恶的成员，愤怒者玛塔乌斯，就潜藏在兵营的地牢里。地下非常适合他那黑暗的心态。$B$B如果我再年轻些，还在前线的话，我就亲自把他干掉。而实情是，我被留在后方指挥我们的军队。所以我只要把荣幸交给你了。
text.completion: You are well on your way to becoming a true champion of the Light, $n.  Well done.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: A sick and twisted soul.

english.title: The Wrathcaster
english.objectives: Slay Mataus the Wrathcaster.
english.description: One of the more vile members of the Scarlet Crusade, Mataus the Wrathcaster, lurks within the barracks' dungeon.  Undeath suits his dark manner.$b$bWere I younger and on the front lines, I'd run him through myself.  As things are, I'm left behind to lead our forces from the rear.  So I leave the pleasure to you.
english.completion: You are well on your way to becoming a true champion of the Light, $n.  Well done.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: A sick and twisted soul.

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 猎手
text.objectives: 杀死猎手雷奥普德。
text.description: 我们的人在要塞的枪林弹雨中损失了大半。我还没见着开火的敌人长什么样呢，不过也用不着。我知道上面那人的名字。$B$B雷奥普德。$B$B没错，上面只有一个人，挨个儿地把我的人都干掉了。而在我看来，你也只有一个。$B$B听上去像是一次公平的战斗。
text.completion: One less thing to worry about.  Nice work up there.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: Deadly with any weapon at range.

english.title: The Huntsman
english.objectives: Slay Huntsman Leopold.
english.description: We've already lost half a dozen men to a hail of bullets and arrows coming from atop this fortress.  I haven't seen the face of the enemy that's firing, but I don't need to.  I know the name of the man up there.$b$bLeopold.$b$bThat's right, there's only one man up there, picking off my men one-by-one.  And from what I can see, there's only one of you.$b$bSounds like a fair fight to me.
english.completion: One less thing to worry about.  Nice work up there.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Deadly with any weapon at range.

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 不再污秽
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。
text.description: 你能感觉到么？污染已经从这幢建筑上消失了。$B$B神圣的建筑就是神圣的，像洛汗和其他血色混账这样的坏人只能将其压住一时。$B$B拿下修道院后，我们距离占领提尔之手又近了一步。把战果报告给安吉拉。她应该在镇中央某处带人朝大教堂冲锋。
text.completion: Good, the abbey is ours.  I never doubted Eligor's ability for a moment.

english.title: Befouled No More
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Can you sense it?  The taint is already lifting from this building.$b$bA holy building wants to be holy, and villains like Rohan and the rest of his Scarlet scum only hold it back.$b$bWith the abbey secure, we are a step closer to taking Tyr's Hand.  Report the results of our strike to Angela.  She should be leading the charge on the cathedral from somewhere in the center of town.
english.completion: Good, the abbey is ours.  I never doubted Eligor's ability for a moment.

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 银色动荡
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。
text.description: 我得说，咱们把这些兵营打成这样，也算是胜利了。一个指挥官、一个猎手，还有一个术士，全给杀了……更不用说我们解放出来的圣物。或者我该说……是你解放出来的。$B$B大教堂还在，不过撑不了多久了。去跟安吉拉·杜萨图斯谈谈。提尔之手大教堂的命运就掌握在她无所不能的手里。
text.completion: It sounds like Korfax really cleaned house over at the barracks.  It's very much like him to show off like that.

english.title: Argent Upheaval
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I'll say we've done enough damage to these barracks to call this a win.  A commander, a huntsman, and a warlock, all slain... not to mention the relics that we've liberated.  Or shall I say... YOU liberated.$b$bThe cathedral still remains, but not for long.  Talk with Archmage Angela Dosantos, in the central courtyard.  The fate of Tyr's Hand's cathedral falls in her able hands.
english.completion: It sounds like Korfax really cleaned house over at the barracks.  It's very much like him to show off like that.

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 指挥官
text.objectives: 杀死血色指挥官玛尔兰。
text.description: 血色指挥官玛尔兰狡猾、精明、为了赢得战斗不择手段。但首要的是，她十分忠诚。$B$B毫无疑问，你可以在兵营中央大厅里找到她，在血红的旗帜下战斗，直到她胜利或是死亡。$B$B一定要让结果是后者。
text.completion: Good, good.  These barracks are as good as fallen.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: She has nothing left to lose.

english.title: The Commander
english.objectives: Slay Scarlet Commander Marjhan.
english.description: Scarlet Commander Marjhan is cunning, shrewd, and willing to do anything to win a battle.  Before all these things, however, she is loyal.$b$bI have no doubt you'll find her in the barracks' central chamber, fighting under a crimson banner, until she either wins or dies.$b$bMake sure it's the latter.
english.completion: Good, good.  These barracks are as good as fallen.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: She has nothing left to lose.

starters.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 北伐军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 如同鼠辈
text.objectives: 杀死十字军领主瓦德玛尔。
text.description: 好吧，很高兴埃里戈尔和科尔法克斯还是留了点乐子给我。他们身陷其中的鏖战正好让他们无法莽撞地冲进这座大教堂的中央。$B$B毕竟，这是你的职责。$B$B大教堂就在前面，血色势力最后的一处堡垒。在那里，十字军领主瓦德玛尔坐镇在那个摇摇欲坠、由谎言搭成的布道坛上。$B$B他将无处可逃，我们也不会心慈手软。血色十字军伪善的残余将在这里终结。杀掉他。
text.completion: While I can't agree with their methods, I can't argue with their results.  In many ways, the Scarlet were well-intentioned, but their zeal grew too strong, and their hate blinded them to reason. I only hope that the same doesn't happen to our Brotherhood of Light.
text.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: How the mighty have fallen.

english.title: Like Rats
english.objectives: Slay Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
english.description: Well, I'm glad that Eligor and Korfax left some fun for me.  It was a battle unto itself to keep them from rushing headlong into the middle of this cathedral.$b$bThat's YOUR job, after all.$b$bThe cathedral lies ahead of us, the last real bastion of Scarlet power remaining.  Within it, Crusader Lord Valdelmar sits atop Tyr's Hand's crumbling pulpit of lies.$b$bThere will be no escape; there will be no mercy.  The last simpering vestiges of the Scarlet Crusade end here.  Slay him.
english.completion: While I can't agree with their methods, I can't argue with their results.  In many ways, the Scarlet were well-intentioned, but their zeal grew too strong, and their hate blinded them to reason. I only hope that the same doesn't happen to our Brotherhood of Light.
english.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: How the mighty have fallen.

starters.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 焰须巡逻营
text.objectives: 前往暮光高地的焰须巡逻营，找到科甘·焰须。
text.description: 我原本打算去焰须巡逻营报到的，就在赶往那里的途中，我的坐骑被敌人击落了。$B$B暮光之锤对整个暮光高地发动了突袭。他们的建筑物竟然直接从村子中央的地下冒了出来。那真是一场噩梦！$B$B混乱过后，焰须成为少数几名幸存者之一。他正试图招募幸存者组织狮鹫之翼。$B$B如果你希望蛮锤矮人也加入联盟的阵营，就去西边帮助焰须吧。
text.completion: Come to join the patrol, lad? Glad to have ya. I need some bodies helpin' to get our defenses under control here. Help me out and I'll see if I can't find some more prestigious work for ya.
text.completed: 前往暮光高地的焰须巡逻营，找到科甘·焰须。

english.title: Firebeard's Patrol
english.objectives: Seek out Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: I was on my way to join Firebeard's Patrol when my bird was shot down.$B$BTwilight's Hammer launched surprise attacks all over the Highlands. Sometimes their buildings crawled right out of the earth in the middle of our villages. It was a nightmare!$B$BIn the chaos, Firebeard is one of the few who's kept his head on straight. He's trying to piece together a full gryphon wing from the survivors.$B$BIf you want to bring the Wildhammer into the Alliance, start by helping out Firebeard, to the west.
english.completion: Come to join the patrol, lad? Glad to have ya. I need some bodies helpin' to get our defenses under control here. Help me out and I'll see if I can't find some more prestigious work for ya.
english.completed: Seek out Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: Mo' Better Shredder
text.objectives: Locate a Salvageable Shredder on the Twilight Shores, and use it to summon a Bilgewater Salvage Expert. Defend the shredder until it is operational again.
text.description: $N, I've got plans for a better shredder. But my engineers can't wade into a combat zone alone.$B$BGo locate a salvageable shredder in the Twilight Shores, and use it to signal one of my salvage experts to join you. Defend the shredder while we make some "upgrades."$B$BThe Alliance won't know what hit them! At least, not until my marketing campaign kicks in!
text.completion: That's right baby! That's right! Cold steel and hot death! What should we name our new creation? The Gnugatron? No - better - the $n-o-matic. That's got a ring to it.
text.completed: Return to Juice Gnugat at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Mo' Better Shredder
english.objectives: Locate a Salvageable Shredder on the Twilight Shores, and use it to summon a Bilgewater Salvage Expert. Defend the shredder until it is operational again.
english.description: $N, I've got plans for a better shredder. But my engineers can't wade into a combat zone alone.$B$BGo locate a salvageable shredder in the Twilight Shores, and use it to signal one of my salvage experts to join you. Defend the shredder while we make some "upgrades."$B$BThe Alliance won't know what hit them! At least, not until my marketing campaign kicks in!
english.completion: That's right baby! That's right! Cold steel and hot death! What should we name our new creation? The Gnugatron? No - better - the $n-o-matic. That's got a ring to it.
english.completed: Return to Juice Gnugat at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 巨人守护者
text.objectives: 从巨人守护者身上获得寒月之石和烈日之石。
text.description: 装着节杖的箱子似乎是被魔法封住，纹丝不动。$B$B牌匾上描绘着两个巨人雕像，身体中央分别是太阳和月亮形状石头的嵌槽。$B$B画上两个雕像所守护的金字塔看起来正是外面那座。$B$B也许这些都值得你调查一番。
text.progress: You wipe away the sand from the hieroglyphs only for them to become covered in a new layer.  You'd best hurry.
text.completion: You place the two gems inside the sockets in the wall.
text.completed: Return to the Sand-Covered Hieroglyphs at Orsis in Uldum.

english.title: Colossal Guardians
english.objectives: Obtain the Stone of the Moon and the Stone of the Sun from the Colossal Guardians.
english.description: The chest containing the scepter appears to be magically sealed and will not budge.$B$BThe plaque above it depicts two giant statues holding star and moon-shaped stones sockets at their center.$B$BThe two statues are pictured guarding pyramids that look like the ones outside.$B$BPerhaps it's worth your while to investigate these.
english.progress: You wipe away the sand from the hieroglyphs only for them to become covered in a new layer.  You'd best hurry.
english.completion: You place the two gems inside the sockets in the wall.
english.completed: Return to the Sand-Covered Hieroglyphs at Orsis in Uldum.

text.title: 坍塌之后
text.objectives: 拿到晨星宝珠、晚星宝珠、北极星宝珠和落星宝珠。
text.description: 啊啊，那没什么，真的。$B$B那些雕像本来就摇摇欲坠——就差推一把了。$B$B你去那些碎石堆里清理清理怎样？$B$B我有预感，一切就要水落石出了。
text.progress: Find anything interesting, $n?
text.completion: Fine work, $n. It looks as though our work here is nearly complete.
text.completed: 与群星之厅的哈里森·琼斯谈谈。

english.title: After the Fall
english.objectives: Collect the Orb of the Morning Star, the Orb of the Evening Star, Orb of the North Star and the Orb of the Shooting Star.
english.description: Aww, that was nothin', really.$b$bThose statues were teetering as it was - just needed a little push is all.$b$bHow about you go and sort through that rubble?$b$bI've got a feeling we're close to getting this all sorted out.
english.progress: Find anything interesting, $n?
english.completion: Fine work, $n. It looks as though our work here is nearly complete.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 保卫奎尔丹尼
text.objectives: 在奎尔丹尼小屋杀死16名死亡猎手入侵者。
text.description: 亡灵来了！被遗忘者！他们越来越近，打算对我们发动全面进攻……那些可怕的憎恶！$B$B我麾下年轻的德莱尼人同高原精灵一起接受过战斗训练。他们并非毫无还手之力，但他们需要帮助！$B$B拜托你，$N，援助他们！把被遗忘者赶回去！
text.completion: Such aberrations in the face of the light... You are brave to face them, $n.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: In Defense of Quel'Danil
english.objectives: Slay 16 Deathstalker Invaders at Quel'Danil Lodge.
english.description: The undead are here! The Forsaken! They've been moving closer and closer, but to launch an all-out attack on us... those horrid abominations!$B$BThe young draenei I was charged with have trained with the Highvale elves in combat. They are not defenseless, but they need help!$B$BPlease, $n, assist them! Drive back the Forsaken!
english.completion: Such aberrations in the face of the light... You are brave to face them, $n.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 高原精灵文档
text.objectives: 收集高原精灵报告、高原精灵记录，以及高原精灵笔记。
text.description: 高原精灵在这里保存了多年的详细记录。死亡、出生、季节……但也有重要的侦查情报，以及同联盟其他部分的联络方法。$B$B这些文档在混乱中散落了。如果它们落在被遗忘者的手里，就会有更多的人有生命危险！拜托你，你必须赶在部落前面把这些文档拿回来……
text.progress: Are they safe?
text.completion: Thank the Light. We will not let the Forsaken have anything that can be turned against us, no matter how small.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at the Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: The Highvale Documents
english.objectives: Collect the Highvale Report, the Highvale Records, and the Highvale Notes.
english.description: The Highvale have kept detailed records here for years. Deaths, births, seasons... but also vital scouting information and methods of contact with the rest of the Alliance.$B$BThe documents will be scattered in the chaos. If they fall into the hands of the Forsaken, more lives could be at risk! Please, you must retrieve the documents before they are taken by the Horde...
english.progress: Are they safe?
english.completion: Thank the Light. We will not let the Forsaken have anything that can be turned against us, no matter how small.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at the Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: Just a Fancy Cockroach
text.objectives: Kill 5 Amethyst Scarabs, 5 Sapphire Scarabs, 5 Turquoise Scarabs, and 5 Emerald Scarabs.
text.description: Evidently, the ancient statues were home to various species of scarab.$b$bDetermined to leave this site in the best condition possible, you resolve to ridding the chamber of these pests.

english.title: Just a Fancy Cockroach
english.objectives: Kill 5 Amethyst Scarabs, 5 Sapphire Scarabs, 5 Turquoise Scarabs, and 5 Emerald Scarabs.
english.description: Evidently, the ancient statues were home to various species of scarab.$b$bDetermined to leave this site in the best condition possible, you resolve to ridding the chamber of these pests.

text.title: 向法奥瑞斯传达信息
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒的法奥瑞斯国王谈一谈。
text.description: 赶快，$N。我们必须同我的兄弟——也就是国王——谈一谈。$B$B他正逐渐倾向于避免同奥拉基尔和尼斐塞特开战。他愚蠢地以为这个问题还存在用外交手段解决的可能。$B$B也许等他听说这里所发生的事情之后，就会理智起来的。
text.completion: This is just the beginning, $n.  If Deathwing's minions can bury entire cities, we have little chance of defeating them through conventional means.

english.title: Send Word to Phaoris
english.objectives: Speak to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
english.description: Hurry, $N.  We must speak to my brother, the king.$B$BHe is bent on averting war with Al'Akir and the Neferset.  He has foolish hopes that there is a diplomatic solution to this problem.$B$BMaybe once he hears what occurred here he will see reason.
english.completion: This is just the beginning, $n.  If Deathwing's minions can bury entire cities, we have little chance of defeating them through conventional means.

text.title: 宰相的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆埃卡赫莱平原的宰相塔诺忒普谈一谈。
text.description: 让宰相塔诺忒普违背我兄弟的意志将会十分困难。他的立场恰恰就取决于法奥瑞斯的意愿。$B$B要想推动对尼斐塞特的战争，我得靠点运气才行。$B$B无论如何你都得和他谈谈。也许他会听取一个外来人的见解。$B$B宰相就在埃卡赫莱平原处理公务。
text.completion: What manner of creature are you?  You will leave the king's lands before... Wait!  You are that $n I've heard so much about. You must pardon my lack of hospitality.  We have seen all manner of hostile intruders since the barrier around Uldum failed.

english.title: The Vizier's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to Vizier Tanotep at the Akhenet Fields in Uldum.
english.description: Getting Vizier Tanotep to go against my brother's wishes is going to be extremely difficult.  His very position is based on enforcing the will of Phaoris.$B$BI've had little luck making the case for open war against Neferset.$B$BNevertheless you must speak to him.  Perhaps he will listen to an outsider's perspective.$B$BYou will find the Vizier at the Akhenet Fields on official business.
english.completion: What manner of creature are you?  You will leave the king's lands before... Wait!  You are that $n I've heard so much about. You must pardon my lack of hospitality.  We have seen all manner of hostile intruders since the barrier around Uldum failed.

text.title: 高阶祭司的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆维尔纳尔水坝内的高阶祭司阿门特谈一谈。
text.description: 只有高阶祭司阿门特的一票不在我们的控制之下。$B$B他会依照神谕的指示选择，不管我们做什么都无法动摇他。$B$B我认为那反而让我们的机会均等。$B$B我们面对的唯一问题是，自从奥丹姆周围的屏障坍塌以来，他的预见就不是那么准确了。$B$B在重获神谕之力前，他是不会进行投票的。$B$B从维尔纳尔水坝任意一侧的梯子上去，找他谈谈，看你能不能帮什么忙。
text.completion: War, you say. Divinations for war are always difficult.  Some wars must never be fought, even if victory was assured.  Some wars have to be waged even if defeat is certain.

english.title: The High Priest's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to High Priest Amet inside the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.
english.description: High Priest Amet's vote is the only one that is completely outside of our control.$B$BHe will vote as his divinations tell him and nothing we do will dissuade him.$B$BI figure that gives us even odds either way.$B$BThe only problem we face is that his clairvoyance has failed him ever since the barriers around Uldum fell.$B$BHe will not cast a vote unless he regains power over his divinations.$B$BTake the stairs at either side of the Vir'naal Dam and Speak to him to see what you can do to help.
english.completion: War, you say. Divinations for war are always difficult.  Some wars must never be fought, even if victory was assured.  Some wars have to be waged even if defeat is certain.

text.title: 高阶指挥官的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒军团前哨的高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯谈一谈。
text.description: 如果我们要通过战争表决，就必须让高阶议会全体一致投赞成票。$B$B我肯定高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯得知奥西斯所发生的一切后，会把他的一票给我们。$B$B请去拉穆卡恒和他谈谈，促成这件事。我必须做好计划失败的准备。
text.completion: No need to fill me in on the events in Orsis, $n. I've heard about them already.  And about you.  Any enemy of Al'Akir is a friend of mine.

english.title: The High Commander's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum.
english.description: If we're to pass a resolution for war, the high council's vote needs to be unanimous.$B$BI'm certain High Commander Kamses will give us his vote once he hears about what happened at Orsis.$B$BPlease speak to him in Ramkahen and make sure that's the case.  I must make preparations in case our plan fails.
english.completion: No need to fill me in on the events in Orsis, $n. I've heard about them already.  And about you.  Any enemy of Al'Akir is a friend of mine.

text.title: 塔诺忒普的儿子
text.objectives: 从尼斐塞特守卫身上获得维尔纳尔三角洲地图。
text.description: 我毕生服侍于国王，万事不为所动……只有一个例外：我的儿子。$B$B塔赫特被尼斐塞特哨兵抓走了。$B$B他们声称是因为我的儿子擅闯了他们的领地。法奥瑞斯正试图和他们谈判，放他出来……但我担心会出现最坏的情况。$B$B如果你能找到塔赫特，我就保证我的一票属于你。$B$B我不知道他们把囚犯都关在哪儿了，但我曾看见那些守卫是靠地图来确认他们穿越茂密植被的路线的。
text.progress: This might be the map you're after.
text.completion: You've obtained a map of the Vir'Naal river delta.
text.giverWindow: Neferset guards may carry maps pointing to Tahet's location.

english.title: Tanotep's Son
english.objectives: Obtain the Vir'Naal Delta Map from a Neferset Guard.
english.description: I have devoted my life to serving the King.  That service is unrivaled in importance by anything... with one exception: my son.$B$BTahet was captured by Neferset sentries.$B$BThey claim my son was trespassing upon their territory.  Phaoris is attempting to negotiate his release... but I fear for the worst.$B$BIf you were to find Tahet, I would pledge my vote to you.$B$BI do not know where they take the prisoners, but I've seen the guards consult maps to guide them through the thick vegetation.
english.progress: This might be the map you're after.
english.completion: You've obtained a map of the Vir'Naal river delta.
english.giverWindow: Neferset guards may carry maps pointing to Tahet's location.

text.title: 血神哈卡
text.objectives: 杀死哈卡的化身。
text.description: 哈卡……仅仅是提起这个夺灵者的名字，许多人就会四散奔逃。在堕神圣地，阿塔莱获得了他的大部分骸骨，准备让他死而复生。他的子嗣已经开始在该地区纷纷出现。$B$B将这枚蛋放在圣地里。它会强行提前召唤哈卡。不要犹豫，$N，他的化身一旦出现就立即发起攻击！
text.completion: You have successfully stopped Hakkar here, but I fear we are far from done. The Atal'ai transported most of the blood they produced to Zul'Gurub, where the Hakkari work to summon The Blood God there. $n, I do not think that this was ever meant to be the place of Hakkar's arrival - it was merely a test to see if the blood was potent enough! Hakkar can only be summoned in Zul'Gurub...and I fear we may be too late to stop the Hakkari with the blood they now have in their possession.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

english.title: The Blood God Hakkar
english.objectives: Kill the Avatar of Hakkar.
english.description: Hakkar... The mere mention of The Soulflayer's name will send many running. In the Sanctum of the Fallen God the Atal'ai have recovered a significant portion of his skeleton and seek to restore him to life. Already his children have begun to show up in the area.$B$BPlace this egg in that sanctum, and it will force his summoning prematurely. $N, do not hesitate. Strike once his avatar appears!
english.completion: You have successfully stopped Hakkar here, but I fear we are far from done. The Atal'ai transported most of the blood they produced to Zul'Gurub, where the Hakkari work to summon The Blood God there. $n, I do not think that this was ever meant to be the place of Hakkar's arrival - it was merely a test to see if the blood was potent enough! Hakkar can only be summoned in Zul'Gurub...and I fear we may be too late to stop the Hakkari with the blood they now have in their possession.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

text.title: 神灵哈卡
text.objectives: 将装满的哈卡之卵交给塔纳利斯的叶基亚。
text.description: 现在是获取哈卡化身的精华的时候了。$B$B把哈卡之卵拿到悲伤沼泽的那座沉没的神庙中，在堕神圣地中使用卵的力量激怒死去的神灵。$B$B他将派出那些被称作“嗜血者”的奴仆对付你，杀掉它们，取出它们的哈卡莱血液，然后用这些血液熄灭包含哈卡灵魂能量的不灭火焰。当你熄灭所有的火焰时，哈卡的化身就可以进入我们的世界了。$B$B打败他，将他的精华封印在哈卡之卵中。
text.completed: Return to Yeh'kinya at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

english.title: The God Hakkar
english.objectives: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
english.description: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.$B$BTake the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth.  Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.$B$BHe will send his minions against you.  Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit.  When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.$B$BDefeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
english.completed: Return to Yeh'kinya at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

text.title: 净化处理
text.objectives: 登上净化者500型开始净化处理。
text.description: 你已经在诺莫瑞根待了不少时间了，$N，这么久以来，你还活着，也没有丧失理智，真是叫人惊讶！我们得把你弄出去。$B$B在你前往地面和其他侏儒团聚之前，你必须得完成净化处理。到下一个房间去，登上净化者500型。剩下来的就交给它吧！应该不会……很痛。$B$B你都完成之后，到技师布朗格那里去登记，他会给你弄套合适的装备。
text.completion: There, now you're fit to head off to the surface and start your new life. The High Tinker will be delighted to hear of your arrival.
text.completed: Speak to Technician Braggle.

english.title: Decontamination
english.objectives: Board the Sanitron 500 to begin the decontamination process.
english.description: You've been down here in Gnomeregan for a long time, $N, and it's amazing that you've survived and kept your wits so long! We need to get you out.$B$BBefore we can send you to the surface to join the rest of the gnomes, you have to go through the decontamination process. Just head into the next room and board the Sanitron 500. It will do the rest! It shouldn't even hurt... much.$B$BWhen you're all done, check in with Technician Braggle and he'll make sure you get some suitable gear.
english.completion: There, now you're fit to head off to the surface and start your new life. The High Tinker will be delighted to hear of your arrival.
english.completed: Speak to Technician Braggle.

text.title: 只有你和马迪亚斯
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
text.description: 军情七处的人都死了。你得赶快去找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。$B$B好消息是，小队指挥官告诉过你他大概会在哪里。
text.completion: Where are the rest of my people?

english.title: Just You and Mathias
english.objectives: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The SI:7 are all dead. Time to find Master Mathias Shaw.$B$BGood thing the squad commander told you where he would be.
english.completion: Where are the rest of my people?

text.title: 只有你和马迪亚斯
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
text.description: That's a blow to our efforts. Damn Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Master Shaw.

english.objectives: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: That's a blow to our efforts. Damn Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Master Shaw.

text.description: The Kor'kron are all dead. Time to find Garona Halforcen.$B$BGood thing the squad commander told you where she would be.

english.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Kor'kron are all dead. Time to find Garona Halforcen.$B$BGood thing the squad commander told you where she would be.
