text.description: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

english.title: Just You and Garona
english.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

text.title: 顿沃德幸存者
text.objectives: 在顿沃德废墟寻找顿沃德家族的幸存者。
text.description: 如我所知，你的使命是说服蛮锤氏族与联盟并肩作战。我不知道你是否清楚该怎么做。$B$B总之，说到打仗的话，你最好能赢得某个蛮锤家族的支持。往西南走，杀戮熔炉竞技场对面就是顿沃德家族的废址。他们的家园遭遇重创，但是这样的攻击并不足以击溃整个家族。问题是，你能不能找到他们。
text.completion: If it's Dunwalds you be lookin' for, it's Dunwalds you've found. A couple of'm anyway. I can't find me other brothers for the life of me.

english.title: Dunwalds Don't Die
english.objectives: Look for Dunwald family survivors in the Dunwald Ruins.
english.description: As I understand it, you're to be looking to bring the Wildhammer clans together with the Alliance for war. Not sure you know what you're gettin' into.$B$BAnyway, if it's battle you're preparin' for, there's definitely one family you want by your side. Head southwest, to the opposite side of the Crucible of Carnage, and there you'll find Clan Dunwald's ruins. They're rightly ravaged, but that's not likely to be stoppin' the Dunwalds. It's just a matter of findin' them.
english.completion: If it's Dunwalds you be lookin' for, it's Dunwalds you've found. A couple of'm anyway. I can't find me other brothers for the life of me.

text.title: 顺手之劳
text.objectives: 在顿沃德家族的领地内杀死20名暮光之锤的成员。
text.description: 嗨，$G小伙子:姑娘;。别听凯莉瞎说，你不用为我们的兄弟担心啦，他们能照顾自己的。我相信，他们很快就会设法回到这里。$B$B既然你打算寻找家族的幸存者，不如顺便帮我个忙……暮光之锤的教徒和他们的仆从依然在顿沃德家族的地盘上肆虐。如果你能警告一下这帮不受欢迎的客人，我会很感谢你的。
text.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about lad. My kinda $r.
text.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: While Meeting The Family
english.objectives: Kill 20 Twilight's Hammer in Dunwald territory.
english.description: Hey there, $glad:lass;. I'm sure Keely's got you worrying about our brothers, but they can take care of themselves. They'll find their way back here one way or another.$B$BMaybe you can do me a favor while you're out meeting the family... Dunwald territory is still infested with Twilight's Hammer and their servants. I'd appreciate it if you could remind them that they're not welcome.
english.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about lad. My kinda $r.
english.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 搜寻废墟
text.objectives: 找到12具顿沃德受害者的尸体。
text.description: 暮光之锤洗劫了我们的镇子，真是可恨至极。我和我的兄弟很可能是最后的防御力量。但是我得确认这一点。$B$B在你搜寻废墟的过程中，看看能不能找到族人的尸体。我想知道是否还有幸存者……以及是否有族人顺利逃生的迹象。
text.completion: That many dead, eh? Not seemin' likely that anyone outside of me brothers fought through it then. I guess I already expected as much. Thanks for takin' the time to look for me.
text.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Sifting Through The Wreckage
english.objectives: Search for the bodies of 12 Dunwald Victims.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer were damn thorough when they sacked our town.  Me and me brothers may well be the only ones that held'm back. I gotta be sure though.$B$BAs you're siftin' through the ruins, keep an eye out for the bodies of me kinsmen. I wanna know if dere were any survivors... or if it seems like some might have gotten away.
english.completion: That many dead, eh? Not seemin' likely that anyone outside of me brothers fought through it then. I guess I already expected as much. Thanks for takin' the time to look for me.
english.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 东尼利·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到东尼利·顿沃德。
text.description: 你是来找我们的，我也希望能找到我的兄弟。听上去我们有着同样的目的。$B$B东尼利是几兄弟中最年长的，他的体格健壮，头脑却不怎么灵活。他应该在顿沃德小屋的北部废墟。你能不能帮我找到他？如果他一切安好的话，我就放心了。
text.completion: Hi friend! I don't think I know you... I'm Donnelly Dunwald. What's your name? I don't think I know you... Do I know you?

english.title: Donnelly Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Donnelly Dunwald.
english.description: So you be lookin' to find us, and I be lookin' to find me brothers. It sounds to me like we got some common ground in there abouts.$B$BDonnelly's our eldest, and while his size shows it, his wits might not. He's usually up in the northern ruins - in the hovel. Do ya think you might go lookin' for him for me? It'd be a right comfort if I knew he were safe.
english.completion: Hi friend! I don't think I know you... I'm Donnelly Dunwald. What's your name? I don't think I know you... Do I know you?

text.title: 伊欧因·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到伊欧因·顿沃德。
text.description: 伊欧因是双胞胎之一。他非常喜欢喝酒。你应该去古井周围找他——那附近曾经建有麦酒的储存室。$B$B让伊欧因去拜访一下他的姐姐吧，她快担心死了。如果你能找到麦酒桶，那他肯定就在附近了。
text.completion: Of all the buildings in all the towns to collapse, why'd it have to be this one?!

english.title: Eoin Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Eoin Dunwald.
english.description: Eoin's one of the twins. He's got a penchant for the drink. You'll likely be findin' him over by the old well - the ale stores were in a building there.$B$BMind making him to pay his worrying sister a visit? Shouldn't take much convincin' if you can get to the ale first.
english.completion: Of all the buildings in all the towns to collapse, why'd it have to be this one?!

text.title: 凯登·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到凯登·顿沃德。
text.description: 凯登是另一名双胞胎。他也有一项嗜好，不过不是喝酒。我敢说，暮光之锤入侵以来，他过得不知道有多开心呢。但愿酣战能舒缓他好斗的天性吧。$B$B我觉得你可以去铁匠铺旁边的市场找他。他以前常在那里晃悠，如今市场到处都是暮光之锤的成员，说不定对他来说，那里更有家的感觉。$B$B找到凯登，最好能活着把他带回来。
text.completion: Well look at ya, all geared and fancy. Keely send you to keep an eye on old Cayden, eh? Won't be needin' it. I got these louts handled. Hahah! They chose the wrong dwarf to be ambushin' today! Ahahahahah!

english.title: Cayden Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Cayden Dunwald.
english.description: Cayden's the other twin. He's got a thirst too, but not for ale. I'm sure he's been havin' a grand time of it since the Twilight came to our doorstep. Gettin' some of that aggression out of his system mayhaps.$B$BI'm thinkin' the best place to go lookin for him is at market row, by the old smithy. He used ta hang out there anyway, but since that place is swarmin' with the most Twilight, he's probably got all the more reason to be callin' it home now.$B$BBring'm back for me. In one piece would be nice.
english.completion: Well look at ya, all geared and fancy. Keely send you to keep an eye on old Cayden, eh? Won't be needin' it. I got these louts handled. Hahah! They chose the wrong dwarf to be ambushin' today! Ahahahahah!

text.title: 寻找尖喙
text.objectives: 搜寻顿沃德小屋，帮助东尼利找到尖喙。
text.description: 我的狮鹫不见了。尖喙！你在哪儿？！$B$B愿意帮我找他吗？他就在顿沃德小屋。我肯定。$B$B尖喙？！你在哪儿呀？$B$B希望他没事才好。
text.completion: You found'm! You found Beak! I like you, new friend! I'm gonna go show Keely. Keely like Beak too.
text.completed: Return to Donnelly Dunwald at Dunwald Hovel in Twilight Highlands.
text.objective1: Search the cellar in southern Dunwald Hovel
text.objective2: Search the cellar in northwestern Dunwald Hovel
text.objective3: Search the buildings in eastern Dunwald Hovel

english.title: Finding Beak
english.objectives: Help Donnelly find Beak in Dunwald Hovel.
english.description: I lost me gryphon. Beak! Where are you Beak?!$B$BWanna help me find him? I know he's in da hovel. He hasta be.$B$BBeak?! Wheres are ya?$B$BI hope he's okay.
english.completion: You found'm! You found Beak! I like you, new friend! I'm gonna go show Keely. Keely like Beak too.
english.completed: Return to Donnelly Dunwald at Dunwald Hovel in Twilight Highlands.
english.objective1: Search the cellar in southern Dunwald Hovel
english.objective2: Search the cellar in northwestern Dunwald Hovel
english.objective3: Search the buildings in eastern Dunwald Hovel

text.title: 我只要喝的
text.objectives: 搜寻伊欧因·顿沃德提到的酒窖，找到酒桶。
text.description: 嗨，伙计。要么你帮我找点喝的来，要么你就走吧。$B$B进入那座旧仓库的地下室。我怀疑那个一本正经的老图书管理员其实私下在书本后偷喝美酒呢。他肯定在地下室里藏有酒桶！$B$B如果你有所发现的话，就赶紧回来找我！别拖拖拉拉的……这事儿非常紧急！
text.progress: You stink of sober! Find me some drink!
text.completion: Donnelly's belly! That's more like it. Good to not be dyin' of the thirst again. Here, have some. Good ol' Eoin's never so impolite as ta not share!
text.completed: Speak to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Anything But Water
english.objectives: Check the cellar Eoin Dunwald mentioned for a keg.
english.description: Look, buddy. Either you're here to help me find some drink, or you're in the way.$B$BWhy don't ya go down to the old storehouse and look downstairs. I had a mighty suspicion that ol' bookkeeper up in there was sneaking sips between pages. I bet he has a keg in his basement!$B$BIf ya find anything, come straight back to me! No dallyin'... this is urgent!
english.progress: You stink of sober! Find me some drink!
english.completion: Donnelly's belly! That's more like it. Good to not be dyin' of the thirst again. Here, have some. Good ol' Eoin's never so impolite as ta not share!
english.completed: Speak to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 再次开战
text.objectives: 跟凯登·顿沃德一起参与所谓的伏击行动。
text.description: 好吧，好吧。你也想参与行动？没问题。$B$B准备好了就告诉我一声。
text.progress: They keep comin an' I'll keep swinging!
text.completion: A thing of beauty, isn't it? An' they keep comin' back for more. Love it! I'll go find Keely and settle her nerves in a bit. Just one more go through the row.
text.completed: Return to Cayden Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
text.objective1: Accompany Cayden through Dunwald Market Row

english.title: Once More Into The Fire
english.objectives: Accompany Cayden Dunwald through the somewhat obvious ambush.
english.description: Fine, fine. You want a piece of the action? You can join in.$B$BLet me know when you're ready ta go.
english.progress: They keep comin an' I'll keep swinging!
english.completion: A thing of beauty, isn't it? An' they keep comin' back for more. Love it! I'll go find Keely and settle her nerves in a bit. Just one more go through the row.
english.completed: Return to Cayden Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
english.objective1: Accompany Cayden through Dunwald Market Row

text.title: 稳定的供给
text.objectives: 收集6桶蛮锤麦酒。
text.description: 嗨，伙计。你真是个友善体贴的好朋友呢，你愿不愿意帮我个忙啊？$B$B在顿沃德废墟……这些建筑物里一定有各种供给品。如果你找到麦酒，就带回来给我好吗？矮人总是嫌酒不够！$B$B我得回去找凯莉，所以你可能要费些功夫才能找到我，不过我不会亏待你的。
text.progress: Where's me booze?
text.completion: Woooooh! That's exactly what my belly needs! You get me all the nice things.
text.completed: Return to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: A Steady Supply
english.objectives: Collect 6 Barrels of Wildhammer Ale.
english.description: Hey bud. Seeing as how you're so friendly and great and all, think you might do a dwarf a favor?$B$BThese are Dunwald ruins... there's SURE to be more stock in some of these buildings. If you come upon more ale, bring it my way, will ya? A good dwarf can never have enough!$B$BI'm thinkin' I'll find my way back to Keely, so ya might have to hunt me down, but I'll try'n make it worth it to ya.
english.progress: Where's me booze?
english.completion: Woooooh! That's exactly what my belly needs! You get me all the nice things.
english.completed: Return to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 再次回家
text.objectives: 跟顿沃德据点的凯莉·顿沃德谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该去找凯莉。她迫切地想要知道新的消息。
text.completion: Thank you for bandin' my brothers back together. I know they're tough, but they're even tougher when they're side by side, and there's a lot of Twilight out there. You're good to put a gal's heart at ease.

english.title: Home Again
english.objectives: Speak to Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout.
english.description: Ya should find Keely. She'll be eager for word.
english.completion: Thank you for bandin' my brothers back together. I know they're tough, but they're even tougher when they're side by side, and there's a lot of Twilight out there. You're good to put a gal's heart at ease.

text.title: 像顿沃德那样战斗
text.objectives: 跟弗莱恩·顿沃德谈一谈，帮助顿沃德兄弟杀死达隆卡。
text.description: 他们已经出发了，准备找那只指挥顿沃德攻击战的双头怪报仇。我本来想叫他们等你一起的，但这帮家伙都是天生的急性子。$B$B他们朝废墟中央的城镇广场去了。赶紧去找他们吧，不然你就享受不到战斗的乐子了。
text.completion: Thanks for your help. You've got a warrior's spirit in ya - you coulda fooled me for a Wildhammer if it weren't for your... well.. you know. I know Firebeard sent you to unite us. My love for that dwarf runs shallow, but you know now we've got plenty of reasons to make enemies of Twilight. If you see him, tell him that when the battle starts, the Dunwald family will be there.
text.completed: Speak to Flynn Dunwald or Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: There are few things in the highlands as terrifying as the Dunwalds reunited.

english.title: Doing It Like a Dunwald
english.objectives: Speak to Flynn Dunwald and aid the Dunwald brothers in killing Darunga.
english.description: They already left to hunt down the ettin that lead the attack on Dunwald. I asked them to at least give ya a chance to catch up, but I'm not sure waitin's in their blood.$B$BThey made off towards the town square, in the center of the ruins. You should go join'm before ya miss out on all the fun.
english.completion: Thanks for your help. You've got a warrior's spirit in ya - you coulda fooled me for a Wildhammer if it weren't for your... well.. you know. I know Firebeard sent you to unite us. My love for that dwarf runs shallow, but you know now we've got plenty of reasons to make enemies of Twilight. If you see him, tell him that when the battle starts, the Dunwald family will be there.
english.completed: Speak to Flynn Dunwald or Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: There are few things in the highlands as terrifying as the Dunwalds reunited.

text.title: 黑暗刺客
text.objectives: 收集5枚黑暗刺客的坠饰。
text.description: 即便沦为猎物，那也是我藏身羊群理应承担的风险。$B$B<马蒂亚斯打量着你。>$B$B暮光之锤倒是有所长进，派出了黑暗刺客追杀我。他们还不错，可惜只是几具灌注了最优秀的杀手之魂的行尸走肉。$B$B你可以帮我个忙吗？除掉黑暗刺客，并带回他们的灵魂坠饰。
text.progress: How many pendants do you have?
text.completion: I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all of these. I'll probably fence them and donate the proceeds to the Stormwind orphanage. Now to find someone sick enough to buy such a thing. It'll probably be a goblin. Or, a gnome warlock.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dark Assassins
english.objectives: Collect 5 Dark Assassin Pendants.
english.description: Even I get hunted. I suppose that's what I get for hiding amongst the sheep.$B$B<Mathias studies you for a moment.>$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has taken it up a notch and sent their dark assassins after me. Nice bunch of guys. Dead now. They're made from the souls of the most skilled killers.$B$BWant to do me a favor? Hunt them down. Bring back their soul pendants.
english.progress: How many pendants do you have?
english.completion: I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all of these. I'll probably fence them and donate the proceeds to the Stormwind orphanage. Now to find someone sick enough to buy such a thing. It'll probably be a goblin. Or, a gnome warlock.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 黑暗刺客
text.objectives: 收集5枚黑暗刺客的坠饰。
text.description: $C，即便我沦为猎物，那也是藏身羊群的乐趣之一。$B$B<迦罗娜打量着你。>$B$B暮光之锤倒是有所长进，派出了黑暗刺客追杀我。他们还不错，可惜只是几具灌注了最优秀的杀手之魂的行尸走肉。$B$B你可以帮我个忙吗？除掉他们。$B$B黑暗刺客的脖子上挂着灵魂坠饰。将坠饰带回来给我。对他们而言，灵魂是可有可无的。
text.progress: How many pendants do you have?
text.completion: What do you think I should do with all of these? Maybe I'll melt them down and have the metal imbued into a new dagger that I can thrust into Cho'gall's chest. Think there's time for that?
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dark Assassins
english.objectives: Collect 5 Dark Assassin Pendants.
english.description: Even I get hunted, $c. But that's part of the fun of hiding amongst the sheep.$B$B<Garona studies you for a moment.>$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has taken it up a notch and sent their dark assassins after me. Nice for a group of dead guys. They're made from the souls of only the most skilled killers.$B$BDo me a favor? Hunt them down.$B$BThey wear their souls in pendants about their necks. Bring them back to me. Souls optional.
english.progress: How many pendants do you have?
english.completion: What do you think I should do with all of these? Maybe I'll melt them down and have the metal imbued into a new dagger that I can thrust into Cho'gall's chest. Think there's time for that?
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重挫暮光之锤
text.objectives: 杀死10名要塞老兵、堕落的元素师和（或）暮光守备官。
text.description: 缺乏行之有效的传统的消灭坏人的计划，任何突袭行动都不可能成功。$B$B你的目标有很多，像是要塞老兵、堕落的元素师还有暮光守备官。$B$B你想怎么除掉他们，随你便。
text.completion: None of us are too good to get our hands a little dirty. Or bloody, in this case.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Bring the Hammer Down
english.objectives: Slay 10 Citadel Veterans, Corrupted Elementalists, and/or Twilight Vindicators.
english.description: No foray into the field would be complete without a good old-fashioned take-the-bad-guys-out kind of mission.$B$BBetween the citadel veterans, the corrupted elementalists, and the twilight vindicators, I'm sure you'll have plenty of targets.$B$BHow you choose to kill them is up to you.
english.completion: None of us are too good to get our hands a little dirty. Or bloody, in this case.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重挫暮光之锤
text.objectives: 杀死10名要塞老兵、堕落的元素师和（或）暮光守备官。
text.description: 没有人比暮光之锤教徒更恶劣，他们连自己都憎恨！没有人能超越他们！这些白痴想要摧毁整个世界。$B$B就凭这一点，他们就该被彻底灭绝。$B$B你的目标有很多，像是要塞老兵、堕落的元素师还有暮光守备官。$B$B你想怎么除掉他们，随你便。
text.completion: Feels good to get a little blood on your hands, doesn't it? Especially when that blood belongs to such self-deluded fools.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Bring the Hammer Down
english.objectives: Slay 10 Citadel Veterans, Corrupted Elementalists, and/or Twilight Vindicators.
english.description: There's nothing worse than a self-hating Twilight's Hammer cultist. Nothing! These idiots actually want to bring about the end of the world.$B$BThat marks them for extinction in my book.$B$BBetween the citadel veterans, the corrupted elementalists, and the twilight vindicators, you should have no shortage of targets.$B$BI could care less how you choose to kill them.
english.completion: Feels good to get a little blood on your hands, doesn't it? Especially when that blood belongs to such self-deluded fools.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 铲除鳄患
text.objectives: 消灭8只盐齿鳄鱼。
text.description: 镇子东边的雄鹿沼泽里全是鳄鱼。全是，你听明白了吗？鳄鱼的每个部位我都能卖，只要你能想得到。$B$B鳄鱼皮、牙齿、尾巴、舌头、眼睛，随你说。我的意思是，它们不好卖了。因为鳄鱼太多了！我们显然是供大于求。$B$B那么，既然它们对我没用了，偶尔还会把我的客人吃掉，我就要你去杀掉那些混账。帮个忙吧，好不好？我要在这儿跟你们的人商量点事情。
text.completion: All taken care of? Good to hear. Takes a load off my mind. Now I can focus on proper business for the fine folk of Marshtide and Stonard, weary from the war... and all that junk.
text.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Croc-Out
english.objectives: Slay 8 Sawtooth Crocolisks.
english.description: The Stagalbog east of town is swarming with crocolisks. Swarming, you hear me? I've sold every bit of crocolisk you could imagine.$B$BCrocolisk hides, teeth, tails, tongues, eyes, you name it. My point is, they ain't sellin' anymore. There's too many crocs! We're over-supplied and under-demanded.$B$BSo since they're of no use to me, and they occasionally eat my guests, I need you to just kill the suckers. Do me the favor, eh? I'll be here negotiatin' things with your people.
english.completion: All taken care of? Good to hear. Takes a load off my mind. Now I can focus on proper business for the fine folk of Marshtide and Stonard, weary from the war... and all that junk.
english.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 来自唤地者的帮助
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的唤地者耶法谈一谈。
text.description: 古加尔的古器的调查行动进入了死胡同。暮光之锤强迫一批被俘的蛮锤铁匠为他们劳作，并在任务完成后将他们淹死在湖中。$B$B<马迪亚斯啐了一口。>$B$B我们需要帮助。你可以在源质矿洞的西南方找到大地之环的成员唤地者耶法。$B$B她和她的地精助手需要帮助，才能关闭附近的元素传送门。作为交换，我觉得她会帮我们解决问题的。
text.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than happy to lend you whatever assistance that I can.

english.title: Help from the Earthcaller
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: My investigation into Cho'gall's artifact has hit a dead end. The Twilight's Hammer enslaved a group of Wildhammer smiths and then drowned them in the lake when they were done with their services.$B$B<Mathias spits.>$B$BWe need help. There's an Earthen Ring woman, Earthcaller Yevaa, southwest at the Elementium mine.$B$BShe and her goblin initiate need help with the shutting down the elemental portals hereabouts. I'm thinking that in exchange, she can help us with our problem.
english.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than happy to lend you whatever assistance that I can.

text.title: 来自唤地者的帮助
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的唤地者耶法谈一谈。
text.description: 古加尔的古器的调查行动进入了死胡同。暮光之锤强迫一批被俘的蛮锤铁匠为他们劳作，并在任务完成后将他们淹死在湖中。$B$B<迦罗娜啐了一口。>$B$B虽然我很不情愿，但是我们需要帮助。你可以在西南方的源质矿洞找到大地之环的成员唤地者耶法和她的宠物地精。她是一名隶属于大地之环的女德莱尼。$B$B她和她的地精需要帮助，才能关闭附近的元素传送门。作为交换，她会帮我们解决问题的。
text.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than willing to help you in any way that I can.

english.title: Help from the Earthcaller
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: My investigation into Cho'gall's artifact has hit a dead end. The Twilight's Hammer enslaved a group of Wildhammer smiths and then drowned them in the lake when they were done with their services.$B$B<Garona spits.>$B$BI hate to say it, but we need help. There's an Earthen Ring woman, a draenei named Earthcaller Yevaa.  She and her pet goblin are southwest at the Elementium mine.$B$BThey need help with shutting down the elemental portals around here. In exchange, she can help us with our problem.
english.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than willing to help you in any way that I can.

text.title: 过载的传送门
text.objectives: 杀死衰弱的艾帕克萨尔、衰弱的阿瑟隆和衰弱的埃德曼图斯。
text.description: 我曾经是大地之环传送门的看守者。在我们赶去援助深岩之洲的时候，暮光之锤趁机侵入并腐蚀了这片区域。$B$B他们派出强大的升腾者看守我们的传送门。暮光之锤犯了一个严重的错误。$B$B我要你前往传送门，使用控制器令它们过载。这项操作将释放传送门的全部能量，令升腾者进入虚弱状态。接下来你就可以动手了。
text.completion: The last portal is deep within the mine here, but we'll deal with that in a bit.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Portal Overload
english.objectives: Slay Debilitated Apexar, Debilitated Aetheron, and Debilitated Edemantus.
english.description: I used to be the caretaker of the Earthen Ring's portals here. But while we were away helping to save Deepholm, the Twilight's Hammer moved in and corrupted the area.$B$BThey're using powerful ascendants to guard our portals. That's where they've made a critical error.$B$BI want you to go to the portals and use the controllers to overload them. This will unleash all of the portal's energy, debilitating the ascendant. Slay it.
english.completion: The last portal is deep within the mine here, but we'll deal with that in a bit.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 洛克之灵
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地瓦拉尔湖的瓦拉尔女伯爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我完全不了解古加尔在制造何种器物，但是我知道有谁可以帮上忙。$B$B瓦拉尔女伯爵是北面瓦拉尔湖的上古之魂。她不喜欢暮光之锤，因为他们污染了水源。$B$B向她请教你所寻找的智慧吧。
text.completion: I know why you are here, $n. Your reasons sing within your fluids. I know about the dead dwarf forgesmith polluting my lake. If you want to find out what his corpse remembers, you must earn it.

english.title: Spirit of the Loch
english.objectives: Speak with Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: I have no knowledge of any artifact that Cho'gall is crafting, but I think I know one that can help.$B$BCountess Verrall is the ancient spirit of Loch Verrall to the north. She has no love for the Twilight's Hammer, who have polluted her waters.$B$BSeek her for the wisdom that you seek.
english.completion: I know why you are here, $n. Your reasons sing within your fluids. I know about the dead dwarf forgesmith polluting my lake. If you want to find out what his corpse remembers, you must earn it.

text.title: 加农领主的末日
text.objectives: 杀死加农领主。
text.description: 加农领主是我的死对头，他竟然蠢到与暮光之锤结盟并决定为其效忠。$B$B在过去的岁月里，我们勉强维持着互不侵犯的休战协议。如今他已然倒戈，这令我别无选择，只能干掉他。或者我应该说，如果你希望揭开矮人铁匠遇害事件的真相，你就该为我除掉加农领主。$B$B去东南边的加农的火海找到他。
text.completion: I am pleased. Lord Cannon was always an unworthy adversary. Very well, $r, I will help you gain the information which you seek.
text.completed: Return to Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Slay him to appease Countess Verrall.

english.title: Fire the Cannon
english.objectives: Slay Lord Cannon.
english.description: My arch-nemesis, Lord Cannon, has foolishly decided to throw his allegiance to the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIn the past, we've coexisted with a shaky truce, but his change of heart leaves me little choice but to put an end to him. Or, I should say, if you want the information that you seek from the dead dwarf, you're going to kill Lord Cannon for me.$B$BSeek him at Cannon's Inferno to the southeast.
english.completion: I am pleased. Lord Cannon was always an unworthy adversary. Very well, $r, I will help you gain the information which you seek.
english.completed: Return to Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Slay him to appease Countess Verrall.

text.title: 摆脱束缚
text.objectives: 在暮光堡垒杀死10个被奴役的元素生物，让它们获得自由。
text.description: 元素生物是我唯一了解的领域。我能准确地感受到它们的情绪。我要说，它们一点也不喜欢被奴役的感觉！$B$B我的意思是，如果你想要释放那些被奴役的元素生物，我相信它们不仅会对你感激不已，还会转而对抗它们的主子。$B$B$N，这简直就是双赢啊。
text.completion: What'd I tell you? Elementals aren't so bad after all, eh?
text.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Unbinding
english.objectives: Free 10 Enslaved elementals by slaying them at the Twilight Citadel.
english.description: Look, if there's one thing I know, it's elementals. I've been able to really gain an appreciation for how they feel. Let me tell you, they don't appreciate being enslaved one bit!$B$BSo, what I'm saying here is that if you were to free the enslaved elementals, I'm sure that not only would they show their gratitude, they'd also likely turn on their masters.$B$BSounds like a win-win to me, $N.
english.completion: What'd I tell you? Elementals aren't so bad after all, eh?
english.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 尝起来像是陆行鸟
text.objectives: 从沼泽陆行鸟身上获得9条巨大的沼泽陆行鸟之腿。
text.description: 你！没错，就是你！你想让我在贸易巨头面前替你美言几句吗？那就帮我个忙！$B$B我听说你就是那个把龙虾尾巴弄来的人。它们很棒，但作为沼泽食物还不大上台面。我需要在浓汤里放鸟腿！$B$B镇子外的忧伤湿地里有的是沼泽陆行鸟。把你能找到的最大的鸟腿给我弄来！
text.progress: Have you got those drumsticks?
text.completion: Ah, good, good! Just what I needed.
text.completed: Return to Pierre Fishflay at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Tastes Like Strider
english.objectives: Collect 9 Jumbo Swampstrider Drumsticks from Swampstriders.
english.description: You there! Yes, you! You want a good word put in with the Trade Baron? Give me a hand!$B$BI heard you're the one that got all those makrura tails. They're wonderful, but not enough for proper swamp food. I need drumsticks for my gumbo!$B$BThere's plenty of swampstriders just outside town in the Sorrowmurk. I want the biggest drumsticks you can find!
english.progress: Have you got those drumsticks?
english.completion: Ah, good, good! Just what I needed.
english.completed: Return to Pierre Fishflay at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 暗月火山套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把火山套牌交给他们。
text.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Ember cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a Volcanic deck!   Congratulations!
text.completion: So you have put together a deck of Embers.   Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.   Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

text.title: Pay Attention!
text.objectives: Nazgrim wants you to see what lies in the broken Alliance crate north of The Immortal Coil.
text.description: Listen, $r. It's not that I don't appreciate the rescue and all, but this is a dire situation.$b$bYou have to pay better attention out there!$b$bI was watching, and you passed right over a busted alliance crate.$b$bThere's bound to be something in there that could help me and my boys.$b$bHow about you get out there and take a look-see, hrm?
text.completion: Sure enough... This looks to be something that Nazgrim will take quite an interest in.

english.title: Pay Attention!
english.objectives: Nazgrim wants you to see what lies in the broken Alliance crate north of The Immortal Coil.
english.description: Listen, $r. It's not that I don't appreciate the rescue and all, but this is a dire situation.$b$bYou have to pay better attention out there!$b$bI was watching, and you passed right over a busted alliance crate.$b$bThere's bound to be something in there that could help me and my boys.$b$bHow about you get out there and take a look-see, hrm?
english.completion: Sure enough... This looks to be something that Nazgrim will take quite an interest in.

text.title: 有幸
text.objectives: 在群星之厅的装置旁使用繁星宝珠。
text.description: 看来剩下来的事情就是把宝珠放在这个装置每一个角落的基座上。$B$B<哈里森看了你一会儿，然后把宝珠递给你。>$B$B那么，去吧，$N。$B$B没有你，我们是无法有如此发现的。
text.completion: Well, now. Would ya look at that! As amazing as this is, I am confident that there's more to our discovery than meets the eye... Much more.
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

english.title: Do the Honors
english.objectives: Use the Orbs of the Stars near the mechanism in the Chamber of the Stars.
english.description: It looks like all that's left to do is to place the orbs on the pedestals at each corner of this mechanism.$b$bWe appear to have stumbled upon what may be the most important find in modern history.$b$b<Harrison looks at you for a moment, then hands you the orbs.>$b$bWell, go ahead, $n.$b$bWe'd have never made this discovery without you.
english.completion: Well, now. Would ya look at that! As amazing as this is, I am confident that there's more to our discovery than meets the eye... Much more.
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

text.title: 被压制
text.objectives: 杀死6名癫狂的麻疯侏儒。
text.description: 我的名字叫内温·扭钳，是生还者高效救助小队，又称S.A.F.E.的指挥官。$B$B我不知道你是怎么从下面的辐射中幸存下来的，$N，不过其他大多数人都没那么走运。我的队伍正在搜索幸存者，但被辐射的混乱麻疯侏儒人数太多，我们支撑不了多久。他们都疯了！$B$B如果你还有力气挥动武器，或是施放法术，能不能帮我清理掉一些麻疯侏儒？
text.completion: Well done, $n. My men can take it from here. Let's focus on getting the other survivors out now.
text.completed: Speak to Nevin Twistwrench inside Gnomeregan.

english.title: Pinned Down
english.objectives: Kill 6 Crazed Leper Gnomes.
english.description: My name is Nevin Twistwrench and I'm the commander of the Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition, or S.A.F.E.$B$BI don't know how you managed to survive the radiation down here, $N, but most of the others haven't fared so well. My team is rounding up the survivors, but the radiation-addled leper gnomes are too numerous for us to hold back much longer. They've lost their minds!$B$BIf you're still strong enough to wield a weapon or cast a spell, would you help us clear out some of these leper gnomes?
english.completion: Well done, $n. My men can take it from here. Let's focus on getting the other survivors out now.
english.completed: Speak to Nevin Twistwrench inside Gnomeregan.

text.title: 照料幸存者
text.objectives: 使用传送信标将6名幸存者传送至安全地区。
text.description: 如果我们不做些什么的话，内温和幸存者们都没法活着出去。我要把小队紧急传送信标给你。我们还有力气和弹药，能自己杀出去，但那些幸存者无法这样逃脱。$B$B对幸存者们使用信标，安排他们传送到我的人在外面设好的安全地带。你完成以后，回来向我报告，我们会做好安排，把你也弄出去。
text.completion: I know Nevin will be pleased with all the survivors you managed to help. I still can't believe you managed to stay so strong down here in the radiation. You've seen the shape the other survivors are in. Let's get you to the loading room for decontamination.
text.completed: Speak with Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.

english.title: See to the Survivors
english.objectives: Use the Teleport Beacon to teleport 6 Survivors to safety.
english.description: If we don't do something quick, neither Nevin nor the survivors will make it out of here alive. I'm going to give you my squad's emergency teleport beacon. We still have enough strength and ammunition to fight our way out of here, but those survivors are in no condition to make a run for it.$B$BUse the beacon on survivors to arrange for them to be teleported out of here to the safe area my men have set up. Once you've done that, report back to me and we'll make arrangements to get you out of here.
english.completion: I know Nevin will be pleased with all the survivors you managed to help. I still can't believe you managed to stay so strong down here in the radiation. You've seen the shape the other survivors are in. Let's get you to the loading room for decontamination.
english.completed: Speak with Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.

text.title: 卡兹穆尔大厅
text.objectives: 击败艾隆纳亚。
text.description: 在地图大厅中，有一道门通往传说中的卡兹穆尔大厅。没有人知道里面隐藏着怎样的秘密！$B$B我们只知道泰坦的守护者艾隆纳亚负责看守大厅，她的体型和力量都不可小觑。如果你想要揭开奥达曼的秘密，就必须击败她！
text.completion: Don't worry about the chamber, my boys will check it out! You have more important things to do!
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.

english.title: The Chamber of Khaz'mul
english.objectives: Defeat Ironaya.
english.description: In the Map Chamber there is a door which leads to the legendary Chamber of Khaz'mul. Who knows what secrets could be hidden inside!$B$BWhat we do know is that it is guarded by Ironaya, a Titanic Watcher of immense size and power. You'll need to defeat her if you intend to unlock the secrets of Uldaman!
english.completion: Don't worry about the chamber, my boys will check it out! You have more important things to do!
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.

text.title: 珍贵的能量核心
text.objectives: 取回黑曜石能量核心和泰坦能量核心。
text.description: 造物者创造了两名远古巨石卫士，命令他们在艾隆纳亚和阿扎达斯沉睡期间确保奥达曼不受入侵者的骚扰以及协助处理日常运作事务。其中一位卫士驻守在神殿大厅，而艾卡默克洞穴中另一名的卫士已经被某种生物腐化了。$B$B我担心是某个上古之神干的，你帮我查明事情的真相吧！击败两名巨石卫士，取回他们的能量核心。其中就有我们想知道的一切信息。
text.progress: Where are the cores, lad? By Muradin's Beard, where are the bloody cores? Sorry about that. Have you been able to obtain the cores?
text.completion: This is incredible, $n. The power coursing through each core...the contrasting powers so close together! I'll take this to the proper dwarves right away. These cores are extremely important!
text.completed: Return to Kand Sandseeker.

english.title: It's What's Inside That Counts
english.objectives: Obtain the Obsidian Power Core and the Titan Power Core.
english.description: The Makers built two Ancient Stone Keepers to help protect Uldaman from would-be invaders and to oversee daily operations while Ironaya and Archaedas slumber. One is still fully operational in Temple Hall, but the one in Echomok Cavern has been corrupted by something.$B$BI fear that one of the Old Gods is responsible for this, and you're going to help me see if that's the case! Topple both of the guardians and bring me their power cores. They'll tell us all we need to know.
english.progress: Where are the cores, lad? By Muradin's Beard, where are the bloody cores? Sorry about that. Have you been able to obtain the cores?
english.completion: This is incredible, $n. The power coursing through each core...the contrasting powers so close together! I'll take this to the proper dwarves right away. These cores are extremely important!
english.completed: Return to Kand Sandseeker.

text.title: 到地面去
text.objectives: 跟托尔本·光爆谈一谈，传送到地面，然后去找内温·扭钳。
text.description: 内温刚送消息过来说，他和他的人正要到地面上去。他会在S.A.F.E.建立的总部里等你。$B$B看见那儿的托尔本·光爆了吗？做好前往地面的准备后，就跟他谈谈，他会安排把你送上去。认识你很高兴，$N，能作为小小的一份子帮助你逃离诺莫瑞根，在地面开始新生活，我很荣幸。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to get so many survivors out of Gnomeregan this time. Everyone is going to be thrilled to meet you and hear your story.
text.completed: 跟托尔本·光爆谈一谈，传送到地面，然后去找内温·扭钳。

english.title: To the Surface
english.objectives: Speak to Torben Zapblast to get teleported to the surface and report to Nevin Twistwrench.
english.description: Nevin has just sent word that he and his men are making their way to the surface. He'll be waiting for you in the building that S.A.F.E. has established as its headquarters.$B$BSee Torben Zapblast over there? Talk to him when you're ready to head to the surface and he'll arrange to have you transported up there. It's been a pleasure meeting you, $N, and I'm honored to have played a small role in helping you escape from Gnomeregan to start your life on the surface.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to get so many survivors out of Gnomeregan this time. Everyone is going to be thrilled to meet you and hear your story.
english.completed: Speak to Torben Zapblast to get teleported to the surface and report to Nevin Twistwrench.

text.title: 偽造的文件
text.objectives: 在暴风城的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.description: 在暴风城的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.progress: 你有什麽要给我的吗?

english.title: Forged Documents
english.objectives: Find a resident of Stormwind City to accept your Forged Documents.
english.description: Find a resident in Stormwind City to accept your forged documents.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?

text.title: 被囚的公主
text.objectives: 杀死加加恩·火锤。
text.description: 加加恩·火锤和他的黑铁矮人部下驻守在三号挖掘场中一个石门前，而我们对那扇门背后的秘密却一无所知！这帮家伙老是干扰我们的作业，我受够了！探险者协会是唯一有权处置奥达曼遗物的组织！$B$B我要你进入挖掘场，干掉加加恩，好让我们安静地开展工作。我要知道那扇门背后到底有什么！
text.completion: Fantastic! Great work! We'll know all that Dig Three has to tell us in no time at all!
text.completed: Return to Olga Runesworn.

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: Kill Galgann Firehammer.
english.description: Galgann Firehammer and his band of Dark Irons are in Dig Three guarding a door that we know nothing about!  I've had it with their men getting in the way of our work here! The Explorers' League is the only group authorized to handle the artifacts throughout Uldaman!$B$BGo to the dig and dispose of him so that our work can continue undisturbed. I want to know what's behind that door!
english.completion: Fantastic! Great work! We'll know all that Dig Three has to tell us in no time at all!
english.completed: Return to Olga Runesworn.

text.title: 阿扎达斯，远古巨石卫士
text.objectives: 击败阿扎达斯。
text.description: 奥达曼之旅的真正目的是拿到诺甘农圆盘。其中记载的秘密可以改变我们对整个世界的认知。圆盘上记录了无数造物者的秘密……其价值远远超越你所能想象到的任何物质财富。$B$B唯一的问题是，造物者创造了一个古老而强大的造物，阿扎达斯来守护圆盘。不仅如此，他还统领着一支令人生畏的军队。我要你去击败他，为探险者协会拿到圆盘！
text.completion: Well done, lad! Now go to the discs and learn all you can!
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
text.giverWindow: It's all about the discs!

english.title: Archaedas, The Ancient Stone Watcher
english.objectives: Defeat Archaedas.
english.description: The true goal in Uldaman is to obtain the Discs of Norgannon. The secrets on these discs could change everything about how we view our world. Countless secrets of the Makers are inscribed on them...their value is beyond any material wealth you could possibly imagine.$B$BThe problem is that Archaedas, an ancient and powerful creation of the Makers, guards the discs with a venerable army at his disposal. I need you to defeat him and secure the discs for the Explorers' League!
english.completion: Well done, lad! Now go to the discs and learn all you can!
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
english.giverWindow: It's all about the discs!

text.title: 白金圆盘
text.objectives: 同石头守卫交谈，了解他守护着怎样的古代知识。然后将你的发现告诉首席勘探员杜尔林！
text.description: 财宝室的中间是四块巨大的白金圆盘，每块圆盘上都刻满了各种各样的未知文字和图案。你的手触摸这些圆盘的时候，你感到了一丝震动。就在你接触圆盘的一瞬间，一个巨大的石头守卫者的形象出现在了你的面前。$B$B“你好。我是知识的守卫者。土灵的创造者所留下的一切有关这个种族的知识都已经存储在了这张诺甘农圆盘上了。”$B$B你发掘到了迄今为止这个世界上最宝贵的知识财富！
text.end: 学习石头守护者所看守的知识

english.title: The Platinum Discs
english.objectives: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Then, tell Lead Prospector Durdin what you found out!
english.description: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin.  Touching them makes your hand tingle.  Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.$B$B"Salutations.  I am a keeper of knowledge.  The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."$B$BYou have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!
english.end: Learn what lore that the stone watcher has to offer

text.title: 卡兹穆尔大厅
text.objectives: 击败艾隆纳亚。
text.description: 我认为，在地图大厅中，有一道紧锁的大门通往传说中的卡兹穆尔大厅。我们还不知道里面藏着什么遗物。$B$B我们只知道泰坦的守护者艾隆纳亚负责看守大厅，她的体型和力量都不可小觑。如果你想要进一步探索这个地方，就必须击败她。
text.completion: Reliquary agents are en route to investigate the chamber. You have more important matters to attend to.
text.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher.

english.title: The Chamber of Khaz'mul
english.objectives: Defeat Ironaya.
english.description: In the Map Chamber there is a locked door which I believe leads to the legendary Chamber of Khaz'mul. We do not yet know what artifacts wait inside it.$B$B$B$BWhat we do know is that it is guarded by Ironaya, a Titanic Watcher of immense size and power. You'll need to defeat her if you intend to progress any further into this place.
english.completion: Reliquary agents are en route to investigate the chamber. You have more important matters to attend to.
english.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher.

text.title: 阿扎达斯，远古巨石卫士
text.objectives: 击败阿扎达斯。
text.description: 奥达曼之旅的真正目的是拿到诺甘农圆盘。其中的秘密可以改变我们观察世界的方法。圆盘上装载了造物者数不尽的秘密……其价值远远超越你所能想象的任何物质财富。$B$B唯一的问题是，阿扎达斯率领一支古老的军队守护着圆盘，他是造物者在远古时期创造的石卫士。我要你击败他，确保神圣遗物学会拿到圆盘！
text.completion: You are a most reliable agent, $n. Proceed to the discs and learn all you can. Report back to me immediately after.
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
text.giverWindow: The discs are the key.

english.title: Archaedas, The Ancient Stone Watcher
english.objectives: Defeat Archaedas.
english.description: The true goal in Uldaman is to obtain the Discs of Norgannon. These platinum discs could grant our order unbelievable power. Countless secrets of the Makers are inscribed on them...their value is beyond any material wealth you could possibly imagine.$B$BThe only problem in obtaining them is that Archaedas, an ancient and powerful creation of the Makers, guards the discs with a venerable army at his disposal. I need you to defeat him and secure the discs for The Reliquary.
english.completion: You are a most reliable agent, $n. Proceed to the discs and learn all you can. Report back to me immediately after.
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
english.giverWindow: The discs are the key.

text.title: 被囚的公主
text.objectives: 杀死加加恩·火锤。
text.description: 加加恩·火锤和他的黑铁矮人部下驻守在三号挖掘场中的石门处，而我们对那扇门背后的秘密一无所知！这帮家伙老是干扰我们的作业，我受够了！神圣遗物学会是唯一有权处置奥达曼古器的组织！$B$B进入挖掘场，杀死加加恩，帮助我们恢复正常作业。我想知道门后面有什么东西！
text.completion: Well done. Dig Three and any secrets beyond that door will soon be ours and ours alone.
text.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow.

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: Kill Galgann Firehammer.
english.description: Galgann Firehammer and his band of Dark Irons are in Dig Three guarding a door that we know nothing about!  I've had it with their men getting in the way of our work here! The Reliquary is the only group authorized to handle the artifacts throughout Uldaman!$B$BGo to the dig and dispose of him so that our work can continue undisturbed. I want to know what's behind that door!
english.completion: Well done. Dig Three and any secrets beyond that door will soon be ours and ours alone.
english.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow.

text.title: 我们需要更多的矿石
text.objectives: 取回黑曜石能量核心和泰坦能量核心。
text.description: 造物者创造了两名远古巨石卫士，命令他们在艾隆纳亚和阿扎达斯沉睡期间确保奥达曼不受入侵者的骚扰以及协助处理日常运作事务。其中一位卫士驻守在神殿大厅，而艾卡默克洞穴中另一名的卫士已经被某种生物腐化了。$B$B我担心是某个上古之神干的，你帮我查明事情的真相吧！击败两名巨石卫士，取回他们的能量核心。其中就有我们想知道的一切信息。
text.progress: Do you have the cores with you, or are you just here to chat? Perhaps we should stop this whole charade and enjoy some snacks and fine wine instead?
text.completion: Both of these cores are still far more potent than most of the cores we use  to power our own protectors, and these are ancient devices! Thank you, these will prove extremely valuable to our society.
text.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow.

english.title: We Require More Minerals
english.objectives: Obtain the Obsidian Power Core and the Titan Power Core.
english.description: The Titans built two Ancient Stone Keepers to help protect Uldaman from would-be invaders and to oversee daily operations while Ironaya and Archaedas slumber. One is still fully operational in Temple Hall, but the one in Echomok Cavern has been corrupted by something.$B$BI suspect that one of the Old Gods is responsible for this, and you're going to help me see if that is indeed true. Topple both of the guardians and bring me their power cores. They'll tell us all we need to know.
english.progress: Do you have the cores with you, or are you just here to chat? Perhaps we should stop this whole charade and enjoy some snacks and fine wine instead?
english.completion: Both of these cores are still far more potent than most of the cores we use  to power our own protectors, and these are ancient devices! Thank you, these will prove extremely valuable to our society.
english.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow.

text.title: 到林子里去
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河的一个女狼人。
text.description: 那天我看到一个最奇怪的队伍穿过镇子。一驾马拉的大车，装满了箱子，赶驾的是个女狼人，一个血精灵坐在她旁边，后面还跟着个矮人圣骑士，嘴里骂着我所听过的最有想象力的脏话。$B$B看起来他们是要朝东瘟疫之地去，不过我想他们现在应该刚过了索多里尔河不远。真不知道他们要去干嘛？
text.completion: 有事吗?

english.title: Into the Woods
english.objectives: Find a worgen woman at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I saw the strangest commotion coming through town the other day.  A horse-drawn cart, loaded with crates and chests, a worgen woman at the reins, a blood elf by her side, and a dwarven paladin running behind, yelling some of the most creative obscenities I've heard in quite some time.$b$bThey looked like they were headed to Eastern Plaguelands, though I'd imagine they can't be far past the Thondroril River by now.  I wonder what they were up to?
english.completion: Yes?

starters.name: 银色黎明军官普尔哈特

text.title: 访客
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河的一个女狼人。
text.description: 我听治愈者营地的消息来源说，不久就会有客人来拜访。他们是一群圣骑士——由一个狼人女商贩带领，真没想到——很快就将抵达这里。我期待着与他们见面，尤其是其中的某一个。$B$B你能不能路过的时候去瞧瞧他们？我说不好，不过等你到的时候，他们应该正好要跋涉过西边的索多里尔河。
text.completion: 有事吗?

english.title: Visitors
english.objectives: Find a worgen woman at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: My sources at the Menders' Stead have informed me that we will be having some visitors soon.  A group of paladins - led by a worgen tradeswoman, of all things - will be arriving here shortly.  I look forward to meeting them.  Particularly one of them.$b$bWould you mind stopping in and checking in on them?  I can't say for sure, but by the time you get there, they should just be crossing the Thondroril River, far to the west.
english.completion: Yes?

starters.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 未做完的好事
text.objectives: 跟柯尔普萨之森的埃达尔拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，$G小伙子:姑娘;。$B$B我是伦德尔。$B$B看来我和莫安纳来得正是时候。$B$B埃鲁纳克说这里的形势生死攸关，他还真不是开玩笑！$B$B嗯……于是我们放下手边的事务，急冲冲地从东边赶来支援。$B$B在别无选择的情况下，我们不得不放弃了那位濒临死亡的小姑娘，把她留在一个小小的通气孔边。$B$B你能不能赶去那里帮帮她？晚了就来不及了。
text.completion: Oh, finally... I don't know how much longer I can last!
text.giverWindow: Help!

english.title: Good Deed Left Undone
english.objectives: Speak to Adarrah in the Kelp'thar Forest.
english.description: G'day, $gladdie:lassie;.$b$bThe name's Rendel.$b$bSeems ol' Moanah and I got here in the nick of time, eh?$b$bErunak wasn't kiddin' when he said it was life or death!$b$bSo... in our rush ta git over here, we left a little unfinished business off to the east a ways.$b$bA little lady was near death herself. We had no choice but ta leave her by a little air vent when we came here to yer rescue.$b$bHow bout yeh git over and help her while there's still time?
english.completion: Oh, finally... I don't know how much longer I can last!
english.giverWindow: Help!

text.title: 偽造的文件
text.objectives: Find a resident of Orgimmar to accept your Forged Documents.
text.description: Find a resident in Orgimmar to accept your forged documents.
text.progress: 你有什麽要给我的吗?

english.title: Forged Documents
english.objectives: Find a resident of Orgimmar to accept your Forged Documents.
english.description: Find a resident in Orgimmar to accept your forged documents.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?

text.title: 铲除格纳什
text.objectives: 将格纳什的徽记交给走私者洞穴的萨米尔。
text.description: 你击败了可怕的海巨人，真了不起啊！$B$B这头怪兽再也不会在走私者洞穴附近游荡了，那里的新住民应该大可放宽心了吧。
text.progress: You took down that Sea Giant, $c?
text.completion: It's not much, but it's all I've got down here. You're more than welcome to it, $c.

english.title: An Opened Can of Whoop Gnash
english.objectives: Bring Gnash's Head to Samir in Smuggler's Hole.
english.description: What an accomplishment, felling a  mighty sea giant!$b$bThe new residents of Smuggler's Hole will feel considerably safer knowing this monster is no longer loitering outside their haven.
english.progress: You took down that Sea Giant, $c?
english.completion: It's not much, but it's all I've got down here. You're more than welcome to it, $c.

text.title: 分散敌人的注意
text.objectives: 杀死阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅
text.description: 我们必须铲除三名暮光升腾者的候选人：阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅。$B$B我希望你能分散他们的注意。时机成熟时，我会从背后发动突袭并解决他们。$B$B$N，无论如何，你都不能低估这些家伙。他们是冷酷无情的一流杀手，才会挤上候选者的位子。
text.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion of Twilight. We work well together, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Distract Them for Me
english.objectives: Slay Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.
english.description: There are three candidates for Ascendancy that we need to eliminate: Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.$B$BI'd like for you to serve as my distraction. When the time is right, I'll step in and finish them off from behind.$B$BWhatever you do, $N, do not underestimate them. Each got to where they are by being ruthless and very good at what they do.
english.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion of Twilight. We work well together, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 分散敌人的注意
text.objectives: 杀死阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅
text.description: There are three candidates for Ascendancy that need killing: Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.$B$BI want you to serve as a distraction. When the time is right, I'll step in to finish them off from behind.$B$BJust make sure that whatever you do, you don't underestimate them, $N. Each of those lunatics got to where they are by being ruthless and very good at what they do.
text.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion. Not bad work, $n. Not bad at all.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 驯龙者纳克拉尔
text.objectives: 向暮光高地溅血谷地的纳克拉尔·掠爪报到。
text.description: $N，溅血谷地的要塞是龙喉氏族在暮光高地的指挥中心，就在河流上游。纳克拉尔·掠爪利用他强大的能量，在溅血谷地中训练并组织龙骑士。$B$B龙喉兽人要取得最终的胜利，就看溅血谷地的成果了。去找纳克拉尔，确保一切进展顺利。
text.completion: Another mewling Horde whelp? Zaela saps our strength by diluting our forces with the weak. Very well, $c. Prove yourself to me, and show me what your Horde is made of.
text.completed: Report to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Narkrall, the Drake-Tamer
english.objectives: Report to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: $N, the stronghold at Bloodgulch is the heart of the Dragonmaw empire in the Highlands. It is just up the river. Narkrall Rakeclaw is using his considerable power to amass a wing of drake-riders there.$B$BFor the Dragonmaw to succeed, Bloodgulch must succeed. Go to Narkrall and make sure it is so.
english.completion: Another mewling Horde whelp? Zaela saps our strength by diluting our forces with the weak. Very well, $c. Prove yourself to me, and show me what your Horde is made of.
english.completed: Report to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 疯狂的沼鳍
text.objectives: 消灭12只沼鳍鱼人。
text.description: 恐怕热砂港的其他人都完蛋了。鱼人来的时候，东边营地里的年轻人都牺牲了。$B$B是的，这片海滩上总是有鱼人……但没有见过这么多的。他们从海里成群而来，嘶号着吐着沫，蜂拥而至展开攻击！$B$B我们不能让他们还在周围到处晃荡，是不是？你能不能帮老地精一个忙，把他们给揍回海里去呢？
text.completion: You have to wonder just what's out there. This is the coast of the Forbidding Sea, with nothing beyond its reaches... but all these fishy folk just stomped right out of it. What's more, I saw where they've been going...
text.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Marshfin Madness
english.objectives: Slay 12 Marshfin Murlocs.
english.description: I'm afraid the rest of the Steamwheedle here are gone. All the young ones at the camp to the east were lost when the murlocs came.$B$BYes, there's always been murlocs on these shores... but not in these numbers. They came in droves from the sea at night, howling and frothing, swarming up onto the land to attack!$B$BWe can't have them still running around, now can we? Would you put an old goblin at ease and go beat some of them back into the water?
english.completion: You have to wonder just what's out there. This is the coast of the Forbidding Sea, with nothing beyond its reaches... but all these fishy folk just stomped right out of it. What's more, I saw where they've been going...
english.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 瑟莱德丝公主
text.objectives: 杀死瑟莱德丝公主。
text.description: 别紧张，年轻的$R。我叫扎尔塔，塞纳留斯之子，我来是寻求你的援助。$B$B很久以前，我犯下了一个错误，同瑟莱德丝公主，一名强大的、具有上古之神血统的土元素公主结合。我们的子嗣，半人马可汗，出生后忤逆于我，将我无情地杀害了。现在，瑟莱德丝的污染加深，威胁到的不止是玛拉顿。$B$B来杀掉她，把我的灵魂解放出来，让我们把凄凉之地重新恢复成一个生命繁荣的允诺之地，一如塞纳留斯所愿。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. As you can see, my mere presence here has resulted in a bloom of glorious life despite my mate's presence. Names aside, perhaps one day you will again venture into Desolace and find it a verdant oasis free of any traces of the Old Gods.
text.giverWindow: You must stop her!

english.title: Princess Theradras
english.objectives: Kill Princess Theradras.
english.description: Do not be alarmed, young $r. I am Zaetar, son of Cenarius, and I come to you for your assistance.$B$BLong ago, I made the mistake of mating with Princess Theradras, a powerful earth elemental aligned with the Old Gods. Our children, the centuar Kahns, turned on me upon birth and slew me mercilessly. Now, Theradras' taint runs deep and threatens far more than just Maraudon.$B$BCome slay her and free my spirit so that we may restore Desolace to a place of verdant life and promise, as Cenarius would want.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. As you can see, my mere presence here has resulted in a bloom of glorious life despite my mate's presence. Names aside, perhaps one day you will again venture into Desolace and find it a verdant oasis free of any traces of the Old Gods.
english.giverWindow: You must stop her!

text.title: 戒卫的游戏
text.objectives: 将戒卫的棋卒传送到面向里边的位置，以完成戒卫的游戏。
text.description: 你看到这尊雕像分裂成了两座，然后是四座，然后是八座一模一样的雕像，以方阵排列。$B$B你听到了一个声音，不是从你的耳朵传进来的，而是直接传入你的心灵：$B$B   “真正的戒卫不会面向外界，寻求危机的迹象。$B  真正的戒卫总是检视自己，专注于保护他的内心。”$B$B也许这是一道谜题？
text.completion: The jade statue becomes one again, and you place it in your pocket.  You hear a shifting noise in the tomb's central chamber.

english.title: The Warden's Game
english.objectives: Complete the Warden's Game by teleporting the Warden's Pawns into inward-facing positions.
english.description: You see the statue split into two, then four, then eight identical statues in a square formation.$b$bYou hear a voice, not through your ears, but in the back of your mind:$b$b   "A true warden does not face OUTWARD, searching for signs of danger.$b  A true warden keeps his gaze INWARD, always focused on protecting his quarry."$b$bPerhaps this is a riddle of some sort?
english.completion: The jade statue becomes one again, and you place it in your pocket.  You hear a shifting noise in the tomb's central chamber.

text.title: 泪水之池
text.objectives: 从阿塔哈卡神庙周围的泪水之池里收集5件阿塔莱神器。
text.description: The trolls that lurk within this temple have done grievious harm to my kind, $n. We were sent here to guard this place, and were instead used to unleash the terrible powers within.$B$BI must beg you for the help only a mortal can give. You can be my hand within the temple; should I enter by myself, I risk being turned against my brothers as well.$B$BWe shall make a pact. If you wish to help, first gather Atal'ai artifacts from the waters around the temple, and return them to me.
text.progress: Your gathering of these artifacts will be a sign of faith. Once rendered, I will perform the ritual.
text.completion: The essence of the green dragonflight wafts from these artifacts; the vestiges of my corrupted kin. In purifying them, I form a bond between us. Step forward, $n, and receive the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius atop the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.objectives: Collect 5 Atal'ai Artifacts from the Pool of Tears surrounding the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

text.title: 源质之斧
text.objectives: 取回源质之斧。
text.description: 暮光之锤俘虏并屠杀了很多红龙，但是尚有一只幸存。你还记得莉拉斯塔萨吗？她被囚禁在附近，我们要帮她重获自由。$B$B首先，我们需要一件锋利的器物砍断她的镣铐。$B$B双头怪守护者盲眼负责看守南面的升腾祭坛。$B$B他有一柄精心打造的源质之斧。说不定这就是古加尔的“终极”武器？
text.progress: Do you have the axe? They're going to kill Lirastrasza soon.
text.completion: That thing looks sharp. Sharp enough to the do deed, at least. But if I'm a judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: He has the Elementium Axe!

english.title: The Elementium Axe
english.objectives: Obtain the Elementium Axe.
english.description: The Twilight cowards have captured and killed too many red dragons, but one yet lives. Do you remember Lirastrasza? She's shackled nearby and we're going to free her.$B$BBut first, we need something sharp enough to cut through her chains.$B$BThere's an old ettin named Blindeye the Guardian. He stands watch at the Altar of Ascension to the south.$B$BHe has a purely-wrought Elementium axe. I wonder if that's Cho'gall's "ultimate" weapon?
english.progress: Do you have the axe? They're going to kill Lirastrasza soon.
english.completion: That thing looks sharp. Sharp enough to the do deed, at least. But if I'm a judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He has the Elementium Axe!

She's chained nearby and we're going to free her.$B$BBut first, we need something sharp enough to cut her free.$B$BThere's an old ettin named Blindeye the Guardian. He stands watch at the Altar of Ascension to the south.$B$BHe has a purely-wrought Elementium axe. I wonder if that's Cho'gall's "ultimate" weapon?
text.progress: Do you have the axe?
text.completion: That's a very sharp axe. It'll do the job, but if I'm any judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
